devanagari: तृतीय श्लोकेर अर्थ कैल विवरण ।
चतुर्थ श्लोकेर अर्थ शुन भक्त - गण ॥3॥
cc-adi-3.3.translation: I have given the purport of the third verse. Now, O devotees, please listen to the meaning of the fourth with full attention.

devanagari: चैतन्य - सिंहेर नवद्वीपे अवतार ।
सिंह - ग्रीव, सिंह - वीर्य, सिंहेर हुङ्कार ॥30॥
cc-adi-3.30.translation: Thus the lionlike Lord Caitanya has appeared in Navadvīpa. He has the shoulders of a lion, the powers of a lion, and the loud voice of a lion.

devanagari: सेइ सिंह वसुक्जीवेर हृदय - कन्दरे ।
कल्मष - द्विरद नाशे याँहार हुङ्कारे ॥31॥
cc-adi-3.31.translation: May that lion be seated in the core of the heart of every living being. Thus with His resounding roar may He drive away one's elephantine vices.

devanagari: प्रथम लीलाय ताँर ‘विश्वम्भ र’ नाम ।
भक्ति - रसे भरिल, धरिल भूत - ग्राम ॥32॥
cc-adi-3.32.translation: In His early pastimes He is known as Viśvambhara because He floods the world with the nectar of devotion and thus saves the living beings.

devanagari: डुभृधातुर अर्थ - पोषण, धारण ।
पुषिल, धरिल प्रेम दिया त्रिभुवन ॥33॥
cc-adi-3.33.translation: The verbal root "ḍubhṛñ" [which is the root of the word "viśvambhara"] indicates nourishing and maintaining. He [Lord Caitanya] nourishes and maintains the three worlds by distributing love of God.

lines: śrī-kṛṣṇa jānāye saba viśva kaila dhanya
devanagari: शेष - लीलाय धरे नाम ‘श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य’ ।
श्रीकृष्ण जानाये सब विश्व कैल धन्य ॥34॥
cc-adi-3.34.translation: In His later pastimes He is known as Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya. He blesses the whole world by teaching about the name and fame of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ताँर झुगावतार जानि’ गर्ग महाशय ।
कृष्णेर नाम - करणे करियाछे निर्णय ॥35॥
cc-adi-3.35.translation: Knowing Him [Lord Caitanya] to be the incarnation for the Kali-yuga, Gargamuni, during the naming ceremony of Kṛṣṇa, predicted His appearance.

devanagari: आसन्वर्णास्त्रयो ह्यस्य गृह्णतोऽनु - युगं तनूः ।
शुक्लो रक्तस्तथा पीत इदानीं कृष्णतां गतः ॥36॥
cc-adi-3.36.translation: "This boy [Kṛṣṇa] has three other colors-white, red and yellow-as He appears in different ages. Now He has appeared in a transcendental blackish color."

devanagari: शुक्ल, रक्त, पीत - वर्ण - एइ तिन द्युति ।
सत्य - त्रेता - कलि - काले धरेन श्री - पति ॥37॥
cc-adi-3.37.translation: White, red and yellow—these are the three bodily lusters that the Lord, the husband of the goddess of fortune, assumes in the ages of Satya, Tretā and Kali respectively.

devanagari: इदानीं द्वापरे तिंहो हैला कृष्ण - वर्ण ।
एइ सब शास्त्रागम - पुराणेर मर्म ॥38॥
cc-adi-3.38.translation: Now, in the Dvāpara-yuga, the Lord had descended in a blackish hue. This is the essence of the statements in the Purāṇas and other Vedic literatures with reference to the context.

devanagari: द्वापरे भगवान्श्यामः पीत - वासा निजायुधः ।
श्री - वत्सादिभिर ङ्कैश्च लक्षणैरुपलक्षितः ॥39॥
cc-adi-3.39.translation: "In the Dvāpara-yuga the Personality of Godhead appears in a blackish hue. He is dressed in yellow, He holds His own weapons, and He is decorated with the Kaustubha jewel and marks of Śrīvatsa. This is how His symptoms are described."

devanagari: अनर्पित - चरी चिरात्करुणयावतीर्णः कलौ समर्पयितुमुन्नतोज्वल - रसां स्व - भक्ति - श्रियम् ।
हरिः पुरट - सुन्दर - द्युति - कदम्ब - सन्दीपितः सदा हृदय - कन्दरे स्फुरतु वः शची - नन्दनः ॥4॥
cc-adi-3.4.translation: "May that Lord who is known as the son of Śrīmatī Śacīdevī be transcendentally situated in the innermost core of your heart. Resplendent with the radiance of molten gold, He has descended in the Age of Kali by His causeless mercy to bestow what no incarnation has ever offered before: the most elevated mellow of devotional service, the mellow of conjugal love."

devanagari: कलि - युगे युग - धर्म - नामेर प्रचार ।
तथि ला गि’ पीत - वर्ण चैतन्यावतार ॥40॥
cc-adi-3.40.translation: The religious practice for the Age of Kali is to broadcast the glories of the holy name. Only for this purpose has the Lord, in a yellow color, descended as Lord Caitanya.

devanagari: तप्त - हेम - सम - कान्ति, प्रकाण्ड शरीर ।
नव - मेघ जिनि कण्ठ - ध्वनि ये गम्भीर ॥41॥
cc-adi-3.41.translation: The luster of His expansive body resembles molten gold. The deep sound of His voice conquers the thundering of newly assembled clouds.

devanagari: दैर्घ्य - विस्तारे येइ आपनार हात ।
चारि हस्त हय ‘महा - पुरुष’ विख्यात ॥42॥
cc-adi-3.42.translation: One who measures four cubits in height and in breadth by his own hand is celebrated as a great personality.

devanagari: ‘न्यग्रोध - परिमण्डल’ हय ताँर नाम ।
न्यग्रोध - परिमण्डल - तनु चैतन्य गुण - धाम ॥43॥
cc-adi-3.43.translation: Such a person is called nyagrodha-parimaṇḍala. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who personifies all good qualities, has the body of a nyagrodha-parimaṇḍala.

devanagari: आजानुलम्बित - भुज कमल - लोचन ।
तिलफुल - जिनि - नासा, सुधांशु - वदन ॥44॥
cc-adi-3.44.translation: His arms are long enough to reach His knees, His eyes are just like lotus flowers, His nose is like a sesame flower, and His face is as beautiful as the moon.

devanagari: शान्त, दान्त, कृष्ण - भक्ति - निष्ठा - परायण ।
भक्त - वत्सल, सुशील, सर्व - भूते सम ॥45॥
cc-adi-3.45.translation: He is peaceful, self-controlled and fully devoted to the transcendental service of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa. He is affectionate toward His devotees, He is gentle, and He is equally disposed toward all living beings.

devanagari: चन्दनेर अङ्गद - बाला, चन्दन - भूषण ।
नृत्य - काले प रि’ करेन कृष्ण - सङ्कीर्तन ॥46॥
cc-adi-3.46.translation: He is decorated with sandalwood bangles and armlets and anointed with the pulp of sandalwood. He especially wears these decorations to dance in śrī-kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtana.

lines: ei saba guṇa lañā muni vaiśampāyana
devanagari: एइ सब गुण लञा मुनि वैशम्पायन ।
सहस्त्रनामे कैल तर नाम - गणन ॥47॥
cc-adi-3.47.translation: Recording all these qualities of Lord Caitanya, the sage Vaiśampāyana included His name in the Viṣṇu-sahasra-nāma.

lines: dui līlāya cāri cāri nāma viśeṣa
devanagari: दुइ लीला चैतन्येर - आदि आर शेष ।
दुइ लीलाय चारि चारि नाम विशेष ॥48॥
cc-adi-3.48.translation: The pastimes of Lord Caitanya have two divisions—the early pastimes [ādi-līlā] and later pastimes [śeṣa-līlā]. He has four names in each of these two līlās.

devanagari: सुवर्ण - वर्णो हेमाङ्गो वराङ्गश्चन्दनाङ्गदी ।
सन्यास - कृच्छमः शान्तो निष्ठा - शान्ति - परायणः ॥49॥
cc-adi-3.49.translation: "In His early pastimes He appears as a householder with a golden complexion. His limbs are beautiful, and His body, smeared with the pulp of sandalwood, seems like molten gold. In His later pastimes He accepts the sannyāsa order, and He is equipoised and peaceful. He is the highest abode of peace and devotion, for He silences the impersonalist nondevotees."

devanagari: पूर्ण भगवान्कृष्ण व्रजेन्द्र कुमार ।
गोलोके व्रजेर सह नित्य विहार ॥5॥
cc-adi-3.5.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa, the son of the King of Vraja, is the Supreme Lord. He eternally enjoys transcendental pastimes in His eternal abode, Goloka, which includes Vrajadhāma.

lines: vyakta kari' bhāgavate kahe bāra bāra
devanagari: व्यक्त क रि’ भागवते कहे बार बार ।
कलि - युगे धर्म - नाम - सङ्कीर्तन सार ॥50॥
cc-adi-3.50.translation: In Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam it is repeatedly and clearly said that the essence of religion in the Age of Kali is the chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: इति द्वापर उर्वीश स्तुवन्ति जगदीश्वरम् ।
नाना - तन्त्र - विधानेन कलावपि यथा शृणु ॥51॥
cc-adi-3.51.translation: "O King, in this way people in Dvāpara-yuga worshiped the Lord of the universe. In Kali-yuga they also worship the Supreme Personality of Godhead by the regulations of the revealed scriptures. Kindly now hear of that from me.

devanagari: कृष्ण - वर्णं त्विषाकृष्णं साङ्गोपाङ्गास्त्र - पार्षदम् ।
यज्ञैः सङ्कीर्तन - प्रायैर्यजन्ति हि सु - मेधसः ॥52॥
cc-adi-3.52.translation: "In the Age of Kali, intelligent persons perform congregational chanting to worship the incarnation of Godhead who constantly sings the name of Kṛṣṇa. Although His complexion is not blackish, He is Kṛṣṇa Himself. He is accompanied by His associates, servants, weapons and confidential companions."

lines: ei śloke kahe tāṅra mahimāra sīmā
devanagari: शुन, भाइ, एइ सब चैतन्य - महिमा ।
एइ श्लोके कहे ताँर महिमार सीमा ॥53॥
cc-adi-3.53.translation: My dear brothers, please hear all these glories of Lord Caitanya. This verse clearly summarizes His activities and characteristics.

lines: 'kṛṣṇa' ei dui varṇa sadā yāṅra mukhe
athavā, kṛṣṇake tiṅho varṇe nija sukhe
devanagari: ‘कृष्ण’ एइ दुइ वर्ण सदा याँर मुखे ।
अथवा, कृष्णके तिंहो वर्णे निज सुखे ॥54॥
cc-adi-3.54.translation: The two syllables "kṛṣ-ṇa" are always in His mouth; or, He constantly describes Kṛṣṇa with great pleasure.

lines: kṛṣṇa vinu tāṅra mukhe nāhi āise āna
devanagari: कृष्ण - वर्ण - शब्देर अर्थ दुइ त प्रमाण ।
कृष्ण विनु ताँर मुखे नाहि आइसे आन ॥55॥
cc-adi-3.55.translation: These are two meanings of the word "kṛṣṇa-varṇa." Indeed, nothing else but Kṛṣṇa issues from His mouth.

devanagari: केह ताँरे बले यदि कृष्ण - वरण ।
आर विशेषणे तार करे निवारण ॥56॥
cc-adi-3.56.translation: If someone tries to describe Him as being of blackish complexion, the next adjective [tviṣā akṛṣṇam] immediately restricts him.

devanagari: देह - कान्त्ये हय तेंहो अकृष्ण - वरण ।
अकृष्ण - वरणे कहे पीत - वरण ॥57॥
cc-adi-3.57.translation: His complexion is certainly not blackish. Indeed, His not being blackish indicates that His complexion is yellow.

lines: kalau yaṁ vidvāṁsaḥ sphuṭam abhiyajante dyuti-bharād
sa devaś caitanyākṛtir atitarāṁ naḥ kṛpayatu
devanagari: कलौ यं विद्वांसः स्फुटमभियजन्ते द्युति - भराद् अकृष्णाङ्गं कृष्णं मख - विधिभिरुत्कीर्तन - मयैः ।
उपास्यं च प्राहुर्यमखिल - चतुर्थाश्रम - जुषां स देवश्चैतन्याकृतिरतितरां नः कृपयतु ॥58॥
cc-adi-3.58.translation: "By performing the sacrifice of congregational chanting of the holy name, learned scholars in the Age of Kali worship Lord Kṛṣṇa, who is now non-blackish because of the great upsurge of the feelings of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. He is the only worshipable Deity for the paramahaṁsas, who have attained the highest stage of the fourth order [sannyāsa]. May that Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord Caitanya, show us His great causeless mercy."

devanagari: प्रत्यक्ष ताँहार तप्त - काञ्चनेर द्युति ।
याँहार छटाय नाशे अज्ञान - तमस्तति ॥59॥
cc-adi-3.59.translation: One can vividly see His glowing complexion of molten gold, which dispels the darkness of ignorance.

devanagari: ब्रह्मार एक दिने तिंहो एक - बार ।
अवतीर्ण हञा करेन प्रकट विहार ॥6॥
cc-adi-3.6.translation: Once in a day of Brahmā, He descends to this world to manifest His transcendental pastimes.

devanagari: जीवेर कल्मष - तमो नाश करिबारे ।
अङ्ग - उपाङ्ग - नाम नाना अस्त्र धरे ॥60॥
cc-adi-3.60.translation: The sinful life of the living beings results from ignorance. To destroy that ignorance, He has brought various weapons, such as His plenary associates, His devotees and the holy name.

devanagari: भक्तिर विरोधी कर्म - धर्म वा अधर्म ।
ताहारऽकल्म ष’ नाम, सेइ महा - तमः ॥61॥
cc-adi-3.61.translation: The greatest ignorance consists of activities, whether religious or irreligious, that are opposed to devotional service. They are to be known as sins [kalmaṣa].

lines: bāhu tuli' hari bali' prema-dṛṣṭye cāya
devanagari: बाहु तुलि’ हरि ब लि’ प्रेम - दृष्ट्ये चाय ।
करिया कल्मष नाश प्रेमेते भासाय ॥62॥
cc-adi-3.62.translation: Raising His arms, chanting the holy name and looking upon all with deep love, He drives away all sins and floods everyone with love of Godhead.

lines: smitālokaḥ śokaṁ harati jagatāṁ yasya parito
padālambhaḥ kaṁ vā praṇayati na hi prema-nivahaṁ
sa devaś caitanyākṛtir atitarāṁ naḥ kṛpayatu
devanagari: स्मितालोकः शोकं हरति जगतां यस्य परितो गिरां तु प्रारम्भः कुशल - पटली पल्लवयति ।
पदालम्भः कं वा प्रणयति न हि प्रेम - निवहं स देवश्चैतन्याकृतिरतितरां नः कृपयतु ॥63॥
cc-adi-3.63.translation: "May the Supreme Personality of Godhead in the form of Lord Śrī Caitanya bestow His causeless mercy upon us. His smiling glance at once drives away all the bereavements of the world, and His very words enliven the auspicious creepers of devotion by expanding their leaves. Taking shelter of His lotus feet invokes transcendental love of God at once."

devanagari: श्री - अङ्ग, श्री - मुख येइ करे दरशन ।
तार पाप - क्षय हय, पाय प्रेम - धन ॥64॥
cc-adi-3.64.translation: Anyone who looks upon His beautiful body or beautiful face becomes freed from all sins and obtains the wealth of love of Godhead.

devanagari: अन्य अवतारे सब सैन्य - शस्त्र सङ्गे ।
चैतन्य - कृष्णेर सैन्य अङ्ग - उपाङ्गे ॥65॥
cc-adi-3.65.translation: In other incarnations the Lord descended with armies and weapons, but in this incarnation His soldiers are His plenary parts and associates.

lines: sa caitanyaḥ kiṁ me punar api dṛśor yāsyati padam
devanagari: सदोपास्यः श्रीमान्धृत - मनुज - कायैः प्रणयितां वहद्भिर्गीर्वाणैर्गिरिश - परमेष्ठि - प्रभृतिभिः ।
स्व - भक्तेभ्यः शुद्धां निज - भजन - मुद्रामुपदिशन् स चैतन्यः किं मे पुनरपि दृशोर्यास्यति पदम् ॥66॥
cc-adi-3.66.translation: "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is always the most worshipable Deity of the demigods, including Lord Śiva and Lord Brahmā, who came in the garb of ordinary men, bearing love for Him. He instructs His own pure devotional service to His own devotees. Will He again be the object of my vision?"

devanagari: आङ्गोपाङ्ग अस्त्र करे स्व - कार्य - साधन ।
‘अङ्ग’ - शब्देर अर्थ आर शुन दिया मन ॥67॥
cc-adi-3.67.translation: His plenary parts and associates perform the work of weapons as their own specific duties. Please hear from me another meaning of the word "aṅga."

devanagari: ‘अङ्ग’ - शब्दे अंश कहे शास्त्र - परमाण ।
अङ्गेर अवयव उपाङ्ग’ - व्याख्यान ॥68॥
cc-adi-3.68.translation: According to the evidence of the revealed scriptures, a bodily limb [aṅga] is also called a part [aṁśa], and a part of a limb is called a partial part [upāṅga].

lines: tac cāpi satyaṁ na tavaiva māyā
devanagari: नारायणस्त्वं न हि सर्व - देहिनाम् आत्मास्यधीशाखिल - लोक - साक्षी ।
नारायणोऽङ्गं नर - भू - जलायनात् तच्चापि सत्यं न तवैव माया ॥69॥
cc-adi-3.69.translation: "O Lord of lords, You are the seer of all creation. You are indeed everyone's dearest life. Are You not, therefore, my father, Nārāyaṇa? 'Nārāyaṇa' refers to one whose abode is in the water born from Nara [Garbhodakaśāyī Viṣṇu], and that Nārāyaṇa is Your plenary portion. All Your plenary portions are transcendental. They are absolute and are not creations of māyā."

lines: satya, tretā, dvāpara, kali, cāri-yuga jāni
devanagari: सत्य, त्रेता, द्वापर, कलि, चारि - युग जानि ।
सेइ चारि - युगे दिव्य एक - युग मानि ॥7॥
cc-adi-3.7.translation: We know that there are four ages [yugas], namely Satya, Tretā, Dvāpara and Kali. These four together comprise one divya-yuga.

lines: seho tomāra aṁśa, tumi mūla nārāyaṇa
devanagari: जल - शायी अन्तर्यामी येइ नारायण ।
सेहो तोमार अंश, तुमि मूल नारायण ॥70॥
cc-adi-3.70.translation: The manifestation of the Nārāyaṇa who predominates in everyone's heart, as well as the Nārāyaṇa who lives in the waters [Kāraṇa, Garbha and Kṣīra], is Your plenary portion. You are therefore the original Nārāyaṇa.

devanagari: ‘अङ्ग’ - शब्दे अंश कहे, सेहो सत्य हय ।
माया - कार्य नहे - सब चिदानन्द - मय ॥71॥
cc-adi-3.71.translation: The word "aṅga" indeed refers to plenary portions. Such manifestations should never be considered products of material nature, for they are all transcendental, full of knowledge and full of bliss.

devanagari: अद्वैत, नित्या नन्द - चैतन्येर दुइ अङ्ग ।
अङ्गेर अवयव - गण कहिये उपाङ्ग ॥72॥
cc-adi-3.72.translation: Śrī Advaita Prabhu and Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu are both plenary portions of Lord Caitanya. Thus They are the limbs [aṅgas] of His body. The parts of these two limbs are called the upāṅgas.

lines: sei saba astra haya pāṣaṇḍa dalite
devanagari: अङ्गोपाङ्ग तीक्ष्ण अस्त्र प्रभुर सहिते ।
सेइ सब अस्त्र हय पाषण्ड दलिते ॥73॥
cc-adi-3.73.translation: Thus the Lord is equipped with sharp weapons in the forms of His parts and plenary portions. All these weapons are competent enough to crush the faithless atheists.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द गोसाञि साक्षात् हलधर ।
अद्वैत आचार्य गोसाञि साक्षातीश्वर ॥74॥
cc-adi-3.74.translation: Śrī Nityānanda Gosāñi is directly Haladhara [Lord Balarāma], and Advaita Ācārya is the Personality of Godhead Himself.

devanagari: श्रीवासादि पारिषद सैन्य सङ्गे लञा ।
दुइ सेनापति बुले कीर्तन करिया ॥75॥
cc-adi-3.75.translation: These two captains, with Their soldiers such as Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, travel everywhere, chanting the holy name of the Lord.

devanagari: पाषण्ड - दलन - वाना नित्यानन्द राय ।
आचार्य - हुङ्कारे पाप - पाषण्डी पलाय ॥76॥
cc-adi-3.76.translation: Lord Nityānanda's very features indicate that He is the subduer of the unbelievers. All sins and unbelievers flee from the loud shouts of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: सङ्कीर्तन - प्रवर्तक श्रीकृष्ण - चैतन्य ।
सङ्कीर्तन - यज्ञे ताँरे भजे, सेइ धन्य ॥77॥
cc-adi-3.77.translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is the initiator of saṅkīrtana [congregational chanting of the holy name of the Lord]. One who worships Him through saṅkīrtana is fortunate indeed.

lines: sei ta' sumedhā, āra kubuddhi saṁsāra
devanagari: सेइ त’ सुमेधा, आर कुबुद्धि संसार ।
सर्व - यज्ञ हैते कृष्ण - नाम - ग्रज्ञ सार ॥78॥
cc-adi-3.78.translation: Such a person is truly intelligent, whereas others, who have but a poor fund of knowledge, must endure a cycle of repeated birth and death. Of all sacrificial performances, the chanting of the Lord's holy name is the most sublime.

lines: koṭi aśvamedha eka kṛṣṇa nāma sama
yei kahe, se pāṣaṇḍī, daṇḍe tāre yama
devanagari: कोटि अश्वमेध ए क कृष्ण नाम सम ।
येइ कहे, से पाषण्डी, दण्डे तारे ग्रम ॥79॥
cc-adi-3.79.translation: One who says that ten million aśvamedha sacrifices are equal to the chanting of the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa is undoubtedly an atheist. He is sure to be punished by Yamarāja.

devanagari: एकात्तर चतुर्युगे एक मन्वन्तर ।
चौद्द मन्वन्तर ब्रह्मार दिवस भितर ॥8॥
cc-adi-3.8.translation: Seventy-one divya-yugas constitute one manv-antara. There are fourteen manv-antaras in one day of Brahmā.

devanagari: ‘भागवत - सन्दर्भ - ग्रन्थेर मङ्गलाचरणे ।
ए - श्लोक जीव - गोसाबि करियाछेन व्याख्याने ॥80॥
cc-adi-3.80.translation: In the auspicious introduction of Bhāgavata-sandarbha, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī has given the following verse as an explanation.

devanagari: अन्तः कृष्णं बहिरं दर्शिताङ्गादि - वैभवम् ।
कलौ सङ्कीर्तनाद्यैः स्म कृष्ण - चैतन्यमाश्रिताः ॥81॥
cc-adi-3.81.translation: "I take shelter of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is outwardly of a fair complexion but is inwardly Kṛṣṇa Himself. In this Age of Kali He displays His expansions [His aṅgas and upāṅgas] by performing congregational chanting of the holy name of the Lord."

lines: kṛpā kari vyāsa prati kariyāchena kathana
devanagari: उप - पुराणेह शुनि श्रीकृष्ण - वचन ।
कृपा करि व्यास प्रति करियाछेन कथन ॥82॥
cc-adi-3.82.translation: In the Upapurāṇas we hear Śrī Kṛṣṇa showing His mercy to Vyāsadeva by speaking to him as follows.

devanagari: अहमेव क्वचिद्गह्मन्सन्यासाश्रममाश्रितः ।
हरि - भक्तिं ग्राहयामि कलौ पाप - हतान्नरान् ॥83॥
cc-adi-3.83.translation: "O learned brāhmaṇa, sometimes I accept the renounced order of life to induce the fallen people of the Age of Kali to accept devotional service to the Lord."

devanagari: भागवत, भारत - शास्त्र, आगम, पुराण ।
चैतन्य - कृष्ण - अवतारे प्रकट प्रमाण ॥84॥
cc-adi-3.84.translation: Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, the Mahābhārata, the Purāṇas and other Vedic literatures all give evidence to prove that Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the incarnation of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: प्रत्यक्षे देखह नाना प्रकट प्रभाव ।
अलौकिक कर्म, अलौकिक अनुभाव ॥85॥
cc-adi-3.85.translation: One can also directly see Lord Caitanya's manifest influence in His uncommon deeds and uncommon Kṛṣṇa conscious realization.

lines: dekhiyā nā dekhe yata abhaktera gaṇa
ulūke nā dekhe yena sūryera kiraṇa
devanagari: देखिया ना देखे व्रत अभक्तेर गण ।
उलूके ना देखे येन सूर किरण ॥86॥
cc-adi-3.86.translation: But faithless unbelievers do not see what is clearly evident, just as owls do not see the rays of the sun.

devanagari: त्वां शील - रूप - चरितैः परम - प्रकृष्टैः सत्त्वेन सात्त्विकतया प्रबलैश्च शास्त्रैः ।
प्रख्यात - दैव - परमार्थ - विदां मतैश्च नैवासुर - प्रकृतयः प्रभवन्ति बोद्धम् ॥87॥
cc-adi-3.87.translation: "O my Lord, those influenced by demoniac principles cannot realize You, although You are clearly the Supreme by dint of Your exalted activities, forms, character and uncommon power, which are confirmed by all the revealed scriptures in the quality of goodness and the celebrated transcendentalists in the divine nature."

lines: āpanā lukāite kṛṣṇa nānā yatna kare
devanagari: आपना लुकाइते कृष्ण नाना यत्न करे ।
तथापि ताँहार भक्त जानये ताँहारे ॥88॥
cc-adi-3.88.translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa tries to hide Himself in various ways, but nevertheless His pure devotees know Him as He is.

devanagari: उल्लङ्घित - त्रिविध - सीम - समातिशायि - सम्भावनं तव परिव्रढ़िम - स्वभावम् ।
माया - बलेन भवतापि निगुह्यमानं पश्यन्ति केचिदनिशं त्वदनन्य - भावाः ॥89॥
cc-adi-3.89.translation: "O my Lord, everything within material nature is limited by time, space and thought. Your characteristics, however, being unequaled and unsurpassed, are always transcendental to such limitations. You sometimes cover such characteristics by Your own energy, but nevertheless Your unalloyed devotees are always able to see You under all circumstances."

devanagari: ‘वैवस्व त’ - नाम एइ सप्तम मन्वन्तर ।
साताइश चतुर्युग ताहार अन्तर ॥9॥
cc-adi-3.9.translation: The present Manu, who is the seventh, is called Vaivasvata [the son of Vivasvān]. Twenty-seven divya-yugas [27 x 4,320,000 solar years] of his age have now passed.

devanagari: असुर - स्वभावे कृष्णे कभु नाहि जाने ।
लुकाइते नारे कृष्ण भक्त - जन - स्थाने ॥90॥
cc-adi-3.90.translation: Those whose nature is demoniac cannot know Kṛṣṇa at any time, but He cannot hide Himself from His pure devotees.

devanagari: द्वौ भूत - सर्गी लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च ।
विष्णु - भक्तः स्मृतो दैव आसुरस्तद्विपर्ययः ॥91॥
cc-adi-3.91.translation: "There are two classes of men in the created world. One consists of the demoniac and the other of the godly. The devotees of Lord Viṣṇu are the godly, whereas those who are just the opposite are called demons."

devanagari: आचार्य गोसाञि प्रभुर भक्त - अवतार ।
कृष्ण - अवतार - हेतु याँहार हुङ्कार ॥92॥
cc-adi-3.92.translation: Advaita Ācārya Gosvāmī is an incarnation of the Lord as a devotee. His loud calling was the cause for Kṛṣṇa's incarnation.

devanagari: कृष्ण यदि पृथिवीते करेन अवतार ।
प्रथमे करेन गुरु - वर्गेर सञ्चार ॥93॥
cc-adi-3.93.translation: Whenever Śrī Kṛṣṇa desires to manifest His incarnation on earth, first He creates the incarnations of His respectable predecessors.

lines: pitā mātā guru ādi yata mānya-gaṇa
devanagari: पिता माता गुरु आदि ग्रत मान्य - गण ।
प्रथमे करेन सबार पृथिवीते जनम ॥94॥
cc-adi-3.94.translation: Thus respectable personalities such as His father, mother and spiritual master all take birth on earth first.

lines: advaita ācārya prakaṭa hailā sei sātha
devanagari: माधव - ईश्वर - पुरी, शची, जगन्नाथ ।
अद्वैत आचार्य प्रकट हैला सेइ साथ ॥95॥
cc-adi-3.95.translation: Mādhavendra Purī, Īśvara Purī, Śrīmatī Śacīmātā and Śrīla Jagannātha Miśra all appeared with Śrī Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: प्रकटिया देखे आचार्य सकल संसार ।
कृष्ण - भक्ति गन्ध - हीन विषय - व्यवहार ॥96॥
cc-adi-3.96.translation: Advaita Ācārya having appeared, He found the world devoid of devotional service to Śrī Kṛṣṇa because people were engrossed in material affairs.

lines: keha pāpe, keha puṇye kare viṣaya-bhoga
devanagari: केह पापे, केह पुण्ये करे विषय - भोग ।
भक्ति - गन्ध नाहि, याते याय भव - रोग ॥97॥
cc-adi-3.97.translation: Everyone was engaged in material enjoyment, whether sinfully or virtuously. No one was interested in the transcendental service of the Lord, which can give total relief from the repetition of birth and death.

lines: vicāra karena, lokera kaiche hita haya
devanagari: लोक - गति दे खि’ आचार्य करुण - हृदय ।
विचार करेन, लोकेर कैछे हित हय ॥98॥
cc-adi-3.98.translation: Seeing the activities of the world, the Ācārya felt compassion and began to ponder how He could act for the people's benefit.

devanagari: आपनि श्री कृष्ण यदि करेन अवतार ।
आपने आच रि’ भक्ति करेन प्रचार ॥99॥
cc-adi-3.99.translation: [Advaita Ācārya thought:] "If Śrī Kṛṣṇa were to appear as an incarnation, He Himself could preach devotion by His personal example.

devanagari: श्री - चैतन्य - प्रसादेन तद्रूपस्य विनिर्णयम् ।
बालोऽपि कुरुते शास्त्रं दृष्ट्वा व्रज - विलासिनः ॥1॥
cc-adi-4.1.translation: By the mercy of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, even a foolish child can fully describe the real nature of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the enjoyer of the pastimes of Vraja, according to the vision of the revealed scriptures.

lines: āra saba avatāra tāṅte āsi' mile
devanagari: पूर्ण भगवानवतरे येइ काले ।
आर सब अवतार ताँते आ सि’ मिले ॥10॥
cc-adi-4.10.translation: When the complete Supreme Personality of Godhead descends, all other incarnations of the Lord meet together within Him.

devanagari: षष्ठ श्लोकेर अर्थ करिते प्रकाश ।
प्रथमे कहिये सेइ श्लोकेर आभास ॥101॥
cc-adi-4.101.translation: To explain the sixth verse, I shall first give a hint of its meaning.

lines: eho bāhya hetu, pūrve kariyāchi sūcana
devanagari: अवतरि’ प्रभु प्रचारिल सङ्कीर्तन ।
एहो बाह्य हेतु, पूर्वे करियाछि सूचन ॥102॥
cc-adi-4.102.translation: The Lord came to propagate saṅkīrtana. That is an external purpose, as I have already indicated.

devanagari: अवतारेर आर एक आछे मुख्य - बीज ।
रसिक - शेखर कृष्णेर सेइ कार्य निज ॥103॥
cc-adi-4.103.translation: There is a principal cause for Lord Kṛṣṇa's appearance. It grows from His own engagements as the foremost enjoyer of loving exchanges.

lines: ati gūḍha hetu sei tri-vidha prakāra
devanagari: अति गूढ़ हेतु सेइ त्रि - विध प्रकार ।
दामोदर - स्वरूप हैते याहार प्रचार ॥104॥
cc-adi-4.104.translation: That most confidential cause is threefold. Svarūpa Dāmodara has revealed it.

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि - प्रभुर अति अन्तरङ्ग ।
ताहाते जानेन प्रभुर ए - सब प्रसङ्ग ॥105॥
cc-adi-4.105.translation: Svarūpa Gosāñi is the most intimate associate of the Lord. He, therefore, knows all these topics well.

devanagari: राधिकार भाव - मूर्ति प्रभुर अन्तर ।
सेइ भावे सुख - दुःख उठे निरन्तर ॥106॥
cc-adi-4.106.translation: The heart of Lord Caitanya is the image of Śrī Rādhikā's emotions. Thus feelings of pleasure and pain arise constantly therein.

devanagari: शेष - लीलाय प्रभुर कृष्ण - विरह - उन्माद ।
भ्रम - मय चेष्टा, आर प्रलाप - मय वाद ॥107॥
cc-adi-4.107.translation: In the final portion of His pastimes, Lord Caitanya was obsessed with the madness of separation from Lord Kṛṣṇa. He acted in erroneous ways and talked deliriously.

lines: sei bhāve matta prabhu rahe rātri-dine
devanagari: राधिकार भाव यैछे उद्धव - दर्शने ।
सेइ भावे मत्त प्रभु रहे रात्रि - दिने ॥108॥
cc-adi-4.108.translation: Just as Rādhikā went mad at the sight of Uddhava, so Lord Caitanya was obsessed day and night with the madness of separation.

lines: rātre pralāpa kare svarūpera kaṇṭha dhari'
devanagari: रात्रे प्रलाप करे स्वरूपेर कण्ठ ध रि’ ।
आवेशे आपन भाव कहये उघा ड़ि’ ॥109॥
cc-adi-4.109.translation: At night He talked incoherently in grief with His arms around Svarūpa Dāmodara's neck. He spoke out His heart in ecstatic inspiration.

devanagari: नारायण, चतुर्व्यह, मत्स्याद्यवतार ।
युग - मन्वन्तरावतार, व्रत आछे आर ॥11॥
cc-adi-4.11-12.translation: Lord Nārāyaṇa, the four primary expansions [Vāsudeva, Saṅkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna and Aniruddha], Matsya and the other līlā incarnations, the yuga-avatāras and the manvantara incarnations—and as many other incarnations as there are-all descend in the body of Lord Kṛṣṇa. In this way the complete Supreme Godhead, Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself, appears.

lines: yabe yei bhāva uṭhe prabhura antara
devanagari: यबे येइ भाव उठे प्रभुर अन्तर ।
सेइ गीति - श्लोके सुख देन दामोदर ॥110॥
cc-adi-4.110.translation: Whenever a particular sentiment arose in His heart, Svarūpa Dāmodara satisfied Him by singing songs or reciting verses of the same nature.

lines: ebe kārya nāhi kichu e-saba vicāre
devanagari: एबे कार्य नाहि किछु ए - सब विचारे ।
आगे इहा विवरिब करिया विस्तारे ॥111॥
cc-adi-4.111.translation: To analyze these pastimes is not necessary now. Later I shall describe them in detail.

devanagari: पूर्वे व्रजे कृष्णेर त्रि - विध वयो - धर्म ।
कौमार, पौगण्ड, आर कैशोर अतिमर्म ॥112॥
cc-adi-4.112.translation: Formerly in Vraja Lord Kṛṣṇa displayed three ages, namely childhood, boyhood and adolescence. His adolescence is especially significant.

devanagari: वात्सल्य - आवेशे कैल कौमार सफल ।
पौगण्ड सफल कैल ल ञा सखावल ॥113॥
cc-adi-4.113.translation: Parental affection made His childhood fruitful. His boyhood was successful with His friends.

devanagari: राधिकादि ल ञा कैल रासादि - विलास ।
वाञ्छा भ रि’ आस्वादिल रसेर निर्वास ॥114॥
cc-adi-4.114.translation: In youth He tasted the essence of rasa, fulfilling His desires in pastimes like the rāsa dance with Śrīmatī Rādhikā and the other gopīs.

devanagari: कैशोर - वयसे काम, जगत्सकल ।
रासादि - लीलाय तिन करिल सफल ॥115॥
cc-adi-4.115.translation: In His youth Lord Kṛṣṇa made all three of His ages, and the entire universe, successful by His pastimes of amorous love like the rāsa dance.

devanagari: सोऽपि कैशोरक - वयो मानयन्मधुसूदनः ।
रेमे स्त्री - रल - कूट - स्थः क्षपासु क्षपिताहितः ॥116॥
cc-adi-4.116.translation: "Lord Madhusūdana enjoyed His youth with pastimes on autumn nights in the midst of the jewellike milkmaids. Thus He dispelled all the misfortunes of the world."

lines: kaiśoraṁ saphalī-karoti kalayan kuñje vihāraṁ hariḥ
devanagari: वाचा सूचित - शर्वरी - रति - कला - प्रागल्भ्यया राधिका व्रीड़ा - कुञ्चित - लोचनां विरचयन्नग्रे सखीनामसौ ।
तद्वक्षो - रुह - चित्र - केलि - मकरी - पाण्डित्य - पारं गतः कैशोरं सफली - करोति कलयन्कुले विहारं हरिः ॥117॥
cc-adi-4.117.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa made Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī close Her eyes in shame before Her friends by His words relating Their amorous activities on the previous night. Then He showed the highest limit of cleverness in drawing pictures of dolphins in various playful sports on Her breasts. In this way Lord Hari made His youth successful by performing pastimes in the bushes with Śrī Rādhā and Her friends."

devanagari: हरिरेष न चेदवातरिष्यन् मथुरायां मधुराक्षि राधिका च ।
अभविष्यदियं वृथा विसृष्टिर मकराङ्कस्तु विशेषतस्तदात्र ॥118॥
cc-adi-4.118.translation: "O Paurṇamāsī, if Lord Hari had not descended in Mathurā with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, this entire creation-and especially Cupid, the demigod of love-would have been useless."

lines: ei mata pūrve kṛṣṇa rasera sadana
devanagari: एइ मत पूर्वे कृष्ण रसेर सदन ।
यद्यपि करिल रस - निर्यास - चर्वण ॥119॥
cc-adi-4.119-120.translation: Even though Lord Kṛṣṇa, the abode of all mellows, had previously in this way chewed the essence of the mellows of love, still He was unable to fulfill three desires, although He made efforts to taste them.

devanagari: ताँहार प्रथम वाञ्छा करिये व्याख्यान ।
कृष्ण कहे, - ‘आमि हड रसेर निदान ॥121॥
cc-adi-4.121.translation: I shall explain His first desire. Kṛṣṇa says, "I am the primary cause of all rasas.

devanagari: पूर्णानन्द - मय आमि चिन्मय पूर्ण - तत्त्व ।
राधिकार प्रेमे आमा कराय उन्मत्त ॥122॥
cc-adi-4.122.translation: "I am the full spiritual truth and am made of full joy, but the love of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī drives Me mad.

lines: nā jāni rādhāra preme āche kata bala
ye bale āmāre kare sarvadā vihvala
devanagari: ना जानि राधार प्रेमे आछे कत बल ।
ये बले आ मारे करे सर्वदा विह्वल ॥123॥
cc-adi-4.123.translation: "I do not know the strength of Rādhā's love, with which She always overwhelms Me.

lines: sadā āmā nānā nṛtye nācāya udbhaṭa
devanagari: राधिकार प्रेम - गुरु, आमि - शिष्य नट ।
सदा आमा नाना नृत्ये नाचाय उद्भट ॥124॥
cc-adi-4.124.translation: "The love of Rādhikā is My teacher, and I am Her dancing pupil. Her prema makes Me dance various novel dances."

lines: kasmād vṛnde priya-sakhi hareḥ pāda-mūlāt kuto 'sau
kuṇḍāraṇye kim iha kurute nṛtya-śikṣāṁ guruḥ kaḥ
devanagari: कस्माद्वन्दे प्रिय - सखि हरेः पाद - मूलात्कुतोऽसौ कुण्डारण्ये किमिह कुरुते नृत्य - शिक्षा गुरुः कः ।
तं त्वन्मूर्तिः प्रति - तरु - लतं दिग्विदिक्षु स्फुरन्ती शैलूषीव भ्रमति परितो नर्तयन्ती स्व - पश्चात् ॥125॥
cc-adi-4.125.translation: "O my beloved friend Vṛndā, where are you coming from?" \\ "I am coming from the feet of Śrī Hari." \\ "Where is He?" \\ "In the forest on the bank of Rādhā-kuṇḍa." \\ "What is He doing there?" \\ "He is learning dancing." \\ "Who is His master?" \\ "Your image, Rādhā, revealing itself in every tree and creeper in every direction, is roaming like a skillful dancer, making Him dance behind."

devanagari: निज - प्रेमास्वादे मोर हय ये आह्लाद ।
ताहा ह’ते कोटि - गुण राधा - प्रेमास्वाद ॥126॥
cc-adi-4.126.translation: "Whatever pleasure I get from tasting My love for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, She tastes ten million times more than Me by Her love.

devanagari: आमि यैछे परस्पर विरुद्ध - धर्माश्रय ।
राधा - प्रेम तैछे सदा विरुद्ध - धर्म - मय ॥127॥
cc-adi-4.127.translation: "Just as I am the abode of all mutually contradictory characteristics, so Rādhā's love is always full of similar contradictions.

lines: tathāpi se kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bāḍaye sadāi
devanagari: राधा - प्रेमा विभु - यार बाड़िते नाहि ठा ञि ।
तथापि से क्षणे क्षणे बाड़ये सदाइ ॥128॥
cc-adi-4.128.translation: "Rādhā's love is all-pervading, leaving no room for expansion. But still it is expanding constantly.

lines: yāhā va-i guru vastu nāhi suniścita
devanagari: याहा वइ गुरु वस्तु नाहि सुनिश्चित ।
तथापि गुरुर धर्म गौरव - वर्जित ॥129॥
cc-adi-4.129.translation: "There is certainly nothing greater than Her love. But Her love is devoid of pride. That is the sign of its greatness.

devanagari: अतएव विष्णु तखन कृष्णेर शरीरे ।
विष्णु - द्वारे करे कृष्ण असुर - संहारे ॥13॥
cc-adi-4.13.translation: At that time, therefore, Lord Viṣṇu is present in the body of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and Lord Kṛṣṇa kills the demons through Him.

lines: yāhā haite sunirmala dvitīya nāhi āra
devanagari: याहा हैते सुनिर्मल द्वितीय नाहि आर ।
तथापि सर्वदा वाम्य - वक्र - व्यवहार ॥130॥
cc-adi-4.130.translation: "Nothing is purer than Her love. But its behavior is always perverse and crooked."

devanagari: विभुरपि कलयन्सदाभिवृद्धि गुरुरपि गौरव - चर्यया विहीनः ।
मुहुरुपचित - वक्रिमापि शुद्धो जयति मुर - द्विषि राधिकानुरागः ॥131॥
cc-adi-4.131.translation: "All glories to Rādhā's love for Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of the demon Mura. Although it is all-pervading, it tends to increase at every moment. Although it is important, it is devoid of pride. And although it is pure, it is always beset with duplicity."

devanagari: सेइ प्रेमार श्री - राधिका परम ‘आश्रय’ ।
सेइ प्रेमार आमि हइ केवल ‘विषय’ ॥132॥
cc-adi-4.132.translation: "Śrī Rādhikā is the highest abode of that love, and I am its only object.

devanagari: विषय - जातीय सुख आमार आस्वाद ।
आमा हैते कोटि - गुण आश्रयेर आह्लाद ॥133॥
cc-adi-4.133.translation: "I taste the bliss to which the object of love is entitled. But the pleasure of Rādhā, the abode of that love, is ten million times greater.

lines: yatne āsvādite nāri, ki kari upāya
devanagari: आश्रय - जातिय सुख पाइते मन धाय ।
यत्न आस्वादिते नारि, कि करि उपाय ॥134॥
cc-adi-4.134.translation: "My mind races to taste the pleasure experienced by the abode, but I cannot taste it, even by My best efforts. How may I taste it?

lines: kabhu yadi ei premāra ha-iye āśraya
devanagari: कभु यदि एइ प्रेमार हइये आश्रय ।
तबे एइ प्रेमानन्देर अनुभव हय ॥135॥
cc-adi-4.135.translation: "If sometime I can be the abode of that love, only then may I taste its joy."

devanagari: एत चि न्ति’ रहे कृष्ण परम - कौतुकी ।
हृदये बाड़ये प्रेम - लोभ धक्धकि ॥136॥
cc-adi-4.136.translation: Thinking in this way, Lord Kṛṣṇa was curious to taste that love. His eager desire for that love increasingly blazed in His heart.

lines: ei eka, śuna āra lobhera prakāra
devanagari: एइ एक, शुन आर लोभेर प्रकार ।
स्व - माधुर्य देखि’ कृष्ण करेन विचार ॥137॥
cc-adi-4.137.translation: That is one desire. Now please hear of another. Seeing His own beauty, Lord Kṛṣṇa began to consider.

lines: tri-jagate ihāra keha nāhi pāya sīmā
devanagari: अद्भुत, अनन्त, पूर्ण मोर मधुरिमा ।
त्रि - जगते इहार केह नाहि पाय सीमा ॥138॥
cc-adi-4.138.translation: "My sweetness is wonderful, infinite and full. No one in the three worlds can find its limit.

devanagari: एइ प्रेम - द्वारे नित्य राधिका एकलि ।
आमार माधुर्यामृत आस्वादे सकलि ॥139॥
cc-adi-4.139.translation: "Only Rādhikā, by the strength of Her love, tastes all the nectar of My sweetness.

lines: ye lāgi' avatāra, kahi se mūla kāraṇa
devanagari: आनुषङ्ग - कर्म एइ असुर - मारण ।
ये लागि’ अवतार, कहि से मूल कारण ॥14॥
cc-adi-4.14.translation: Thus the killing of the demons is but secondary work. I shall now speak of the main reason for the Lord's incarnation.

lines: tathāpi svacchatā tāra bāḍhe kṣaṇe kṣaṇa
devanagari: यद्यपि निर्मल राधार सत्प्रेम - दर्पण।
तथापि स्वच्छता तार बाढ़े क्षणे क्षण ॥140॥
cc-adi-4.140.translation: "Although Rādhā's love is pure like a mirror, its purity increases at every moment.

lines: e-darpaṇera āge nava nava rūpe bhāse
devanagari: आमार माधुर्य नाहि बाढ़िते अवकाशे ।
ए - दर्पणेर आगे नव नव रूपे भासे ॥141॥
cc-adi-4.141.translation: "My sweetness also has no room for expansion, yet it shines before that mirror in newer and newer beauty.

lines: kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bāḍe doṅhe, keha nāhi hāri
devanagari: मन्माधुर्य राधार प्रेम दोंहे होड़ करि’ ।
क्षणे क्षणे बाड़े दोंह, केह नाहि हारि ॥142॥
cc-adi-4.142.translation: "There is constant competition between My sweetness and the mirror of Rādhā's love. They both go on increasing, but neither knows defeat.

lines: āmāra mādhurya nitya nava nava haya
devanagari: आमार माधुर्य नित्य नव नव हय ।
स्व - स्व - प्रेम - अनुरूप भक्ते आस्वादय ॥143॥
cc-adi-4.143.translation: "My sweetness is always newer and newer. Devotees taste it according to their own respective love.

devanagari: दर्पणाद्ये दे खि’ यदि आपन माधुरी ।
आस्वादिते हय लोभ, आस्वादिते नारि ॥144॥
cc-adi-4.144.translation: "If I see My sweetness in a mirror, I am tempted to taste it, but nevertheless I cannot.

devanagari: विचार करिये यदि आस्वाद - उपाय ।
राधिका - स्वरूप हइते तबे मन धाय ॥145॥
cc-adi-4.145.translation: "If I deliberate on a way to taste it, I find that I hanker for the position of Rādhikā."

lines: ayam aham api hanta prekṣya yaṁ lubdha-cetāḥ
devanagari: अपरिकलित - पूर्वः कश्चमत्कार - कारी स्फुरति मम गरीयानेष माधुर्य - पूरः ।
अयमहमपि ह न्त प्रेक्ष्य ग्यं लुब्ध - चेताः सरभसमुपभोक्तुं कामये राधिकेव ॥146॥
cc-adi-4.146.translation: "Who manifests an abundance of sweetness greater than Mine, which has never been experienced before and which causes wonder to all? Alas, I Myself, My mind bewildered upon seeing this beauty, impetuously desire to enjoy it like Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

devanagari: कृष्ण - माधुर्येर एक स्वाभाविक बल ।
कृष्ण - आदि नर - नारी करये चञ्चल ॥147॥
cc-adi-4.147.translation: The beauty of Kṛṣṇa has one natural strength: it thrills the hearts of all men and women, beginning with Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself.

devanagari: श्रवणे, दर्शने आकर्षये सर्व - मन ।
आपना आस्वादिते कृष्ण करेन यतन ॥148॥
cc-adi-4.148.translation: All minds are attracted by hearing His sweet voice and flute, or by seeing His beauty. Even Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself makes efforts to taste that sweetness.

lines: e mādhuryāmṛta pāna sadā yei kare
devanagari: ए माधुर्यामृत पान सदा येइ करे।
तृष्णा - शान्ति नहे, तृष्णा बाढ़े निरन्तरे ॥149॥
cc-adi-4.149.translation: The thirst of one who always drinks the nectar of that sweetness is never satisfied. Rather, that thirst increases constantly.

devanagari: प्रेम - रस - निय़स करिते आस्वादन ।
राग - मार्ग भक्ति लोके करिते प्रचारण ॥15॥
cc-adi-4.15-16.translation: The Lord's desire to appear was born from two reasons: He wanted to taste the sweet essence of the mellows of love of God, and He wanted to propagate devotional service in the world on the platform of spontaneous attraction. Thus He is known as supremely jubilant and as the most merciful of all.

lines: avidagdha vidhi bhāla nā jāne sṛjana
devanagari: अतृप्त हइया करे विधिर निन्दन ।
अविदग्ध विधि भाल ना जाने सृजन ॥150॥
cc-adi-4.150.translation: Such a person, being unsatisfied, begins to blaspheme Lord Brahmā, saying that he does not know the art of creating well and is simply inexperienced.

lines: koṭi netra nāhi dila, sabe dila dui
devanagari: कोटि नेत्र नाहि दिल, सबे दिल दुङ ।
ताहाते निमेष , - कृष्ण कि देखिब मुञि ॥151॥
cc-adi-4.151.translation: He has not given millions of eyes to see the beauty of Kṛṣṇa. He has given only two eyes, and even those eyes blink. How then shall I see the lovely face of Kṛṣṇa?

devanagari: अटति यद्भवानह्नि काननं त्रुटिगायते त्वामपश्यताम् ।
कुटिल - कुन्तलं श्री - मुखं च ते जड़ उदीक्षतां पक्ष्म - कृशाम् ॥152॥
cc-adi-4.152.translation: [The gopīs say:] "O Kṛṣṇa, when You go to the forest during the day and we do not see Your sweet face, which is surrounded by beautiful curling hairs, half a second becomes as long as an entire age for us. And we consider the creator, who has put eyelids on the eyes we use for seeing You, to be simply a fool."

lines: gopyaś ca kṛṣṇam upalabhya cirād abhīṣṭaṁ
dṛgbhir hṛdi kṛtam alaṁ parirabhya sarvās
devanagari: गोप्यश्च कृष्णमुपलभ्य चिरादभीष्टं यत्प्रेक्ष णे दृशिषु पक्ष्म - कृतं शपन्ति ।
दृग्भिहंदी - कृतमलं परिरभ्य सर्वास् तद्भावमापुरपि नित्य - ग्रुजां दुरापम् ॥153॥
cc-adi-4.153.translation: "The gopīs saw their beloved Kṛṣṇa at Kurukṣetra after a long separation. They secured and embraced Him in their hearts through their eyes, and they attained a joy so intense that not even perfect yogīs can attain it. The gopīs cursed the creator for creating eyelids that interfered with their vision."

lines: kṛṣṇāvalokana vinā netra phala nāhi āna
yei jana kṛṣṇa dekhe, sei bhāgyavān
devanagari: कृष्णावलोकन विना नेत्र फल नाहि आन ।
येइ जन कृष्ण देखे, सेइ भाग्यवान् ॥154॥
cc-adi-4.154.translation: There is no other consummation for the eyes than the sight of Kṛṣṇa. Whoever sees Him is most fortunate indeed.

lines: akṣaṇvatāṁ phalam idaṁ na paraṁ vidāmaḥ
devanagari: अक्षण्वतां फलमिदं न परं विदामः सख्यः पशूननुविवेशयतोर्वयस्यैः ।
वक्त्रं व्रजेश - सुतयोरनुवेणु - जुष्टं यैर्वा निपीतमनुरक्त - कटाक्ष - मोक्षम् ॥155॥
cc-adi-4.155.translation: [The gopīs say:] "O friends, those eyes that see the beautiful faces of the sons of Mahārāja Nanda are certainly fortunate. As these two sons enter the forest, surrounded by Their friends, driving the cows before Them, They hold Their flutes to Their mouths and glance lovingly upon the residents of Vṛndāvana. For those who have eyes, we think there is no greater object of vision."

lines: gopyas tapaḥ kim acaran yad amuṣya rūpaṁ
devanagari: गोप्यस्तपः किमचरन् यदमुष्य रूपं लावण्य - सारमसमोर्ध्वमनन्य - सिद्धम् ।
दृग्भिः पिबन्त्यनुसवाभिनवं दुरापम् एकान्त - धाम यशसः श्रिय ऐश्वरस्य ॥156॥
cc-adi-4.156.translation: [The women of Mathurā say:] "What austerities must the gopīs have performed? With their eyes they always drink the nectar of the face of Lord Kṛṣṇa, which is the essence of loveliness and is not to be equaled or surpassed. That loveliness is the only abode of beauty, fame and opulence. It is self-perfect, ever fresh and extremely rare."

lines: apūrva mādhurī kṛṣṇera, apūrva tāra bala
devanagari: अपूर्व माधुरी कृष्णेर, अपूर्व तार बल ।
याहार श्रवणे मन हय टलमल ॥157॥
cc-adi-4.157.translation: The sweetness of Lord Kṛṣṇa is unprecedented, and its strength is also unprecedented. Simply by hearing of such beauty, the mind becomes unsteady.

lines: samyak āsvādite nāre, mane rahe kṣobha
devanagari: कृष्णेर माधुर्ये कृष्णे उपजय लोभ ।
सम्यकास्वादिते नारे, मने रहे क्षोभ ॥158॥
cc-adi-4.158.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa's own beauty attracts Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself. But because He cannot fully enjoy it, His mind remains full of sorrow.

lines: ei ta' dvitīya hetura kahila vivaraṇa
devanagari: एइ त द्वितीय हेतुर कहिल विवरण ।
तृतीय हेतुर एबे शुनह लक्षण ॥159॥
cc-adi-4.159.translation: This is a description of His second desire. Now please listen as I describe the third.

devanagari: अत्यन्त - निगूढ़ एइ रसेर सिद्धान्त ।
स्वरूप - गोसाञि मात्र जानेन एकान्त ॥160॥
cc-adi-4.160.translation: This conclusion of rasa is extremely deep. Only Svarūpa Dāmodara knows much about it.

lines: yebā keha anya jāne, seho tāṅhā haite
devanagari: येबा केह अन्य जाने, सेहो ताँहा हैते ।
चैतन्य - गोसाञि र तेह अत्यन्त मर्म याते ॥161॥
cc-adi-4.161.translation: Anyone else who claims to know it must have heard it from him, for he was the most intimate companion of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: viśuddha nirmala prema, kabhu nahe kāma
devanagari: गोपी - गणेर प्रेमेर ‘रूढ़ - भाव’ नाम ।
विशुद्ध निर्मल प्रेम, कभु नहे काम ॥162॥
cc-adi-4.162.translation: The love of the gopīs is called rūḍha-bhāva. It is pure and spotless. It is not at any time lust.

devanagari: प्रेमैव गोप - रामानां काम इत्यगमत्प्रथाम् ।
इत्युद्धवादयोऽप्येतं वाञ्छन्ति भगवत्प्रियाः ॥163॥
cc-adi-4.163.translation: "The pure love of the gopīs has become celebrated by the name 'lust.' The dear devotees of the Lord, headed by Śrī Uddhava, desire to taste that love."

lines: lauha āra hema yaiche svarūpe vilakṣaṇa
devanagari: काम, प्रेम, - दोंहाकार विभिन्न लक्षण ।
लौह आर हेम यैछे स्वरूपे विलक्षण ॥164॥
cc-adi-4.164.translation: Lust and love have different characteristics, just as iron and gold have different natures.

devanagari: आत्मेन्द्रिय - प्रीति - वाञ्छा - तारे ब लि’काम’ ।
कृष्णेन्द्रिय - प्रीति - इच्छा धरे ‘प्रेम’ नाम ॥165॥
cc-adi-4.165.translation: The desire to gratify one's own senses is kāma [lust], but the desire to please the senses of Lord Kṛṣṇa is prema [love].

devanagari: कामेर तात्पर्य - निज - सम्भोग केवल ।
कृष्ण - सुख - तात्पर्य - मात्र प्रेम त’ प्रबल ॥166॥
cc-adi-4.166.translation: The object of lust is only the enjoyment of one's own senses. But love caters to the enjoyment of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and thus it is very powerful.

devanagari: लोक - धर्म, वेद - धर्म, देह - धर्म, कर्म ।
लज्जा, धैर्य, देह - सुख, आत्म - सुख - मर्म ॥167॥
cc-adi-4.167-169.translation: Social customs, scriptural injunctions, bodily demands, fruitive action, shyness, patience, bodily pleasures, self-gratification and the path of varṇāśrama-dharma, which is difficult to give up—the gopīs have forsaken all these, as well as their own relatives and their punishment and scolding, for the sake of serving Lord Kṛṣṇa. They render loving service to Him for the sake of His enjoyment.

devanagari: ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञानेते सब जगत्मिश्रित ।
ऐश्वर्य - शिथिल - प्रेमे नाहि मोर प्रीत ॥17॥
cc-adi-4.17.translation: [Lord Kṛṣṇa thought:] "All the universe is filled with the conception of My majesty, but love weakened by that sense of majesty does not satisfy Me.

lines: svaccha dhauta-vastre yaiche nāhi kona dāga
devanagari: इहाके कहिये कृष्णे दृढ़ अनुराग ।
स्वच्छ धौत - वस्त्रे यैछे नाहि कोन दाग ॥170॥
cc-adi-4.170.translation: That is called firm attachment to Lord Kṛṣṇa. It is spotlessly pure, like a clean cloth that has no stain.

devanagari: अतएव काम - प्रेमे बहुत अन्तर ।
काम - अन्ध - तमः, प्रेम - निर्मल भास्कर ॥171॥
cc-adi-4.171.translation: Therefore lust and love are quite different. Lust is like dense darkness, but love is like the bright sun.

lines: kṛṣṇa-sukha lāgi mātra, kṛṣṇa se sambandha
devanagari: अतएव गोपी - गणेर नाहि काम - गन्ध ।
कृष्ण - सुख लागि मात्र, कृष्ण से सम्बन्ध ॥172॥
cc-adi-4.172.translation: Thus there is not the slightest taint of lust in the gopīs' love. Their relationship with Kṛṣṇa is only for the sake of His enjoyment.

lines: tenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathate na kiṁ svit
devanagari: यत्ते सुजात - चरणाम्बुरुहं स्तनेषु भीताः शनैः प्रिय दधीमहि कर्कशेषु ।
तेनाटवीमटसि तद्व्यथते न किं स्वित् कूर्पादिभिर्भमति धीर्भवदायुषां नः ॥173॥
cc-adi-4.173.translation: "O dearly beloved! Your lotus feet are so soft that we place them gently on our breasts, fearing that Your feet will be hurt. Our life rests only in You. Our minds, therefore, are filled with anxiety that Your tender feet might be wounded by pebbles as You roam about on the forest path."

devanagari: आत्म - सुख - दुःखे गोपीर नाहिक विचार ।
कृष्ण - सुख - हेतु चेष्टा मनो - व्यवहार ॥174॥
cc-adi-4.174.translation: The gopīs do not care for their own pleasures or pains. All their physical and mental activities are directed toward offering enjoyment to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: kṛṣṇa lāgi' āra saba kare parityāga
devanagari: कृष्ण लागि’ आर सब करे परित्याग ।
कृष्ण - सुख - हेतु करे शुद्ध अनुराग ॥175॥
cc-adi-4.175.translation: They renounced everything for Kṛṣṇa. They have pure attachment to giving Kṛṣṇa pleasure.

devanagari: मया परोक्षं भजता तिरोहितं ।
मासूयितुं मार्हथ तत्प्रियं प्रियाः ॥176॥
cc-adi-4.176.translation: "O My beloved gopīs, you have renounced social customs, scriptural injunctions and your relatives for My sake. I disappeared behind you only to increase your concentration upon Me. Since I disappeared for your benefit, you should not be displeased with Me."

lines: kṛṣṇera pratijñā eka āche pūrva haite
ye yaiche bhaje, kṛṣṇa tāre bhaje taiche
devanagari: कृष्णेर प्रतिज्ञा एक आछे पूर्व हैते ।
ये यैछे भजे, कृष्ण तारे भजे तैछे ॥177॥
cc-adi-4.177.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa has a promise from before to reciprocate with His devotees according to the way they worship Him.

devanagari: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम् ।
मम वर्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥178॥
cc-adi-4.178.translation: "In whatever way My devotees surrender unto Me, I reward them accordingly. Everyone follows My path in all respects, O son of Pṛthā."

lines: se pratijñā bhaṅga haila gopīra bhajane
devanagari: से प्रतिज्ञा भङ्ग हैल गोपीर भजने ।
ताहाते प्रमाण कृष्ण - श्री - मुख - वचने ॥179॥
cc-adi-4.179.translation: That promise has been broken by the worship of the gopīs, as Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself admits.

lines: tāra preme vaśa āmi nā ha-i adhīna
devanagari: आमारे ईश्वर माने, आपनाके हीन ।
तार प्रेमे वश आमि ना हइ अधीन ॥18॥
cc-adi-4.18.translation: "If one regards Me as the Supreme Lord and himself as a subordinate, I do not become subservient to his love, nor can it control Me.

devanagari: न पारयेऽहं निरवद्य - संयुजां स्व - साधु - कृत्यं विबुधायुषापि वः ।
या माभजन्दुर्जय - गेह - शृङ्खलाः संवृश्च्य तद्वः प्रतियातु साधुना ॥180॥
cc-adi-4.180.translation: "O gopīs, I am not able to repay My debt for your spotless service, even within a lifetime of Brahmā. Your connection with Me is beyond reproach. You have worshiped Me, cutting off all domestic ties, which are difficult to break. Therefore please let your own glorious deeds be your compensation."

lines: tabe ye dekhiye gopīra nija-dehe prīta
seho ta' kṛṣṇera lāgi, jāniha niścita
devanagari: तबे ग्ने देखिये गोपीर निज - देहे प्रीत ।
सेहो त’ कृष्णेर लागि, जानिह निश्चित ॥181॥
cc-adi-4.181.translation: Now, whatever affection we see the gopīs show in their own bodies, know it for certain to be only for the sake of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ‘एइ देह कैलॆ आमि कृष्णे समर्पण ।
ताँर धन ताँर इहा सम्भोग - साधन ॥182॥
cc-adi-4.182.translation: [The gopīs think:] "I have offered this body to Lord Kṛṣṇa. He is its owner, and it brings Him enjoyment.

devanagari: ए - देह - दर्शन - स्पर्शे कृष्ण - सन्तोष ण’ ।
एइ ला गि’ करे देहेर मार्जन - भूषण ॥183॥
cc-adi-4.183.translation: "Kṛṣṇa finds joy in seeing and touching this body." It is for this reason that they cleanse and decorate their bodies.

devanagari: निजाङ्गमपि या गोप्यो ममेति समुपासते ।
ताभ्यः परं न मे पार्थ निगूढ़ - प्रेम - भाजनम् ॥184॥
cc-adi-4.184.translation: "O Arjuna, there are no greater receptacles of deep love for Me than the gopīs, who cleanse and decorate their bodies because they consider them Mine."

devanagari: आर एक अद्भुत गोपी - भावेर स्व भाव ।
बुद्धिर गोचर नहे याहार प्रभाव ॥185॥
cc-adi-4.185.translation: There is another wonderful feature of the emotion of the gopīs. Its power is beyond the comprehension of the intelligence.

devanagari: गोपी - गण करे यबे कृष्ण - दरशन ।
सुख - वाञ्छा नाहि, सुख हय कोटि - गुण ॥186॥
cc-adi-4.186.translation: When the gopīs see Lord Kṛṣṇa, they derive unbounded bliss, although they have no desire for such pleasure.

devanagari: गोपीका - दर्शने कृष्णेर ये आनन्द हय ।
ताहा हैते कोटि - गुण गोपी आस्वादय ॥187॥
cc-adi-4.187.translation: The gopīs taste a pleasure ten million times greater than the pleasure Lord Kṛṣṇa derives from seeing them.

devanagari: ताँ सबार नाहि निज - सुख - अनुरोध ।
तथापि बाढ़ये सुख, पड़िल विरोध ॥188॥
cc-adi-4.188.translation: The gopīs have no inclination for their own enjoyment, and yet their joy increases. That is indeed a contradiction.

lines: e virodhera eka mātra dekhi samādhāna
devanagari: ए विरोधेर एक मात्र देखि समाधान ।
गोपिकार सुख कृष्ण - सुखे पर्यवसान ॥189॥
cc-adi-4.189.translation: For this contradiction I see only one solution: the joy of the gopīs lies in the joy of their beloved Kṛṣṇa.

lines: āmāke ta' ye ye bhakta bhaje yei bhāve
tāre se se bhāve bhaji,—e mora svabhāve
devanagari: आमाके त’ ये ये भक्त भजे येइ भावे ।
तारे से से भावे भजि , - ए मोर स्वभावे ॥19॥
cc-adi-4.19.translation: "In whatever transcendental mellow My devotee worships Me, I reciprocate with him. That is My natural behavior.

lines: se mādhurya bāḍhe yāra nāhika samatā
devanagari: गोपिका - दर्शने कृष्णेर बाढ़ प्रफुल्लता ।
से माधुर्य बाढ़े यार नाहिक समता ॥190॥
cc-adi-4.190.translation: When Lord Kṛṣṇa sees the gopīs, His joy increases, and His unparalleled sweetness increases also.

lines: āmāra darśane kṛṣṇa pāila eta sukha
devanagari: आमार दर्शने कृष्ण पाइल एत सुख ।
एइ सुखे गोपीर प्रफुल्ल अङ्ग - मुख ॥191॥
cc-adi-4.191.translation: [The gopīs think:] "Kṛṣṇa has obtained so much pleasure by seeing me." That thought increases the fullness and beauty of their faces and bodies.

lines: gopī-śobhā dekhi' kṛṣṇera śobhā bāḍhe yata
kṛṣṇa-śobhā dekhi' gopīra śobhā bāḍhe tata
devanagari: गोपी - शोभा दे खि’ कृष्णेर शोभा बाढ़े यत ।
कृष्ण - शोभा दे खि’ गोपीर शोभा बाढ़े तत ॥192॥
cc-adi-4.192.translation: The beauty of Lord Kṛṣṇa increases at the sight of the beauty of the gopīs. And the more the gopīs see Lord Kṛṣṇa's beauty, the more their beauty increases.

lines: paraspara bāḍhe, keha mukha nāhi muḍi
devanagari: एइ - मत परस्पर पड़े हुड़ाहुड़ि ।
परस्पर बाढ़े, केह मुख नाहि मुड़ि ॥193॥
cc-adi-4.193.translation: In this way a competition takes place between them in which no one acknowledges defeat.

devanagari: किन्तु कृष्णेर सुख हय गोपी - रूप - गुणे ।
ताँर सुखे सुख - वृद्धि हये गोपी - गणे ॥194॥
cc-adi-4.194.translation: Kṛṣṇa, however, derives pleasure from the beauty and good qualities of the gopīs. And when the gopīs see His pleasure, the joy of the gopīs increases.

devanagari: अतएव सेइ सुख कृष्ण - सुख पोखे ।
एइ हेतु गोपी - प्रेमे नाहि काम - दोषे ॥195॥
cc-adi-4.195.translation: Therefore we find that the joy of the gopīs nourishes the joy of Lord Kṛṣṇa. For that reason the fault of lust is not present in their love.

devanagari: उपेत्य पथि सुन्दरी - ततिभिराभिरभ्यर्चितं स्मिताङ्कर - करम्बितैर्नटदपाङ्ग - भङ्गी - शतैः ।
स्तन - स्तवक - सञ्चरन्नयन - चञ्चरीकाञ्चलं व्रजे विजयिनं भजे विपिन - देशतः केशवम् ॥196॥
cc-adi-4.196.translation: "I worship Lord Keśava. Coming back from the forest of Vraja, He is worshiped by the gopīs, who mount the roofs of their palaces and meet Him on the path with a hundred manners of dancing glances and gentle smiles. The corners of His eyes wander, like large black bees, around the gopīs' breasts."

devanagari: आर एक गोपी - प्रेमेर स्वाभाविक चिह्न ।
ये प्रकारे हय प्रेम काम - गन्ध - हीन ॥197॥
cc-adi-4.197.translation: There is another natural symptom of the gopīs' love that shows it to be without a trace of lust.

devanagari: गोपी - प्रेमे करे कृष्ण - माधुर्येर पुष्टि ।
माधुयें बाढ़ाय प्रेम हञा महा - तुष्टि ॥198॥
cc-adi-4.198.translation: The love of the gopīs nourishes the sweetness of Lord Kṛṣṇa. That sweetness in turn increases their love, for they are greatly satisfied.

devanagari: प्रीति - विषयानन्दे तदाश्रयानन्द ।
ताँहा नाहि निज - सुख - वाञ्छार सम्बन्ध ॥199॥
cc-adi-4.199.translation: The happiness of the abode of love is in the happiness of the object of that love. This is not a relationship of desire for personal gratification.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-4.2.translation: All glory to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. All glory to Lord Nityānanda. All glory to Śrī Advaita Ācārya. And all glory to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya.

devanagari: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम् ।
मम वत्मनुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥20॥
cc-adi-4.20.translation: “ 'In whatever way My devotees surrender unto Me, I reward him accordingly. Everyone follows My path in all respects, O son of Pṛthā.'

lines: nirupādhi prema yāṅhā, tāṅhā ei rīti
devanagari: निरुपाधि प्रेम याँहा, ताँहा एइ रीति ।
प्रीति - विषय - सुखे आश्रयेर प्रीति ॥200॥
cc-adi-4.200-201.translation: Whenever there is unselfish love, that is its style. The reservoir of love derives pleasure when the lovable object is pleased. When the pleasure of love interferes with the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the devotee becomes angry toward such ecstasy.

devanagari: अङ्ग - स्तम्भारम्भमुत्तुङ्गयन्तं प्रेमानन्दं दारुको नाभ्यनन्दत् ।
कंसारातेजने येन साक्षाद् अक्षोदीयानन्तरायो व्यधायि ॥202॥
cc-adi-4.202.translation: "Śrī Dāruka did not relish his ecstatic feelings of love, for they caused his limbs to become stunned and thus obstructed his service of fanning Lord Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: गोविन्द - प्रेक्षणाक्षेपि - बाष्प - पूराभिवर्षिणम् ।
उच्चैरनिन्ददानन्दमरविन्द - विलोचना ॥203॥
cc-adi-4.203.translation: "The lotus-eyed Rādhārāṇī powerfully condemned the ecstatic love that caused a flow of tears that hindered Her sight of Govinda."

devanagari: आर शुद्ध - भक्त कृष्ण - प्रेम - सेवा विने ।
स्व - सुखार्थ सालोक्यादि ना करे ग्रहणे ॥204॥
cc-adi-4.204.translation: Furthermore, pure devotees never forsake the loving service of Lord Kṛṣṇa to aspire for their own personal pleasure through the five kinds of liberation.

devanagari: मद्गुण - श्रुति - मात्रेण मयि सर्व - गुहाशये ।
मनो - गतिरविच्छिन्ना यथा गङ्गाम्भसोऽम्बुधौ ॥205॥
cc-adi-4.205.translation: "Just as the celestial waters of the Ganges flow unobstructed into the ocean, so when My devotees simply hear of Me, their minds come to Me, who resides in the hearts of all.

devanagari: लक्षणं भक्ति - योगस्य निर्गुणस्य ह्युदाहृतम् ।
अहैतुक्यव्यवहिता या भक्तिः पुरुषोत्तमे ॥206॥
cc-adi-4.206.translation: "These are the characteristics of transcendental loving service to Puruṣottama, the Supreme Personality of Godhead: it is causeless, and it cannot be obstructed in any way.

devanagari: सालोक्य - सार्टि - सारूप्य - सामीप्यैकत्व मप्युत ।
दीयमानं न गृह्णन्ति विना मत्सेवनं जनाः ॥207॥
cc-adi-4.207.translation: "My devotees do not accept sālokya, sārṣṭi, sārūpya, sāmīpya or oneness with Me-even if I offer these liberations-in preference to serving Me."

devanagari: मत्सेवया प्रतीतं ते सालोक्यादि - चतुष्टयम् ।
नेच्छन्ति सेवया पूर्णाः कुतोऽन्यत्काल - विप्लुतम् ॥208॥
cc-adi-4.208.translation: "My devotees, having fulfilled their desires by serving Me, do not accept the four kinds of salvation that are easily earned by such service. Why then should they accept any pleasures that are lost in the course of time?"

lines: nirmala, ujjvala, śuddha yena dagdha hema
devanagari: काम - गन्ध - हीन स्वाभाविक गोपी - प्रेम ।
निर्मल, उज्वल, शुद्ध येन दग्ध हेम ॥209॥
cc-adi-4.209.translation: The natural love of the gopīs is devoid of any trace of lust. It is faultless, bright and pure, like molten gold.

lines: mora putra, mora sakhā, mora prāṇa-pati
devanagari: मोर पुत्र, मोर सखा, मोर प्राण - पति ।
एइ - भावे येइ मोरे करे शुद्ध - भक्ति ॥21॥
cc-adi-4.21-22.translation: "If one cherishes pure loving devotion to Me, thinking of Me as his son, his friend or his beloved, regarding himself as great and considering Me his equal or inferior, I become subordinate to him.

lines: gopikā hayena priyā śiṣyā, sakhī dāsī
devanagari: कृष्णेर सहाय, गुरु, बान्धव, प्रेयसी ।
गोपिका हयेन प्रिया शिष्या, सखी दासी ॥210॥
cc-adi-4.210.translation: The gopīs are the helpers, teachers, friends, wives, dear disciples, confidantes and serving maids of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: सहाया गुरवः शिष्या भुजिष्या बान्धवाः स्त्रियः ।
सत्यं वदामि ते पार्थ गोप्यः किं मे भवन्ति न ॥211॥
cc-adi-4.211.translation: "O Pārtha, I speak to you the truth. The gopīs are My helpers, teachers, disciples, servants, friends and consorts. I do not know what they are not to Me."

devanagari: गोपिका जानेन कृष्णेर मनेर वाञ्छित ।
प्रेम - सेवा - परिपाटी, इष्ट - समीहित ॥212॥
cc-adi-4.212.translation: The gopīs know Kṛṣṇa's desires, and they know how to render perfect loving service for His enjoyment. They perform their service expertly for the satisfaction of their beloved.

devanagari: मन्माहात्म्यं मत्सपर्या मच्छुद्धां मन्मनो - गतम् ।
जानन्ति गोपिकाः पार्थ नान्ये जानन्ति तत्त्वतः ॥213॥
cc-adi-4.213.translation: "O Pārtha, the gopīs know My greatness, My loving service, respect for Me, and My mentality. Others cannot really know these."

devanagari: सेइ गोपी - गण - मध्ये उत्तमा राधिका ।
रूपे, गुणे, सौभाग्ये, प्रेमे सर्वाधिका ॥214॥
cc-adi-4.214.translation: Among the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhikā is the foremost. She surpasses all in beauty, in good qualities, in good fortune and, above all, in love.

devanagari: यथा राधा प्रिया विष्णोस्तस्याः कुण्डं प्रियं तथा ।
सर्व - गोपीषु सैवैका विष्णोरत्यन्त - वल्लभा ॥215॥
cc-adi-4.215.translation: "Just as Rādhā is dear to Lord Kṛṣṇa, so Her bathing place [Rādhā-kuṇḍa] is dear to Him. She alone is His most beloved of all the gopīs."

devanagari: त्रैलोक्ये पृथिवी धन्या ग्रत्र वृन्दावनं पुरी ।
तत्रापि गोपिकाः पार्थ यत्र राधाभिधा मम ॥216॥
cc-adi-4.216.translation: "O Pārtha, in all the three planetary systems, this earth is especially fortunate, for on earth is the town of Vṛndāvana. And there the gopīs are especially glorious because among them is My Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī."

devanagari: राधा - सह क्रीड़ा रस - वृद्धिर कारण ।
आर सब गोपी - गण रसोपकरण ॥217॥
cc-adi-4.217.translation: All the other gopīs help increase the joy of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes with Rādhārāṇī. The gopīs act as the instruments of Their mutual enjoyment.

devanagari: कृष्णेर वल्लभा राधा कृष्ण - प्राण - धन ।
ताँहा विनु सुख - हेतु नहे गोपी - गण ॥218॥
cc-adi-4.218.translation: Rādhā is the beloved consort of Kṛṣṇa, and She is the wealth of His life. Without Her, the gopīs cannot give Him pleasure.

devanagari: कंसारिरपि संसार - वासना - बद्ध - शृङ्खलाम् ।
राधामाधाय हृदये तत्याज व्रज - सुन्दरीः ॥219॥
cc-adi-4.219.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of Kaṁsa, left aside the other gopīs during the rāsa dance and took Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī to His heart, for She is the helper of the Lord in realizing the essence of His desires."

devanagari: सेइ राधार भाव लञा चैतन्यावतार ।
युग - धर्म नाम - प्रेम कैल परचार ॥220॥
cc-adi-4.220.translation: Lord Caitanya appeared with the sentiment of Rādhā. He preached the dharma of this age—the chanting of the holy name and pure love of God.

devanagari: सेइ भावे निज - वाञ्छा करिल पूरण ।
अवतारेर एइ वाञ्छा मूल कारण ॥221॥
cc-adi-4.221.translation: In the mood of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, He also fulfilled His own desires. This is the principal reason for His appearance.

devanagari: श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य गोसाञि व्रजेन्द्रकुमार ।
रस - मय - मूर्ति कृष्ण साक्षात्शृङ्गार ॥222॥
cc-adi-4.222.translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is Kṛṣṇa [Vrajendra-kumāra], the embodiment of rasas. He is amorous love personified.

devanagari: सेइ रस आस्वादिते कैल अवतार ।
आनुसङ्गे कैल सब रसेर प्रचार ॥223॥
cc-adi-4.223.translation: He made His appearance to taste that conjugal mellow and incidentally to broadcast all the rasas.

lines: śṛṅgāraḥ sakhi mūrtimān iva madhau mugdho hariḥ krīḍati
devanagari: विश्वेषामनुरञ्जनेन जनयन्नानन्दमिन्दीवर - श्रेणी - श्यामल - कोमलैरुपनयन्नङ्गैरनङ्गोत्सवम् ।
स्वच्छन्दं व्रज - सुन्दरीभिरभितः प्रत्यङ्गमालिङ्गितः शृङ्गारः सखि मूर्तिमानिव मधौ मुग्धो हरिः क्रीड़ति ॥224॥
cc-adi-4.224.translation: "My dear friends, just see how Śrī Kṛṣṇa is enjoying the season of spring! With the gopīs embracing each of His limbs, He is like amorous love personified. With His transcendental pastimes, He enlivens all the gopīs and the entire creation. With His soft bluish-black arms and legs, which resemble blue lotus flowers, He has created a festival for Cupid."

devanagari: श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य गोसाञि रसेर सदन ।
अशेष - विशेषे कैल रस आस्वादन ॥225॥
cc-adi-4.225.translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is the abode of rasa. He Himself tasted the sweetness of rasa in endless ways.

lines: caitanyera dāse jāne ei saba marma
devanagari: सेइ द्वारे प्रवर्ताइल कलि - युग - धर्म ।
चैतन्येर दासे जाने एइ सब मर्म ॥226॥
cc-adi-4.226.translation: Thus He initiated the dharma for the Age of Kali. The devotees of Lord Caitanya know all these truths.

devanagari: अद्वैत आचार्य, नित्यानन्द, श्रीनिवास ।
गदाधर, दामोदर, मुरारि, हरिदास ॥227॥
cc-adi-4.227-228.translation: Advaita Ācārya, Nityānanda, Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita, Gadādhara, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Murāri Gupta, Haridāsa and all the other devotees of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya—bowing down with devotion, I hold their lotus feet on my head.

lines: mūla ślokera artha śuna kariye prakāśa
devanagari: षष्ठ - श्लोकेर एइ कहिल आभास ।
मूल श्लोकेर अर्थ शुन करिये प्रकाश ॥229॥
cc-adi-4.229.translation: I have given a hint of the sixth verse. Now please hear as I reveal the meaning of that original verse.

devanagari: मयि भक्तिर्हि भूतानाममृतत्वाय कल्पते ।
दिष्ट्या यदासीन्मत्स्नेहो भवतीनां मदापनः ॥23॥
cc-adi-4.23.translation: “ 'Devotional service rendered to Me by the living beings revives their eternal life. O My dear damsels of Vraja, your affection for Me is your good fortune, for it is the only means by which you have obtained My favor.'

lines: saukhyaṁ cāsyā mad-anubhavataḥ kīdṛśaṁ veti lobhāt
devanagari: श्री - राधायाः प्रणय - महिमा कीदृशो वानयैवा - स्वाद्यो ग्रेनाद्भुत - मधुरिमा कीदृशो वा मदीयः ।
सौख्यं चास्या मदनुभवतः कीदृशं वेति लोभात् तद्भावाढ्यः समजनि शची - गर्भ - सिन्धौ हरीन्दुः ॥230॥
cc-adi-4.230.translation: "Desiring to understand the glory of Rādhārāṇī's love, the wonderful qualities in Him that She alone relishes through Her love, and the happiness She feels when She realizes the sweetness of His love, the Supreme Lord Hari, richly endowed with Her emotions, appears from the womb of Śrīmatī Śacīdevī, as the moon appeared from the ocean."

lines: e saba siddhānta gūḍha,—kahite nā yuyāya
nā kahile, keha ihāra anta nāhi pāya
devanagari: ए सब सिद्धान्त गूढ़, - कहिते ना युयाय ।
ना कहिले, केह इहार अन्त नाहि पाय ॥231॥
cc-adi-4.231.translation: All these conclusions are unfit to disclose in public. But if they are not disclosed, no one will understand them.

lines: bujhibe rasika bhakta, nā bujhibe mūḍha
devanagari: अतएव कहि किछु करिजा निगूढ़ ।
बुझिबे रसिक भक्त, ना बुझिबे मूढ़ ॥232॥
cc-adi-4.232.translation: Therefore I shall mention them, revealing only their essence, so that loving devotees will understand them but fools will not.

devanagari: हृदये धरये ये चैतन्य - नित्यानन्द ।
ए - सब सिद्धान्ते सेइ पाइबे आनन्द ॥233॥
cc-adi-4.233.translation: Anyone who has captured Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu in his heart will become blissful by hearing all these transcendental conclusions.

lines: e saba siddhānta haya āmrera pallava
devanagari: ए सब सिद्धान्त हय आमेर पल्लव ।
भक्त - गण - कोकिलेर सर्वदा व ल्लभ ॥234॥
cc-adi-4.234.translation: All these conclusions are like the newly grown twigs of a mango tree; they are always pleasing to the devotees, who in this way resemble cuckoo birds.

devanagari: अभक्त - उष्टेर इथे ना हय प्रवेश ।
तबे चित्ते हय मोर आनन्द - विशेष ॥235॥
cc-adi-4.235.translation: The camellike nondevotees cannot enter into these topics. Therefore there is special jubilation in my heart.

lines: ye lāgi kahite bhaya, se yadi nā jāne
ihā va-i kibā sukha āche tribhuvane
devanagari: ये लागि कहिते भय, से यदि ना जाने ।
इहा वइ किबा सुख आछे त्रिभुवने ॥236॥
cc-adi-4.236.translation: For fear of them I do not wish to speak, but if they do not understand, then what can be happier in all the three worlds?

devanagari: अतएव भक्त - गणे करि नमस्कार ।
निःशङ्के कहिये, तार हौक्चमत्कार ॥237॥
cc-adi-4.237.translation: Therefore after offering obeisances to the devotees, for their satisfaction I shall speak without hesitating.

devanagari: कृष्णेर विचार एक आछये अन्तरे ।
पूर्णानन्द - पूर्ण - रस - रूप कहे मोरे ॥238॥
cc-adi-4.238.translation: Once Lord Kṛṣṇa considered within His heart, "Everyone says that I am complete bliss, full of all rasas.

devanagari: आमा हइते आनन्दित हय त्रिभुवन ।
आमाके आनन्द दिबे - ऐछे कोन्जन ॥239॥
cc-adi-4.239.translation: "All the world derives pleasure from Me. Is there anyone who can give Me pleasure?

devanagari: माता मोरे पुत्र - भावे करेन बन्धन ।
अतिहीन - ज्ञाने करे लालन पालन ॥24॥
cc-adi-4.24.translation: "Mother sometimes binds Me as her son. She nourishes and protects Me, thinking Me utterly helpless.

lines: āmā haite yāra haya śata śata guṇa
devanagari: आमा हैते यार हय शत शत गुण ।
सेइ - जन आह्लादिते पारे मोर मन ॥240॥
cc-adi-4.240.translation: "One who has a hundred times more qualities than Me could give pleasure to My mind.

lines: āmā haite guṇī baḍa jagate asambhava
devanagari: आमा हैते गुणी बड़ जगते असम्भव ।
एकलि राधाते ताहा करि अनुभव ॥241॥
cc-adi-4.241.translation: "One more qualified than Me is impossible to find in the world. But in Rādhā alone I feel the presence of one who can give Me pleasure.

devanagari: कोटि - काम जि नि’ रूप यद्यपि आमार ।
असमोर्ध्व - माधुर्घ - साम्य नाहि झार ॥242॥
cc-adi-4.242-243.translation: "Although My beauty defeats the beauty of ten million Cupids, although it is unequaled and unsurpassed and although it gives pleasure to the three worlds, seeing Rādhārāṇī gives pleasure to My eyes.

devanagari: मोर वंशी - गीते आकर्षये त्रिभुवन ।
राधार वचने हरे आमार श्रवण ॥244॥
cc-adi-4.244.translation: "The vibration of My transcendental flute attracts the three worlds, but My ears are enchanted by the sweet words of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

devanagari: यद्यपि आमार गन्धे जगत्सुगन्ध ।
मोर चित्त - प्राण हरे राधा - अङ्ग - गन्ध ॥245॥
cc-adi-4.245.translation: "Although My body lends fragrance to the entire creation, the scent of Rādhārāṇī's limbs captivates My mind and heart.

devanagari: यद्यपि आमार रसे जगत्सरस ।
राधार अधर - रस आमा करे वश ॥246॥
cc-adi-4.246.translation: "Although the entire creation is full of different tastes because of Me, I am charmed by the nectarean taste of the lips of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

devanagari: यद्यपि आमार स्पर्श कोटीन्दु - शीतल ।
राधिकार स्पर्शे आमा करे सुशीतल ॥247॥
cc-adi-4.247.translation: "And although My touch is cooler than ten million moons, I am refreshed by the touch of Śrīmatī Rādhikā.

lines: ei mata jagatera sukhe āmi hetu
devanagari: एइ मत जगतेर सुखे आमि हेतु ।
राधिकार रूप - गुण आमार जीवातु ॥248॥
cc-adi-4.248.translation: "Thus although I am the source for the happiness of the entire world, the beauty and attributes of Śrī Rādhikā are My life and soul.

devanagari: एइ मत अनुभव आमार प्रतीत ।
विचारि’ देखिये यदि, सब विपरीत ॥249॥
cc-adi-4.249.translation: "In this way My affectionate feelings for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī may be understood, but on analysis I find them contradictory.

lines: tumi kon baḍa loka,—tumi āmi sama
devanagari: सखा शुद्ध - सख्ये करे, स्कन्धे आरोहण ।
तुमि कोन्बड़ लोक, - तुमि आमि सम ॥25॥
cc-adi-4.25.translation: "My friends climb on My shoulders in pure friendship, saying, 'What kind of big man are You? You and I are equal.'

devanagari: राधार दर्शने मोर जुड़ाय नयन ।
आमार दर्शने राधा सुखे अगेयान ॥250॥
cc-adi-4.250.translation: "My eyes are fully satisfied when I look upon Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, but by looking upon Me, She becomes even more advanced in satisfaction.

devanagari: परस्पर वेणु - गीते हरये चेतन ।
मोर भ्रमे तमालेरे करे आलिङ्गन ॥251॥
cc-adi-4.251.translation: "The flutelike murmur of the bamboos rubbing against one another steals Rādhārāṇī's consciousness, for She thinks it to be the sound of My flute. And She embraces a tamāla tree, mistaking it for Me.

lines: kṛṣṇa-sukhe magna rahe vṛkṣa kari' kole
devanagari: कृष्ण - आलिङ्गन पाइनु, जनम सफले ।
कृष्ण - सुखे मग्न रहे वृक्ष करि’ कोले ॥252॥
cc-adi-4.252.translation: “ 'I have gotten the embrace of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,' She thinks, 'so now My life is fulfilled.' Thus She remains immersed in pleasing Kṛṣṇa, taking the tree in Her arms.

lines: uḍiyā paḍite cāhe, preme haya andha
devanagari: अनुकूल - वाते यदि पाय मोर गन्ध ।
उड़िया पड़िते चाहे, प्रेमे हय अन्ध ॥253॥
cc-adi-4.253.translation: "When a favorable breeze carries to Her the fragrance of My body, She is blinded by love and tries to fly into that breeze.

devanagari: ताम्बूल - चर्वित यबे करे आस्वादने ।
आनन्द - समुद्रे डुबे, किछुइ ना जाने ॥254॥
cc-adi-4.254.translation: "When She tastes the betel chewed by Me, She merges in an ocean of joy and forgets everything else.

lines: āmāra saṅgame rādhā pāya ye ānanda
śata-mukhe bali, tabu nā pāi tāra anta
devanagari: आमार सङ्गमे राधा पाय ग्ने आनन्द ।
शत - मुखे बलि, तबु ना पाई तार अन्त ॥255॥
cc-adi-4.255.translation: "Even with hundreds of mouths I could not express the transcendental pleasure She derives from My association.

lines: tāhā dekhi' sukhe āmi āpanā pāśari
devanagari: लीला - अन्ते सुखे इँहार अङ्गेर माधुरी ।
ताहा दे खि’ सुखे आमि आपना पाशरि ॥256॥
cc-adi-4.256.translation: "Seeing the luster of Her complexion after Our pastimes together, I forget My own identity in happiness.

lines: āmāra vrajera rasa seha nāhi jāne
devanagari: दोहार ये सम - रस, भरत - मुनि माने ।
आमार व्रजेर रस सेह नाहि जाने ॥257॥
cc-adi-4.257.translation: "The sage Bharata has said that the mellows of lover and beloved are equal. But he does not know the mellows of My Vṛndāvana.

lines: anyera saṅgame āmi yata sukha pāi
devanagari: अन्येर सङ्गमे आमि व्रत सुख पाइ ।
ताहा हैते राधा - सुख शत अधिकाइ ॥258॥
cc-adi-4.258.translation: "The happiness I feel when meeting Rādhārāṇī is a hundred times greater than the happiness I get from meeting others."

lines: tvām āsādya mamedam indriya-kulaṁ rādhe muhur modate
devanagari: निर्भूतामृत - माधुरी - परिमलः कल्याणि बिम्बाधरो वक्त्रं पङ्कज - सौरभं कुहरित - श्लाघा - भिदस्ते गिरः ।
अङ्गं चन्दन - शीतलं तनुरियं सौन्दर्य - सर्वस्व - भाक् त्वामासाद्य ममेदमिन्द्रिय - कुलं राधे मुहुर्मोदते ॥259॥
cc-adi-4.259.translation: "My dear auspicious Rādhārāṇī, Your body is the source of all beauty. Your red lips are softer than the sense of immortal sweetness, Your face bears the aroma of a lotus flower, Your sweet words defeat the vibrations of the cuckoo, and Your limbs are cooler than the pulp of sandalwood. All My transcendental senses are overwhelmed in ecstatic pleasure by tasting You, who are completely decorated by beautiful qualities."

lines: priyā yadi māna kari' karaye bhartsana
veda-stuti haite hare sei mora mana
devanagari: प्रिया यदि मान क रि’ करये भर्सन ।
वेद - स्तुति हैते हरे सेइ मोर मन ॥26॥
cc-adi-4.26.translation: "If My beloved consort reproaches Me in a sulky mood, that steals My mind from the reverent hymns of the Vedas.

devanagari: रूपे कंस - हरस्य लुब्ध - नयनां स्पर्शेऽतिहृष्यत्त्वचं वाण्यामुत्कलित - श्रुतिं परिमले संछ - नासा - पुटाम् ।
आरज्यद्रसनां किलाधर - पुटे न्यञ्चन्मुखाम्भोरुहां दम्भोगीर्ण - महा - धृतिं बहिरपि प्रोद्यद्विकाराकुलाम् ॥260॥
cc-adi-4.260.translation: "Her eyes are enchanted by the beauty of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of Kaṁsa. Her body thrills in pleasure at His touch. Her ears are always attracted to His sweet voice, Her nostrils are enchanted by His fragrance, and Her tongue hankers for the nectar of His soft lips. She hangs down her lotuslike face, exercising self-control only by pretense, but She cannot help showing the external signs of Her spontaneous love for Lord Kṛṣṇa."

lines: tāte jāni, mote āche kona eka rasa
āmāra mohinī rādhā, tāre kare vaśa
devanagari: ताते जानि, मोते आछे कोन एक रस ।
आमार मोहिनी राधा, तारे करे वश ॥261॥
cc-adi-4.261.translation: "Considering this, I can understand that some unknown mellow in Me controls the entire existence of My captivator, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

lines: āmā haite rādhā pāya ye jātīya sukha
devanagari: आमा हैते राधा पाय ये जातीय सुख ।
ताहा आस्वादिते आमि सदाइ उन्मुख ॥262॥
cc-adi-4.262.translation: "I am always eager to taste the joy that Rādhārāṇī derives from Me.

lines: nānā yatna kari āmi, nāri āsvādite
devanagari: नाना यत्न करि आमि, नारि आस्वादिते ।
सेइ सुख - माधुर्य - घ्राणे लोभ बाढ़ चित्ते ॥263॥
cc-adi-4.263.translation: "In spite of various efforts, I have not been able to taste it. But My desire to relish that pleasure increases as I smell its sweetness.

devanagari: रस आस्वादिते आमि कैल अवतार ।
प्रेम - रस आस्वादिल विविध प्रकार ॥264॥
cc-adi-4.264.translation: "I have appeared in the world to taste mellows. I shall taste the mellows of pure love in various ways.

lines: rāga-mārge bhakta bhakti kare ye prakāre
devanagari: राग - मार्गे भक्त भक्ति करे ये प्रकारे ।
ताहा शिखाइल लीला - आचरण - द्वारे ॥265॥
cc-adi-4.265.translation: "I shall teach devotional service, which springs from the spontaneous love of the devotees, by demonstrating it Myself with My pastimes.

lines: ei tina tṛṣṇā mora nahila pūraṇa
devanagari: एइ तिन तृष्णा मोर नहिल पूरण ।
विजातीय - भावे नहे ताहा आस्वादन ॥266॥
cc-adi-4.266.translation: "But these three desires have not been satisfied, for one cannot enjoy them in a contrary position.

lines: sei tina sukha kabhu nahe āsvādane
devanagari: राधिकार भाव - कान्ति अङ्गीकार विने ।
सेइ तिन सुख कभु नहे आस्वादने ॥267॥
cc-adi-4.267.translation: "Unless I accept the luster of the ecstatic love of Śrī Rādhikā, these three desires cannot be fulfilled.

devanagari: राधा - भाव अङ्गीकरि’ धरि’ तार वर्ण ।
तिन - सुख आस्वादिते हब अवतीर्ण ॥268॥
cc-adi-4.268.translation: "Therefore, assuming Rādhārāṇī's sentiments and bodily complexion, I shall descend to fulfill these three desires."

lines: sarva-bhāve kaila kṛṣṇa ei ta' niścaya
devanagari: सर्व - भावे कैल कृष्ण एइ त निश्चय ।
हेन - काले आइल युगावतार - समय ॥269॥
cc-adi-4.269.translation: In this way Lord Kṛṣṇa came to a decision. Simultaneously, the time came for the incarnation of the age.

devanagari: एइ शुद्ध - भक्त लञा करिमु अवतार ।
करिब विविध - विध अद्भुत विहार ॥27॥
cc-adi-4.27-28.translation: "Taking these pure devotees with Me, I shall descend and sport in various wonderful ways, unknown even in Vaikuṇṭha. I shall broadcast such pastimes by which even I am amazed.

devanagari: सेइ - काले श्री - अद्वैत करेन आराधन ।
ताँहार हुङ्कारे कैल कृष्णे आकर्षण ॥270॥
cc-adi-4.270.translation: At that time Śrī Advaita was earnestly worshiping Him. Advaita attracted Him with His loud calls.

devanagari: पिता - माता, गुरु - गण, आगे अवता रि’ ।
राधिकार भाव - वर्ण अङ्गीकार करि’ ॥271॥
cc-adi-4.271-272.translation: First Lord Kṛṣṇa made His parents and elders appear. Then Kṛṣṇa Himself, with the sentiments and complexion of Rādhikā, appeared in Navadvīpa, like the full moon, from the womb of mother Śacī, which is like an ocean of pure milk.

lines: ei ta' kariluṅ ṣaṣṭha ślokera vyākhyāna
devanagari: एइ त’ करिलुँ षष्ठ श्लोकेर व्याख्यान ।
श्री - रूप - गोसाञि र पाद - पद्म क रि’ ध्यान ॥273॥
cc-adi-4.273.translation: Meditating on the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī, I have thus explained the sixth verse.

lines: ei dui ślokera āmi ye karila artha
devanagari: एइ दुइ श्लोकेर आमि ये करिल अर्थ ।
श्री - रूप - गोसाञि र श्लोक प्रमाण समर्थ ॥274॥
cc-adi-4.274.translation: I can support the explanation of these two verses [verses 5 and 6 of the First Chapter] with Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī's verse.

lines: rasa-stomaṁ hṛtvā madhuram upabhoktuṁ kam api yaḥ
rucaṁ svām āvavre dyutim iha tadīyāṁ prakaṭayan
sa devaś caitanyākṛtir atitarāṁ naḥ kṛpayatu
devanagari: अपारं कस्यापि प्रणयि - जन - वृन्दस्य कुतुकी रस - स्तोमं हृत्वा मधुरमुपभोक्तुं कमपि यः ।
रुचं स्वामावत्रे द्युतिमिह तदीयां प्रकटयन् स देवश्चैतन्याकृतिरतितरां नः कृपयतु ॥275॥
cc-adi-4.275.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa desired to taste the limitless nectarean mellows of the love of one of His multitude of loving damsels [Śrī Rādhā], and so He has assumed the form of Lord Caitanya. He has tasted that love while hiding His own dark complexion with Her effulgent yellow color. May that Lord Caitanya confer upon us His grace."

devanagari: मङ्गलाचरणं कृष्ण - चैतन्य - तत्त्व - लक्षणम् ।
प्रयोजनं चावतारे श्लोक - षट्कैर्निरूपितम् ॥276॥
cc-adi-4.276.translation: Thus the auspicious invocation, the essential nature of the truth of Lord Caitanya, and the need for His appearance have been set forth in six verses.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥277॥
