cc-adi-4.277.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: मो - विषये गोपी - गणेर उपपति - भावे ।
योग - माया करिबेक आपन - प्रभावे ॥29॥
cc-adi-4.29.translation: "The influence of yogamāyā will inspire the gopīs with the sentiment that I am their paramour.

devanagari: चतुर्थ श्लोकेर अर्थ कैल विवरण ।
पञ्चम श्लोकेर अर्थ शुन भक्त - गण ॥3॥
cc-adi-4.3.translation: I have described the meaning of the fourth verse. Now, O devotees, kindly hear the explanation of the fifth verse.

lines: āmiha nā jāni tāhā, nā jāne gopī-gaṇa
duṅhāra rūpa-guṇe duṅhāra nitya hare mana
devanagari: आमिह ना जानि ताहा, ना जाने गोपी - गण ।
दुँहार रूप - गुणे दुँहार नित्य ह रे मन ॥30॥
cc-adi-4.30.translation: "Neither the gopīs nor I shall notice this, for our minds will always be entranced by one another's beauty and qualities.

lines: dharma chāḍi' rāge duṅhe karaye milana
kabhu mile, kabhu nā mile,—daivera ghaṭana
devanagari: धर्म छा ड़ि’ रागे दुँहे करये मिलन ।
कभु मिले, कभु ना मिले, - दैवेर घटन ॥31॥
cc-adi-4.31.translation: "Pure attachment will unite us even at the expense of moral and religious duties [dharma]. Destiny will sometimes bring us together and sometimes separate us.

lines: ei dvāre kariba saba bhaktere prasāda
devanagari: एइ सब रस - निर्यास करिब आस्वाद ।
एइ द्वारे करिब सब भक्तेरे प्रसाद ॥32॥
cc-adi-4.32.translation: "I shall taste the essence of all these rasas, and in this way I shall favor all the devotees.

devanagari: व्रजेर निर्मल राग शुनि’ भक्त - गण ।
राग - मार्गे भजे येन छाड़ि’ धर्म - कर्म ॥33॥
cc-adi-4.33.translation: "Then, by hearing about the pure love of the residents of Vraja, devotees will worship Me on the path of spontaneous love, abandoning all rituals of religiosity and fruitive activity."

devanagari: अनुग्रहाय भक्तानां मानुषं देहमाश्रितः ।
भजते तादृशीः क्रीड़ा याः श्रुत्वा तत्परो भवेत् ॥34॥
cc-adi-4.34.translation: "Kṛṣṇa manifests His eternal humanlike form and performs His pastimes to show mercy to the devotees. Having heard such pastimes, one should engage in service to Him."

devanagari: ‘भवेत्’ क्रिया विधिलिं, सेइ इहा कय ।
कर्तव्य अवश्य एइ, अन्यथा प्रत्यवाय ॥35॥
cc-adi-4.35.translation: Here the use of the verb "bhavet," which is in the imperative mood, tells us that this certainly must be done. Noncompliance would be abandonment of duty.

devanagari: एइ वाञ्छा यैछे कृष्ण - प्राकट्य - कारण ।
असुर - संहार - आनुषङ्ग प्रयोजन ॥36॥
cc-adi-4.36-37.translation: Just as these desires are the fundamental reason for Kṛṣṇa's appearance whereas destroying the demons is only an incidental necessity, so for Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, promulgating the dharma of the age is incidental.

lines: kona kāraṇe yabe haila avatāre mana
devanagari: कोन कारणे यबे हैल अवतारे मन ।
युग - धर्म - काल हैल से काले मिलन ॥38॥
cc-adi-4.38.translation: When the Lord desired to appear for another reason, the time for promulgating the religion of the age also arose.

devanagari: दुइ हेतु अवतरि’ लञा भक्त - गण ।
आपने आस्वादे प्रेम - नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ॥39॥
cc-adi-4.39.translation: Thus with two intentions the Lord appeared with His devotees and tasted the nectar of prema with the congregational chanting of the holy name.

devanagari: मूल - श्लोकेर अर्थ करिते प्रकाश ।
अर्थ लागाइते आगे कहिये आभास ॥4॥
cc-adi-4.4.translation: Just to explain the original verse, I shall first suggest its meaning.

devanagari: सेइ द्वारे आचण्डाले कीर्तन सञ्चारे ।
नाम - प्रेम - माला गाँथि’ पराइल संसारे ॥40॥
cc-adi-4.40.translation: Thus He spread kīrtana even among the untouchables. He wove a wreath of the holy name and prema with which He garlanded the entire material world.

devanagari: एइ - मत भक्त - भाव क रि’ अङ्गीकार ।
आपनि आच रि’ भक्ति करिल प्रचार ॥41॥
cc-adi-4.41.translation: In this way, assuming the sentiment of a devotee, He preached devotional service while practicing it Himself.

lines: dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya, āra ye śṛṅgāra
devanagari: दास्य, सख्य, वात्सल्य, आर ये शृङ्गार ।
चारि प्रेम, चतुर्विध भक्त - इ आधार ॥42॥
cc-adi-4.42.translation: Four kinds of devotees are the receptacles of the four kinds of mellows in love of God, namely servitude, friendship, parental affection and conjugal love.

lines: nija nija bhāva sabe śreṣṭha kari' māne
devanagari: निज निज भाव सबे श्रेष्ठ क रि’ माने ।
निज - भावे करे कृष्ण - सुख आस्वादने ॥43॥
cc-adi-4.43.translation: Each kind of devotee feels that his sentiment is the most excellent, and thus in that mood he tastes great happiness with Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: taṭastha ha-iyā mane vicāra yadi kari
saba rasa haite śṛṅgāre adhika mādhurī
devanagari: तटस्थ हइया मने विचार यदि करि ।
सब रस हैते शृङ्गारे अधिक माधुरी ॥44॥
cc-adi-4.44.translation: But if we compare the sentiments in an impartial mood, we find that the conjugal sentiment is superior to all in sweetness.

devanagari: यथोत्तरमसौ स्वाद - विशेषोल्लासमय्यपि ।
रतिर्वासनया स्वाद्वी भासते कापि कस्यचित् ॥45॥
cc-adi-4.45.translation: "Increasing love is experienced in various tastes, one above another. But that love which has the highest taste in the gradual succession of desire manifests itself in the form of conjugal love."

lines: ataeva madhura rasa kahi tara nāma
devanagari: अतएव मधुर रस कहि तार नाम ।
स्वकीया - परकीया - भावे द्वि - विध संस्थान ॥46॥
cc-adi-4.46.translation: Therefore I call it madhura-rasa. It has two further divisions, namely wedded and unwedded love.

lines: vraja vinā ihāra anyatra nāhi vāsa
devanagari: परकीया - भावे अति रसेर उल्लास ।
व्रज विना इहार अन्यत्र नाहि वास ॥47॥
cc-adi-4.47.translation: There is a great increase of mellow in the unwedded conjugal mood. Such love is found nowhere but in Vraja.

devanagari: व्रज - वधू - गणेर एइ भाव निरवधि ।
तार मध्ये श्री - राधाय भावेर अवधि ॥48॥
cc-adi-4.48.translation: This mood is unbounded in the damsels of Vraja, but among them it finds its perfection in Śrī Rādhā.

devanagari: प्रौढ़ निर्मल - भाव प्रेम सर्वोत्तम ।
कृष्णेर माधुर्य - रस - आस्वाद - कारण ॥49॥
cc-adi-4.49.translation: Her pure, mature love surpasses that of all others. Her love is the cause of Lord Kṛṣṇa's tasting the sweetness of the conjugal relationship.

lines: caturtha ślokera artha ei kaila sāra
devanagari: चतुर्थ श्लोकेर अर्थ एइ कैल सार ।
प्रेम - नाम प्रचारिते एइ अवतार ॥5॥
cc-adi-4.5.translation: I have given the essential meaning of the fourth verse: this incarnation descends to propagate the chanting of the holy name and spread love of God.

devanagari: अतएव सेइ भाव अङ्गीकार करि’ ।
साधिलेन निज वाञ्छा गौराङ्ग - श्री - हरि ॥50॥
cc-adi-4.50.translation: Therefore Lord Gaurāṅga, who is Śrī Hari Himself, accepted the sentiments of Rādhā and thus fulfilled His own desires.

lines: sa caitanyaḥ kiṁ me punar api dṛśor yāsyati padam
devanagari: सुरेशानां दुर्गं गतिरतिशयेनोपनिषदां मुनीनां सर्व - स्वं प्रणत - पटलीनां मधुरिमा ।
विनिर्मासः प्रेम्णो निखिल - पशु - पालाम्बुज - दृशां स चैतन्यः किं मे पुनरपि दृशोर्यास्यति पदम् ॥51॥
cc-adi-4.51.translation: "Lord Caitanya is the shelter of the demigods, the goal of the Upaniṣads, the be-all and end-all of the great sages, the beautiful shelter of His devotees, and the essence of love for the lotus-eyed gopīs. Will He again be the object of my vision?"

lines: rasa-stomaṁ hṛtvā madhuram upabhoktuṁ kam-api yaḥ
rucaṁ svām āvavre dyutim iha tadīyāṁ prakaṭayan
sa devaś caitanyākṛtir atitarāṁ naḥ kṛpayatu
devanagari: अपारं कस्यापि प्रणयि - जन - वृन्दस्य कुतुकी रस - स्तोमं हृत्वा मधुरमुपभोक्तुं कमपि यः ।
रुचं स्वामावत्रे द्युतिमिह तदीयां प्रकटयन् स देवश्चैतन्याकृतिरतितरां नः कृपयतु ॥52॥
cc-adi-4.52.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa desired to taste the limitless nectarean mellows of the love of one of His multitude of loving damsels [Śrī Rādhā], and so He has assumed the form of Lord Caitanya. He has tasted that love while hiding His own dark complexion with Her effulgent yellow color. May that Lord Caitanya confer upon us His grace."

lines: tāra mukhya hetu kahi, śuna sarva-jana
devanagari: भाव - ग्रहणेर हेतु कैल धर्म - स्थापन ।
तार मुख्य हेतु कहि, शुन सर्व - जन ॥53॥
cc-adi-4.53.translation: To accept ecstatic love is the main reason He appeared and reestablished the religious system for this age. I shall now explain that reason. Everyone please listen.

lines: mūla hetu āge ślokera kaila ābhāsa
ebe kahi sei ślokera artha prakāśa
devanagari: मूल हेतु आगे श्लोकेर कैल आभास ।
एबे कहि सेइ श्लोकेर अर्थ प्रकाश ॥54॥
cc-adi-4.54.translation: Having first given hints about the verse describing the principal reason why the Lord appeared, now I shall manifest its full meaning.

lines: ekātmānāv api bhuvi purā deha-bhedaṁ gatau tau
caitanyākhyaṁ prakaṭam adhunā tad-dvayaṁ caikyam āptaṁ
devanagari: राधा कृष्ण - प्रणय - विकृतिह्णदिनी शक्तिरस्माद् एकात्मानावपि भुवि पुरा देह - भेदं गतौ तौ ।
चैतन्याख्यं प्रकटमधुना तदद्वयं चैक्यमाप्तं राधा - भाव - द्युति - सुवलितं नौमि कृष्ण - स्वरूपम् ॥55॥
cc-adi-4.55.translation: "The loving affairs of Śrī Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are transcendental manifestations of the Lord's internal pleasure-giving potency. Although Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are one in Their identity, They separated Themselves eternally. Now these two transcendental identities have again united, in the form of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya. I bow down to Him, who has manifested Himself with the sentiment and complexion of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī although He is Kṛṣṇa Himself."

lines: rādhā-kṛṣṇa eka ātmā, dui deha dhari'
devanagari: राधा - कृष्ण एक आत्मा, दुइ देह धरि ।
अन्योन्ये विलसे रस आस्वादन क रि’ ॥56॥
cc-adi-4.56.translation: Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are one and the same, but They have assumed two bodies. Thus They enjoy each other, tasting the mellows of love.

lines: sei dui eka ebe caitanya gosāñi
devanagari: सेइ दुइ एक एबे चैतन्य गोसाञि ।
रस आस्वादिते दोंहे हैला एक - ठाङि ॥57॥
cc-adi-4.57.translation: Now, to enjoy rasa, They have appeared in one body as Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: ithi lāgi' āge kari tāra vivaraṇa
devanagari: इथि ला गि’ आगे करि तार विवरण ।
याहा हैते हय गौरेर महिमा - कथन ॥58॥
cc-adi-4.58.translation: Therefore I shall first delineate the position of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. From that the glory of Lord Caitanya will be known.

devanagari: राधिका हयेन कृष्णेर प्रणय - विकार।
स्वरूप - शक्ति - ‘ह्लादिनी’ नाम याँहार ॥59॥
cc-adi-4.59.translation: Śrīmatī Rādhikā is the transformation of Kṛṣṇa's love. She is His internal energy called hlādinī.

lines: satya ei hetu, kintu eho bahiraṅga
āra eka hetu, śuna, āche antaraṅga
devanagari: सत्य एइ हेतु, किन्तु एहो बहिरङ्ग ।
आर एक हेतु, शुन, आछे अन्तरङ्ग ॥6॥
cc-adi-4.6.translation: Although this is true, this is but the external reason for the Lord's incarnation. Please hear one other reason—the confidential reason-for the Lord's appearance.

devanagari: ह्लादिनी कराय कृष्णे आनन्दास्वादन ।
ह्लादिनीर द्वारा करे भक्तेर पोषण ॥60॥
cc-adi-4.60.translation: That hlādinī energy gives Kṛṣṇa pleasure and nourishes His devotees.

lines: eka-i cic-chakti tāṅra dhare tina rūpa
devanagari: सच्चिदानन्द, पूर्ण, कृष्णेर स्वरूप ।
एक - इ चिच्छक्ति ताँर धरे तिन रूप ॥61॥
cc-adi-4.61.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa's body is eternal [sat], full of knowledge [cit] and full of bliss [ānanda]. His one spiritual energy manifests three forms.

devanagari: आनन्दांशे ह्लादिनी, सदंशे सन्धिनी ।
चिदंशे सम्वित् - यारे ज्ञान क रि’ मानि ॥62॥
cc-adi-4.62.translation: Hlādinī is His aspect of bliss; sandhinī, of eternal existence; and samvit, of cognizance, which is also accepted as knowledge.

devanagari: ह्लादिनी सन्धिनी सम्वित्त्वय्येका सर्व - संस्थितौ ।
ह्लाद - ताप - करी मिश्रा त्वयि नो गुण - वर्जिते ॥63॥
cc-adi-4.63.translation: "O Lord, You are the support of everything. The three attributes hlādinī, sandhinī and samvit exist in You as one spiritual energy. But the material modes, which cause happiness, misery and mixtures of the two, do not exist in You, for You have no material qualities."

devanagari: सन्धिनीर सार अंश - ‘शुद्ध - सत्त्व’ नाम ।
भगवानेर सत्ता हय याहाते विश्राम ॥64॥
cc-adi-4.64.translation: The essential portion of the sandhinī potency is śuddha-sattva. Lord Kṛṣṇa's existence rests upon it.

lines: mātā, pitā, sthāna, gṛha, śayyāsana āra
devanagari: माता, पिता, स्थान, गृह, शय्यासन आर ।
ए - सब कृष्णेर शुद्ध - सत्त्वेर विकार ॥65॥
cc-adi-4.65.translation: Kṛṣṇa's mother, father, abode, house, bedding, seats and so on are all transformations of śuddha-sattva.

devanagari: सत्त्वं विशुद्धं वसुदेव - शब्दितं यदीयते तत्र पुमानपावृतः ।
सत्त्वे च तस्मिन्भगवान्वा सुदेवो ह्यधोक्षजो मे मनसा विधीयते ॥66॥
cc-adi-4.66.translation: "The condition of pure goodness [śuddha-sattva], in which the Supreme Personality of Godhead appears uncovered, is called vasudeva. In that pure state the Supreme Godhead, who is beyond the material senses and who is known as Vāsudeva, is perceived by my mind."

devanagari: कृष्णे भगवत्ता - ज्ञान - संवितेर सार ।
ब्रह्म - ज्ञानादिक सब तार परिवार ॥67॥
cc-adi-4.67.translation: The essence of the samvit potency is knowledge that the Supreme Personality of Godhead is Lord Kṛṣṇa. All other kinds of knowledge, such as the knowledge of Brahman, are its components.

devanagari: ह्लादिनीर सार ‘प्रेम’, प्रेम - सार ‘भाव’ ।
भावेर परम - काष्ठा, नाम ‘महा - भाव’ ॥68॥
cc-adi-4.68.translation: The essence of the hlādinī potency is love of God, the essence of love of God is emotion [bhāva], and the ultimate development of emotion is mahābhāva.

devanagari: महाभाव - स्वरूपा श्री - राधा - ठाकुराणी ।
सर्व - गुण - खनि कृष्ण - कान्ता - शिरोमणि ॥69॥
cc-adi-4.69.translation: Śrī Rādhā Ṭhākurāṇī is the embodiment of mahābhāva. She is the repository of all good qualities and the crest jewel among all the lovely consorts of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: पूर्वे येन पृथिवीर भार हरिबारे ।
कृष्ण अवतीर्ण हैला शास्त्रेते प्रचारे ॥7॥
cc-adi-4.7.translation: The scriptures proclaim that Lord Kṛṣṇa previously descended to take away the burden of the earth.

devanagari: तयोरप्युभयोर्मध्ये राधिका सर्वथाधिका ।
महाभाव - स्वरूपेयं गुणैरतिवरीयसी ॥70॥
cc-adi-4.70.translation: "Of these two gopīs [Rādhārāṇī and Candrāvalī], Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is superior in all respects. She is the embodiment of mahābhāva, and She surpasses all in good qualities."

devanagari: कृष्ण - प्रेम - भावित याँर चित्तेन्द्रिय - काय ।
कृष्ण - निज - शक्ति राधा क्रीड़ार सहाय ॥71॥
cc-adi-4.71.translation: Her mind, senses and body are steeped in love for Kṛṣṇa. She is Kṛṣṇa's own energy, and She helps Him in His pastimes.

devanagari: आनन्द - चिन्मय - रस - प्रतिभाविताभिस् ताभिर्य एव निज - रूपतया कलाभिः ।
गोलोक एव निवसत्यखिलात्म - भूतो गोविन्दमादि - पुरुषं तमहं भजामि ॥72॥
cc-adi-4.72.translation: "I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, who resides in His own realm, Goloka, with Rādhā, who resembles His own spiritual figure and who embodies the ecstatic potency [hlādinī]. Their companions are Her confidantes, who embody extensions of Her bodily form and who are imbued and permeated with ever-blissful spiritual rasa."

devanagari: कृष्णेरे कराय यैछे रस आस्वादन ।
क्रीड़ार सहाय यैछे, शुन विवरण ॥73॥
cc-adi-4.73.translation: Now please listen to how Lord Kṛṣṇa's consorts help Him taste rasa and how they help in His pastimes.

devanagari: कृष्ण - कान्ता - गण देखि त्रि - विध प्रकार ।
एक लक्ष्मी - गण, पुरे महिषी - गण आर ॥74॥
cc-adi-4.74-75.translation: The beloved consorts of Lord Kṛṣṇa are of three kinds: the goddesses of fortune, the queens, and the milkmaids of Vraja, who are the foremost of all. These consorts all proceed from Rādhikā.

lines: aṁśinī rādhā haite tina gaṇera vistāra
devanagari: अवतारी कृष्ण यैछे करे अवतार ।
अंशिनी राधा हैते तिन गणेर विस्तार ॥76॥
cc-adi-4.76.translation: Just as the fountainhead, Lord Kṛṣṇa, is the cause of all incarnations, so Śrī Rādhā is the cause of all these consorts.

devanagari: वैभव - गण येन ताँर अङ्ग - विभूति ।
बिम्ब - प्रतिबिम्ब - रूप महिषीर तति ॥77॥
cc-adi-4.77.translation: The goddesses of fortune are partial manifestations of Śrīmatī Rādhikā, and the queens are reflections of Her image.

devanagari: लक्ष्मी - गण ताँर वैभव - विलासांश - रूप ।
महिषी - गण वैभव - प्रकाश - स्वरूप ॥78॥
cc-adi-4.78.translation: The goddesses of fortune are Her plenary portions, and they display the forms of vaibhava-vilāsa. The queens are of the nature of Her vaibhava-prakāśa.

devanagari: आकार स्वभाव - भेदे व्रज - देवी - गण ।
काय - व्यूह - रूप ताँर रसेर कारण ॥79॥
cc-adi-4.79.translation: The Vraja-devīs have diverse bodily features. They are Her expansions and are the instruments for expanding rasa.

devanagari: स्वयं - भगवानेर कर्म नहे भार - हरण ।
स्थिति - कर्ता विष्णु करेन जगत्पालन ॥8॥
cc-adi-4.8.translation: To take away this burden, however, is not the work of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The maintainer, Lord Viṣṇu, is the one who protects the universe.

lines: bahu kāntā vinā nahe rasera ullāsa
devanagari: बहु कान्ता विना नहे रसेर उल्लास ।
लीलार सहाय ला गि’ बहुत प्रकाश ॥80॥
cc-adi-4.80.translation: Without many consorts, there is not such exultation in rasa. Therefore there are many manifestations of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī to assist in the Lord's pastimes.

devanagari: तार मध्ये व्रजे नाना भाव - रस - भेदे ।
कृष्णके कराय रासादिक - लीलास्वादे ॥81॥
cc-adi-4.81.translation: Among them are various groups of consorts in Vraja who have varieties of sentiments and mellows. They help Lord Kṛṣṇa taste all the sweetness of the rāsa dance and other pastimes.

devanagari: गोविन्दानन्दिनी राधा, गोविन्द - मोहिनी ।
गोविन्द - सर्वस्व, सर्व - कान्ता - शिरोमणि ॥82॥
cc-adi-4.82.translation: Rādhā is the one who gives pleasure to Govinda, and She is also the enchantress of Govinda. She is the be-all and end-all of Govinda, and the crest jewel of all His consorts.

devanagari: देवी कृष्ण - मयी प्रोक्ता राधिका पर - देवता ।
सर्व - लक्ष्मी - मयी सर्व - कान्तिः सम्मोहिनी परा ॥83॥
cc-adi-4.83.translation: "The transcendental goddess Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is the direct counterpart of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa. She is the central figure for all the goddesses of fortune. She possesses all the attractiveness to attract the all-attractive Personality of Godhead. She is the primeval internal potency of the Lord."

devanagari: ‘देवी’ कहि द्योतमाना, परमा सुन्दरी ।
किम्वा, कृष्ण - पूजा - क्रीड़ार वसति नगरी ॥84॥
cc-adi-4.84.translation: "Devī" means "resplendent and most beautiful." Or else it means "the lovely abode of the worship and love sports of Lord Kṛṣṇa."

lines: yāṅhā yāṅhā netra paḍe tāṅhā kṛṣṇa sphure
devanagari: कृष्ण - मयी - कृष्ण यार भितरे बाहिरे ।
याँहा याँहा नेत्र पड़े ताँहा कृष्ण स्फुरे ॥85॥
cc-adi-4.85.translation: "Kṛṣṇa-mayī" means "one whose within and without are Lord Kṛṣṇa." She sees Lord Kṛṣṇa wherever She casts Her glance.

lines: tāṅra śakti tāṅra saha haya eka-rūpa
devanagari: किम्वा, प्रेम - रस - मय कृष्णेर स्वरूप ।
ताँर शक्ति ताँर सह हय एक - रूप ॥86॥
cc-adi-4.86.translation: Or, She is identical with Lord Kṛṣṇa, for She embodies the mellows of love. The energy of Lord Kṛṣṇa is identical with Him.

devanagari: कृष्ण - वाञ्छा - पूर्ति - रूप करे आराधने ।
अतएव ‘राधिका’ नाम पुराणे वाखाने ॥87॥
cc-adi-4.87.translation: Her worship [ārādhana] consists of fulfilling the desires of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore the Purāṇas call Her Rādhikā.

devanagari: अनयाराधितो नूनं भगवान्हरिरीश्वरः ।
यन्नो विहाय गोविन्दः प्रीतो यामनयद्रहः ॥88॥
cc-adi-4.88.translation: "Truly the Personality of Godhead has been worshiped by Her. Therefore Lord Govinda, being pleased, has brought Her to a lonely spot, leaving us all behind."

devanagari: अतएव सर्व - पूज्या, परम - देवता ।
सर्व - पालिका, सर्व जगतेर माता ॥89॥
cc-adi-4.89.translation: Therefore Rādhā is parama-devatā, the supreme goddess, and She is worshipable for everyone. She is the protectress of all, and She is the mother of the entire universe.

devanagari: किन्तु कृष्णेर येइ हय अवतार - काल ।
भार - हरण - काल ताते हइल मिशाल ॥9॥
cc-adi-4.9.translation: But the time to lift the burden of the world mixed with the time for Lord Kṛṣṇa's incarnation.

devanagari: ‘सर्व - लक्ष्मी’ शब्द पूर्वे करियाछि व्याख्यान ।
सर्व - लक्ष्मी - गणेर तिंहो हन अधिष्ठान ॥90॥
cc-adi-4.90.translation: I have already explained the meaning of "sarva-lakṣmī." Rādhā is the original source of all the goddesses of fortune.

devanagari: किम्वा, ‘सर्व - लक्ष्मी कृष्णेर षड् - विध ऐश्वर्य ।
ताँर अधिष्ठात्री शक्ति - सर्व - शक्ति - वर्य ॥91॥
cc-adi-4.91.translation: Or "sarva-lakṣmī" indicates that She fully represents the six opulences of Kṛṣṇa. Therefore She is the supreme energy of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: सर्व - सौन्दर्य - कान्ति वैसये याँहाते ।
सर्व - लक्ष्मी - गणेर शोभा हय याँहा हैते ॥92॥
cc-adi-4.92.translation: The word "sarva-kānti" indicates that all beauty and luster rest in Her body. All the lakṣmīs derive their beauty from Her.

devanagari: किम्वा ‘कान्ति’ - शब्दे कृष्णेर सब इच्छा कहे ।
कृष्णेर सकल वाञ्छा राधातेइ रहे ॥93॥
cc-adi-4.93.translation: "Kānti" may also mean "all the desires of Lord Kṛṣṇa." All the desires of Lord Kṛṣṇa rest in Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

devanagari: राधिका करेन कृष्णेर वाञ्छित पूरण ।
‘सर्व - कान्ति’ - शब्देर एइ अर्थ विवरण ॥94॥
cc-adi-4.94.translation: Śrīmatī Rādhikā fulfills all the desires of Lord Kṛṣṇa. This is the meaning of "sarva-kānti."

devanagari: जगत्मोहन कृष्ण, ताँहार मोहिनी ।
अतएव समस्तेर परा ठाकुराणी ॥95॥
cc-adi-4.95.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa enchants the world, but Śrī Rādhā enchants even Him. Therefore She is the supreme goddess of all.

devanagari: राधा - पूर्ण - शक्ति, कृष्ण - पूर्ण - शक्तिमान् ।
दुइ वस्तु भेद नाइ, शास्त्र - परमाण ॥96॥
cc-adi-4.96.translation: Śrī Rādhā is the full power, and Lord Kṛṣṇa is the possessor of full power. The two are not different, as evidenced by the revealed scriptures.

devanagari: मृगमद, तार गन्ध - यैछे अविच्छेद ।
अग्नि, ज्वालाते - यैछे कभु नाहि भेद ॥97॥
cc-adi-4.97.translation: They are indeed the same, just as musk and its scent are inseparable, or as fire and its heat are nondifferent.

devanagari: राधा - कृष्ण ऐछे सदा एक - इ स्वरूप ।
लीला - रस आस्वादिते धरे दुइ - रूप ॥98॥
cc-adi-4.98.translation: Thus Rādhā and Lord Kṛṣṇa are one, yet They have taken two forms to enjoy the mellows of pastimes.

devanagari: प्रेम - भक्ति शिखाइते आपने अवतरि ।
राधा - भाव - कान्ति दुई अङ्गीकार करि’ ॥99॥
cc-adi-4.99-100.translation: To promulgate prema-bhakti [devotional service in love of Godhead], Kṛṣṇa appeared as Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya with the mood and complexion of Śrī Rādhā. Thus I have explained the meaning of the fifth verse.

devanagari: वन्देऽनन्ताद्भुतैश्वर्यं श्री - नित्यानन्दमीश्वरम् ।
यस्येच्छया तत्स्वरूपमज्ञेनापि निरूप्यते ॥1॥
cc-adi-5.1.translation: Let me offer my obeisances to Lord Śrī Nityānanda, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, whose opulence is wonderful and unlimited. By His will, even a fool can understand His identity.

devanagari: सृष्ट्यादिक सेवा, - ताँर आज्ञार पालन ।
‘शेष’ - रूपे करे कृष्णेर विविध सेवन ॥10॥
cc-adi-5.10.translation: He executes the orders of Lord Kṛṣṇa in the work of creation, and in the form of Lord Śeṣa He serves Kṛṣṇa in various ways.

devanagari: अनन्त - शय्याते ताँहा करिल शयन ।
सहस्र मस्तक ताँर सहस्र वदन ॥100॥
cc-adi-5.100-101.translation: He lay there with Ananta as His bed. Lord Ananta is a divine serpent having thousands of heads, thousands of faces, thousands of eyes and thousands of hands and feet. He is the seed of all incarnations and is the cause of the material world.

lines: tāṅra nābhi-padma haite uṭhila eka padma
devanagari: ताँर नाभि - पद्म हैते उठिल एक प द्म ।
सेइ पद्मे हैल ब्रह्मार जन्म - सद्म ॥102॥
cc-adi-5.102.translation: From His navel grew a lotus flower, which became the birthplace of Lord Brahmā.

lines: teṅho brahmā hañā sṛṣṭi karila sṛjana
devanagari: सेइ पद्म - नाले हैल चौद्द - भुवन ।
तेंहो ब्रह्मा हा सृष्टि करिल सृजन ॥103॥
cc-adi-5.103.translation: Within the stem of that lotus were the fourteen worlds. Thus the Supreme Lord, as Brahmā, created the entire creation.

devanagari: विष्णु - रूप हझा करे जगत्पालने ।
गुणातीत - विष्णु स्पर्श नाहि माया - गुणे ॥104॥
cc-adi-5.104.translation: And as Lord Viṣṇu He maintains the entire world. Lord Viṣṇu, being beyond all material attributes, has no touch with the material qualities.

devanagari: रुद्र - रूप धरि करे जगत्संहार ।
सृष्टि - स्थिति - प्रलय - इच्छाय याँहार ॥105॥
cc-adi-5.105.translation: Assuming the form of Rudra, He destroys the creation. Thus creation, maintenance and dissolution are created by His will.

devanagari: हिरण्य - गर्भ, अन्तर्यामी, जगत्का रण ।
याँर अंश करि’ करे विराट - कल्पन ॥106॥
cc-adi-5.106.translation: He is the Supersoul, Hiraṇyagarbha, the cause of the material world. The universal form is conceived as His expansion.

devanagari: हेन नारायण , - याँर अंशेर अंश ।
सेइ प्रभु नित्यानन्द सर्व - अवतंस ॥107॥
cc-adi-5.107.translation: That Lord Nārāyaṇa is a part of a plenary part of Lord Nityānanda Balarāma, who is the source of all incarnations.

lines: ekādaśa ślokera artha śuna diyā mana
devanagari: दशम श्लोकेर अर्थ कैल विवरण ।
एकादश श्लोकेर अर्थ शुन दिया मन ॥108॥
cc-adi-5.108.translation: I have thus explained the tenth verse. Now please listen to the meaning of the eleventh verse with all your mind.

devanagari: यस्यांशांशांशः परात्माखिलानां पोष्टा विष्णुर्भाति दुग्धाब्धि - शायी ।
क्षौणी - भर्ता यत्कला सोऽप्यनन्तस् तं श्री - नित्यानन्द - रामं प्रपद्ये ॥109॥
cc-adi-5.109.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances unto the feet of Śrī Nityānanda Rāma, whose secondary part is the Viṣṇu lying in the ocean of milk. That Kṣīrodakaśāyī Viṣṇu is the Supersoul of all living entities and the maintainer of all the universes. Śeṣa Nāga is His further subpart.

devanagari: सर्व - रूपे आस्वादये कृष्ण - सेवानन्द ।
सेइ बलराम - गौर - सङ्गे नित्यानन्द ॥11॥
cc-adi-5.11.translation: In all the forms He tastes the transcendental bliss of serving Kṛṣṇa. That same Balarāma is Lord Nityānanda, the companion of Lord Gaurasundara.

lines: dharaṇīra madhye sapta samudra ye gaṇi
devanagari: नारायणेर नाभि - नाल - मध्येते धरणी ।
धरणीर मध्ये सप्त समुद्र ये गणि ॥110॥
cc-adi-5.110.translation: The material planets rest within the stem that grew from the lotus navel of Lord Nārāyaṇa. Among these planets are seven oceans.

devanagari: ताँहा क्षीरोदधि - मध्ये ‘श्वेतद्वीप’ नाम ।
पालयिता विष्णु, - ताँर सेइ निज धाम ॥111॥
cc-adi-5.111.translation: There, in part of the ocean of milk, lies Śvetadvīpa, the abode of the sustainer, Lord Viṣṇu.

devanagari: सकल जीवेर तिंहो हये अन्तर्यामी ।
जगत्पालक तिंहो जगतेर स्वामी ॥112॥
cc-adi-5.112.translation: He is the Supersoul of all living entities. He maintains this material world, and He is its Lord.

devanagari: युग - मन्वन्तरे ध रि’ नाना अवतार ।
धर्म संस्थापन करे, अधर्म संहार ॥113॥
cc-adi-5.113.translation: In the ages and millenniums of Manu, He appears as different incarnations to establish the principles of real religion and vanquish the principles of irreligion.

devanagari: देव - गणे ना पाय याँहार दरशन ।
क्षीरोदक - तीरे याइ’ करेन स्तवन ॥114॥
cc-adi-5.114.translation: Unable to see Him, the demigods go to the bank of the ocean of milk and offer prayers to Him.

devanagari: तबे अवत रि’ करे जगत्पालन ।
अनन्त वैभव ताँर नाहिक गणन ॥115॥
cc-adi-5.115.translation: He then descends to maintain the material world. His unlimited opulences cannot be counted.

lines: sei viṣṇu haya yāṅra aṁśāṁśera aṁśa
devanagari: सेइ विष्णु हय याँर अंशांशेर अंश ।
सेइ प्रभु नित्यानन्द सर्व - अवतंस ॥116॥
cc-adi-5.116.translation: That Lord Viṣṇu is but a part of a part of a plenary portion of Lord Nityānanda, who is the source of all incarnations.

lines: kāṅhā āche mahī, śire, hena nāhi jāni
devanagari: सेइ विष्णु ‘शेष’ - रूपे धरेन धरणी ।
काँहा आछे मही, शिरे, हेन नाहि जानि ॥117॥
cc-adi-5.117.translation: That same Lord Viṣṇu, in the form of Lord Śeṣa, holds the planets upon His heads, although He does not know where they are, for He cannot feel their existence upon His heads.

devanagari: सहस्त्र विस्तीर्ण याँर फणार मण्डल ।
सूर्य जिनि’ मणि - गण करे झल - मल ॥118॥
cc-adi-5.118.translation: His thousands of extended hoods are adorned with dazzling jewels surpassing the sun.

devanagari: पञ्चाशत्कोटि - योजन पृथिवी - विस्तार ।
याँर एक - फणे रहे सर्षप - आकार ॥119॥
cc-adi-5.119.translation: The universe, which measures five hundred million yojanas in diameter, rests on one of His hoods like a mustard seed.

devanagari: सप्तम श्लोकेर अर्थ करि चारि - श्लोके।
याते नित्यानन्द - तत्त्व जाने सर्व - लोके ॥12॥
cc-adi-5.12.translation: I have explained this seventh verse in four subsequent verses. By these verses all the world can know the truth about Lord Nityānanda.

lines: īśvarera sevā vinā nāhi jāne āra
devanagari: सेइ त’ ‘अनन्त’ ‘शेष’ - भक्त - अवतार ।
ईश्वरेर सेवा विना नाहि जाने आर ॥120॥
cc-adi-5.120.translation: That Ananta Śeṣa is the devotee incarnation of Godhead. He knows nothing but service to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: niravadhi guṇa gā'na, anta nāhi pā'na
devanagari: सहस्र - वदने करे कृष्ण - गुण गान ।
निरवधि गुण गान, अन्त नाहि पान ॥121॥
cc-adi-5.121.translation: With His thousands of mouths He sings the glories of Lord Kṛṣṇa, but although He always sings in that way, He does not find an end to the qualities of the Lord.

devanagari: सनकादि भागवत शुने याँर मुखे ।
भगवानेर गुण कहे, भासे प्रेम - सुखे ॥122॥
cc-adi-5.122.translation: The four Kumāras hear Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam from His lips, and they in turn repeat it in the transcendental bliss of love of Godhead.

devanagari: छत्र, पादुका, शय्या, उपाधान, वसन ।
आराम, आवास, यज्ञ - सूत्र, सिंहासन ॥123॥
cc-adi-5.123.translation: He serves Lord Kṛṣṇa, assuming all the following forms: umbrella, slippers, bedding, pillow, garments, resting chair, residence, sacred thread and throne.

devanagari: एत मूर्ति - भेद करि कृष्ण - सेवा करे ।
कृष्णेर शेषता पाञा ‘शेष’ नाम धरे ॥124॥
cc-adi-5.124.translation: He is thus called Lord Śeṣa, for He has attained the ultimate end of servitude to Kṛṣṇa. He takes many forms for the service of Kṛṣṇa, and thus He serves the Lord.

lines: sei ta' ananta, yāṅra kahi eka kalā
hena prabhu nityānanda, ke jāne tāṅra khelā
devanagari: सेइ त’ अनन्त, याँर कहि एक कला ।
हेन प्रभु नित्यानन्द, के जाने ताँर खेला ॥125॥
cc-adi-5.125.translation: That person of whom Lord Ananta is a kalā, or part of a plenary part, is Lord Nityānanda Prabhu. Who, therefore, can know the pastimes of Lord Nityānanda?

devanagari: ए - सब प्रमाणे जानि नित्यानन्द - तत्त्व - सीमा ।
ताँहाके ‘अनन्त’ कहि, कि ताँर महिमा ॥126॥
cc-adi-5.126.translation: From these conclusions we can know the limit of the truth of Lord Nityānanda. But what glory is there in calling Him Ananta?

lines: athavā bhaktera vākya māni satya kari'
devanagari: अथवा भक्तेर वाक्य मानि सत्य क रि’ ।
सकल सम्भवे ताँते, याते अवतारी ॥127॥
cc-adi-5.127.translation: But I accept it as the truth because it has been said by devotees. Since He is the source of all incarnations, everything is possible in Him.

lines: pūrve yaiche kṛṣṇake keho kāho kari' māne
devanagari: अवतार - अवतारी - अभेद, ये जाने ।
पूर्वे यैछे कृष्णके केहो काहो करि’ माने ॥128॥
cc-adi-5.128.translation: They know that there is no difference between the incarnation and the source of all incarnations. Previously Lord Kṛṣṇa was regarded in the light of different principles by different people.

lines: keho kahe, kṛṣṇa haya sākṣāt vāmana
devanagari: केहो कहे, कृष्ण साक्षात्लर - नारायण ।
केहो कहे, कृष्ण हय साक्षात्वामन ॥129॥
cc-adi-5.129.translation: Some said that Kṛṣṇa was directly Lord Nara-Nārāyaṇa, and some called Him Lord Vāmanadeva incarnate.

devanagari: मायातीते व्यापि - वैकुण्ठ - लोके पूर्णेश्वर्यै श्री - चतुर्व्यह - मध्ये ।
रूपं ग्रस्योद्भाति सङ्कर्षणाख्यं तं श्री - नित्यानन्द - रामं प्रपद्ये ॥13॥
cc-adi-5.13.translation: I surrender unto the lotus feet of Śrī Nityānanda Rāma, who is known as Saṅkarṣaṇa in the midst of the catur-vyūha [consisting of Vāsudeva, Saṅkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna and Aniruddha]. He possesses full opulences and resides in Vaikuṇṭhaloka, far beyond the material creation.

devanagari: केहो कहे, कृष्ण क्षीरोद - शायी अवतार ।
असम्भव नहे, सत्य वचन सबार ॥130॥
cc-adi-5.130.translation: Some called Lord Kṛṣṇa an incarnation of Lord Kṣīrodakaśāyī. All these names are true; nothing is impossible.

devanagari: कृष्ण यबे अवतरे सर्वांश - आश्रय ।
सर्वांश आ सि’ तबे कृष्णेते मिलय ॥131॥
cc-adi-5.131.translation: When the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa appears, He is the shelter of all plenary parts. Thus at that time all His plenary portions join in Him.

lines: yei yei rūpe jāne, sei tāhā kahe
sakala sambhave kṛṣṇe, kichu mithyā nahe
devanagari: येइ येइ रूपे जाने, सेइ ताहा कहे ।
सकल सम्भवे कृष्णे, किछु मिथ्या नहे ॥132॥
cc-adi-5.132.translation: In whatever form one knows the Lord, one speaks of Him in that way. In this there is no falsity, since everything is possible in Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: अतएव श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य गोसाञि ।
सर्व अवतार - लीला क रि’ सबारे देखाइ ॥133॥
cc-adi-5.133.translation: Therefore Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu has exhibited to everyone all the pastimes of all the various incarnations.

devanagari: एइ - रूपे नित्यानन्द ‘अनन्त’ - प्रकाश ।
सेइ - भावे - कहे मुञि चैतन्येर दास ॥134॥
cc-adi-5.134.translation: Thus Lord Nityānanda has unlimited incarnations. In transcendental emotion He calls Himself a servant of Lord Caitanya.

lines: kabhu guru, kabhu sakhā, kabhu bhṛtya-līlā
pūrve yena tina-bhāve vraje kaila khelā
devanagari: कभु गुरु, कभु सखा, कभु भृत्य - लीला ।
पूर्वे येन तिन - भावे व्रजे कैल खेला ॥135॥
cc-adi-5.135.translation: Sometimes He serves Lord Caitanya as His guru, sometimes as His friend and sometimes as His servant, just as Lord Balarāma played with Lord Kṛṣṇa in these three different modes in Vraja.

devanagari: वृष हञा कृष्ण - सने माथा - माथि रण ।
कभु कृष्ण करे ताँर पाद - संवाहन ॥136॥
cc-adi-5.136.translation: Playing like a bull, Lord Balarāma fights with Kṛṣṇa head to head. And sometimes Lord Kṛṣṇa massages the feet of Lord Balarāma.

lines: āpanāke bhṛtya kari' kṛṣṇe prabhu jāne
devanagari: आपनाके भृत्य करि’ कृष्णे प्रभु जाने ।
कृष्णेर कलार कला आपनाके माने ॥137॥
cc-adi-5.137.translation: He considers Himself a servant and knows Kṛṣṇa to be His master. Thus He regards Himself as a fragment of His plenary portion.

devanagari: वृषायमाणौ नर्दन्तौ युयुधाते परस्परम् ।
अनुकृत्य रुतैर्जन्तूंचेरतुः प्राकृतौ यथा ॥138॥
cc-adi-5.138.translation: "Acting just like ordinary boys, They played like roaring bulls as They fought each other, and They imitated the calls of various animals."

devanagari: क्वचिक्रीड़ा - परिश्रान्तं गोपोत्सङ्गोपबर्हणम् ।
स्वयं विश्रामयत्या पाद - संवाहनादिभिः ॥139॥
cc-adi-5.139.translation: "Sometimes when Lord Kṛṣṇa's elder brother, Lord Balarāma, felt tired after playing and lay His hand on the lap of a cowherd boy, Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself served Him by massaging His feet."

devanagari: प्रकृतिर पार ‘परव्योम - नामे धाम ।
कृष्ण - विग्रह यैछे विभूत्यादि - गुणवान् ॥14॥
cc-adi-5.14.translation: Beyond the material nature lies the realm known as paravyoma, the spiritual sky. Like Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself, it possesses all transcendental attributes, such as the six opulences.

devanagari: केयं वा कुत आयाता दैवी वा नातासुरी ।
प्रायो मायास्तु मे भर्तुर्नान्या मेऽपि विमोहिनी ॥140॥
cc-adi-5.140.translation: "Who is this mystic power, and where has she come from? Is she a demigod or a demoness? She must be the illusory energy of My master, Lord Kṛṣṇa, for who else can bewilder Me?"

lines: brahmā bhavo 'ham api yasya kalāḥ kalāyāḥ
śrīś codvahema ciram asya nṛpāsanaṁ kva
devanagari: यस्याङ्घि - पङ्कज - रजोऽखिल - लोक - पालैर् मौल्युत्तमैधृतमुपासित - तीर्थ - तीर्थम् ।
ब्रह्मा भवोऽहमपि यस्य कलाः कलायाः श्रीशोद्वहेम चिरमस्य नृपासनं क्व ॥141॥
cc-adi-5.141.translation: "What is the value of a throne to Lord Kṛṣṇa? The masters of the various planetary systems accept the dust of His lotus feet on their crowned heads. That dust makes the holy places sacred, and even Lord Brahmā, Lord Śiva, Lakṣmī and I Myself, who are all portions of His plenary portion, eternally carry that dust on our heads."

lines: ekale īśvara kṛṣṇa, āra saba bhṛtya
yāre yaiche nācāya, se taiche kare nṛtya
devanagari: एकले ईश्वर कृष्ण, आर सब भृत्य ।
यारे यैछे नाचाय, से तैछे करे नृत्य ॥142॥
cc-adi-5.142.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa alone is the supreme controller, and all others are His servants. They dance as He makes them do so.

lines: āra saba pāriṣada, keha vā kiṅkara
devanagari: एइ मत चैतन्य - गोसाञि एकले ईश्वर ।
आर सब पारिषद, केह वा किङ्कर ॥143॥
cc-adi-5.143.translation: Thus Lord Caitanya is also the only controller. All others are His associates or servants.

devanagari: गुरु - वर्ग, नित्यानन्द, अद्वैत आचार्य ।
श्रीवासादि, आर व्रत - लघु, सम, आर्य ॥144॥
cc-adi-5.144-145.translation: His elders such as Lord Nityānanda, Advaita Ācārya and Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, as well as His other devotees-whether His juniors, equals or superiors-are all His associates who help Him in His pastimes. Lord Gaurāṅga fulfills His aims with their help.

lines: dui-jana lañā prabhura yata kichu raṅga
devanagari: अद्वैत आचा र्य, नित्यानन्द , - दुइ अङ्ग ।
दुइ - जन लञा प्रभुर व्रत किछु रङ्ग ॥146॥
cc-adi-5.146.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya and Śrīla Nityānanda Prabhu, who are plenary parts of the Lord, are His principal associates. With these two the Lord performs His pastimes in various ways.

lines: prabhu guru kari' māne, tiṅho ta' kiṅkara
devanagari: अद्वैत - आचार्य - गोसाञि साक्षातीश्वर ।
प्रभु गुरु करि’ माने, तिंहो त’ किङ्कर ॥147॥
cc-adi-5.147.translation: Lord Advaita Ācārya is directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Although Lord Caitanya accepts Him as His preceptor, Advaita Ācārya is a servant of the Lord.

devanagari: आचार्य - गोसाञि र तत्त्व ना याय कथन ।
कृष्ण अवतारि येंहो तारिल भुवन ॥148॥
cc-adi-5.148.translation: I cannot describe the truth of Advaita Ācārya. He has delivered the entire world by making Lord Kṛṣṇa descend.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - स्वरूप पूर्वे हइया लक्ष्मण ।
लघु - भ्राता हैया करे रामेर सेवन ॥149॥
cc-adi-5.149.translation: Lord Nityānanda Svarūpa formerly appeared as Lakṣmaṇa and served Lord Rāmacandra as His younger brother.

devanagari: सर्वग, अनन्त, विभु - वैकुण्ठादि धाम ।
कृष्ण, कृष्ण - अवतारेर ताहाजि विश्राम ॥15॥
cc-adi-5.15.translation: That Vaikuṇṭha region is all-pervading, infinite and supreme. It is the residence of Lord Kṛṣṇa and His incarnations.

devanagari: रामेर चरित्र सब , - दुःखेर कारण ।
स्वतन्त्र लीलाय दुःख सहेन लक्ष्मण ॥150॥
cc-adi-5.150.translation: The activities of Lord Rāma were full of suffering, but Lakṣmaṇa, of His own accord, tolerated that suffering.

lines: niṣedha karite nāre, yāte choṭa bhāi
mauna dhari' rahe lakṣmaṇa mane duḥkha pāi'
devanagari: निषेध करिते नारे, याते छोट भाइ ।
मौन ध रि’ रहे लक्ष्मण मने दुःख पाइ’ ॥151॥
cc-adi-5.151.translation: As a younger brother He could not stop Lord Rāma from His resolution, and so He remained silent, although unhappy in His mind.

devanagari: कृष्ण - अवतारे ज्येष्ठ हैला सेवार कारण ।
कृष्णके कराइल नाना सुख आस्वादन ॥152॥
cc-adi-5.152.translation: When Lord Kṛṣṇa appeared, He [Balarāma] became His elder brother to serve Him to His heart's content and make Him enjoy all sorts of happiness.

devanagari: राम - लक्ष्मण - कृष्ण - रामेर अंश - विशेष ।
अवतार - काले दोंहे दोंहाते प्रवेश ॥153॥
cc-adi-5.153.translation: Śrī Rāma and Śrī Lakṣmaṇa, who are plenary portions of Lord Kṛṣṇa and Lord Balarāma, entered into Them at the time of Kṛṣṇa's and Balarāma's appearance.

devanagari: सेइ अंश लञा ज्येष्ठ - कनिष्ठाभिमान ।
अंशांशि - रूपे शास्त्रे करये व्याख्यान ॥154॥
cc-adi-5.154.translation: Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma present Themselves as elder or younger brother, but in the scriptures They are described as the original Supreme Personality of Godhead and His expansion.

lines: kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṁ samabhavat paramaḥ pumān yo
devanagari: रामादि - मूर्तिषु कला - नियमेन तिष्ठन् नानावतारमकरोद्भुवनेषु किन्तु ।
कृष्णः स्वयं समभवत्परमः पुमान् यो गोविन्दमादि - पुरुषं तमहं भजामि ॥155॥
cc-adi-5.155.translation: "I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, who by His various plenary portions appeared in the world in different forms and incarnations such as Lord Rāma, but who personally appears in His supreme original form as Lord Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: श्री - चैतन्य - सेइ कृष्ण, नित्यानन्द - राम ।
नित्यानन्द पूर्ण करे चैतन्येर काम ॥156॥
cc-adi-5.156.translation: Lord Caitanya is the same Lord Kṛṣṇa, and Lord Nityānanda is Lord Balarāma. Lord Nityānanda fulfills all of Lord Caitanya's desires.

lines: eka kaṇā sparśi mātra,—se kṛpā tāṅhāra
devanagari: नित्यानन्द - महिमा - सिन्धु अनन्त, अपार ।
एक कणा स्पर्श मात्र , - से कृपा ताँहार ॥157॥
cc-adi-5.157.translation: The ocean of Lord Nityānanda's glory is infinite and unfathomable. Only by His mercy can I touch even a drop of it.

lines: āra eka śuna tāṅra kṛpāra mahimā
devanagari: आर एक शुन ताँर कृपार महिमा ।
अधम जीवेरे चढ़ाइल ऊर्ध्व - सीमा ॥158॥
cc-adi-5.158.translation: Please listen to another glory of His mercy. He made a fallen living entity climb to the highest limit.

devanagari: वेद - गुह्य कथा एइ अयोग्य कहिते ।
तथापि कहिये ताँर कृपा प्रकाशिते ॥159॥
cc-adi-5.159.translation: To disclose it is not proper, for it should be kept as confidential as the Vedas, yet I shall speak of it to make His mercy known to all.

devanagari: ताहार उपरि - भागे ‘कृष्ण - लोक’ - ख्याति ।
द्वारका - मथुरा - गोकुल - त्रि - विधत्वे स्थिति ॥16॥
cc-adi-5.16.translation: In the highest region of that spiritual sky is the spiritual planet called Kṛṣṇaloka. It has three divisions-Dvārakā, Mathurā and Gokula.

devanagari: उल्लास - उपरि लेखों तोमार प्रसाद ।
नित्यानन्द प्रभु, मोर क्षम अपराध ॥160॥
cc-adi-5.160.translation: O Lord Nityānanda, I write of Your mercy out of great exultation. Please forgive me for my offenses.

devanagari: अवधूत गोसाञि र एक भृत्य प्रेम - धाम ।
मीनकेतन रामदास हय ताँर नाम ॥161॥
cc-adi-5.161.translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu had a servant named Śrī Mīnaketana Rāmadāsa, who was a reservoir of love.

devanagari: आमार आलये अहोरात्र - सङ्कीर्तन ।
ताहाते आइला तेंहो पात्रा निमन्त्रण ॥162॥
cc-adi-5.162.translation: At my house there was saṅkīrtana day and night, and therefore he visited there, having been invited.

devanagari: महा - प्रेम - मय तिंहो वसिला अङ्गने ।
सकल वैष्णव ताँर वन्दिला चरणे ॥163॥
cc-adi-5.163.translation: Absorbed in emotional love, he sat in my courtyard, and all the Vaiṣṇavas bowed down at his feet.

lines: preme kā're vaṁśī māre, kāhāke cāpaḍe
devanagari: नमस्कार करिते, कार उपरेते चड़े।
प्रेमे कार वंशी मारे, काहाके चापड़े ॥164॥
cc-adi-5.164.translation: In a joyful mood of love of God he sometimes climbed upon the shoulder of someone offering obeisances, and sometimes he struck others with his flute or mildly slapped them.

lines: ye nayana dekhite aśru haya mane yāra
devanagari: ये नयन देखिते अश्रु हय मने यार ।
सेइ नेत्रे अविच्छिन्न वहे अश्रु - धार ॥165॥
cc-adi-5.165.translation: When someone saw the eyes of Mīnaketana Rāmadāsa, tears would automatically flow from his own eyes, for a constant shower of tears flowed from the eyes of Mīnaketana Rāmadāsa.

lines: eka aṅge jāḍya tāṅra, āra aṅge kampa
devanagari: कभु कोन अङ्गे देखि पुलक - कदम्ब ।
एक अङ्गे जाडूय ताँर, आर अङ्गे कम्प ॥166॥
cc-adi-5.166.translation: Sometimes there were eruptions of ecstasy like kadamba flowers on some parts of his body, and sometimes one limb would be stunned while another would be trembling.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द ब लि’ यबे करेन हुङ्कार ।
ताहा दे खि’ लोकेर हय महा - चमत्कार ॥167॥
cc-adi-5.167.translation: Whenever he shouted aloud the name Nityānanda, the people around him were filled with great wonder and astonishment.

lines: guṇārṇava miśra nāme eka vipra ārya
devanagari: गुणार्णव मिश्र नामे एक विप्र आर्छ ।
श्री - मूर्ति - निकटे तेंहो करे सेवा - कार्य ॥168॥
cc-adi-5.168.translation: One respectable brāhmaṇa named Śrī Guṇārṇava Miśra was serving the Deity.

lines: aṅgane āsiyā teṅho nā kaila sambhāṣa
tāhā dekhi' kruddha hañā bale rāmadāsa
devanagari: अङ्गने आसिया तेंहो ना कैल सम्भाष ।
ताहा दे खि’ क्रुद्ध हञा बले रामदास ॥169॥
cc-adi-5.169.translation: When Mīnaketana was seated in the yard, this brāhmaṇa did not offer him respect. Seeing this, Śrī Rāmadāsa became angry and spoke.

devanagari: सर्वोपरि श्री - गोकुल - ब्रजलोक - धाम ।
श्री - गोलोक, श्वेतद्वीप, वृन्दावन नाम ॥17॥
cc-adi-5.17.translation: Śrī Gokula, the highest of all, is also called Vraja, Goloka, Śvetadvīpa and Vṛndāvana.

lines: baladeva dekhi' ye nā kaila pratyudgama'
devanagari: ‘एइ त’ द्वितीय सूत रोमहरषण ।
बलदेव दे खि’ ये ना कैल प्रत्युद्गम’ ॥170॥
cc-adi-5.170.translation: "Here I find the second Romaharṣaṇa-sūta, who did not stand to show honor when he saw Lord Balarāma."

lines: eta bali' nāce gāya, karaye santoṣa
devanagari: एत बलि’ नाचे गाय, करये सन्तोष ।
कृष्ण - कार्य करे विप्र - ना करिल रोष ॥171॥
cc-adi-5.171.translation: After saying this, he danced and sang to his heart's content, but the brāhmaṇa did not become angry, for he was then serving Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: mora bhrātā-sane tāṅra kichu haila vāda
devanagari: उत्सवान्ते गेला तिंहो करिया प्रसाद ।
मोर भ्राता - सने ताँर किछु हैल वाद ॥172॥
cc-adi-5.172.translation: At the end of the festival Mīnaketana Rāmadāsa went away, offering his blessings to everyone. At that time he had some controversy with my brother.

devanagari: चैतन्य - प्रभुते ताँर सुदृढ़ विश्वास ।
नित्यानन्द - प्रति ताँर विश्वास - आभास ॥173॥
cc-adi-5.173.translation: My brother had firm faith in Lord Caitanya but only a dim glimmer of faith in Lord Nityānanda.

lines: ihā jāni' rāmadāsera duḥkha ha-ila mane
tabe ta' bhrātāre āmi karinu bhartsane
devanagari: इहा जा नि’ रामदासेर दुःख हइल मने ।
तबे त’ भ्रातारे आमि करिनु भर्सने ॥174॥
cc-adi-5.174.translation: Knowing this, Śrī Rāmadāsa felt unhappy in his mind. I then rebuked my brother.

lines: nityānanda nā māna, tomāra habe sarva-nāśa
devanagari: दुइ भाइ एक - तनु - समान - प्रकाश ।
नित्यानन्द ना मान, तोमार हबे सर्व - नाश ॥175॥
cc-adi-5.175.translation: "These two brothers," I told him, "are like one body; They are identical manifestations. If you do not believe in Lord Nityānanda, you will fall down.

lines: ekete viśvāsa, anye nā kara sammāna
devanagari: एकेते विश्वास, अन्ये ना कर सम्मान ।
“अर्ध - कुक्कुटी - न्याय” तोमार प्रमाण ॥176॥
cc-adi-5.176.translation: "If you have faith in one but disrespect the other, your logic is like the logic of accepting half a hen.

lines: kiṁvā, doṅhā nā māniñā hao ta' pāṣaṇḍa
eke māni' āre nā māni,—ei-mata bhaṇḍa
devanagari: किंवा, दोंहा ना मानिन्ना हओ त’ पाषण्ड ।
एके मा नि’ आरे ना मानि , - एइ - मत भण्ड ॥177॥
cc-adi-5.177.translation: "It would be better to be an atheist by slighting both brothers than a hypocrite by believing in one and slighting the other."

lines: kruddha haiyā vaṁśī bhāṅgi' cale rāmadāsa
devanagari: क्रुद्ध हैया वंशी भाङ्गि’ चले रामदास ।
तत्काले आमार भ्रातार हैल सर्व - नाश ॥178॥
cc-adi-5.178.translation: Thus Śrī Rāmadāsa broke his flute in anger and went away, and at that time my brother fell down.

lines: āra eka kahi tāṅra dayāra svabhāva
devanagari: एइ त कहिल ताँर सेवक - प्रभाव ।
आर एक कहि ताँर दयार स्वभाव ॥179॥
cc-adi-5.179.translation: I have thus described the power of the servants of Lord Nityānanda. Now I shall describe another characteristic of His mercy.

devanagari: सर्वग, अनन्त, विभु, कृष्ण - तनु - सम ।
उपर्युधो व्यापियाछे, नाहिक नियम ॥18॥
cc-adi-5.18.translation: Like the transcendental body of Lord Kṛṣṇa, Gokula is all-pervading, infinite and supreme. It expands both above and below, without any restriction.

lines: bhāike bhartsinu muñi, lañā ei guṇa
sei rātre prabhu more dilā daraśana
devanagari: भाइके भर्तिसनु मुञि, लबा एइ गुण ।
सेइ रात्रे प्रभु मोरे दिला दरशन ॥180॥
cc-adi-5.180.translation: That night Lord Nityānanda appeared to me in a dream because of my good quality in chastising my brother.

devanagari: नैहाटि - निकटे झामटपुर’ नामे ग्राम ।
ताँहा स्वप्ने देखा दिला नित्यानन्द - राम ॥181॥
cc-adi-5.181.translation: In the village of Jhāmaṭapura, which is near Naihāṭi, Lord Nityānanda appeared to me in a dream.

devanagari: दण्डवत् हैया आमि पडिनु पायेते ।
निज - पाद - पद्म प्रभु दिला मोर माथे ॥182॥
cc-adi-5.182.translation: I fell at His feet, offering my obeisances, and He then placed His own lotus feet upon my head.

lines: uṭhi' tāṅra rūpa dekhi' hainu camatkāra
devanagari: ‘उठ’, ‘उठ’ बलि’ मोरे बले बार बार।
उठि’ ताँर रूप दे खि’ हैनु चमत्कार ॥183॥
cc-adi-5.183.translation: "Arise! Get up!" He told me again and again. Upon rising, I was greatly astonished to see His beauty.

devanagari: श्याम - चिक्कण कान्ति, प्रकाण्ड शरीर ।
साक्षात्कन्दर्प, यैछे महा - मल्ल - वीर ॥184॥
cc-adi-5.184.translation: He had a glossy blackish complexion, and His tall, strong, heroic stature made Him seem like Cupid himself.

devanagari: सुवलित हस्त, पद, कमल - नयान ।
पट्ट - वस्त्र शिरे, पट्ट - वस्त्र परिधान ॥185॥
cc-adi-5.185.translation: He had beautifully formed hands, arms and legs, and eyes like lotus flowers. He wore a silk cloth, with a silk turban on His head.

devanagari: सुवर्ण - कुण्डल कर्णे, स्वर्णाङ्गद - वाला ।
पायेते नूपुर बाजे, कण्ठे पुष्प - माला ॥186॥
cc-adi-5.186.translation: He wore golden earrings on His ears, and golden armlets and bangles. He wore tinkling anklets on His feet and a garland of flowers around His neck.

devanagari: चन्दन - लेपित - अङ्ग, तिलक सुठाम ।
मत्त - गज जिनि मद - मन्थर पयान ॥187॥
cc-adi-5.187.translation: His body was anointed with sandalwood pulp, and He was nicely decorated with tilaka. His movements surpassed those of a maddened elephant.

devanagari: कोटि - चन्द्र जि नि’ मुख उज्वल - वरण ।
दाड़िम्ब - बीज - सम दन्त ताम्बूल - चर्वण ॥188॥
cc-adi-5.188.translation: His face was more beautiful than millions upon millions of moons, and His teeth were like pomegranate seeds because of His chewing betel.

devanagari: प्रेमे मत्त अङ्ग डाहिने - वामे दोले ।
‘कृष्ण’ ‘कृष्ण’ बलिया गम्भीर बोल बले ॥189॥
cc-adi-5.189.translation: His body moved to and fro, right and left, for He was absorbed in ecstasy. He chanted "Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa" in a deep voice.

lines: eka-i svarūpa tāra, nāhi dui kāya
devanagari: ब्रह्माण्डे प्रकाश तार कृष्णेर इच्छाय ।
एकइ स्वरूप तार, नाहि दुइ काय ॥19॥
cc-adi-5.19.translation: That abode is manifested within the material world by the will of Lord Kṛṣṇa. It is identical to that original Gokula; they are not two different bodies.

lines: rāṅgā-yaṣṭi haste dole yena matta siṁha
devanagari: राङ्गा - यष्टि हस्ते दोले येन मत्त सिंह ।
चारि - पाशे वेड़ि आछे चरणेते भृङ्ग ॥190॥
cc-adi-5.190.translation: His red stick moving in His hand, He seemed like a maddened lion. All around the four sides of His feet were bumblebees.

devanagari: पारिषद - गणे देखि सब गोप - वेशे ।
‘कृष्ण’ ‘कृष्ण’ कहे सबे सप्रेम आवेशे ॥191॥
cc-adi-5.191.translation: His devotees, dressed like cowherd boys, surrounded His feet like so many bees and also chanted "Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa," absorbed in ecstatic love.

lines: śiṅgā vāṁśī bājāya keha, keha nāce gāya
devanagari: शिङ्गा वांशी बाजाय केह, केह नाचे गाय ।
सेवक योगाय ताम्बूल, चामर ढुलाय ॥192॥
cc-adi-5.192.translation: Some of them played horns and flutes, and others danced and sang. Some of them offered betel nuts, and others waved cāmara fans about Him.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - स्वरूपेर देखिया वैभव ।
किबा रूप, गुण, लीला - अलौकिक सब ॥193॥
cc-adi-5.193.translation: Thus I saw such opulence in Lord Nityānanda Svarūpa. His wonderful form, qualities and pastimes are all transcendental.

lines: ānande vihvala āmi, kichu nāhi jāni
tabe hāsi' prabhu more kahilena vāṇī
devanagari: आनन्दे विह्वल आमि, किछु नाहि जानि ।
तबे हा सि’ प्रभु मोरे कहिलेन वाणी ॥194॥
cc-adi-5.194.translation: I was overwhelmed with transcendental ecstasy, not knowing anything else. Then Lord Nityānanda smiled and spoke to me as follows.

lines: āre āre kṛṣṇadāsa, nā karaha bhaya
devanagari: आरे आरे कृष्णदास, ना करह भय ।
वृन्दावने याह, ताँहा सर्व लभ्य हय ॥195॥
cc-adi-5.195.translation: "O my dear Kṛṣṇadāsa, do not be afraid. Go to Vṛndāvana, for there you will attain all things."

lines: eta bali' prerilā more hātasāni diyā
devanagari: एत बलि’ प्रेरिला मोरे हातसानि दिया ।
अन्तर्धान कैल प्रभु निज - गण लञा ॥196॥
cc-adi-5.196.translation: After saying this, He directed me toward Vṛndāvana by waving His hand. Then He disappeared with His associates.

devanagari: मूर्च्छित हइया मुञि पड़िनु भूमिते ।
स्वप्न - भङ्ग हैल, देखि, हाछे प्रभाते ॥197॥
cc-adi-5.197.translation: I fainted and fell to the ground, my dream broke, and when I regained consciousness I saw that morning had come.

lines: ki dekhinu ki śuninu, kariye vicāra
devanagari: कि देखिनु कि शुनिनु, करिये विचार ।
प्रभु - आज्ञा हैल वृन्दावन याइबार ॥198॥
cc-adi-5.198.translation: I thought about what I had seen and heard and concluded that the Lord had ordered me to proceed to Vṛndāvana at once.

devanagari: सेइ क्षणे वृन्दावने करिनु गमन ।
प्रभुर कृपाते सुखे आइनु वृन्दावन ॥199॥
cc-adi-5.199.translation: That very second I started for Vṛndāvana, and by His mercy I reached there in great happiness.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-5.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. All glories to Lord Nityānanda. All glories to Advaita Ācārya. And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: चिन्तामणि - भूमि, कल्प - वृक्ष - मय वन ।
चर्म - चक्षे देखे तारे प्रपञ्चे र सम ॥20॥
cc-adi-5.20.translation: The land there is touchstone [cintāmaṇi], and the forests abound with desire trees. Material eyes see it as an ordinary place.

devanagari: जय जय नित्यानन्द, नित्यानन्द - राम ।
याँहार कृपाते पाइनु वृन्दावन - धाम ॥200॥
cc-adi-5.200.translation: All glory, all glory to Lord Nityānanda Balarāma, by whose mercy I have attained shelter in the transcendental abode of Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: जय जय नित्यानन्द, जय कृपा - मय ।
याँहा हैते पाइनु रूप - सनातनाश्रय ॥201॥
cc-adi-5.201.translation: All glory, all glory to the merciful Lord Nityānanda, by whose mercy I have attained shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Sanātana.

devanagari: याँहा हैते पाइनु रघुनाथ - महाशय ।
याँहा हैते पाइनु श्री - स्वरूप - आश्रय ॥202॥
cc-adi-5.202.translation: By His mercy I have attained the shelter of the great personality Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, and by His mercy I have found the refuge of Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara.

devanagari: सनातन - कृपाय पाइनु भक्तिर सिद्धान्त ।
श्री - रूप - कृपाय पाइनु भक्ति - रस - प्रान्त ॥203॥
cc-adi-5.203.translation: By the mercy of Sanātana Gosvāmī I have learned the final conclusions of devotional service, and by the grace of Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī I have tasted the highest nectar of devotional service.

devanagari: जय जय नित्यानन्द - चरणारविन्द ।
याँहा हैते पाइनु श्री - राधा - गोविन्द ॥204॥
cc-adi-5.204.translation: All glory, all glory to the lotus feet of Lord Nityānanda, by whose mercy I have attained Śrī Rādhā-Govinda.

lines: jagāi mādhāi haite muñi se pāpiṣṭha
purīṣera kīṭa haite muñi se laghiṣṭha
devanagari: जगाइ माधाइ हैते मुञि से पापिष्ठ ।
पुरीषेर कीट हैते मुञि से लघिष्ठ ॥205॥
cc-adi-5.205.translation: I am more sinful than Jagāi and Mādhāi and even lower than the worms in the stool.

lines: mora nāma śune yei tāra puṇya kṣaya
mora nāma laya yei tāra pāpa haya
devanagari: मोर नाम शुने येइ तार पुण्य क्षय ।
मोर नाम लय येइ तार पाप होय ॥206॥
cc-adi-5.206.translation: Anyone who hears my name loses the results of his pious activities. Anyone who utters my name becomes sinful.

lines: emana nirghṛṇa more kebā kṛpā kare
devanagari: एमन निघृण मोरे केबा कृपा करे ।
एक नित्यानन्द विनु जगत्भितरे ॥207॥
cc-adi-5.207.translation: Who in this world but Nityānanda could show His mercy to such an abominable person as me?

lines: uttama, adhama, kichu nā kare vicāra
devanagari: प्रेमे मत्त नित्यानन्द कृपा - अवतार ।
उत्तम, अधम, किछु ना करे विचार ॥208॥
cc-adi-5.208.translation: Because He is intoxicated by ecstatic love and is an incarnation of mercy, He does not distinguish between the good and the bad.

lines: ye āge paḍaye, tāre karaye nistāra
devanagari: ये आगे पड़ये, तारे करये निस्तार ।
अतएव निस्तारिला मो - हेन दुराचार ॥209॥
cc-adi-5.209.translation: He delivers all those who fall down before Him. Therefore He has delivered such a sinful and fallen person as me.

devanagari: प्रेम - नेत्रे देखे तार स्वरूप - प्रकाश ।
गोप - गोपी - सङ्गे याँहा कृष्णेर विलास ॥21॥
cc-adi-5.21.translation: But with the eyes of love of Godhead one can see its real identity as the place where Lord Kṛṣṇa performs His pastimes with the cowherd boys and cowherd girls.

devanagari: मो - पापिष्ठे आनिलेन श्री - वृन्दावन ।
मो - हेन अधमे दिला श्री - रूप - चरण ॥210॥
cc-adi-5.210.translation: Although I am sinful and I am the most fallen, He has conferred upon me the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī.

devanagari: श्री - मदन - गोपाल - श्री - गोविन्द - दरशन ।
कहिबार योग्य नहे ए - सब कथन ॥211॥
cc-adi-5.211.translation: I am not fit to speak all these confidential words about my visiting Lord Madana Gopāla and Lord Govinda.

devanagari: वृन्दावन - पुरन्दर श्री - मदन - गोपाल ।
रास - विलासी साक्षात्व्रजेन्द्र कुमार ॥212॥
cc-adi-5.212.translation: Lord Madana Gopāla, the chief Deity of Vṛndāvana, is the enjoyer of the rāsa dance and is directly the son of the King of Vraja.

devanagari: श्री - राधा - ललिता - सङ्गे रास - विलास ।
मन्मथ - मन्मथ - रूपे याँहार प्रकाश ॥213॥
cc-adi-5.213.translation: He enjoys the rāsa dance with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, Śrī Lalitā and others. He manifests Himself as the Cupid of Cupids.

devanagari: तासामाविर भूच्छौरिः स्मयमान - मुखाम्बुजः ।
पीताम्बर - धरः स्रग्वी साक्षान्मन्मथ - मन्मथः ॥214॥
cc-adi-5.214.translation: "Wearing yellow garments and decorated with a flower garland, Lord Kṛṣṇa, appearing among the gopīs with His smiling lotus face, looked directly like the charmer of the heart of Cupid."

lines: dui pāśe rādhā lalitā karena sevana
devanagari: स्व - माधुर्ये लोकेर मन करे आकर्षण ।
दुइ पाशे राधा ललिता करेन सेवन ॥215॥
cc-adi-5.215.translation: With Rādhā and Lalitā serving Him on His two sides, He attracts the hearts of all by His own sweetness.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - दया मोरे ताँरे देखाइल ।
श्री - राधा - मदन - मोहने प्रभु करि’ दिल ॥216॥
cc-adi-5.216.translation: The mercy of Lord Nityānanda showed me Śrī Madanamohana and gave me Śrī Madanamohana as my Lord and master.

devanagari: मो - अधमे दिल श्री - गोविन्द दरशन ।
कहिबार कथा नहे अक थ्य - कथन ॥217॥
cc-adi-5.217.translation: He granted to one as low as me the sight of Lord Govinda. Words cannot describe this, nor is it fit to be disclosed.

devanagari: वृन्दावने योग - पीठे कल्प - तरु - वने ।
रत्न - मण्डप, ताहे रत्न - सिंहासने ॥218॥
cc-adi-5.218-219.translation: On an altar made of gems in the principal temple of Vṛndāvana, amidst a forest of desire trees, Lord Govinda, the son of the King of Vraja, sits upon a throne of gems and manifests His full glory and sweetness, thus enchanting the entire world.

devanagari: चिन्तामणि - प्रकर - सद्मसु कल्प - वृक्ष - लक्षावृतेषु सुरभीरभिपालयन्तम् ।
लक्ष्मी - सहस्र - शत - सम्भ्रम - सेव्यमानं गोविन्दमादि - पुरुषं तमहं भजामि ॥22॥
cc-adi-5.22.translation: "I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, the first progenitor, who is tending cows yielding all desires in abodes built with spiritual gems and surrounded by millions of purpose trees. He is always served with great reverence and affection by hundreds and thousands of goddesses of fortune."

devanagari: वाम - पाचे श्री - राधिका सखी - गण - सङ्गे ।
रासादिक - लीला प्रभु करे कत रङ्गे ॥220॥
cc-adi-5.220.translation: By His left side is Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and Her personal friends. With them Lord Govinda enjoys the rāsa-līlā and many other pastimes.

devanagari: याँर ध्यान निज - लोके करे पद्मासन ।
अष्टादशाक्षर - मन्त्रे करे उपासन ॥221॥
cc-adi-5.221.translation: Lord Brahmā, sitting on his lotus seat in his own abode, always meditates on Him and worships Him with the mantra consisting of eighteen syllables.

devanagari: चौद्द - भुवने याँर सबे करे ध्यान ।
वैकुण्ठादि - पुरे याँर लीला - गुण गान ॥222॥
cc-adi-5.222.translation: Everyone in the fourteen worlds meditates upon Him, and all the denizens of Vaikuṇṭha sing of His qualities and pastimes.

devanagari: याँर माधुरीते करे लक्ष्मी आकर्षण ।
रूप - गोसाञि करियाछेन से - रूप वर्णन ॥223॥
cc-adi-5.223.translation: The goddess of fortune is attracted by His sweetness, which Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī has described in this way:

lines: mā prekṣiṣṭhās tava yadi sakhe bandhu-saṅge 'sti raṅgaḥ
devanagari: स्मेरां भङ्गी - त्रय - परिचितां साचि - विस्तीर्ण - दृष्टिं वंशी - न्यस्ताधर - किशलयामुज्ज्वलां चन्द्रकेण ।
गोविन्दाख्यां हरि - तनुमितः केशि - तीर्थोपकण्ठे मा प्रेक्षिष्ठास्तव यदि सखे बन्धु - सङ्गेऽस्ति रङ्गः ॥224॥
cc-adi-5.224.translation: "My dear friend, if you are indeed attached to your worldly friends, do not look at the smiling face of Lord Govinda as He stands on the bank of the Yamunā at Keśīghāṭa. Casting sidelong glances, He places His flute to His lips, which seem like newly blossomed twigs. His transcendental body, bending in three places, appears very bright in the moonlight."

lines: yebā ajñe kare tāṅre pratimā-hena jñāna
devanagari: साक्षात्व्रजेन्द्र - सुत इथे नाहि आन ।
येबा अज्ञे करे ताँरे प्रतिमा - हेन ज्ञान ॥225॥
cc-adi-5.225.translation: Without a doubt He is directly the son of the King of Vraja. Only a fool considers Him a statue.

lines: ghora narakete paḍe, ki baliba āra
devanagari: सेइ अपराधे तार नाहिक निस्तार ।
घोर नरकेते पड़े, कि बलिब आर ॥226॥
cc-adi-5.226.translation: For that offense, he cannot be liberated. Rather, he will fall into a terrible hellish condition. What more should I say?

lines: hena ye govinda prabhu, pāinu yāṅhā haite
devanagari: हेन ये गोविन्द प्रभु, पाइनु याँहा हैते ।
ताँहार चरण - कृपा के पारे वर्णिते ॥227॥
cc-adi-5.227.translation: Therefore who can describe the mercy of the lotus feet of Him [Lord Nityānanda] by whom I have attained the shelter of this Lord Govinda?

devanagari: वृन्दावने वैसे यत वैष्णव - मण्डल ।
कृष्ण - नाम - परायण, परम - मङ्गल ॥228॥
cc-adi-5.228.translation: All the groups of Vaiṣṇavas who live in Vṛndāvana are absorbed in chanting the all-auspicious name of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: याँर प्राण - धन - नित्यानन्द - श्री - चैतन्य ।
राधा - कृष्ण - भक्ति विने नाहि जाने अन्य ॥229॥
cc-adi-5.229.translation: Lord Caitanya and Lord Nityānanda are their life and soul. They do not know anything but devotional service to Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: मथुरा - द्वारकाय निज - रूप प्रकाशिया ।
नाना - रूपे विलसये चतुर्व्यह हैञा ॥23॥
cc-adi-5.23.translation: He manifests His own, form in Mathurā and Dvārakā. He enjoys pastimes in various ways by expanding into the quadruple forms.

devanagari: से वैष्णवेर पद - रेणु, तार पद - छाया ।
अधमेरे दिल प्रभु - नित्यानन्द - दया ॥230॥
cc-adi-5.230.translation: The dust and shade of the lotus feet of the Vaiṣṇavas have been granted to this fallen soul by the mercy of Lord Nityānanda.

devanagari: ‘ताँहा सर्व लभ्य ह य’ - प्रभुर वचन ।
सेइ सूत्र - एइ तार कैल विवरण ॥231॥
cc-adi-5.231.translation: Lord Nityānanda said, "In Vṛndāvana all things are possible." Here I have explained His brief statement in detail.

lines: se saba pāinu āmi vṛndāvane āya
sei saba labhya ei prabhura kṛpāya
devanagari: से सब पाइनु आमि वृन्दावने आय ।
सेइ सब लभ्य एइ प्रभुर कृपाय ॥232॥
cc-adi-5.232.translation: I have attained all this by coming to Vṛndāvana, and this was made possible by the mercy of Lord Nityānanda.

devanagari: आपनार कथा लिखि निर्लज्ज हइया ।
नित्यानन्द - गुणे लेखाय उन्मत्त करिया ॥233॥
cc-adi-5.233.translation: I have described my own story without reservations. The attributes of Lord Nityānanda, making me like a madman, force me to write these things.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - प्रभुर गुण - महिमा अपार ।
‘सहस्र - वदने’ शेष नाहि पाय याँर ॥234॥
cc-adi-5.234.translation: The glories of Lord Nityānanda's transcendental attributes are unfathomable. Even Lord Śeṣa with His thousands of mouths cannot find their limit.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥235॥
cc-adi-5.235.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: वासुदेव - सङ्कर्षण - प्रद्युम्नानिरुद्ध ।
सर्व - चतुर्व्यह - अंशी, तुरीय, विशुद्ध ॥24॥
cc-adi-5.24.translation: Vāsudeva, Saṅkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna and Aniruddha are the primary quadruple forms from whom all other quadruple forms are manifested. They are all purely transcendental.

devanagari: एइ तिन लोके कृष्ण केवल - लीला - मय ।
निज - गण लञा खेले अनन्त समय ॥25॥
cc-adi-5.25.translation: Only in these three places [Dvārakā, Mathurā and Gokula] does the all-sporting Lord Kṛṣṇa perform His endless pastimes with His personal associates.

devanagari: पर - व्योम - मध्ये क रि’ स्वरूप प्रका श ।
नारायण - रूपे करेन विविध विलास ॥26॥
cc-adi-5.26.translation: In the Vaikuṇṭha planets of the spiritual sky the Lord manifests His identity as Nārāyaṇa and performs pastimes in various ways.

devanagari: स्वरूप - विग्रह कृष्णेर केवल द्वि - भुज ।
नारायण - रूपे सेइ तनु चतुर्भुज ॥27॥
cc-adi-5.27-28.translation: Kṛṣṇa's own form has only two hands, but in the form of Lord Nārāyaṇa He has four hands. Lord Nārāyaṇa holds a conchshell, disc, club and lotus flower, and He is full of great opulence. The śrī, bhū and nīlā energies serve at His lotus feet.

lines: tathāpi jīvere kṛpāya kare eka karma
devanagari: यद्यपि केवल ताँर क्रीड़ा - मात्र धर्म ।
तथापि जीवेरे कृपाय करे एक कर्म ॥29॥
cc-adi-5.29.translation: Although His pastimes are His only characteristic functions, by His causeless mercy He performs one activity for the fallen souls.

devanagari: एइ षट्श्लोके कहिल कृष्ण - चैतन्य - महिमा ।
पञ्च - श्लोके कहि नित्यानन्द - तत्त्व - सीमा ॥3॥
cc-adi-5.3.translation: I have described the glory of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya in six verses. Now, in five verses, I shall describe the glory of Lord Nityānanda.

lines: cāri mukti diyā kare jīvera nistāra
devanagari: सालोक्य - सामीप्य - सार्टि - सारूप्य - प्रकार ।
चारि मुक्ति दिया करे जीवेर निस्तार ॥30॥
cc-adi-5.30.translation: He delivers the fallen living entities by offering them the four kinds of liberation-sālokya, sāmīpya, sārṣṭi and sārūpya.

devanagari: ब्रह्म - सायुज्य - मुक्तेर ताहा नाहि गति ।
वैकुण्ठ - बाहिरे हय ता’ - सबार स्थिति ॥31॥
cc-adi-5.31.translation: Those who attain brahma-sāyujya liberation cannot gain entrance into Vaikuṇṭha; their residence is outside the Vaikuṇṭha planets.

devanagari: वैकुण्ठ - बाहिरे एक ज्योतिर्मय मण्डल ।
कृष्णेर अङ्गेर प्रभा, परम उज्वल ॥32॥
cc-adi-5.32.translation: Outside the Vaikuṇṭha planets is the atmosphere of the glowing effulgence, which consists of the supremely bright rays of the body of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ‘सिद्ध - लोक’ नाम तार प्रकृतिर पार ।
चित्स्वरूप, ताँहा नाहि चिच्छक्ति विकार ॥33॥
cc-adi-5.33.translation: That region is called Siddhaloka, and it is beyond material nature. Its essence is spiritual, but it does not have spiritual varieties.

devanagari: सूर्य - मण्डल येन बाहिरे निर्विशेष ।
भितरे सूर रथ - आदि सविशेष ॥34॥
cc-adi-5.34.translation: It is like the homogeneous effulgence around the sun. But inside the sun are the chariots, horses and other opulences of the sun-god.

devanagari: कामाद्वेषाद्भयात्स्नेहा यथा भक्त्येश्वरे मनः ।
आवेश्य तदधं हित्वा बहवस्तगतिं गताः ॥35॥
cc-adi-5.35.translation: "As through devotion to the Lord one can attain His abode, many have attained that goal by abandoning their sinful activities and absorbing their minds in the Lord through lust, envy, fear or affection."

devanagari: यदरीणां प्रियाणां च प्राप्यमेकमिवोदितम् ।
तद्ब्रह्म - कृष्णयरैक्यात्किरणार्कोपमा - जुषोः ॥36॥
cc-adi-5.36.translation: "Where it has been stated that the Lord's enemies and devotees attain the same destination, this refers to the ultimate oneness of Brahman and Lord Kṛṣṇa. This may be understood by the example of the sun and the sunshine, in which Brahman is like the sunshine and Kṛṣṇa Himself is like the sun."

devanagari: तैछे पर - व्योमे नाना चिच्छक्ति - विलास ।
निर्विशेष ज्योतिर्बिम्ब बाहिरे प्रकाश ॥37॥
cc-adi-5.37.translation: Thus in the spiritual sky there are varieties of pastimes within the spiritual energy. Outside the Vaikuṇṭha planets appears the impersonal reflection of light.

devanagari: निर्विशेष - ब्रह्म सेइ केवल ज्योतिर्मय ।
सायुज्येर अधिकारी ताँहा पाय लय ॥38॥
cc-adi-5.38.translation: That impersonal Brahman effulgence consists only of the effulgent rays of the Lord. Those fit for sāyujya liberation merge into that effulgence.

devanagari: सिद्ध - लोकस्तु तमसः पारे यत्र वसन्ति हि ।
सिद्धा ब्रह्म - सुखे मग्ना दैत्याश्च हरिणा हताः ॥39॥
cc-adi-5.39.translation: "Beyond the region of ignorance [the material cosmic manifestation] lies the realm of Siddhaloka. The Siddhas reside there, absorbed in the bliss of Brahman. Demons killed by the Lord also attain that realm."

devanagari: सर्व - अवतारी कृष्ण स्वयं भगवान् ।
ताँहार द्वितीय देह श्री - बलराम ॥4॥
cc-adi-5.4.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, is the fountainhead of all incarnations. Lord Balarāma is His second body.

devanagari: सेइ पर - व्योमे नारायणेर चारि पाशे ।
द्वारका - चतुर्व्यहेर द्वितीय प्रकाशे ॥40॥
cc-adi-5.40.translation: In that spiritual sky, on the four sides of Nārāyaṇa, are the second expansions of the quadruple expansions of Dvārakā.

devanagari: वासुदेव - सङ्कर्षण - प्रद्युम्नानिरुद्ध ।
‘द्वितीय चतुर्व्यह’ एइ - तुरीय, विशुद्ध ॥41॥
cc-adi-5.41.translation: Vāsudeva, Saṅkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna and Aniruddha constitute this second quadruple. They are purely transcendental.

devanagari: ताँहा ये रामेर रूप - महा - सङ्कर्षण ।
चिच्छक्ति - आश्रय तिंहो, कारणेर कारण ॥42॥
cc-adi-5.42.translation: There the personal feature of Balarāma called Mahā-saṅkarṣaṇa is the shelter of the spiritual energy. He is the primary cause, the cause of all causes.

devanagari: चिच्छक्ति - विलास एक - ‘शुद्ध - सत्त्व’ नाम ।
शुद्ध - सत्त्व - मयं व्रत वैकुण्ठादि - धाम ॥43॥
cc-adi-5.43.translation: One variety of the pastimes of the spiritual energy is described as pure goodness [viśuddha-sattva]. It comprises all the abodes of Vaikuṇṭha.

devanagari: षड् - विधैश्वर्य ताँहा सकल चिन्मय ।
सङ्कर्षणेर विभूति सब, जानिह निश्चय ॥44॥
cc-adi-5.44.translation: The six attributes are all spiritual. Know for certain that they are all manifestations of the opulence of Saṅkarṣaṇa.

devanagari: ‘जीव - नाम तटस्थाख्य एक शक्ति हय ।
महा - सङ्कर्षण - सब जीवेर आश्रय ॥45॥
cc-adi-5.45.translation: There is one marginal potency, known as the jīva. Mahā-saṅkarṣaṇa is the shelter of all jīvas.

devanagari: याँहा हैते विश्वोत्पत्ति, याँहाते प्रलय ।
सेइ पुरुषेर सङ्कर्षण समाश्रय ॥46॥
cc-adi-5.46.translation: Saṅkarṣaṇa is the original shelter of the puruṣa, from whom this world is created and in whom it is dissolved.

devanagari: सर्वाश्रय, सर्वाद्भुत, ऐश्वर्य अपार ।
‘अनन्त’ कहते नारे महिमा याँहार ॥47॥
cc-adi-5.47.translation: He [Saṅkarṣaṇa] is the shelter of everything. He is wonderful in every respect, and His opulences are infinite. Even Ananta cannot describe His glory.

devanagari: तुरीय, विशुद्ध - सत्त्व, ‘सङ्कर्षण’ नाम ।
तिंहो याँर अंश, सेइ नित्यानन्द - राम ॥48॥
cc-adi-5.48.translation: That Saṅkarṣaṇa, who is transcendental pure goodness, is a partial expansion of Nityānanda Balarāma.

lines: navama ślokera artha śuna diyā mana
devanagari: अष्टम श्लोकेर कैल सङ्क्षेपे विवरण ।
नवम श्लोकेर अर्थ शुन दिया मन ॥49॥
cc-adi-5.49.translation: I have briefly explained the eighth verse. Now please listen with attention as I explain the ninth verse.

devanagari: एकइ स्वरूप दोंहे, भिन्न - मात्र काय ।
आद्य काय - व्यूह, कृष्ण - लीलार सहाय ॥5॥
cc-adi-5.5.translation: They are both one and the same identity. They differ only in form. He is the first bodily expansion of Kṛṣṇa, and He assists in Lord Kṛṣṇa's transcendental pastimes.

devanagari: माया - भर्ताजाण्ड - सङ्घाश्रयाङ्गः शेते साक्षात्कारणाम्भोधि - मध्ये ।
यस्यैकांशः श्री - पुमानादि - देवस् तं श्री - नित्यानन्द - रामं प्रपद्ये ॥50॥
cc-adi-5.50.translation: I offer my full obeisances unto the feet of Śrī Nityānanda Rāma, whose partial representation called Kāraṇodakaśāyī Viṣṇu, lying on the Kāraṇa Ocean, is the original puruṣa, the master of the illusory energy, and the shelter of all the universes.

devanagari: वैकुण्ठ - बाहिरे येइ ज्योतिर्मय धाम ।
ताहार बाहिरे ‘कारणार्ण व’ नाम ॥51॥
cc-adi-5.51.translation: Outside the Vaikuṇṭha planets is the impersonal Brahman effulgence, and beyond that effulgence is the Kāraṇa Ocean, or Causal Ocean.

devanagari: वैकुण्ठ बेड़िया एक आछे जल - निधि ।
अनन्त, अपार - तार नाहिक अवधि ॥52॥
cc-adi-5.52.translation: Surrounding Vaikuṇṭha is a mass of water that is endless, unfathomed and unlimited.

lines: māyika bhūtera tathi janma nāhi haya
devanagari: वैकुण्ठेर पृथिव्यादि सकल चिन्मय ।
मायिक भूतेर तथि जन्म नाहि हय ॥53॥
cc-adi-5.53.translation: The earth, water, fire, air and ether of Vaikuṇṭha are all spiritual. Material elements are not found there.

devanagari: चिन्मय - जल सेइ परम कारण ।
यार एक कणा गङ्गा पतित - पावन ॥54॥
cc-adi-5.54.translation: The water of the Kāraṇa Ocean, which is the original cause, is therefore spiritual. The sacred Ganges, which is but a drop of it, purifies the fallen souls.

devanagari: सेइ त’ कारणार्णवे सेइ सङ्कर्षण ।
आपनार एक अंशे करेन शयन ॥55॥
cc-adi-5.55.translation: In that ocean lies one plenary portion of Lord Saṅkarṣaṇa.

devanagari: महत्वष्टा पुरुष, तिंहो जगत्कारण ।
आद्य - अवतार करे मायाय ईक्षण ॥56॥
cc-adi-5.56.translation: He is known as the first puruṣa, the creator of the total material energy. He, the cause of the universes, the first incarnation, casts His glance over māyā.

devanagari: माया - शक्ति रहे कारणाब्धिर बाहिरे ।
कारण - समुद्र माया परशिते नारे ॥57॥
cc-adi-5.57.translation: Māyā-śakti resides outside the Ocean of Kāraṇa. Māyā cannot touch its waters.

devanagari: सेइ त मायार दुई - विध अवस्थिति ।
जगतेर उपादान ‘प्रधान’, प्रकृति ॥58॥
cc-adi-5.58.translation: Māyā has two varieties of existence. One is called pradhāna or prakṛti. It supplies the ingredients of the material world.

lines: śakti sañcāriyā tāre kṛṣṇa kare kṛpā
devanagari: जगत्कारण नहे प्रकृति जड़ - रूपा ।
शक्ति सञ्चारिया तारे कृष्ण करे कृपा ॥59॥
cc-adi-5.59.translation: Because prakṛti is dull and inert, it cannot actually be the cause of the material world. But Lord Kṛṣṇa shows His mercy by infusing His energy into the dull, inert material nature.

devanagari: सेइ कृष्ण - नवद्वीपे श्री - चैतन्य - चन्द्र ।
सेइ बलराम - सङ्गे श्री - नित्यानन्द ॥6॥
cc-adi-5.6.translation: That original Lord Kṛṣṇa appeared in Navadvīpa as Lord Caitanya, and Balarāma appeared with Him as Lord Nityānanda.

devanagari: कृष्ण - शक्त्ये प्रकृति हय गौण कारण ।
अग्नि - शक्त्ये लौह यैछे करये जारण ॥60॥
cc-adi-5.60.translation: Thus prakṛti, by the energy of Lord Kṛṣṇa, becomes the secondary cause, just as iron becomes red-hot by the energy of fire.

devanagari: अतएव कृष्ण मूल - जगत्कारण ।
प्रकृति कारण यैछे अजा - गल - स्तन ॥61॥
cc-adi-5.61.translation: Therefore Lord Kṛṣṇa is the original cause of the cosmic manifestation. Prakṛti is like the nipples on the neck of a goat, for they cannot give any milk.

devanagari: माया - अंशे कहि तारे निमित्त - कारण ।
सेह नहे, य़ाते कर्ता - हेतु - नारायण ॥62॥
cc-adi-5.62.translation: The māyā aspect of material nature is the immediate cause of the cosmic manifestation. But it also cannot be the real cause, for the original cause is Lord Nārāyaṇa.

devanagari: घटेर निमित्त - हेतु यैछे कुम्भकार ।
तैछे जगतेर कर्ता - पुरुषावतार ॥63॥
cc-adi-5.63.translation: Just as the original cause of an earthen pot is the potter, so the creator of the material world is the first puruṣa incarnation [Kāraṇārṇavaśāyī Viṣṇu].

devanagari: कृष्ण - कर्ता, माया ताँर करेन सहाय ।
घटेर कारण - चक्र - दण्डादि उपाय ॥64॥
cc-adi-5.64.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa is the creator, and māyā only helps Him as an instrument, just like the potter's wheel and other instruments, which are the instrumental causes of a pot.

lines: dūra haite puruṣa kare māyāte avadhāna
devanagari: दूर हैते पुरुष करे मायाते अवधान ।
जीव - रूप वीर्घ ताते करेन आधान ॥65॥
cc-adi-5.65.translation: The first puruṣa casts His glance at māyā from a distance, and thus He impregnates her with the seed of life in the form of the living entities.

lines: māyā haite janme tabe brahmāṇḍera gaṇa
devanagari: एक अङ्गाभासे करे मायाते मिलन ।
माया हैते जन्मे तबे ब्रह्माण्डेर गण ॥66॥
cc-adi-5.66.translation: The reflected rays of His body mix with māyā, and thus māyā gives birth to myriads of universes.

devanagari: अगण्य, अनन्त व्रत अण्ड - सन्निवेश ।
तत - रूपे पुरुष करे सबाते प्रकाश ॥67॥
cc-adi-5.67.translation: The puruṣa enters each and every one of the countless universes. He manifests Himself in as many separate forms as there are universes.

devanagari: पुरुष - नासाते यबे बाहिराय श्वास ।
निश्वास सहिते हय ब्रह्माण्ड - प्रकाश ॥68॥
cc-adi-5.68.translation: When the puruṣa exhales, the universes become manifest with each outward breath.

devanagari: पुनरपि श्वास यबे प्रवेशे अन्तरे ।
श्वास - सह ब्रह्माण्ड पैशे पुरुष - शरीरे ॥69॥
cc-adi-5.69.translation: Thereafter, when He inhales, all the universes again enter His body.

devanagari: सङ्कर्षणः कारण - तोय - शायी गर्भोद - शायी च पयोब्धि - शायी ।
शेषश्च यस्यांश - कलाः स नित्या - नन्दाख्य - रामः शरणं ममास्तु ॥7॥
cc-adi-5.7.translation: May Śrī Nityānanda Rāma be the object of my constant remembrance. Saṅkarṣaṇa, Śeṣa Nāga and the Viṣṇus who lie on the Kāraṇa Ocean, Garbha Ocean and ocean of milk are His plenary portions and the portions of His plenary portions.

devanagari: गवाक्षेर रन्न्र येन त्रसरेणु चले ।
पुरुषेर लोम - कूपे ब्रह्माण्डेर जाले ॥70॥
cc-adi-5.70.translation: Just as atomic particles of dust pass through the openings of a window, so the networks of universes pass through the pores of the skin of the puruṣa.

lines: viṣṇur mahān sa iha yasya kalā-viśeṣo
devanagari: यस्यैक - निश्वसित - कालमथावलम्ब्य जीवन्ति लोम - विलञा जगदण्ड - नाथाः ।
विष्णुर्महान्स इह यस्य कला - विशेषो गोविन्दमादि - पुरुषं तमहं भजामि ॥71॥
cc-adi-5.71.translation: "The Brahmās and other lords of the mundane worlds appear from the pores of Mahā-Viṣṇu and remain alive for the duration of His one exhalation. I adore the primeval Lord, Govinda, for Mahā-Viṣṇu is a portion of His. plenary portion."

devanagari: क्वाहं तमो - महदहं - ख - चराग्नि - वार्मू - संवेष्टिताण्ड - घट - सप्त - वितस्ति - कायः ।
क्वेदृग्विधाविगणिताण्ड - पराणु - च - वाताध्व - रोम - विवरस्य च ते महित्वम् ॥72॥
cc-adi-5.72.translation: "Where am I, a small creature of seven spans the measure of my own hand? I am enclosed in the universe composed of material nature, the total material energy, false ego, ether, air, water and earth. And what is Your glory? Unlimited universes pass through the pores of Your body just like particles of dust passing through the opening of a window."

devanagari: अंशेर अंश येइ, ‘कला’ तार नाम ।
गोविन्देर प्रतिमूर्ति श्री - बलराम ॥73॥
cc-adi-5.73.translation: A part of a part of a whole is called a kalā. Śrī Balarāma is the counterform of Lord Govinda.

devanagari: ताँर एक स्वरूप - श्री - महा - सङ्कर्षण ।
ताँर अंश ‘पुरुष’ हय कलाते गणन ॥74॥
cc-adi-5.74.translation: Balarāma's own expansion is called Mahā-Saṅkarṣaṇa, and His fragment, the puruṣa, is counted as a kalā, or a part of a plenary portion.

lines: yāṅhāke ta' kalā kahi, tiṅho mahā-viṣṇu
devanagari: याँहाके त’ कला कहि, तिंहो महा - विष्णु ।
महा - पुरुषावतारी तेंहो सर्व - जिष्णु ॥75॥
cc-adi-5.75.translation: I say that this kalā is Mahā-Viṣṇu. He is the Mahā-puruṣa, who is the source of the other puruṣas and who is all-pervading.

devanagari: गर्भोद - क्षीरोद - शायी दोंहे ‘पुरुष’ नाम ।
सेइ दुइ, झाँर अंश, विष्णु, विश्व - धाम ॥76॥
cc-adi-5.76.translation: Garbhodaśāyī and Kṣīrodaśāyī are both called puruṣas. They are plenary portions of Kāraṇodaśāyī Viṣṇu, the first puruṣa, who is the abode of all the universes.

devanagari: एकं तु महतः स्रष्ट द्वितीयं त्वण्ड - संस्थितम् ।
तृतीयं सर्व - भूत - स्थं तानि ज्ञात्वा विमुच्यते ॥77॥
cc-adi-5.77.translation: "Viṣṇu has three forms called puruṣas. The first, Mahā-Viṣṇu, is the creator of the total material energy [mahat], the second is Garbhodaśāyī, who is situated within each universe, and the third is Kṣīrodaśāyī, who lives in the heart of every living being. He who knows these three becomes liberated from the clutches of māyā.

devanagari: यद्यपि कहिये ताँरे कृष्णेर ‘कला’ करि ।
मत्स्य - कूर्माद्यवतारेर तिंहो अवतारी ॥78॥
cc-adi-5.78.translation: Although Kṣīrodaśāyī Viṣṇu is called a kalā of Lord Kṛṣṇa, He is the source of Matsya, Kūrma and the other incarnations.

devanagari: एते चांश - कलाः पुंसः कृष्णस्तु भगवान्स्वयम् ।
इन्द्रारि - व्याकुलं लोकं मृड़यन्ति युगे युगे ॥79॥
