cc-adi-5.79.translation: "All these incarnations of Godhead are either plenary portions or parts of the plenary portions of the puruṣa-avatāras. But Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself. In every age He protects the world through His different features when the world is disturbed by the enemies of Indra."

devanagari: श्री - बलराम गोसाञि मूल - सङ्कर्षण ।
पञ्च - रूप ध रि’ करेन कृष्णेर सेवन ॥8॥
cc-adi-5.8.translation: Lord Balarāma is the original Saṅkarṣaṇa. He assumes five other forms to serve Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: सेइ पुरुष सृष्टि - स्थिति - प्रलयेर कर्ता ।
नाना अवतार करे, जगतेर भर्ता ॥80॥
cc-adi-5.80.translation: That puruṣa [Kṣīrodakaśāyī Viṣṇu] is the performer of creation, maintenance and destruction. He manifests Himself in many incarnations, for He is the maintainer of the world.

devanagari: सृष्ट्यादि - निमित्ते येइ अंशेर अवधान ।
सेइ त’ अंशेरे कहि ‘अवतार’ नाम ॥81॥
cc-adi-5.81.translation: That fragment of the Mahā-puruṣa who appears for the purpose of creation, maintenance and annihilation is called an incarnation.

devanagari: आद्यावतार, महा - पुरुष, भगवा न् ।
सर्व - अवतार - बीज, सर्वाश्रय - धाम ॥82॥
cc-adi-5.82.translation: That Mahā-puruṣa is identical with the Personality of Godhead. He is the original incarnation, the seed of all others, and the shelter of everything.

devanagari: आद्योऽवतारः पुरुषः परस्य कालः स्वभावः सदसन्मनश्च ।
द्रव्यं विकारो गुण इन्द्रियाणि विराट्स्वराट्स्थास्नु चरिष्णु भूम्नः ॥83॥
cc-adi-5.83.translation: "The puruṣa is the primary incarnation of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Time, nature, prakṛti (as cause and effect), the mind, the material elements, false ego, the modes of nature, the senses, the universal form, complete independence and the moving and nonmoving beings appear subsequently as His opulences."

devanagari: जगृहे पौरुषं रूपं भगवान्महदादिभिः ।
सम्भूतं षोड़श - कलमादौ लोक - सिसृक्षया ॥84॥
cc-adi-5.84.translation: "In the beginning of the creation, the Lord expanded Himself in the form of the puruṣa incarnation, accompanied by all the ingredients of material creation. First He created the sixteen principal energies suitable for creation. This was for the purpose of manifesting the material universes."

devanagari: यद्यपि सर्वाश्रय तिंहो, ताँहाते संसार ।
अन्तरात्मा - रूपे तिंहो जगताधार ॥85॥
cc-adi-5.85.translation: Although the Lord is the shelter of everything and although all the universes rest in Him, He, as the Supersoul, is also the support of everything.

devanagari: प्रकृति - सहिते ताँर उभय सम्बन्ध ।
तथापि प्रकृति - सह नाहि स्पर्श - गन्ध ॥86॥
cc-adi-5.86.translation: Although He is thus connected with the material energy in two ways, He does not have the slightest contact with it.

devanagari: एतदीशनमीशस्य प्रकृति - स्थोऽपि तद्गुणैः ।
न युज्यते सदात्म - स्थैर्यथा बुद्धिस्तदाश्रया ॥87॥
cc-adi-5.87.translation: "This is the opulence of the Lord. Although situated within the material nature, He is never affected by the modes of nature. Similarly, those who have surrendered to Him and have fixed their intelligence upon Him are not influenced by the modes of nature."

lines: ei mata gītāteha punaḥ punaḥ kaya
devanagari: एइ मत गीतातेह पुनः पुनः कय ।
सर्वदा ईश्वर - तत्त्व अचिन्त्य - शक्ति हय ॥88॥
cc-adi-5.88.translation: Thus the Bhagavad-gītā also states again and again that the Absolute Truth always possesses inconceivable power.

lines: āmi ta' jagate vasi, jagat āmāte
nā āmi jagate vasi, nā āmā jagate
devanagari: आमि त’ जगते वसि, जगतामाते ।
ना आमि जगते वसि, ना आमा जगते ॥89॥
cc-adi-5.89.translation: "I am situated in the material world, and the world rests in Me. But at the same time I am not situated in the material world, nor does it rest on Me in truth.

devanagari: आपने करेन कृष्ण - लीलार सहाय ।
सृष्टि - लीला - कार्य करे ध रि’ चारि काय ॥9॥
cc-adi-5.9.translation: He Himself helps in the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and He does the work of creation in four other forms.

lines: ei ta' gītāra artha kaila paracāra
devanagari: अचिन्त्य ऐश्वर्य एइ जानिह आमार ।
एइ त’ गीतार अर्थ कैल परचार ॥90॥
cc-adi-5.90.translation: "O Arjuna, you should know this as My inconceivable opulence." This is the meaning propagated by Lord Kṛṣṇa in Bhagavad-gītā.

lines: sei ta' puruṣa yāṅra 'aṁśa' dhare nāma
devanagari: सेइ त’ पुरुष याँर ‘अंश’ धरे नाम ।
चैतन्येर सङ्गे सेइ नित्यानन्द - राम ॥91॥
cc-adi-5.91.translation: That Mahā-puruṣa [Kāraṇodakaśāyī Viṣṇu] is known as a plenary part of Him who is Lord Nityānanda Balarāma, the favorite associate of Lord Caitanya.

lines: daśama ślokera artha śuna diyā mana
devanagari: एइ त’ नवम श्लोकेर अर्थ - विवरण ।
दशम श्लोकेर अर्थ शुन दिया मन ॥92॥
cc-adi-5.92.translation: I have thus explained the ninth verse, and now I shall explain the tenth. Please listen with rapt attention.

devanagari: यस्यांशांशः श्रील - गर्भाद - शायी यन्नाभ्यब्जे लोक - सङ्घात - नालम् ।
लोक - स्रष्टुः सूतिका - धाम धातुस् तं श्री - नित्यानन्द - रामं प्रपद्ये ॥93॥
cc-adi-5.93.translation: I offer my full obeisances unto the feet of Śrī Nityānanda Rāma, a partial part of whom is Garbhodakaśāyī Viṣṇu. From the navel of Garbhodakaśāyī Viṣṇu sprouts the lotus that is the birthplace of Brahmā, the engineer of the universe. The stem of that lotus is the resting place of the multitude of planets.

devanagari: सेइ त’ पुरुष अनन्त - ब्रह्माण्ड सृजिया ।
सब अण्डे प्रवेशिला ब हु - मूर्ति हञा ॥94॥
cc-adi-5.94.translation: After creating millions of universes, the first puruṣa entered into each of them in a separate form, as Śrī Garbhodakaśāyī.

devanagari: भितरे प्रवे शि’ देखे सब अन्धकार ।
रहिते नाहिक स्थान करिल विचार ॥95॥
cc-adi-5.95.translation: Entering the universe, He found only darkness, with no place in which to reside. Thus He began to consider.

devanagari: निजाङ्ग - स्वेद - जल करिल सृजन ।
सेइ जले कैल अर्ध - ब्रह्माण्ड भरण ॥96॥
cc-adi-5.96.translation: Then He created water from the perspiration of His own body and with that water filled half the universe.

lines: āyāma, vistāra, dui haya eka sama
devanagari: ब्रह्माण्ड - प्रमाण पञ्चाशत्कोटि - योजन ।
आयाम, विस्तार, दुइ हय एक सम ॥97॥
cc-adi-5.97.translation: The universe measures five hundred million yojanas. Its length and breadth are one and the same.

lines: jale bhari' ardha tāṅhā kaila nija-vāsa
devanagari: जले भ रि’ अर्ध ताँहा कैल निज - वास ।
आर अर्धे कैल चौद्द - भुवन प्रकाश ॥98॥
cc-adi-5.98.translation: After filling half the universe with water, He made His own residence therein and manifested the fourteen worlds in the other half.

devanagari: ताँहाइ प्र कट कैल वैकुण्ठ निज - धाम ।
शेष - शयन - जले करिल विश्राम ॥99॥
cc-adi-5.99.translation: There He manifested Vaikuṇṭha as His own abode and rested in the waters on the bed of Lord Śeṣa.

devanagari: वन्दे तं श्रीमदद्वैता - चार्यमद्भुत - चेष्टितम् ।
यस्य प्रसादादज्ञोऽपि तत्स्वरूपं निरूपयेत् ॥1॥
cc-adi-6.1.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances to Śrī Advaita Ācārya, whose activities are all wonderful. By His mercy, even a foolish person can describe His characteristics.

lines: se puruṣera aṁśa—advaita, nāhi kichu bheda
devanagari: से पुरुषेर अंश - अद्वैत, नाहि किछु भेद ।
शरीर - विशेष ताँर - नाहिक विच्छेद ॥10॥
cc-adi-6.10.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya is a plenary part of that puruṣa and so is not different from Him. Indeed, Śrī Advaita Ācārya is not separate but is another form of that puruṣa.

lines: ātmā haite kṛṣṇera bhakta haya premāspada
devanagari: कृष्णेर समता हैते बड़े भक्त - पद ।
आत्मा हैते कृष्णेर भक्त हय प्रेमास्पद ॥100॥
cc-adi-6.100.translation: The position of being a devotee is higher than that of equality with Lord Kṛṣṇa, for the devotees are dearer to Lord Kṛṣṇa than His own self.

lines: ātmā haite kṛṣṇa bhakte baḍa kari' māne
devanagari: आत्मा हैते कृष्ण भक्ते बड़ करि’ माने ।
इहाते बहुत शास्त्र - वचन प्रमाणे ॥101॥
cc-adi-6.101.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa considers His devotees greater than Himself. In this connection the scriptures provide an abundance of evidence.

devanagari: न तथा मे प्रिय - तम आत्म - योनिर्न शङ्करः ।
न च सङ्कर्षणो न श्रीवात्मा च यथा भवान् ॥102॥
cc-adi-6.102.translation: "O Uddhava! Neither Brahmā, nor Śaṅkara, nor Saṅkarṣaṇa, nor Lakṣmī, nor even My own self is as dear to Me as you."

devanagari: कृष्ण - साम्ये नहे ताँर माधुर्यास्वादन ।
भक्त - भावे करे ताँर माधुर्घ चर्वण ॥103॥
cc-adi-6.103.translation: The sweetness of Lord Kṛṣṇa is not to be tasted by those who consider themselves equal to Kṛṣṇa. It is to be tasted only through the sentiment of servitude.

devanagari: शास्त्रेर सिद्धान्त एइ , - विज्ञेर अनुभव ।
मूढ़ - लोक नाहि जाने भावेर वैभव ॥104॥
cc-adi-6.104.translation: This conclusion of the revealed scriptures is also the realization of experienced devotees. Fools and rascals, however, cannot understand the opulences of devotional emotions.

devanagari: भक्त - भाव अङ्गीकरि’ बलराम, लक्ष्मण ।
अद्वैत, नित्यानन्द, शेष, सङ्कर्षण ॥105॥
cc-adi-6.105-106.translation: Baladeva, Lakṣmaṇa, Advaita Ācārya, Lord Nityānanda, Lord Śeṣa and Lord Saṅkarṣaṇa taste the nectarean mellows of the transcendental bliss of Lord Kṛṣṇa by recognizing Themselves as being His devotees and servants. They are all mad with that happiness, and they know nothing else.

devanagari: अन्येर आछुक्कार्य, आपने श्री - कृष्ण ।
आपन - माधुर्घ - पाने हइला सतृष्ण ॥107॥
cc-adi-6.107.translation: Not to speak of others, even Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself becomes thirsty to taste His own sweetness.

devanagari: स्वा - माधुर्य आस्वादिते करेन यतन ।
भक्त - भाव विनु नहे ताहा आस्वादन ॥108॥
cc-adi-6.108.translation: He tries to taste His own sweetness, but He cannot do so without accepting the emotions of a devotee.

devanagari: भक्त - भाव अङ्गीकरि’ हैला अवतीर्ण ।
श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य - रूपे सर्व - भावे पूर्ण ॥109॥
cc-adi-6.109.translation: Therefore Lord Kṛṣṇa accepted the position of a devotee and descended in the form of Lord Caitanya, who is complete in every respect.

devanagari: सहाय करेन ताँर लइया ‘प्रधान’ ।
कोटि ब्रह्माण्ड करेन इच्छाय निर्माण ॥11॥
cc-adi-6.11.translation: He [Advaita Ācārya] helps in the pastimes of the puruṣa, with whose material energy and by whose will He creates innumerable universes.

devanagari: नाना - भक्त - भावे करेन स्व - माधुर्य पान ।
पूर्व करियाछि एइ सिद्धान्त व्याख्यान ॥110॥
cc-adi-6.110.translation: He tastes His own sweetness through the various emotions of a devotee. I have formerly explained this conclusion.

lines: bhakta-bhāva haite adhika sukha nāhi āra
devanagari: अवतार - गणेर भक्त - भावे अधिकार ।
भक्त - भाव हैते अधिक सुख नाहि आर ॥111॥
cc-adi-6.111.translation: All the incarnations are entitled to the emotions of devotees. There is no higher bliss than this.

devanagari: मूल भक्त - अवतार श्री - सङ्कर्षण ।
भक्त - अवतार तँहि अद्वैते गणन ॥112॥
cc-adi-6.112.translation: The original bhakta-avatāra is Saṅkarṣaṇa. Śrī Advaita is counted among such incarnations.

devanagari: अद्वैत - आचार्य गोसाञि र महिमा अपार ।
याँहार हुङ्कारे कैल चैतन्यावतार ॥113॥
cc-adi-6.113.translation: The glories of Śrī Advaita Ācārya are boundless, for His sincere vibrations brought about Lord Caitanya's descent upon this earth.

devanagari: सङ्कीर्तन प्रचारिया सब जगत्तारिल ।
अद्वैत - प्रसादे लोक प्रेम - धन पाइल ॥114॥
cc-adi-6.114.translation: He liberated the universe by preaching saṅkīrtana. Thus the people of the world received the treasure of love of Godhead through the mercy of Śrī Advaita.

lines: sei likhi, yei śuni mahājana haite
devanagari: अद्वैत - महिमा अनन्त के पारे कहिते ।
सेइ लिखि, येइ शुनि महाजन हैते ॥115॥
cc-adi-6.115.translation: Who can describe the unlimited glories of Advaita Ācārya? I write here as much as I have known from great authorities.

lines: ithe kichu aparādha nā labe āmāra
devanagari: आचार्य - चरणे मोर कोटि नमस्कार ।
इथे किछु अपराध ना लबे आमार ॥116॥
cc-adi-6.116.translation: I offer my obeisances ten million times to the lotus feet of Śrī Advaita Ācārya. Please do not take offense at this.

devanagari: तोमार महिमा - कोटि - समुद्र अगाध ।
ताहार इयत्ता कहि , - ए बड़े अपराध ॥117॥
cc-adi-6.117.translation: Your glories are as fathomless as millions of oceans and seas. Speaking of its measure is a great offense indeed.

devanagari: जय जय जय श्री - अद्वैत आचार्य ।
जय जय श्री - चैतन्य, नित्यानन्द आर्य ॥118॥
cc-adi-6.118.translation: All glories, all glories to Śrī Advaita Ācārya! All glories to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the superior Lord Nityānanda!

devanagari: दुइ श्लोके कहिल अद्वैत - तत्त्व - निरूपण ।
पञ्च - तत्त्वेर विचार किछु शुन, भक्तगण ॥119॥
cc-adi-6.119.translation: Thus in two verses I have described the truth concerning Advaita Ācārya. Now, O devotees, please hear about the five truths [pañca-tattva].

devanagari: जगत्मङ्गल अद्वैत, मङ्गल - गुण - धाम ।
मङ्गल - चरित्र सदा, ‘मङ्गल’ याँर नाम ॥12॥
cc-adi-6.12.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya is all-auspicious to the world, for He is a reservoir of all auspicious attributes. His characteristics, activities and name are always auspicious.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥120॥
cc-adi-6.120.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: koṭi aṁśa, koṭi śakti, koṭi avatāra
eta lañā sṛje puruṣa sakala saṁsāra
devanagari: कोटि अंश, कोटि शक्ति, कोटि अवतार ।
एत लञा सृजे पुरुष सकल संसार ॥13॥
cc-adi-6.13.translation: Mahā-Viṣṇu creates the entire material world, with millions of His parts, energies and incarnations.

devanagari: माया यैछे दुइ अंश - ‘निमित्त’, ‘उपादा न’ ।
माया निमित्त’ - हेतु, उपादान - प्रधान’ ॥14॥
cc-adi-6.14-15.translation: Just as the external energy consists of two parts—the efficient cause [nimitta] and the material cause [upādāna], māyā being the efficient cause and pradhāna the material cause-so Lord Viṣṇu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, assumes two forms to create the material world with the efficient and material causes.

devanagari: आपने पुरुष - विश्वेर ‘निमित्त’ - कारण ।
अद्वैत - रूपे उपादा न’ हन नारायण ॥16॥
cc-adi-6.16.translation: Lord Viṣṇu Himself is the efficient [nimitta] cause of the material world, and Nārāyaṇa in the form of Śrī Advaita is the material cause [upādāna].

devanagari: ‘निमित्तांशे’ करे तेंहो मायाते ईक्षण ।
‘उपादा न’ अद्वैत करेन ब्रह्माण्ड - सृजन ॥17॥
cc-adi-6.17.translation: Lord Viṣṇu, in His efficient aspect, glances over the material energy, and Śrī Advaita, as the material cause, creates the material world.

devanagari: यद्यपि साङ्ख्य माने, ‘प्रधान’ - कारण ।
जड़ हइते कभु नहे जगत्सृजन ॥18॥
cc-adi-6.18.translation: Although the Sāṅkhya philosophy accepts that the material ingredients are the cause, the creation of the world never arises from dead matter.

lines: īśvarera śaktye tabe haye ta' nirmāṇe
devanagari: निज सृष्टि - शक्ति प्रभु सञ्चारे प्रधाने ।
ईश्वरेर शक्त्ये तबे हये त’ निर्माणे ॥19॥
cc-adi-6.19.translation: The Lord infuses the material ingredients with His own creative potency. Then, by the power of the Lord, creation takes place.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-6.2.translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. All glories to Lord Nityānanda. All glories to Advaita Ācārya. And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: अद्वैत - रूपे करे शक्ति - सञ्चारण ।
अतएव अद्वैत हयेन मुख्य कारण ॥20॥
cc-adi-6.20.translation: In the form of Advaita He infuses the material ingredients with creative energy. Therefore, Advaita is the original cause of creation.

lines: āra eka eka mūrtye brahmāṇḍera bhartā
devanagari: अद्वैत - आचार्य कोटि - ब्रह्माण्डेर कर्ता ।
आर एक एक मूर्त्ये ब्रह्माण्डेर भर्ता ॥21॥
cc-adi-6.21.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya is the creator of millions and millions of universes, and by His expansions [as Garbhodakaśāyī Viṣṇu] He maintains each and every universe.

devanagari: सेइ नारायणेर मुख्य अङ्ग - अद्वैत ।
‘अङ्ग’ - शब्दे अंश करि’ कहे भागवत ॥22॥
cc-adi-6.22.translation: Śrī Advaita is the principal limb [aṅga] of Nārāyaṇa. Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam speaks of "limb" [aṅga] as "a plenary portion" [aṁśa] of the Lord.

lines: tac cāpi satyaṁ na tavaiva māyā
devanagari: नारायणस्त्वं न हि सर्व - देहिनाम् आत्मास्यधीशाखिल - लोक - साक्षी ।
नारायणोऽङ्गं नर - भू - जलायनात् तच्चापि सत्यं न तवैव माया ॥23॥
cc-adi-6.23.translation: "O Lord of lords, You are the seer of all creation. You are indeed everyone's dearest life. Are You not, therefore, my father, Nārāyaṇa? 'Nārāyaṇa' refers to one whose abode is in the water born from Nara [Garbhodakaśāyī Viṣṇu ], and that Nārāyaṇa is Your plenary portion. All Your plenary portions are transcendental. They are absolute and are not creations of māyā."

lines: māyāra sambandha nāhi' ei śloke kaya
devanagari: ईश्वरेर अ ङ्ग’ अंश - चिदानन्द - मय ।
मायार सम्बन्ध नाहि’ एइ श्लोके कय ॥24॥
cc-adi-6.24.translation: This verse describes that the limbs and plenary portions of the Lord are all spiritual; they have no relationship with the material energy.

devanagari: ‘अंश’ ना कहिया, केने कह ताँरे ‘अङ्ग’ ।
‘अंश’ हैते ‘अङ्ग,’ याते हय अन्तरङ्ग ॥25॥
cc-adi-6.25.translation: Why has Śrī Advaita been called a limb and not a part? The reason is that "limb" implies greater intimacy.

devanagari: महा - विष्णुर अंश - अद्वैत गुण - धाम ।
ईश्वरे अभेद, तेञि ‘अद्वैत’ पूर्ण नाम ॥26॥
cc-adi-6.26.translation: Śrī Advaita, who is a reservoir of virtues, is the main limb of Mahā-Viṣṇu. His full name is Advaita, for He is identical in all respects with that Lord.

devanagari: पूर्वे यैछे कैल सर्व - विश्वेर सृजन ।
अवतरि’ कैल एबे भक्ति - प्रवर्तन ॥27॥
cc-adi-6.27.translation: As He had formerly created all the universes, now He descended to introduce the path of bhakti.

devanagari: जीव निस्तारिल कृष्ण - भक्ति क रि’ दान ।
गीता - भागवते कैल भक्तिर व्याख्यान ॥28॥
cc-adi-6.28.translation: He delivered all living beings by offering the gift of kṛṣṇa-bhakti. He explained Bhagavad-gītā and Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in the light of devotional service.

devanagari: भक्ति - उपदेश विनु ताँर नाहि कार्य ।
अतएव नाम हैल अद्वैत आचार्य ॥29॥
cc-adi-6.29.translation: Since He has no other occupation than to teach devotional service, His name is Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: पञ्च श्लोके कहिल श्री - नित्यानन्द - तत्त्व ।
श्लोक - द्वये कहि अद्वैताचार महत्त्व ॥3॥
cc-adi-6.3.translation: In five verses I have described the principle of Lord Nityānanda. Then in the following two verses I describe the glories of Śrī Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: वैष्णवेर गुरु तेंहो जगतेर आर्य ।
दुइ - नाम - मिलने हैल ‘अद्वैत - आचार्य’ ॥30॥
cc-adi-6.30.translation: He is the spiritual master of all devotees and is the most revered personality in the world. By a combination of these two names, His name is Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: कमल - नयनेर तेंहो, य़ाते ‘अङ्ग’ ‘अंश’ ।
कमलाक्ष करि धरे नाम अवतंस ॥31॥
cc-adi-6.31.translation: Since He is a limb or part of the lotus-eyed Supreme Lord, He also bears the name Kamalākṣa.

devanagari: ईश्वर - सारूप्य पाय पारिषद - गण ।
चतुर्भुज, पीत - वास, यैछे नारायण ॥32॥
cc-adi-6.32.translation: His associates have the same bodily features as the Lord. They all have four arms and are dressed in yellow garments like Nārāyaṇa.

devanagari: अद्वैत - आचार्य - ईश्वरेर अंश - वर्य ।
ताँर तत्त्व - नाम - गुण, सकलि आश्चर्य ॥33॥
cc-adi-6.33.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya is the principal limb of the Supreme Lord. His truths, names and attributes are all wonderful.

devanagari: याँहार तुलसी - जले, याँहार हुङ्कारे ।
स्व - गण सहिते चैतन्येर अवतारे ॥34॥
cc-adi-6.34.translation: He worshiped Kṛṣṇa with tulasī leaves and water of the Ganges and called for Him in a loud voice. Thus Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared on earth, accompanied by His personal associates.

lines: yāṅra dvārā kaila prabhu kīrtana pracāra
yāṅra dvārā kaila prabhu jagat nistāra
devanagari: याँर द्वारा कैल प्रभु कीर्तन प्रचार ।
याँर द्वारा कैल प्रभु जगनिस्तार ॥35॥
cc-adi-6.35.translation: It is through Him [Advaita Ācārya] that Lord Caitanya spread the saṅkīrtana movement and through Him that He delivered the world.

devanagari: आचार्य गोसाञि र गुण - महिमा अपार ।
जीव - कीट कोथाय पाइबेक तार पार ॥36॥
cc-adi-6.36.translation: The glory and attributes of Advaita Ācārya are unlimited. How can the insignificant living entities fathom them?

lines: āra eka aṅga tāṅra prabhu nityānanda
devanagari: आचार्य गोसाञि चैतन्येर मुख्य अङ्ग ।
आर एक अङ्ग ताँर प्रभु नित्यानन्द ॥37॥
cc-adi-6.37.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya is a principal limb of Lord Caitanya. Another limb of the Lord is Nityānanda Prabhu.

devanagari: प्रभुर उपाङ्ग - श्रीवासादि भक्त - गण ।
हस्त - मुख - नेत्र - अङ्ग चक्राद्यस्त्र - सम ॥38॥
cc-adi-6.38.translation: The devotees headed by Śrīvāsa are His smaller limbs. They are like His hands, face, eyes and His disc and other weapons.

devanagari: ए - सब लइया चैत न्य - प्रभुर विहार ।
ए - सब लइया करेन वाञ्छित प्रचार ॥39॥
cc-adi-6.39.translation: With all of them Lord Caitanya performed His pastimes, and with them He spread His mission.

devanagari: महा - विष्णुर्जगत्कर्ता मायया यः सृजत्यदः ।
तस्यावतार एवायमद्वैताचार्य ईश्वरः ॥4॥
cc-adi-6.4.translation: Lord Advaita Ācārya is the incarnation of Mahā-Viṣṇu, whose main function is to create the cosmic world through the actions of māyā.

devanagari: माधवेन्द्र - पुरीर इँहो शिष्य, एइ ज्ञाने ।
आचार्य - गोसाञि रे प्रभु गुरु करि’ माने ॥40॥
cc-adi-6.40.translation: Thinking "He [Śrī Advaita Ācārya] is a disciple of Śrī Mādhavendra Purī," Lord Caitanya obeys Him, respecting Him as His spiritual master.

devanagari: लौकिक - लीलाते धर्म - मर्यादा - रक्षण ।
स्तुति - भक्त्ये करेन ताँर चरण वन्दन ॥41॥
cc-adi-6.41.translation: To maintain the proper etiquette for the principles of religion, Lord Caitanya bows down at the lotus feet of Śrī Advaita Ācārya with reverential prayers and devotion.

devanagari: चैतन्य - गोसाञि के आचार्य करे ‘प्रभु’ - ज्ञान ।
आपनाके करेन ताँर ‘दास’ - अभिमान ॥42॥
cc-adi-6.42.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya, however, considers Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu His master, and He thinks of Himself as a servant of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: सेइ अभिमान - सुखे आपना पासरे ।
‘कृष्ण - दास’ हओ - जीवे उपदेश करे ॥43॥
cc-adi-6.43.translation: He forgets Himself in the joy of that conception and teaches all living entities, "You are servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

devanagari: कृष्ण - दास - अभिमाने ये आनन्द - सिन्धु ।
कोटी - ब्रह्म - सुख नहे तार एक बिन्दु ॥44॥
cc-adi-6.44.translation: The conception of servitude to Śrī Kṛṣṇa generates such an ocean of joy in the soul that even the joy of oneness with the Absolute, if multiplied ten million times, could not compare to a drop of it.

devanagari: मुञि ये चैतन्य - दास आर नित्यानन्द ।
दास - भाव - सम नहे अन्यत्र आनन्द ॥45॥
cc-adi-6.45.translation: He says, "Nityānanda and I are servants of Lord Caitanya." Nowhere else is there such joy as that which is tasted in this emotion of servitude.

devanagari: परम - प्रेयसी लक्ष्मी हृदये वसति ।
तेंहो दास्य - सुख मागे करिया मिनति ॥46॥
cc-adi-6.46.translation: The most beloved goddess of fortune resides on the chest of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, yet she too, earnestly praying, begs for the joy of service at His feet.

lines: vidhi, bhava, nārada āra śuka, sanātana
devanagari: दास्य - भावे आनन्दित पारि षद - गण ।
विधि, भव, नारद आर शुक, सनातन ॥47॥
cc-adi-6.47.translation: All the associates of Lord Kṛṣṇa, such as Brahmā, Śiva, Nārada, Śuka and Sanātana, are very much pleased in the sentiment of servitude.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द अवधूत सबाते आगल ।
चैतन्येर दास्य - प्रेमे हइला पागल ॥48॥
cc-adi-6.48.translation: Śrī Nityānanda, the wandering mendicant, is the foremost of all the associates of Lord Caitanya. He became mad in the ecstasy of service to Lord Caitanya.

devanagari: श्रीवास, हरिदास, रामदास, गदाधर ।
मुरारि, मुकुन्द, चन्द्रशेखर, वक्रेश्वर ॥49॥
cc-adi-6.49-50.translation: Śrīvāsa, Haridāsa, Rāmadāsa, Gadādhara, Murāri, Mukunda, Candraśekhara and Vakreśvara are all glorious and are all learned scholars, but the sentiment of servitude to Lord Caitanya makes them mad in ecstasy.

devanagari: अद्वैतं हरिणाद्वैतादाचा भक्ति - शंसनात् ।
भक्तावतारमीशं तमद्वैताचार्यमाश्रये ॥5॥
cc-adi-6.5.translation: Because He is nondifferent from Hari, the Supreme Lord, He is called Advaita, and because He propagates the cult of devotion, He is called Ācārya. He is the Lord and the incarnation of the Lord's devotee. Therefore I take shelter of Him.

lines: ei mata gāya, nāce, kare aṭṭahāsa
devanagari: एइ मत गाय, नाचे, करे अट्टहास ।
लोके उपदेशे , - ‘हओ चैतन्येर दा स’ ॥51॥
cc-adi-6.51.translation: Thus they dance, sing and laugh like madmen, and they instruct everyone, "Just be loving servants of Lord Caitanya."

devanagari: चैतन्य - गोसाञि मोरे करे गुरु ज्ञान ।
तथापिह मोर हय दास - अभिमान ॥52॥
cc-adi-6.52.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya thinks, "Lord Caitanya considers Me His spiritual master, yet I feel Myself to be only His servant."

devanagari: कृष्ण - प्रेमेर एइ एक अपूर्व प्रभाव ।
गुरु - सम - लघुके कराय दास्य - भाव ॥53॥
cc-adi-6.53.translation: Love for Kṛṣṇa has this one unique effect: it imbues superiors, equals and inferiors with the spirit of service to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: इहार प्रमाण शुन - शास्त्रेर व्याख्यान ।
महदनुभव य़ाते सुदृढ़ प्रमाण ॥54॥
cc-adi-6.54.translation: For evidence, please listen to the examples described in the revealed scriptures, which are also corroborated by the realization of great souls.

lines: anyera kā kathā, vraje nanda mahāśaya
tāra sama 'guru' kṛṣṇera āra keha naya
devanagari: अन्येर का कथा, व्रजे नन्द महाशय ।
तार सम ‘गुरु’ कृष्णेर आर केह नये ॥55॥
cc-adi-6.55-56.translation: Although no one is a more respected elder for Kṛṣṇa than Nanda Mahārāja in Vraja, who in transcendental paternal love has no knowledge that his son is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, still ecstatic love makes him, not to speak of others, feel himself to be a servant of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: तेंहो रति - मति मागे कृष्णेर चरणे ।
ताहार श्री - मुख - वाणी ताहाते प्रमाणे ॥57॥
cc-adi-6.57.translation: He too prays for attachment and devotion to the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa, as the words from his own mouth give evidence.

lines: teṅho īśvara—hena yadi tomāra mane laya
devanagari: शुन उद्धव, सत्य, कृष्ण - आमार तनय ।
तेंहो ईश्वर - हेन यदि तोमार मने लय ॥58॥
cc-adi-6.58-59.translation: "My dear Uddhava, please hear me. In truth Kṛṣṇa is my son, but even if you think that He is God, I would still bear toward Him my own feelings for my son. May my mind be attached to your Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: अद्वैत - आचार्य गोसाञि साक्षातीश्वर ।
याँहार महिमा नहे जीवेर गोचर ॥6॥
cc-adi-6.6.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya is indeed directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself. His glory is beyond the conception of ordinary living beings.

devanagari: मनसो वृत्तयो नः स्युः कृष्ण - पादाम्बुजाश्रयाः ।
वाचोऽभिधायिनीर्नाम्नां कायस्तत्प्रहृणादिषु ॥60॥
cc-adi-6.60.translation: "May our minds be attached to the lotus feet of your Lord Kṛṣṇa, may our tongues chant His holy names, and may our bodies lie prostrate before Him.

devanagari: कर्मभिर्भाग्यमाणानां यत्र क्वापीश्वरेच्छया ।
मङ्गलाचरितैर्दानै रतिर्नः कृष्ण ईश्वरे ॥61॥
cc-adi-6.61.translation: "Wherever we wander in the material universe under the influence of karma by the will of the Lord, may our auspicious activities cause our attraction to Lord Kṛṣṇa to increase."

devanagari: श्रीदामादि व्रजे यत सखार निचय ।
ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञान - हीन, केवल - सख्य - मयं ॥62॥
cc-adi-6.62.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa's friends in Vṛndāvana, headed by Śrīdāmā, have pure fraternal affection for Lord Kṛṣṇa and have no idea of His opulences.

devanagari: कृष्ण - सङ्गे युद्ध करे, स्कन्धे आरोहण ।
तारा दास्य - भावे करे चरण - सेवन ॥63॥
cc-adi-6.63.translation: Although they fight with Him and climb upon His shoulders, they worship His lotus feet in a spirit of servitude.

devanagari: पाद - संवाहनं चक्रुः केचित्तस्य महात्मनः ।
अपरे हत - पाप्मानो व्यजनैः समवीजयन् ॥64॥
cc-adi-6.64.translation: "Some of the friends of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, massaged His feet, and others whose sinful reactions had been destroyed fanned Him with hand-held fans."

devanagari: कृष्णेर प्रेयसी व्रजे यत गोपी - गण ।
याँर पद - धूलि करे उद्धव प्रार्थन ॥65॥
cc-adi-6.65-66.translation: Even the beloved girl friends of Lord Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana, the gopīs, the dust of whose feet was desired by Śrī Uddhava and beyond whom no one is more dear to Kṛṣṇa, regard themselves as Kṛṣṇa's maidservants.

devanagari: व्रज - जनार्ति - हन्वीर योषितां निज - जन - स्मय - ध्वंसन - स्मित ।
भज सखे भवत्किङ्करीः स्म नो जल - रुहाननं चारु दर्शय ॥67॥
cc-adi-6.67.translation: "O Lord, remover of the afflictions of the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana! O hero of all women! O Lord who destroys the pride of Your devotees by Your sweet, gentle smile! O friend! We are Your maidservants. Please fulfill our desires and show us Your attractive lotus face."

lines: smarati sa pitṛ-gehān saumya bandhūṁś ca gopān
kvacid api sa kathāṁ naḥ kiṅkariṇāṁ gṛṇīte
bhujam aguru-sugandhaṁ mūrdhny adhāsyat kadā nu
devanagari: अपि बत म धु - पुर्यामाग्न - पुत्रोऽधुनास्ते स्मरति स पितृ - गेहान्सौम्य बन्धूंश्च गोपान् ।
क्वचिदपि स कथां नः किङ्करिणां गृणीते भुजमगुरु - सुगन्धं मूर्त्येधास्यत्कदा नु ॥68॥
cc-adi-6.68.translation: "O Uddhava! It is indeed regrettable that Kṛṣṇa resides in Mathurā. Does He remember His father's household affairs, His friends and the cowherd boys? O great soul! Does He ever talk about us, His maidservants? When will He lay on our heads His aguru-scented hand?"

devanagari: ताँ - सबार कथा रहु, - श्रीमती राधिका ।
सबा हैते सकलांशे परम - अधिका ॥69॥
cc-adi-6.69-70.translation: What to speak of the other gopīs, even Śrī Rādhikā, who in every respect is the most elevated of them all and who has bound Śrī Kṛṣṇa forever by Her loving attributes, serves His feet as His maidservant.

devanagari: महा - विष्णु सृष्टि करेन जगदादि कार्य ।
ताँर अवतार साक्षातद्वैत आचार्य ॥7॥
cc-adi-6.7.translation: Mahā-Viṣṇu performs all the functions for the creation of the universes. Śrī Advaita Ācārya is His direct incarnation.

devanagari: हा नाथ रमण प्रेष्ठ क्वासि क्वासि महा - भुज ।
दास्यास्ते कृपणाया मे सखे दर्शय सन्निधिम् ॥71॥
cc-adi-6.71.translation: "O My Lord, O My husband, O most dearly beloved! O mighty-armed Lord! Where are You? Where are You? O My friend, reveal Yourself to Your maidservant, who is very much aggrieved by Your absence."

devanagari: द्वारकाते रुक्मिण्यादि यतेक महिषी ।
ताँहाराओ आपनाके माने कृष्ण - दासी ॥72॥
cc-adi-6.72.translation: In Dvārakā-dhāma, all the queens, headed by Rukmiṇī, also consider themselves maidservants of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: चैद्याय मार्पयितुमुद्यत - कार्मुकेषु राजस्वजेय - भट - शेखरिताङ्घि - रेणुः ।
निन्ये मृगेन्द्र इव भागमजावि - यूथात् तच्छी - निकेत - चरणोऽस्तु ममार्चनाय ॥73॥
cc-adi-6.73.translation: "When Jarāsandha and other kings, bows and arrows upraised, stood ready to deliver me in charity to Śiśupāla, He forcibly took me from their midst, as a lion takes its share of goats and sheep. The dust of His lotus feet is therefore the crown of inconquerable soldiers. May those lotus feet, which are the shelter of the goddess of fortune, be the object of my worship."

devanagari: तपश्चरन्तीमाज्ञाय स्व - पाद - स्पर्शनाशया ।
सख्योपेत्याग्रहीत्पाणिं साहं तद्गृह - मार्जनी ॥74॥
cc-adi-6.74.translation: "Knowing me to be performing austerities with the desire to touch His feet, He came with His friend Arjuna and accepted my hand. Yet I am but a maidservant engaged in sweeping the floor of the house of Śrī Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: आत्मारामस्य तस्येमा वयं वै गृह - दासिकाः ।
सर्व - सङ्ग - निवृत्त्याद्धा तपसा च बभूविम ॥75॥
cc-adi-6.75.translation: "Through austerity and through renunciation of all attachments, we have become maidservants in the home of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is satisfied in Himself."

devanagari: आनेर कि कथा, बलदेव महाशय ।
याँर भाव - शुद्ध - सख्य - वात्सल्यादि - मय ॥76॥
cc-adi-6.76.translation: Not to speak of others, even Lord Baladeva, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is full of emotions like pure friendship and paternal love.

devanagari: तेंहो आपनाके करेन दास - भावना ।
कृष्ण - दास - भाव विनु आछे कोन जना ॥77॥
cc-adi-6.77.translation: He also considers Himself a servant of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Indeed, who is there who does not have this conception of being a servant of Lord Kṛṣṇa?

lines: daśa deha dhari' kare kṛṣṇera sevana
devanagari: सहस्र - वदने येंहो शेष - सङ्कर्षण ।
दश देह ध रि’ करे कृष्णेर सेवन ॥78॥
cc-adi-6.78.translation: He who is Śeṣa, Saṅkarṣaṇa, with His thousands of mouths, serves Śrī Kṛṣṇa by assuming ten forms.

devanagari: अनन्त ब्र ह्माण्डे रुद्र - सदाशिवेर अंश ।
गुणावतार तेंहो, सर्व - देव - अवतंस ॥79॥
cc-adi-6.79.translation: Rudra, who is an expansion of Sadāśiva and who appears in unlimited universes, is also a guṇāvatāra [qualitative incarnation] and is the ornament of all the demigods in the endless universes.

devanagari: ये पुरुष सृष्टि - स्थिति करेन मायाय ।
अनन्त ब्रह्माण्ड सृष्टि करेन लीलाय ॥8॥
cc-adi-6.8.translation: That puruṣa creates and maintains with His external energy. He creates innumerable universes in His pastimes.

devanagari: तेंहो करेन कृष्णेर दास्य - प्रत्याश ।
निरन्तर कहे शिव, ‘मुञि कृष्ण - दास’ ॥80॥
cc-adi-6.80.translation: He also desires only to be a servant of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Śrī Sadāśiva always says, "I am a servant of Lord Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: कृष्ण - प्रेमे उन्मत्त, विह्वल दिगम्बर ।
कृष्ण - गुण - लीला गाय, नाचे निरन्तर ॥81॥
cc-adi-6.81.translation: Intoxicated by ecstatic love for Lord Kṛṣṇa, he becomes overwhelmed and incessantly dances without clothing and sings about Lord Kṛṣṇa's qualities and pastimes.

devanagari: पिता - माता - गुरु - सखा - भाव केने नय ।
कृष्ण - प्रेमेर स्वभावे दास्य - भाव से करय ॥82॥
cc-adi-6.82.translation: All the emotions, whether those of father, mother, teacher or friend, are full of sentiments of servitude. That is the nature of love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: एक कृष्ण - सर्व - सेव्य, जगतीश्वर ।
आर यत सब , - ताँर सेवकानुचर ॥83॥
cc-adi-6.83.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa, the one master and the Lord of the universe, is worthy of being served by everyone. Indeed, everyone is but a servant of His servants.

devanagari: सेइ कृष्ण अवतीर्ण - चैतन्य - ईश्वर ।
अतएव आर सब , - ताँहार किङ्कर ॥84॥
cc-adi-6.84.translation: That same Lord Kṛṣṇa has descended as Lord Caitanya, the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Everyone, therefore, is His servant.

lines: keha māne, keha nā māne, saba tāṅra dāsa
ye nā māne, tāra haya sei pāpe nāśa
devanagari: केह माने, केह ना माने, सब ताँर दास ।
ये ना माने, तार हय सेइ पापे नाश ॥85॥
cc-adi-6.85.translation: Some accept Him whereas others do not, yet everyone is His servant. One who does not accept Him, however, will be ruined by his sinful activities.

lines: caitanyera dāsa muñi, tāṅra dāsera dāsa
devanagari: चैतन्येर दास मुञि, चैतन्येर दास ।
चैतन्येर दास मुञि, ताँर दासेर दास ॥86॥
cc-adi-6.86.translation: "I am a servant of Lord Caitanya, a servant of Lord Caitanya. I am a servant of Lord Caitanya, and a servant of His servants."

lines: eta bali' nāce, gāya, huṅkāra gambhīra
devanagari: एत बलि’ नाचे, गाय, हुङ्कार गम्भीर ।
क्षणेके वसिला आचार्य हैञा सुस्थिर ॥87॥
cc-adi-6.87.translation: Saying this, Advaita Prabhu dances and loudly sings. Then at the next moment He quietly sits down.

devanagari: भक्त - अभिमान मूल श्री - बलरामे ।
सेइ भावे अनुगत ताँर अंश - गणे ॥88॥
cc-adi-6.88.translation: The source of the sentiment of servitude is indeed Lord Balarāma. The plenary expansions who follow Him are all influenced by that ecstasy.

devanagari: ताँर अवतार एक श्री - सङ्कर्षण ।
भक्त ब लि’ अभिमान करे सर्व - क्षण ॥89॥
cc-adi-6.89.translation: Lord Saṅkarṣaṇa, who is one of His incarnations, always considers Himself a devotee.

lines: eka eka mūrte karena brahmāṇḍe praveśa
devanagari: इच्छाय अनन्त मूर्ति करेन प्रकाश ।
एक एक मूर्ते करेन ब्रह्माण्डे प्रवेश ॥9॥
cc-adi-6.9.translation: By His will He manifests Himself in unlimited forms, in which He enters each and every universe.

devanagari: ताँर अवतार आन श्री - युत लक्ष्मण ।
श्री - रामेर दास्य तिंहो कैल अनुक्षण ॥90॥
cc-adi-6.90.translation: Another of His incarnations, Lakṣmaṇa, who is very beautiful and opulent, always serves Lord Rāma.

devanagari: सङ्कर्षण - अवतार कारणाब्धि - शायी ।
ताँहार हृदये भक्त - भाव अनुयायी ॥91॥
cc-adi-6.91.translation: The Viṣṇu who lies on the Causal Ocean is an incarnation of Lord Saṅkarṣaṇa, and, accordingly, the emotion of being a devotee is always present in His heart.

devanagari: ताँहार प्रकाश - भेद, अद्वैत - आचार्य ।
काय - मनो - वाक्ये ताँर भक्ति सदा कार्य ॥92॥
cc-adi-6.92.translation: Advaita Ācārya is a separate expansion of Him. He always engages in devotional service with His thoughts, words and actions.

devanagari: वाक्ये कहे, ‘मुञि चैतन्येर अनुचर’ ।
मुञि ताँर भक्त - मने भावे निरन्तर ॥93॥
cc-adi-6.93.translation: By His words He declares, "I am a servant of Lord Caitanya." Thus with His mind He always thinks, "I am His devotee."

devanagari: जल - तुलसी दिया करे कायाते सेवन ।
भक्ति प्रचारिया सब तारिला भुवन ॥94॥
cc-adi-6.94.translation: With His body He worshiped the Lord by offering Ganges water and tulasī leaves, and by preaching devotional service He delivered the entire universe.

devanagari: पृथिवी धरेन येइ शेष - सङ्कर्षण ।
काय - व्यूह करि’ करेन कृष्णेर सेवन ॥95॥
cc-adi-6.95.translation: Śeṣa Saṅkarṣaṇa, who holds all the planets on His head, expands Himself in different bodies to render service to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: एइ सब हय श्री कृष्णेर अवतार ।
निरन्तर देखि सबार भक्तिर आचार ॥96॥
cc-adi-6.96.translation: These are all incarnations of Lord Kṛṣṇa, yet we always find that they act as devotees.

devanagari: ए - सबाके शास्त्रे कहे ‘भक्त - अवता र’ ।
‘भक्त - अवता र’ - पद उपरि सबार ॥97॥
cc-adi-6.97.translation: The scriptures call them incarnations as devotees [bhakta-avatāra]. The position of being such an incarnation is above all others.

devanagari: एक - मात्र ‘अंशी’ - कृष्ण, ‘अंश’ - अवतार ।
अंशी अंशे देखि ज्येष्ठ - कनिष्ठ - आचार ॥98॥
cc-adi-6.98.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa is the source of all incarnations, and all others are His parts or partial incarnations. We find that the whole and the part behave as superior and inferior.

devanagari: ज्येष्ठ - भावे अंशीते हय प्रभु - ज्ञान ।
कनिष्ठ - भावे आपनाते भक्त - अभिमान ॥99॥
cc-adi-6.99.translation: The source of all incarnations has the emotions of a superior when He considers Himself the master, and He has the emotions of an inferior when He considers Himself a devotee.

devanagari: अगत्येक - गतिं नत्वा हीनार्थाधिक - साधकम् ।
श्री - चैतन्यं लिख्यतेऽस्य प्रेम - भक्ति - वदान्यता ॥1॥
cc-adi-7.1.translation: Let me first offer my respectful obeisances unto Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is the ultimate goal of life for one bereft of all possessions in this material world and is the only meaning for one advancing in spiritual life. Thus let me write about His magnanimous contribution of devotional service in love of God.

devanagari: एकले ईश्वर - तत्त्व चैतन्य - ईश्वर ।
भक्त - भावमय ताँर शुद्ध कलेवर ॥10॥
cc-adi-7.10.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is the supreme controller, the one Personality of Godhead, has ecstatically become a devotee, yet His body is transcendental and not materially tinged.

lines: ye kichu kahile tumi, saba satya haya
devanagari: ये किछु कहिले तुमि, सब सत्य हय ।
कृष्ण - प्रेमा सेइ पाय, यार भाग्योदय ॥100॥
cc-adi-7.100.translation: "Dear Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, what You have said is all true. Only one who is favored by fortune attains love of Godhead.

lines: vedānta nā śuna kene, tāra kibā doṣa
devanagari: कृष्ण भक्ति कर - इहाय सबार सन्तोष ।
वेदान्त ना शुन केने, तार किबा दोष ॥101॥
cc-adi-7.101.translation: "Dear sir, there is no objection to Your being a great devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Everyone is satisfied with this. But why do You avoid discussion on the Vedānta-sūtra? What is the fault in it?"

lines: eta śuni' hāsi' prabhu balilā vacana
duḥkha nā mānaha yadi, kari nivedana
devanagari: एत शुनि’ हासि’ प्रभु बलिला वचन ।
दुःख ना मानह यदि, करि निवेदन ॥102॥
cc-adi-7.102.translation: After hearing the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs speak in that way, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu smiled slightly and said, "My dear sirs, if you don't mind I can say something to you regarding Vedānta philosophy."The seriously inquisitive student or sage, well equipped with knowledge and detachment, realizes that Absolute Truth by rendering devotional service in terms of what he has heard from the Vedānta-śruti.

lines: ihā śuni' bale sarva sannyāsīra gaṇa
devanagari: इहा शुनि’ बले सर्व सन्न्यासीर गण ।
तोमाके देखिये यैछे साक्षात्नारायण ॥103॥
cc-adi-7.103.translation: Hearing this, the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs became somewhat humble and addressed Caitanya Mahāprabhu as Nārāyaṇa Himself, who they all agreed He was.

devanagari: तोमार वचन शुनि’ जुड़ाय श्रवण ।
तोमार माधुरी देखि’ जुड़ाय नयन ॥104॥
cc-adi-7.104.translation: "Dear Caitanya Mahāprabhu," they said, "to tell You the truth, we are greatly pleased to hear Your words, and furthermore Your bodily features are so pleasing that we feel extraordinary satisfaction in seeing You.

devanagari: तोमार प्रभावे सबार आनन्दित मन ।
कभु असङ्गत नहे तोमार वचन ॥105॥
cc-adi-7.105.translation: "Dear sir, by Your influence our minds are greatly satisfied, and we believe that Your words will never be unreasonable. Therefore You can speak on Vedānta-sūtra."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, वेदान्त - सूत्र ईश्वर - वचन ।
व्यास - रूपे कैल याहा श्री - नारायण ॥106॥
cc-adi-7.106.translation: The Lord said, "Vedānta philosophy consists of words spoken by the Supreme Personality of Godhead Nārāyaṇa in the form of Vyāsadeva.

lines: īśvarera vākye nāhi doṣa ei saba
devanagari: भ्रम, प्रमाद, विप्रलिप्सा, करणापाटव ।
ईश्वरेर वाक्ये नाहि दोष एइ सब ॥107॥
cc-adi-7.107.translation: "The material defects of mistakes, illusions, cheating and sensory inefficiency do not exist in the words of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

devanagari: उपनिषत्सहित सूत्र कहे येइ तत्त्व ।
मुख्य - वृत्त्ये सेइ अर्थ परम महत्त्व ॥108॥
cc-adi-7.108.translation: "The Absolute Truth is described by the Upaniṣads and Brahma-sūtra, but one must understand the verses as they are. That is the supreme glory in understanding.

lines: tāhāra śravaṇe nāśa haya sarva kārya
devanagari: गौण - वृत्त्ये येबा भाष्य करिल आचार्य ।
ताहार श्रवणे नाश हय सर्व कार्य ॥109॥
cc-adi-7.109.translation: "Śrīpāda Śaṅkarācārya has described all the Vedic literatures in terms of indirect meanings. One who hears such explanations is ruined.

devanagari: कृष्ण - माधुर्सेर एक अद्भुत स्वभाव ।
आपना आस्वादिते कृष्ण करे भक्त - भाव ॥11॥
cc-adi-7.11.translation: The transcendental mellow of conjugal love of Kṛṣṇa is so wonderful that Kṛṣṇa Himself accepts the form of a devotee to relish and taste it fully.

devanagari: ताँहार नाहिक दोष, ईश्वर - आज्ञा पाञा ।
गौणार्थ करिल मुख्य अर्थ आच्छादिया ॥110॥
cc-adi-7.110.translation: "Śaṅkarācārya is not at fault, for he has thus covered the real purpose of the Vedas under the order of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

devanagari: ‘ब्रह्म’ - शब्दे मुख्य अर्थे कहे भगवान् ।
चिदैश्व र्य - परिपूर्ण, अनू - समान ॥111॥
cc-adi-7.111.translation: "According to direct understanding, the Absolute Truth is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who has all spiritual opulences. No one can be equal to or greater than Him.

devanagari: ताँहार विभूति, देह, - सब चिदाकार ।
चिट्ठिभूति आच्छादि’ ताँरे कहे निराकार ॥112॥
cc-adi-7.112.translation: "Everything about the Supreme Personality of Godhead is spiritual, including His body, opulence and paraphernalia. Māyāvāda philosophy, however, covering His spiritual opulence, advocates the theory of impersonalism.

devanagari: चिदानन्द - तेंहो, ताँर स्थान, परिवार ।
ताँरे कहे - प्राकृत - सत्त्वेर विकार ॥113॥
cc-adi-7.113.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead is full of spiritual potencies. Therefore His body, name, fame and entourage are all spiritual. The Māyāvādī philosopher, due to ignorance, says that these are all merely transformations of the material mode of goodness.

lines: tāṅra doṣa nāhi, teṅho ājñā-kārī dāsa
āra yei śune tāra haya sarva-nāśa
devanagari: ताँर दोष नाहि, तेंहो आज्ञा - कारी दास ।
आर येइ शुने तार हय सर्व - नाश ॥114॥
cc-adi-7.114.translation: "Śaṅkarācārya, who is an incarnation of Lord Śiva, is faultless because he is a servant carrying out the orders of the Lord. But those who follow his Māyāvādī philosophy are doomed. They will lose all their advancement in spiritual knowledge.

devanagari: प्राकृत करिया माने विष्णु - कलेवर ।
विष्णु - निन्दा आर नाहि इहार उपर ॥115॥
cc-adi-7.115.translation: "One who considers the transcendental body of Lord Viṣṇu to be made of material nature is the greatest offender at the lotus feet of the Lord. There is no greater blasphemy against the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

devanagari: ईश्वरेर तत्त्व - येन ज्वलित ज्वलन ।
जीवेर स्वरूप - यैछे स्फुलिङ्गेर कण ॥116॥
cc-adi-7.116.translation: "The Lord is like a great blazing fire, and the living entities are like small sparks of that fire.

devanagari: जीव - तत्त्व - शक्ति, कृष्ण - तत्त्व - शक्तिमान् ।
गीता - विष्णुपुराणादि ताहाते प्रमाण ॥117॥
cc-adi-7.117.translation: "The living entities are energies, not the energetic. The energetic is Kṛṣṇa. This is very vividly described in Bhagavad-gītā, the Viṣṇu Purāṇa and other Vedic literatures.

devanagari: अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् ।
जीव - भूतां महा - बाहो ग्रयेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥118॥
cc-adi-7.118.translation: “ 'Besides the inferior nature, O mighty-armed Arjuna, there is a superior energy of Mine, which is all living entities who are struggling with material nature and are sustaining the universe.'

devanagari: विष्णु - शक्तिः परा प्रोक्ता क्षेत्र - ज्ञाख्या तथा परा ।
अविद्या - कर्म - संज्ञान्या तृतीया शक्तिरिष्यते ॥119॥
cc-adi-7.119.translation: “ 'The potency of Lord Viṣṇu is summarized in three categories-namely, the spiritual potency, the living entities and ignorance. The spiritual potency is full of knowledge; the living entities, although belonging to the spiritual potency, are subject to bewilderment; and the third energy, which is full of ignorance, is always visible in fruitive activities.'

devanagari: इथे भक्त - भाव धरे चैतन्य गोसाञि ।
‘भक्त - स्वरूप’ ताँर नित्यानन्द - भाई ॥12॥
cc-adi-7.12.translation: For this reason Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the supreme teacher, accepts the form of a devotee and accepts Lord Nityānanda as His elder brother.

devanagari: हेन जीव - तत्त्व लञा लि खि’ पर - तत्त्व ।
आच्छन्न करिल श्रेष्ठ ईश्वर - महत्त्व ॥120॥
cc-adi-7.120.translation: "The Māyāvāda philosophy is so degraded that it has taken the insignificant living entities to be the Lord, the Supreme Truth, thus covering the glory and supremacy of the Absolute Truth with monism.

devanagari: व्यासेर सूत्रेते कहे ‘परिणा म’ - वाद ।
‘व्यास भ्रान्त’ बलि’ तार उठाइल विवाद ॥121॥
cc-adi-7.121.translation: "In his Vedānta-sūtra Śrīla Vyāsadeva has described that everything is but a transformation of the energy of the Lord. Śaṅkarācārya, however, has misled the world by commenting that Vyāsadeva was mistaken. Thus he has raised great opposition to theism throughout the entire world.

devanagari: परिणाम - वादे ईश्वर हयेन विकारी ।
एत कहि’ ‘विवर्त’ - वाद स्थापना ये करि ॥122॥
cc-adi-7.122.translation: "According to Śaṅkarācārya, by accepting the theory of the transformation of the energy of the Lord, one creates an illusion by indirectly accepting that the Absolute Truth is transformed.

devanagari: वस्तुतः परिणाम - वाद - सेइ से प्रमाण ।
देहे आत्म - बुद्धि - एइ विवर्तेर स्था न ॥123॥
cc-adi-7.123.translation: "Transformation of energy is a proven fact. It is the false bodily conception of the self that is an illusion.

devanagari: अविचिन्त्य - शक्ति - मुक्त श्री - भगवान् ।
इच्छाय जगद्रूपे पाय परिणाम ॥124॥
cc-adi-7.124.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead is opulent in all respects. Therefore by His inconceivable energies He has transformed the material cosmic manifestation.

lines: prākṛta cintāmaṇi tāhe dṛṣṭānta ye dhari
devanagari: तथापि अचिन्त्य - शक्त्ये हय अविकारी ।
प्राकृत चिन्तामणि ताहे दृष्टान्त ये धरि ॥125॥
cc-adi-7.125.translation: "Using the example of a touchstone, which by its energy turns iron to gold and yet remains the same, we can understand that although the Supreme Personality of Godhead transforms His innumerable energies, He remains unchanged.

devanagari: नाना रत्न - राशि हय चिन्तामणि हैते ।
तथापिह मणि रहे स्वरूपे अविकृते ॥126॥
cc-adi-7.126.translation: "Although a touchstone produces many varieties of valuable jewels, it nevertheless remains the same. It does not change its original form.

devanagari: प्राकृत - वस्तुते यदि अचिन्त्य - शक्ति हय ।
ईश्वरेर अचिन्त्य - शक्ति, - इथे कि विस्मय ॥127॥
cc-adi-7.127.translation: "If there is such inconceivable potency in material objects, why should we not believe in the inconceivable potency of the Supreme Personality of Godhead?

devanagari: ‘प्रणव’ से महावाक्य - वेदेर निदान ।
ईश्वर - स्वरूप प्रणव सर्व - विश्व - धाम ॥128॥
cc-adi-7.128.translation: "The Vedic sound vibration oṁkāra, the principle word in the Vedic literatures, is the basis of all Vedic vibrations. Therefore one should accept oṁkāra as the sound representation of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and the reservoir of the cosmic manifestation.

devanagari: सर्वाश्रय ईश्वरेर प्रणव उद्देश ।
‘तत्त्वम सि’ वाक्य हय वेदेर एकदेश ॥129॥
cc-adi-7.129.translation: "It is the purpose of the Supreme Personality of Godhead to present praṇava [oṁkāra] as the reservoir of all Vedic knowledge. The words tat tvam asi are only a partial explanation of the Vedic knowledge.

lines: ei tina tattva sabe prabhu kari' gāi
devanagari: ‘भक्त - अवता र’ ताँर आचार्य - गोसाञि ।
एइ तिन तत्त्व सबे प्रभु करि’ गाइ ॥13॥
cc-adi-7.13.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya is Lord Caitanya's incarnation as a devotee. Therefore these three tattvas [Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu and Advaita Gosāñi] are the predominators, or masters.

devanagari: ‘प्रणव, महा - वाक्य - ताहा क रि’ आच्छादन ।
महावाक्ये क रि’ तत्त्वम सि’र स्थापन ॥130॥
cc-adi-7.130.translation: "Praṇava [oṁkāra] is the mahā-vākya [mahā-mantra] in the Vedas. Śaṅkarācārya's followers cover this to stress without authority the mantra tat tvam asi.

devanagari: सर्व - वेद - सूत्रे करे कृष्णेर अभिधान ।
मुख्य - वृत्ति छाड़ि’ कैल लक्षणा - व्याख्यान ॥131॥
cc-adi-7.131.translation: "In all the Vedic sūtras and literatures, it is Lord Kṛṣṇa who is to be understood, but the followers of Śaṅkarācārya have covered the real meaning of the Vedas with indirect explanations.

devanagari: स्वतः - प्रमाण वेद - प्रमाण - शिरोमणि ।
लक्षणा करिले स्वतः - प्रमाणता - हानि ॥132॥
cc-adi-7.132.translation: "The self-evident Vedic literatures are the highest evidence of all, but if these literatures are interpreted, their self-evident nature is lost.

devanagari: एइ मत प्रतिसूत्रे सहजार्थ छाड़िया ।
गौणार्थ व्याख्या करे कल्प ना करिया ॥133॥
cc-adi-7.133.translation: "The Māyāvāda school, giving up the real, easily understood meaning of Vedic literature, has introduced indirect meanings, based on their imaginative powers, to prove their philosophy."

devanagari: एइ मते प्रतिसूत्रे करेन दूषण ।
शुनि’ चमत्कार हैल सन्न्यासीर गण ॥134॥
cc-adi-7.134.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus showed for each and every sūtra the defects in Śaṅkarācārya's explanations, all the assembled Māyāvādī sannyāsīs were struck with wonder.

lines: tumi ye khaṇḍile artha, e nahe vivāda
devanagari: सकल सन्यासी कहे , - ‘शुनह श्रीपाद ।
तुमि ने खण्डिले अर्थ, ए नहे विवाद ॥135॥
cc-adi-7.135.translation: All the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs said, "Your Holiness, kindly know from us that we actually have no quarrel with Your refutation of these meanings, for You have given a clear understanding of the sūtras.

devanagari: आचार्य - कल्पित अर्थ , - इहा सभे जानि ।
सम्प्रदाय - अनुरोधे तबु ताहा मानि ॥136॥
cc-adi-7.136.translation: "We know that all this word jugglery springs from the imagination of Śaṅkarācārya, and yet because we belong to his sect, we accept it although it does not satisfy us.

lines: mukhyārtha vyākhyā kara, dekhi tomāra bala'
devanagari: मुख्यर्थ व्याख्या कर, देखि तोमार बल’ ।
मुख्याथै लागाल प्रभु सूत्र - सकल ॥137॥
cc-adi-7.137.translation: "Now let us see," the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs continued, "how well You can describe the sūtras in terms of their direct meaning." Hearing this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu began His direct explanation of the Vedānta-sūtra.

devanagari: बृहद्वस्तु ‘ब्रह्म’ कहि - ‘श्री - भगवान् ।
षड् - विधैश्वर्य - पूर्ण, पर - तत्त्व - धाम ॥138॥
cc-adi-7.138.translation: "Brahman, who is greater than the greatest, is the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He is full of six opulences, and therefore He is the reservoir of ultimate truth and absolute knowledge.

devanagari: स्वरूप - ऐश्वर्ये ताँर नाहि माया - गन्ध ।
सकल वेदेर हय भगवान्से सम्बन्ध’ ॥139॥
cc-adi-7.139.translation: "In His original form the Supreme Personality of Godhead is full of transcendental opulences, which are free from the contamination of the material world. It is to be understood that in all Vedic literature the Supreme Personality of Godhead is the ultimate goal.

devanagari: एक महाप्रभु, आर प्रभु दुइजन ।
दुइ प्रभु सेवे महाप्रभुर चरण ॥14॥
cc-adi-7.14.translation: One of Them is Mahāprabhu, and the other two are prabhus. These two prabhus serve the lotus feet of Mahāprabhu.

lines: ardha-svarūpa nā mānile pūrṇatā haya hāni
devanagari: ताँरे ‘निर्विशे ष’ कहि, चिच्छक्ति ना मानि ।
अर्ध - स्वरूप ना मानिले पूर्णता हय हानि ॥140॥
cc-adi-7.140.translation: "When we speak of the Supreme as impersonal, we deny His spiritual potencies. Logically, if you accept half of the truth, you cannot understand the whole.

devanagari: भगवान्प्राप्ति - हेतु ये करि उपाय ।
श्रवणादि भक्ति कृष्ण - प्राप्तिर सहाय ॥141॥
cc-adi-7.141.translation: "It is only by devotional service, beginning with hearing, that one can approach the Supreme Personality of Godhead. That is the only means to approach Him.

devanagari: सेइ सर्व - वेदेर ‘अभिधेय’ नाम ।
साधन - भक्ति हैते हय प्रेमेर उद्गम ॥142॥
cc-adi-7.142.translation: "By practicing this regulated devotional service under the direction of the spiritual master, certainly one awakens his dormant love of Godhead. This process is called abhidheya.

lines: kṛṣṇa vinu anyatra tāra nāhi rahe rāga
devanagari: कृष्णेर चरणे हय यदि अनुराग ।
कृष्ण विनु अन्यत्र तार नाहि रहे राग ॥143॥
cc-adi-7.143.translation: "If one develops his love of Godhead and becomes attached to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, gradually he loses his attachment to everything else.

devanagari: पञ्चम पुरुषार्थ सेइ प्रेम - महाधन ।
कृष्णेर माधुर्घ - रस कराय आस्वादन ॥144॥
cc-adi-7.144.translation: "Love of Godhead is so exalted that it is considered to be the fifth goal of human life. By awakening one's love of Godhead, one can attain the platform of conjugal love, tasting it even during the present span of life.

lines: premā haite kṛṣṇa haya nija bhakta-vaśa
devanagari: प्रेमा हैते कृष्ण हय निज भक्त - वश ।
प्रेमा हैते पाय कृष्णेर सेवा - सुख - रस ॥145॥
cc-adi-7.145.translation: "The Supreme Lord, who is greater than the greatest, becomes submissive to even a very insignificant devotee because of his devotional service. It is the beautiful and exalted nature of devotional service that the infinite Lord becomes submissive to the infinitesimal living entity because of it. In reciprocal devotional activities with the Lord, the devotee actually enjoys the transcendental mellow quality of devotional service.

devanagari: सम्बन्ध, अभिधेय, प्रयोजन नाम ।
एइ तिन अर्थ सर्व - सूत्रे पर्यवसान ॥146॥
cc-adi-7.146.translation: "One's relationship with the Supreme Personality of Godhead, activities in terms of that relationship, and the ultimate goal of life [to develop love of God]—these three subjects are explained in every code of the Vedānta-sūtra, for they form the culmination of the entire Vedānta philosophy."

devanagari: एइ - मत सर्व - सूत्रेर व्याख्यान शुनिया ।
सकल सन्यासी कहे विनय करिया ॥147॥
cc-adi-7.147.translation: When all the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs thus heard the explanation of Caitanya Mahāprabhu on the basis of sambandha, abhidheya and prayojana, they spoke very humbly.

devanagari: वेदमय - मूर्ति तुमि, - साक्षालारायण ।
क्षम अपराध , - पूर्वे ये कैलुँ निन्दन ॥148॥
cc-adi-7.148.translation: "Dear sir, You are Vedic knowledge personified and are directly Nārāyaṇa Himself. Kindly excuse us for the offenses we previously committed by criticizing You."

lines: sei haite sannyāsīra phiri gela mana
devanagari: सेइ हैते सन्न्यासीर फिरि गेल मन ।
‘कृष्ण’ ‘कृष्ण’ नाम सदा करये ग्रहण ॥149॥
cc-adi-7.149.translation: From that moment when the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs heard the explanation of Vedānta-sūtra from the Lord, their minds changed, and on the instruction of Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they too chanted "Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!" always.

devanagari: एइ तिन तत्त्व , - ‘सर्वाराध्य’ करि मानि ।
चतुर्थ ग्ने भक्त - तत्त्व, - ‘आराधक’ जानि ॥15॥
cc-adi-7.15.translation: The three predominators [Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu and Advaita Prabhu] are worshipable by all living entities, and the fourth principle [Śrī Gadādhara Prabhu] is to be understood as Their worshiper.

devanagari: एइ - मते ताँ - सबार क्षमि’ अपराध ।
सबाकारे कृष्ण - नाम करिला प्रसाद ॥150॥
cc-adi-7.150.translation: Thus Lord Caitanya excused all the offenses of the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs and very mercifully blessed them with kṛṣṇa-nāma.

devanagari: तबे सब सन्यासी महाप्रभुके लैया ।
भिक्षा करिलेन सभे, मध्ये वसाइया ॥151॥
cc-adi-7.151.translation: After this, all the sannyāsīs took the Lord in their midst, and thus they all took their meal together.

devanagari: भिक्षा क रि’ महाप्रभु आइला वासाघर ।
हेन चित्र - लीला करे गौराङ्ग - सुन्दर ॥152॥
cc-adi-7.152.translation: After taking lunch among the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is known as Gaurasundara, returned to His residence. Thus the Lord performs His wonderful pastimes.

devanagari: चन्द्रशेखर, तपन मिश्र, आर सनातन ।
शुनि’ देखि’ आनन्दित सबाकार मन ॥153॥
cc-adi-7.153.translation: Hearing the arguments of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and seeing His victory, Candraśekhara, Tapana Miśra and Sanātana were all extremely pleased.

devanagari: प्रभुके देखिते आइसे सकल सन्यासी ।
प्रभुर प्रशंसा करे सब वाराणसी ॥154॥
cc-adi-7.154.translation: Many Māyāvādī sannyāsīs of Vārāṇasī came to see the Lord after this incident, and the entire city praised Him.

devanagari: वाराणसी - पुरी आइला श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य ।
पुरी - सह सर्व - लोक हैल महा - धन्य ॥155॥
cc-adi-7.155.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the city of Vārāṇasī, and all of its people were very thankful.

lines: lakṣa lakṣa loka āise prabhuke dekhite
devanagari: लक्ष लक्ष लोक आइसे प्रभुके देखिते ।
महा - भिड़ हैल द्वारे, नारे प्रवेशिते ॥156॥
cc-adi-7.156.translation: The crowd at the door of His residence was so great that it numbered hundreds and thousands.

lines: lakṣa lakṣa loka āsi' mile sei sthāne
devanagari: प्रभु यबे या’न विश्वेश्वर - दरशने ।
लक्ष लक्ष लोक आ सि’ मिले सेइ स्थाने ॥157॥
cc-adi-7.157.translation: When the Lord went to visit the temple of Viśveśvara, hundreds and thousands of people assembled to see Him.

devanagari: स्नान करिते यबे या’न गङ्गा - तीरे ।
ताहाञि सकल लोक हय महा - भिड़े ॥158॥
cc-adi-7.158.translation: Whenever Lord Caitanya went to the banks of the Ganges to take bath, big crowds of many hundreds and thousands of people also assembled there.

lines: bāhu tuli' prabhu bale,—bala hari hari
devanagari: बाहु तुलि’ प्रभु बले, - बल हरि हरि ।
हरि - ध्वनि करे लोक स्वर्ग - मर्त्य भ रि’ ॥159॥
cc-adi-7.159.translation: Whenever the crowds were too great, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up, raised His hands and chanted, "Hari! Hari!" to which all the people responded, filling both the land and sky with the vibration.

devanagari: श्रीवासादि यत कोटि कोटि भक्त - गण ।
‘शुद्ध - भक्त’ - तत्त्व - मध्ये ताँ - सबार गणन ॥16॥
cc-adi-7.16.translation: There are innumerable pure devotees of the Lord, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, who are known as unalloyed devotees.

lines: loka nistāriyā prabhura calite haila mana
devanagari: लोक निस्तारिया प्रभुर चलिते हैल मन ।
वृन्दावने पाठाइला श्री - सनातन ॥160॥
cc-adi-7.160.translation: After thus delivering the people in general, the Lord desired to leave Vārāṇasī. After instructing Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī, He sent him toward Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: रात्रि - दिवसे लोकेर शुनि’ कोलाहल ।
वाराणसी छा ड़ि’ प्रभु आइला नीलाचल ॥161॥
cc-adi-7.161.translation: Because the city of Vārāṇasī was always full of tumultuous crowds, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, after sending Sanātana to Vṛndāvana, returned to Jagannātha Purī.

lines: ei līlā kahiba āge vistāra kariyā
devanagari: एइ लीला कहिब आगे विस्तार करिया ।
सङ्क्षेपे कहिलाँ इहाँ प्रसङ्ग पाइया ॥162॥
cc-adi-7.162.translation: I have here given a brief account of these pastimes of Lord Caitanya, but later I shall describe them in an extensive way.

devanagari: एइ पञ्च - तत्त्व - रूपे श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य ।
कृष्ण - नाम - प्रेम दिया विश्व कैला धन्य ॥163॥
cc-adi-7.163.translation: Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates of the Pañca-tattva distributed the holy name of the Lord to invoke love of Godhead throughout the universe, and thus the entire universe was thankful.

devanagari: मथुराते पाठाइल रूप - सनातन ।
दुइ सेनापति कैल भक्ति प्रचारण ॥164॥
cc-adi-7.164.translation: Lord Caitanya dispatched the two generals Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī to Vṛndāvana to preach the bhakti cult.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - गोसाळे पाठाइला गौड़ - देशे ।
तेंहो भक्ति प्रचारिला अशेष - विशेषे ॥165॥
cc-adi-7.165.translation: As Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī were sent toward Mathurā, so Nityānanda Prabhu was sent to Bengal to preach extensively the cult of Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: आपने दक्षिण देश करिला गमन ।
ग्रामे ग्रामे कैला कृष्ण - नाम प्रचारण ॥166॥
cc-adi-7.166.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally went to South India, and He broadcast the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa in every village and town.

devanagari: सेतुबन्ध पर्यन्त कैला भक्तिर प्रचार ।
कृष्ण - प्रेम दिया कैला सबार निस्तार ॥167॥
cc-adi-7.167.translation: Thus the Lord went to the southernmost tip of the Indian peninsula, known as Setubandha [Cape Comorin]. Everywhere He distributed the bhakti cult and love of Kṛṣṇa, and in this way He delivered everyone.

devanagari: एइ त कहिल पञ्च - तत्त्वेर व्याख्यान ।
इहार श्रवणे हय चैतन्य - तत्त्व ज्ञान ॥168॥
cc-adi-7.168.translation: I thus explain the truth of the Pañca-tattva. One who hears this explanation increases in knowledge of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - चैतन्य, नित्यानन्द, अद्वैत, - तिन जन ।
श्रीवास - गदाधर - आदि यत भक्त - गण ॥169॥
cc-adi-7.169.translation: While chanting the Pañca-tattva mahā-mantra, one must chant the names of Śrī Caitanya, Nityānanda, Advaita, Gadādhara and Śrīvāsa with their many devotees. This is the process.

devanagari: गदाधर - पण्डितादि प्रभुर ‘शक्ति’ - अवतार ।
‘अन्तरङ्ग - भक्त’ करि’ गणन याँहार ॥17॥
cc-adi-7.17.translation: The devotees headed by Gadādhara Paṇḍita are to be considered incarnations of the potency of the Lord. They are internal potential devotees engaged in the service of the Lord.

devanagari: संबाकार पादपद्म कोटि नमस्कार ।
यैछे तैछे कहि किछु चैतन्य - विहार ॥170॥
cc-adi-7.170.translation: I again and again offer obeisances unto the Pañca-tattva. Thus I think that I will be able to describe something about the pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥171॥
cc-adi-7.171.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: याँ - सबा लञा प्रभुर नित्य विहार ।
याँ - सबा लञा प्रभुर कीर्तन - प्रचार ॥18॥
cc-adi-7.18-19.translation: The internal devotees or potencies are all eternal associates in the pastimes of the Lord. Only with them does the Lord advent to propound the saṅkīrtana movement, only with them does the Lord taste the mellow of conjugal love, and only with them does He distribute this love of God to people in general.

devanagari: जय जय महाप्रभु श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य ।
ताँहार चरणाश्रित, सेइ बड़ धन्य ॥2॥
cc-adi-7.2.translation: Let me offer glorification to the Supreme Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. One who has taken shelter of His lotus feet is the most glorified person.

devanagari: सेइ पञ्च - तत्त्व मि लि’ पृथिवी आसिया ।
पूर्व - प्रेमभाण्डारेर मुद्रा उघाड़िया ॥20॥
cc-adi-7.20-21.translation: The characteristics of Kṛṣṇa are understood to be a storehouse of transcendental love. Although that storehouse of love certainly came with Kṛṣṇa when He was present, it was sealed. But when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came with His other associates of the Pañca-tattva, they broke the seal and plundered the storehouse to taste transcendental love of Kṛṣṇa. The more they tasted it, the more their thirst for it grew.

lines: nāce, kānde, hāse, gāya, yaiche mada-matta
devanagari: पुनः पुनः पियाइया हय महामत्त ।
नाचे, कान्दे, हासे, गाय, यैछे मद - मत्त ॥22॥
cc-adi-7.22.translation: Śrī Pañca-tattva themselves danced again and again and thus made it easier to drink nectarean love of Godhead. They danced, cried, laughed and chanted like madmen, and in this way they distributed love of Godhead.

lines: yei yāṅhā pāya, tāṅhā kare prema-dāna
devanagari: पात्रापात्र - विचार नाहि, नाहि स्थानास्थान ।
येइ याँहा पाय, ताँहा करे प्रेम - दान ॥23॥
cc-adi-7.23.translation: In distributing love of Godhead, Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates did not consider who was a fit candidate and who was not, nor where such distribution should or should not take place. They made no conditions. Wherever they got the opportunity the members of the Pañca-tattva distributed love of Godhead.

devanagari: लुटिया, खाइया, दिया, भाण्डार उजाड़े ।
आश्चर्य भाण्डार, प्रेम शत - गुण बाड़े ॥24॥
cc-adi-7.24.translation: Although the members of the Pañca-tattva plundered the storehouse of love of Godhead and ate and distributed its contents, there was no scarcity, for this wonderful storehouse is so complete that as the love is distributed, the supply increases hundreds of times.

lines: strī, vṛddha, bālaka, yuvā, sabāre ḍubāya
devanagari: उछलिल प्रेम - वन्या चौदिके वेड़ाय ।
स्त्री, वृद्ध, बालक, नुवा, सबारे डुबाय ॥25॥
cc-adi-7.25.translation: The flood of love of Godhead swelled in all directions, and thus young men, old men, women and children were all immersed in that inundation.

devanagari: सज्जन, दुर्जन, पङ्गु, जड़, अन्ध - गण ।
प्रेम - वन्याय डुबाइल जगतेर जन ॥26॥
cc-adi-7.26.translation: The Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement will inundate the entire world and drown everyone, whether one be a gentleman, a rogue or even lame, invalid or blind.

lines: jagat ḍubila, jīvera haila bīja nāśa
tāhā dekhi' pāṅca janera parama ullāsa
devanagari: जगत्डुबिल, जीवेर हैल बीज नाश ।
ताहा देखि पाँच जनेर परम उ ल्लास ॥27॥
cc-adi-7.27.translation: When the five members of the Pañca-tattva saw the entire world drowned in love of Godhead and the seed of material enjoyment in the living entities completely destroyed, they all became exceedingly happy.

lines: tata tata bāḍhe jala, vyāpe tri-bhuvane
devanagari: यत यत प्रेम - वृष्टि करे पञ्च - जने ।
तत तत बाढ़े जल, व्यापे त्रि - भुवने ॥28॥
cc-adi-7.28.translation: The more the five members of the Pañca-tattva cause the rains of love of Godhead to fall, the more the inundation increases and spreads all over the world.

devanagari: मायावादी, कर्म - निष्ठ कुतार्किक - गण ।
निन्दक, पाषण्डी यत पड़या अधम ॥29॥
cc-adi-7.29-30.translation: The impersonalists, fruitive workers, false logicians, blasphemers, nondevotees and lowest among the student community are very expert in avoiding the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement, and therefore the inundation of Kṛṣṇa consciousness cannot touch them.

lines: pūrve gurv-ādi chaya tattve kaila namaskāra
devanagari: पूर्वे गुर्वादि छय तत्त्वे कैल नमस्कार ।
गुरु - तत्त्व कहियाछि, एबे पाँचेर विचार ॥3॥
cc-adi-7.3.translation: In the beginning I have discussed the truth about the spiritual master. Now I shall try to explain the Pañca-tattva.

devanagari: ताहा दे खि’ महाप्रभु करेन चिन्तन ।
जगडुबाइते आमि करिलुँ यतन ॥31॥
cc-adi-7.31-32.translation: Seeing that the Māyāvādīs and others were fleeing, Lord Caitanya thought: I wanted everyone to be immersed in this inundation of love of Godhead, but some of them have escaped. Therefore I shall devise a trick to drown them also.

lines: eta bali' mane kichu kariyā vicāra
devanagari: एत बलि’ मने किछु करिया विचार ।
सन्यास - आश्रम प्रभु कैला अङ्गीकार ॥33॥
cc-adi-7.33.translation: Thus the Lord accepted the sannyāsa order of life after full consideration.

devanagari: चब्बिश वत्सर छिला गृहस्थ - आश्रमे ।
पञ्च - विंशति वर्षे कैल यति - धर्मे ॥34॥
cc-adi-7.34.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained in householder life for twenty-four years, and on the verge of His twenty-fifth year He accepted the sannyāsa order.

devanagari: सन्यास करिया प्रभु कैला आकर्षण ।
यतेक पाला ञाछिल ताकिर् कादिगण ॥35॥
cc-adi-7.35.translation: After accepting the sannyāsa order, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu attracted the attention of all those who had evaded Him, beginning with the logicians.

devanagari: पड़या, पाषण्डी, कर्मी, निन्दकादि यत ।
तारा आ सि’ प्रभु - पाय हय अवनत ॥36॥
cc-adi-7.36.translation: Thus the students, infidels, fruitive workers and critics all came to surrender unto the lotus feet of the Lord.

devanagari: अपराध क्षमाइल, डुबिल प्रेम - जले ।
केबा एड़ाइबे प्रभुर प्रेम - महाजाले ॥37॥
cc-adi-7.37.translation: Lord Caitanya excused them all, and they merged into the ocean of devotional service, for no one can escape the unique loving network of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: सबा निस्तारिते प्रभु कृपा - अवतार ।
सबा निस्तारिते करे चातुरी अपार ॥38॥
cc-adi-7.38.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared to deliver all the fallen souls. Therefore He devised many methods to liberate them from the clutches of māyā.

lines: tabe nija bhakta kaila yata mleccha ādi
devanagari: तबे निज भक्त कैल यत म्लेच्छ आदि ।
सबे एड़ाइल मात्र काशीर मायावादी ॥39॥
cc-adi-7.39.translation: All were converted into devotees of Lord Caitanya, even the mlecchas and yavanas. Only the impersonalist followers of Śaṅkarācārya evaded Him.

devanagari: पञ्च - तत्त्व अवतीर्ण चैतन्येर सङ्गे ।
पञ्च - तत्त्व लञा करेन सङ्कीर्तन रङ्गे ॥4॥
cc-adi-7.4.translation: These five tattvas incarnate with Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and thus the Lord executes His saṅkīrtana movement with great pleasure.

devanagari: वृन्दावन याइते प्रभु रहिला काशीते ।
मायावादि - गण ताँरे लागिल निन्दिते ॥40॥
cc-adi-7.40.translation: While Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu was passing through Vārāṇasī on His way to Vṛndāvana, the Māyāvādī sannyāsī philosophers blasphemed against Him in many ways.

devanagari: सन्यासी हुइया करे गायन, नाचन ।
ना करे वेदान्त - पाठ, करे सङ्कीर्तन ॥41॥
cc-adi-7.41.translation: "Although a sannyāsī, He does not take interest in the study of Vedānta but instead always engages in chanting and dancing in saṅkīrtana.

devanagari: मूर्ख सन्यासी निज - धर्म नाहि जने ।
भावुक हइया फेरे भावुकेर सने ॥42॥
cc-adi-7.42.translation: "This Caitanya Mahāprabhu is an illiterate sannyāsī and therefore does not know His real function. Guided only by His sentiments, He wanders about in the company of other sentimentalists."

lines: e saba śuniyā prabhu hāse mane mane
upekṣā kariyā kāro nā kaila sambhāṣaṇe
devanagari: ए सब शुनिया प्रभु हासे मने मने ।
उपेक्षा करिया कारो ना कैल सम्भाषणे ॥43॥
cc-adi-7.43.translation: Hearing all this blasphemy, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu merely smiled to Himself, rejected all these accusations and did not talk with the Māyāvādīs.

devanagari: उपेक्षा करिया कैल मथुरा गमन ।
मथुरा देखिया पुनः कैल आगमन ॥44॥
cc-adi-7.44.translation: Thus neglecting the blasphemy of the Vārāṇasī Māyāvādīs, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu proceeded to Mathurā, and after visiting Mathurā He returned to meet the situation.

lines: tāṅra ghare rahilā prabhu svatantra īśvara
devanagari: काशीते लेखक शूद्र - श्रीचन्द्रशेख र ।
ताँर घरे रहिला प्रभु स्वतन्त्र ईश्वर ॥45॥
cc-adi-7.45.translation: This time Lord Caitanya stayed at the house of Candraśekhara, although he was regarded as a śūdra or kāyastha, for the Lord, as the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is completely independent.

devanagari: तपन - मिश्रेर घरे भिक्षा - निर्वाहण ।
सन्न्यासीर सङ्गे नाहि माने निमन्त्रण ॥46॥
cc-adi-7.46.translation: As a matter of principle, Lord Caitanya regularly accepted His food at the house of Tapana Miśra. He never mixed with other sannyāsīs, nor did He accept invitations from them.

lines: tāṅra śikṣā lāgi' prabhu du-māsa rahilā
devanagari: सनातन गोसाञि आसि’ ताँहाइ मिलिला ।
ताँर शिक्षा ला गि’ प्रभु दु - मास रहिला ॥47॥
cc-adi-7.47.translation: When Sanātana Gosvāmī came from Bengal, he met Lord Caitanya at the house of Tapana Miśra, where Lord Caitanya remained continuously for two months to teach him devotional service.

devanagari: ताँरे शिखाइला सब वैष्णवेर धर्म ।
भागवत - आदि शास्त्रेर व्रत गूढ़ मर्म ॥48॥
cc-adi-7.48.translation: On the basis of scriptures like Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, which reveal these confidential directions, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Sanātana Gosvāmī regarding all the regular activities of a devotee.

devanagari: इतिमध्ये चन्द्रशेखर, मिश्र - तपन ।
दुःखी हा प्रभु - पाय कैल निवेदन ॥49॥
cc-adi-7.49.translation: While Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu was instructing Sanātana Gosvāmī, both Candraśekhara and Tapana Miśra became very unhappy. Therefore they submitted an appeal unto the lotus feet of the Lord.

devanagari: पञ्च - तत्त्व - एक - वस्तु, नाहि किछु भेद ।
रस आस्वादिते तबु विविध विभेद ॥5॥
cc-adi-7.5.translation: Spiritually there are no differences between these five tattvas, for on the transcendental platform everything is absolute. Yet there are also varieties in the spiritual world, and in order to taste these spiritual varieties one should distinguish between them.

lines: nā pāri sahite, ebe chāḍiba jīvana
devanagari: कतेक शुनिब प्रभु तोमार निन्दन ।
ना पारि सहिते, एबे छाड़िब जीवन ॥50॥
cc-adi-7.50.translation: "How long can we tolerate the blasphemy of Your critics against Your conduct? We should give up our lives rather than hear such blasphemy.

devanagari: तोमारे निन्दये यत सन्यासीर गण ।
शुनिते ना पारि, फाटे हृदय - श्रवण ॥51॥
cc-adi-7.51.translation: "The Māyāvādī sannyāsīs are all criticizing Your Holiness. We cannot tolerate hearing such criticism, for this blasphemy breaks our hearts."

lines: ihā śuni rahe prabhu īṣat hāsiyā
sei kāle eka vipra milila āsiyā
devanagari: इहा शुनि रहे प्रभु ईषत् हासिया ।
सेइ काले एक विप्र मिलिल आसिया ॥52॥
cc-adi-7.52.translation: While Tapana Miśra and Candraśekhara were thus talking with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, He only smiled slightly and remained silent. At that time a brāhmaṇa came there to meet the Lord.

lines: eka vastu māgoṅ, deha prasanna ha-iyā
devanagari: आसि’ निवेदन करे चरणे धरिया ।
एक वस्तु मागों, देह प्रसन्न हइया ॥53॥
cc-adi-7.53.translation: The brāhmaṇa immediately fell at the lotus feet of Caitanya Mahāprabhu and requested Him to accept his proposal in a joyful mood.

lines: tumi yadi āisa, pūrṇa haya mora mana
devanagari: सकल स न्न्यासी मुञि कैनु निमन्त्रण ।
तुमि यदि आइस, पूर्ण हय मोर मन ॥54॥
cc-adi-7.54.translation: "My dear Lord, I have invited all the sannyāsīs of Benares to my home. My desires will be fulfilled if You also accept my invitation.

lines: nā yāha sannyāsi-goṣṭhī, ihā āmi jāni
devanagari: ना याह सन्यासि - गोष्ठी, इहा आमि जानि ।
मोरे अनुग्रह कर निमन्त्रण मानि’ ॥55॥
cc-adi-7.55.translation: "My dear Lord, I know that You never mix with other sannyāsīs, but please be merciful unto me and accept my invitation.

lines: sannyāsīre kṛpā lāgi' e bhaṅgī tāṅhāra
devanagari: प्रभु हासि’ निमन्त्रण कैल अङ्गीकार ।
सन्यासीरे कृपा लागि’ ए भङ्गी ताँहार ॥56॥
cc-adi-7.56.translation: Lord Caitanya smiled and accepted the invitation of the brāhmaṇa. He made this gesture to show His mercy to the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs.

lines: se vipra jānena prabhu nā yā'na kā'ra ghare
devanagari: से विप्र जानेन प्रभु ना या’न का’र घरे ।
ताँहार प्रेरणाय ताँरे अत्याग्रह करे ॥57॥
cc-adi-7.57.translation: The brāhmaṇa knew that Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu never went to anyone else's house, yet due to inspiration from the Lord he earnestly requested Him to accept this invitation.

lines: āra dine gelā prabhu se vipra-bhavane
devanagari: आर दिने गेला प्रभु से विप्र - भवने ।
देखिलेन, वसियाछेन सन्न्यासीर गणे ॥58॥
cc-adi-7.58.translation: The next day, when Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the house of that brāhmaṇa, He saw all the sannyāsīs of Benares sitting there.

lines: pāda prakṣālana kari vasilā sei sthāne
devanagari: सबा नमस्क रि’ गेला पाद - प्रक्षालने ।
पाद प्रक्षालन करि वसिला सेइ स्थाने ॥59॥
cc-adi-7.59.translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the sannyāsīs He immediately offered obeisances, and then He went to wash His feet. After washing His feet, He sat down by the place where He had done so.

devanagari: पञ्च - तत्त्वात्म कं कृष्णं भक्त - रूप - स्वरूपकम् ।
भक्तावतारं भक्ताख्यं नमामि भक्त - शक्तिकम् ॥6॥
cc-adi-7.6.translation: Let me offer my obeisances unto Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who has manifested Himself in five as a devotee, expansion of a devotee, incarnation of a devotee, pure devotee and devotional energy.

devanagari: वसिया करिला किछु ऐश्वर्य प्रकाश ।
महातेजोमय वपु कोटि - सूर्याभास ॥60॥
cc-adi-7.60.translation: After sitting on the ground, Caitanya Mahāprabhu exhibited His mystic power by manifesting an effulgence as brilliant as the illumination of millions of suns.

devanagari: प्रभावे आकर्षिल सब सन्न्यासीर मन ।
उठिल सन्यासी सब छाड़िया आसन ॥61॥
cc-adi-7.61.translation: When the sannyāsīs saw the brilliant illumination of the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, their minds were attracted, and they all immediately gave up their sitting places and stood in respect.

devanagari: प्रकाशानन्द - नामे सर्व सन्यासि - प्रधान ।
प्रभुके कहिल किछु करिया सम्मान ॥62॥
cc-adi-7.62.translation: The leader of all the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs present was named Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī, and after standing up he addressed Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu as follows with great respect.

lines: ihāṅ āisa, ihāṅ āisa, śunaha śrīpāda
devanagari: इहाँ आइस, इहाँ आइस, शुनह श्रीपाद ।
अपवित्र स्थाने वैस, किबा अवसाद ॥63॥
cc-adi-7.63.translation: "Please come here. Please come here, Your Holiness. Why do You sit in that unclean place? What has caused Your lamentation?"

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - आमि हइ हीन - सम्प्रदाय ।
तोमा - सबार सभाय वसिते ना युयाय ॥64॥
cc-adi-7.64.translation: The Lord replied: "I belong to a lower order of sannyāsīs. Therefore I do not deserve to sit with you."

devanagari: आपने प्रकाशानन्द हातेते धरिया ।
वसाइला सभा - मध्ये सम्मान करिया ॥65॥
cc-adi-7.65.translation: Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī, however, caught Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally by the hand and seated Him with great respect in the midst of the assembly.

devanagari: पुछिल, तोमार नाम ‘श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य’ ।
केशव - भारतीर शिष्य, ताते तुमि धन्य ॥66॥
cc-adi-7.66.translation: Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī then said: "I understand that Your name is Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya. You are a disciple of Śrī Keśava Bhāratī, and therefore You are glorious.

lines: sāmpradāyika sannyāsī tumi, raha ei grāme
ki kāraṇe āmā-sabāra nā kara darśane
devanagari: साम्प्रदायिक सन्यासी तुमि, रह एइ ग्रामे ।
कि कारणे आमा - सबार ना कर दर्शने ॥67॥
cc-adi-7.67.translation: "You belong to our Śaṅkara-sampradāya and live in our village, Vārāṇasī. Why then do You not associate with us? Why is it that You avoid even seeing us?

lines: bhāvuka saba saṅge lañā kara saṅkīrtana
devanagari: सन्यासी हइया कर नर्तन - गायन ।
भावुक सब सङ्गे लञा कर सङ्कीर्तन ॥68॥
cc-adi-7.68.translation: "You are a sannyāsī. Why then do You indulge in chanting and dancing, engaging in Your saṅkīrtana movement in the company of fanatics?

lines: tāhā chāḍi' kara kene bhāvukera karma
devanagari: वेदान्त - पठन, ध्यान, - सन्न्यासीर धर्म ।
ताहा छा ड़ि’ कर केने भावुकेर कर्म ॥69॥
cc-adi-7.69.translation: "Meditation and the study of Vedānta are the sole duties of a sannyāsī. Why do You abandon these to dance with fanatics?

devanagari: स्वयं भगवान्कृष्ण एकले ईश्वर ।
अद्वितीय, नन्दात्मज, रसिक - शेखर ॥7॥
cc-adi-7.7.translation: Kṛṣṇa, the reservoir of all pleasure, is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself, the supreme controller. No one is greater than or equal to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, yet He appears as the son of Mahārāja Nanda.
