lines: hīnācāra kara kene, ithe ki kāraṇa
devanagari: प्रभावे देखिये तोमा साक्षात्नारायण ।
हीनाचार कर केने, इथे कि कारण ॥70॥
cc-adi-7.70.translation: "You look as brilliant as if You were Nārāyaṇa Himself. Will You kindly explain the reason that You have adopted the behavior of lower-class people?"

lines: guru more mūrkha dekhi' karila śāsana
devanagari: प्रभु कहे - शुन, श्रीपाद, इहार कारण ।
गुरु मोरे मूर्ख देखि’ करिल शासन ॥71॥
cc-adi-7.71.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied to Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī, "My dear sir, kindly hear the reason. My spiritual master considered Me a fool, and therefore he chastised Me.

devanagari: मूर्ख तुमि, तोमार नाहिक वेदान्ताधिकार ।
‘कृष्ण - मन्त्र’ जप सदा , - एइ मन्त्र - सार ॥72॥
cc-adi-7.72.translation: “ 'You are a fool,' he said. 'You are not qualified to study Vedānta philosophy, and therefore You must always chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. This is the essence of all mantras, or Vedic hymns.

devanagari: कृष्ण - मन्त्र हैते हबे संसार - मोचन ।
कृष्ण - नाम है पाबे कृष्णेर चरण ॥73॥
cc-adi-7.73.translation: "Simply by chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa one can obtain freedom from material existence. Indeed, simply by chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra one will be able to see the lotus feet of the Lord.

lines: nāma vinu kali-kāle nāhi āra dharma
devanagari: नाम विनु कलि - काले नाहि आर धर्म ।
सर्व - मन्त्र - सार नाम, एइ शास्त्र - मर्म ॥74॥
cc-adi-7.74.translation: “ 'In this Age of Kali there is no other religious principle than the chanting of the holy name, which is the essence of all Vedic hymns. This is the purport of all scriptures.'

lines: eta bali' eka śloka śikhāila more
kaṇṭhe kari' ei śloka kariha vicāre
devanagari: एत बलि’ एक श्लोक शि खाइल मोरे ।
कण्ठे क रि’ एइ श्लोक करिह विचारे ॥75॥
cc-adi-7.75.translation: "After describing the potency of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, My spiritual master taught Me another verse, advising Me to always keep the name within My throat.

devanagari: हरेर्नाम हरेर्नाम हरेर्नामैव केवलम् ।
कलौ नास्त्येव नास्त्येव नास्त्येव गतिरन्यथा ॥76॥
cc-adi-7.76.translation: “ 'in this age of Kali there is no alternative, there is no alternative, there is no alternative for spiritual progress than the holy name, the holy name, the holy name of the Lord.'

lines: ei ājñā pāñā nāma la-i anukṣaṇa
nāma laite laite mora bhrānta haila mana
devanagari: एइ आज्ञा पाञा नाम लइ अनुक्षण ।
नाम लेते लैते मोर भ्रान्त हैल मन ॥77॥
cc-adi-7.77.translation: "Since I received this order from My spiritual master, I always chant the holy name, but I think that by chanting and chanting the holy name I have been bewildered.

lines: hāsi, kāndi, nāci, gāi, yaiche madamatta
devanagari: धैर्य धरिते नारि, हैलाम उन्मत्त ।
हासि, कान्दि, नाचि, गाइ, यैछे मदमत्त ॥78॥
cc-adi-7.78.translation: "While chanting the holy name of the Lord in pure ecstasy, I lose myself, and thus I laugh, cry, dance and sing just like a madman.

lines: tabe dhairya dhari' mane kariluṅ vicāra
devanagari: तबे धैर्य ध रि’ मने करि लुँ विचार ।
कृष्ण - नामे ज्ञानाच्छन्न हइल आमार ॥79॥
cc-adi-7.79.translation: "Collecting My patience, therefore, I began to consider that chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa had covered all My spiritual knowledge.

devanagari: रासादि - विलासी, व्रजललना - नागर ।
आर यत सब देख , - ताँर परिकर ॥8॥
cc-adi-7.8.translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is the supreme enjoyer in the rāsa dance. He is the leader of the damsels of Vraja, and all others are simply His associates.

lines: pāgala ha-ilāṅ āmi, dhairya nāhi mane
devanagari: पागल हइलाँ आमि, धैर्य नाहि मने ।
एत चि न्ति’ निवेदि लुँ गुरुर चरणे ॥80॥
cc-adi-7.80.translation: "I saw that I had become mad by chanting the holy name, and I immediately submitted this at the lotus feet of my spiritual master.

lines: kibā mantra dilā, gosāñi, kibā tāra bala
devanagari: किबा मन्त्र दिला, गोसाञि, किबा तार बल ।
जपिते जपिते मन्त्र करिल पागल ॥81॥
cc-adi-7.81.translation: “ 'My dear lord, what kind of mantra have you given Me? I have become mad simply by chanting this mahā-mantra!

lines: eta śuni' guru hāsi balilā vacana
devanagari: हासाय, नाचाय, मोरे कराय क्रन्दन ।
एत शुनि’ गुरु हासि बलिला वचन ॥82॥
cc-adi-7.82.translation: “ 'Chanting the holy name in ecstasy causes one to dance, laugh and cry.' When My spiritual master heard all this, he smiled and then began to speak.

lines: yei jape, tāra kṛṣṇe upajaye bhāva
devanagari: कृष्ण - नाम - महा - मन्त्रेर एइ त स्वभाव ।
येइ जपे, तार कृष्णे उपजये भाव ॥83॥
cc-adi-7.83.translation: It is the nature of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra that anyone who chants it immediately develops his loving ecstasy for Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: कृष्ण - विषयक प्रेमा - परम पुरुषार्थ ।
यार आगे तृण - तुल्य चारि पुरुषार्थ ॥84॥
cc-adi-7.84.translation: “ 'Religiosity, economic development, sense gratification and liberation are known as the four goals of life, but before love of Godhead, the fifth and highest goal, these appear as insignificant as straw in the street.

lines: mokṣādi ānanda yāra nahe eka bindu
devanagari: पञ्चम पुरुषार्थ - प्रेमानन्दामृत - सिन्धु ।
मोक्षादि आनन्द यार नहे एक बिन्दु ॥85॥
cc-adi-7.85.translation: “ 'For a devotee who has actually developed bhāva, the pleasure derived from dharma, artha, kāma and mokṣa appears like a drop in the presence of the sea.

lines: bhāgye sei premā tomāya karila udaya
devanagari: कृष्ण - नामेर फल - ‘प्रेमा’, सर्व - शास्त्रे कय ।
भाग्ये सेइ प्रेमा तोमाय करिल उदय ॥86॥
cc-adi-7.86.translation: “ 'The conclusion of all revealed scriptures is that one should awaken his dormant love of Godhead. You are greatly fortunate to have already done so.

devanagari: प्रेमार स्वभावे करे चित्त - तनु क्षोभ ।
कृष्णेर चरण - प्राप्त्ये उपजाय लोभ ॥87॥
cc-adi-7.87.translation: “ 'It is a characteristic of love of Godhead that by nature it induces transcendental symptoms in one's body and makes one more and more greedy to achieve the shelter of the lotus feet of the Lord.

lines: premāra svabhāve bhakta hāse, kānde, gāya
devanagari: प्रेमार स्वभावे भक्त हासे, कान्दे, गाय ।
उन्मत्त हइया नाचे, इति - उति धाय ॥88॥
cc-adi-7.88.translation: “ 'When one actually develops love of Godhead, he naturally sometimes cries, sometimes laughs, sometimes chants and sometimes runs here and there just like a madman.

lines: unmāda, viṣāda, dhairya, garva, harṣa, dainya
devanagari: स्वेद, कम्प, रोमाञ्चाश्रु, गद्गद, वैवर्य ।
उन्माद, विषाद, धैर्य, गर्व, हर्ष, दैन्य ॥89॥
cc-adi-7.89-90.translation: “ 'Perspiration, trembling, standing of one's bodily hairs, tears, faltering, fading, madness, melancholy, patience, pride, joy and humility—these are various natural symptoms of ecstatic love of Godhead, which causes a devotee to dance and float in an ocean of transcendental bliss while chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra.

devanagari: सेइ कृष्ण अवतीर्ण श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य ।
सेइ परिकर - गण सङ्गे सब धन्य ॥9॥
cc-adi-7.9.translation: The selfsame Lord Kṛṣṇa advented Himself as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with all His eternal associates, who are also equally glorious.

devanagari: भाल हैल, पाइले तुमि परम - पुरुषार्थ ।
तोमार प्रेमेते आमि हैलाँ कृतार्थ ॥91॥
cc-adi-7.91.translation: “ 'It is very good, my dear child, that You have attained the supreme goal of life by developing love of Godhead. Thus You have pleased me very much, and I am very much obliged to You.

devanagari: नाच, गाओ, भक्त - सङ्गे कर सङ्कीर्तन ।
कृष्ण - नाम उपदे शि’ तार’ सर्व - जन ॥92॥
cc-adi-7.92.translation: “ 'My dear child, continue dancing, chanting and performing saṅkīrtana in association with devotees. Furthermore, go out and preach the value of chanting kṛṣṇa-nāma, for by this process You will be able to deliver all fallen souls.'

lines: eta bali' eka śloka śikhāila more
devanagari: एत बलि’ एक श्लोक शिखाइ ल मोरे ।
भागवतेर सार एइ - बले वारे वारे ॥93॥
cc-adi-7.93.translation: "Saying this, My spiritual master taught Me one verse from Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. It is the essence of all the Bhāgavatam's instructions; therefore he instructed Me on this verse again and again."

devanagari: एवं - व्रतः स्व - प्रिय - नाम - कीर्त्या जातानुरागो द्रुत - चित्त उच्चैः ।
हसत्यथो रोदिति रौति गायत्य् उन्माद - वन्नृत्यति लोक - बाह्यः ॥94॥
cc-adi-7.94.translation: “ 'When a person is actually advanced and takes pleasure in chanting the holy name of the Lord, who is very dear to him, he is agitated and loudly chants the holy name. He also laughs, cries, becomes agitated and chants just like a madman, not caring for outsiders.'

lines: ei tāṅra vākye āmi dṛḍha viśvāsa dhari'
devanagari: एइ ताँर वाक्ये आमि दृढ़ विश्वास धरि ।
निरन्तर कृष्ण - नाम सङ्कीर्तन करि ॥95॥
cc-adi-7.95-96.translation: "I firmly believe in these words of My spiritual master, and therefore I always chant the holy name of the Lord, alone and in the association of devotees. That holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa sometimes causes Me to chant and dance, and therefore I chant and dance. Please do not think that I intentionally do it. I do it automatically.

devanagari: कृष्ण - नामे ये आनन्द - सिन्धु - आस्वादन ।
ब्रह्मानन्द तार आगे खातोदक - सम ॥97॥
cc-adi-7.97.translation: "Compared to the ocean of transcendental bliss which is tasted by chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, the pleasure derived from impersonal Brahman realization [brahmānanda] is like the shallow water in a canal.

devanagari: त्वत्साक्षात्करणाह्लाद - विशुद्धाब्धि - स्थितस्य मे ।
सुखानि गोष्पदायन्ते ब्राह्माण्यपि जगद्गुरो ॥98॥
cc-adi-7.98.translation: “ 'My dear Lord, O master of the universe, since I have directly seen You, my transcendental bliss has taken the shape of a great ocean. Being situated in that ocean, I now realize all other so-called happiness to be like the water contained in the hoofprint of a calf.' "

lines: citta phiri' gela, kahe madhura vacana
devanagari: प्रभुर मिष्ट - वाक्य शुनि’ सन्न्यासीर गण।
चित्त फि रि’ गेल, कहे मधुर वचन ॥99॥
cc-adi-7.99.translation: After hearing Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs were moved. Their minds changed, and thus they spoke with pleasing words.

devanagari: वन्दे चैतन्य - देवं तं भगवन्तं यदिच्छया ।
प्रसभं नर्त्यते चित्रं लेख - रङ्गे जड़ोऽप्ययम् ॥1॥
cc-adi-8.1.translation: I offer my respects to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, by whose desire I have become like a dancing dog and, although I am a fool, I have suddenly taken to the writing of Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta.

lines: more nā mānile saba loka habe nāśa
ithi lāgi' kṛpārdra prabhu karila sannyāsa
devanagari: मोरे ना मानिले सब लोक हबे नाश ।
इथि ला गि’ कृपार्द्र प्रभु करिल सन्न्यास ॥10॥
cc-adi-8.10.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thought, "Unless people accepted Him they would all be destroyed." Thus the merciful Lord accepted the sannyāsa order.

devanagari: सन्यासि - बुद्ध्ये मोरे करिबे नमस्कार ।
तथापि खण्डिबे दुःख, पाइबे निस्तार ॥11॥
cc-adi-8.11.translation: "If a person offers obeisances to Lord Caitanya, even due to accepting Him only as an ordinary sannyāsī, his material distresses will diminish, and he will ultimately get liberation."

lines: hena kṛpāmaya caitanya nā bhaje yei jana
devanagari: हेन कृपामय चैतन्य ना भजे येइ जन ।
सर्वोत्तम हइलेओ तारे असुरे गणन ॥12॥
cc-adi-8.12.translation: One who does not show respect unto this merciful Lord, Caitanya Mahāprabhu, or does not worship Him should be considered a demon, even if he is very exalted in human society.

devanagari: अतएव पुनः कहों ऊर्ध्व - बाहु हञा ।
चैतन्य - नित्यानन्द भज कुतर्क छाड़िया ॥13॥
cc-adi-8.13.translation: Therefore I say again, lifting my arms: O fellow human beings, please worship Śrī Caitanya and Nityānanda without false arguments!

lines: yadi vā tārkika kahe,—tarka se pramāṇa
devanagari: यदि वा ताकिर् क कहे , - तकर् से प्रमाण ।
तकर् - शास्त्रे सिद्ध येइ, सेइ सेव्यमान ॥14॥
cc-adi-8.14.translation: Logicians say, "Unless one gains understanding through logic and argument, how can one decide upon a worshipable Deity?"

devanagari: श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य - दया करह विचार ।
विचार करिते चित्ते पाबे चमत्कार ॥15॥
cc-adi-8.15.translation: If you are indeed interested in logic and argument, kindly apply it to the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. If you do so, you will find it to be strikingly wonderful.

lines: bahu janma kare yadi śravaṇa, kīrtana
tabu ta' nā pāya kṛṣṇa-pade prema-dhana
devanagari: बहु जन्म करे यदि श्रवण, कीर्तन ।
तबु त’ ना पाय कृष्ण - पदे प्रेम - धन ॥16॥
cc-adi-8.16.translation: If one is infested with the ten offenses in the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, despite his endeavor to chant the holy name for many births, he will not get the love of Godhead which is the ultimate goal of this chanting.

devanagari: ज्ञानतः सु - लभा मुक्तिभुक्तिर्यज्ञादि - पुण्यतः ।
सेयं साधन - साहस्त्रैर्हरि - भक्तिः सु - दुर्लभा ॥17॥
cc-adi-8.17.translation: "By cultivating philosophical knowledge one can understand his spiritual position and thus be liberated, and by performing sacrifices and pious activities one can achieve sense gratification in a higher planetary system, but the devotional service of the Lord is so rare that even by executing hundreds and thousands of such sacrifices one cannot obtain it."

lines: kṛṣṇa yadi chuṭe bhakte bhukti mukti diyā
kabhu prema-bhakti nā dena rākhena lukāiyā
devanagari: कृष्ण यदि छुटे भक्ते भुक्ति मुक्ति दिया ।
कभु प्रेम - भक्ति ना देन राखेन लुकाइया ॥18॥
cc-adi-8.18.translation: If a devotee wants material sense gratification or liberation from the Lord, Kṛṣṇa immediately delivers it, but pure devotional service He keeps hidden.

lines: rājan patir gurur alaṁ bhavatāṁ yadūnāṁ
daivaṁ priyaḥ kula-patiḥ kva ca kiṅkaro vaḥ
astv evam aṅga bhagavān bhajatāṁ mukundo
muktiṁ dadāti karhicit sma na bhakti-yogam
devanagari: राजन्पतिर्गुरुरलं भवतां यदूनां दैवं प्रियः कुल - पतिः क्व च किङ्करो वः ।
अस्त्वेवमङ्ग भगवान्भजतां मुकुन्दो मुक्तिं ददाति कर्हिचित्स्म न भक्ति - योगम् ॥19॥
cc-adi-8.19.translation: "The great sage Nārada said, 'My dear Mahārāja Yudhiṣṭhira, the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa is always ready to help you. He is your master, guru, God, very dear friend and head of your family. Yet sometimes He agrees to act as your servant or order-carrier. You are greatly fortunate because this relationship is only possible by bhakti-yoga. The Lord can give liberation [mukti] very easily, but He does not give one bhakti-yoga, because by that process He is bound to the devotee.' "

devanagari: जय जय श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य गौरचन्द्र ।
जय जय परमानन्द जय नित्यानन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-8.2.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is known as Gaurasundara. I also offer my respectful obeisances unto Nityānanda Prabhu, who is always very joyful.

lines: hena prema śrī-caitanya dilā yathā tathā
devanagari: हेन प्रेम श्री - चैतन्य दिला यथा तथा ।
जगाइ माधाइ पर्यन्त - अन्येर का कथा ॥20॥
cc-adi-8.20.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has freely given this love of Kṛṣṇa everywhere and anywhere, even to the most fallen, such as Jagāi and Mādhāi. What then to speak of those who are already pious and elevated?

lines: bilāila yāre tāre, nā kaila vicāra
devanagari: स्वतन्त्र ईश्वर प्रेम - निगूढ़ - भाण्डार ।
बिलाइल यारे तारे, ना कैल विचार ॥21॥
cc-adi-8.21.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, as the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself, is fully independent. Therefore, although it is the most confidentially stored benediction, He can distribute love of Godhead to anyone and everyone without consideration.

devanagari: अद्यापिह देख चैतन्य - नाम येइ लय ।
कृष्ण - प्रेमे पुलकाश्रु - विह्वल से हय ॥22॥
cc-adi-8.22.translation: Whether he is offensive or inoffensive, anyone who even now chants śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya prabhu-nityānanda is immediately overwhelmed with ecstasy, and tears fill his eyes.

devanagari: ‘नित्यान न्द’ बलिते हय कृष्ण - प्रेमोदय ।
आउलाय सकल अङ्ग, अश्रु - गङ्गा वय ॥23॥
cc-adi-8.23.translation: Simply by talking of Nityānanda Prabhu one awakens his love for Kṛṣṇa. Thus all his bodily limbs are agitated by ecstasy, and tears flow from his eyes like the waters of the Ganges.

lines: kṛṣṇa balile aparādhīra nā haya vikāra
devanagari: ‘कृष्ण - नाम’ करे अपराधेर विचार ।
कृष्ण बलिले अपराधीर ना हय विकार ॥24॥
cc-adi-8.24.translation: There are offenses to be considered while chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra. Therefore simply by chanting Hare Kṛṣṇa one does not become ecstatic.

devanagari: तदश्म - सारं हृदयं बतेदं यद्गृह्यमाणैर्हरि - नामधेयैः ।
न विक्रियेताथ ग्रदा विकारो नेत्रे जलं गात्र - रुहेषु हर्षः ॥25॥
cc-adi-8.25.translation: "If one's heart does not change, tears do not flow from his eyes, his body does not shiver, nor his hairs stand on end as he chants the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, it should be understood that his heart is as hard as iron. This is due to his offenses at the lotus feet of the Lord's holy name."

devanagari: ‘एक’ कृष्ण - नामे करे सर्व - पाप नाश ।
प्रेमेर कारण भक्ति करेन प्रकाश ॥26॥
cc-adi-8.26.translation: Simply chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra without offenses vanquishes all sinful activities. Thus pure devotional service, which is the cause of love of Godhead, becomes manifest.

devanagari: प्रेमेर उदये हय प्रेमेर विकार ।
स्वेद - कम्प - पुलकादि गद्गदाश्रुधार ॥27॥
cc-adi-8.27.translation: When one's transcendental loving service to the Lord is actually awakened, it generates transformations in the body such as perspiration, trembling, throbbing of the heart, faltering of the voice and tears in the eyes.

lines: eka kṛṣṇa-nāmera phale pāi eta dhana
devanagari: अनायासे भव - क्षय, कृष्णेर सेवन ।
एक कृष्ण - नामेर फले पाइ एत धन ॥28॥
cc-adi-8.28.translation: As a result of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, one makes such great advancement in spiritual life that simultaneously his material existence terminates and he receives love of Godhead. The holy name of Kṛṣṇa is so powerful that by chanting even one name, one very easily achieves these transcendental riches.

lines: tabu yadi prema nahe, nahe aśrudhāra
devanagari: हेन कृष्ण - नाम यदि लय बहु - बार ।
तबु यदि प्रेम नहे, नहे अश्रुधार ॥29॥
cc-adi-8.29-30.translation: If one chants the exalted holy name of the Lord again and again and yet his love for the Supreme Lord does not develop and tears do not appear in his eyes, it is evident that because of his offenses in chanting, the seed of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa does not sprout.

devanagari: जय जयाद्वैत आचार्य कृपामय ।
जय जय गदाधर पण्डित महाशय ॥3॥
cc-adi-8.3.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Advaita Ācārya, who is very merciful, and also to that great personality Gadādhara Paṇḍita, the learned scholar.

lines: nāma laite prema dena, vahe aśrudhāra
devanagari: चैतन्य - नित्यानन्दे नाहि एसब विचार ।
नाम लेते प्रेम देन, वहे अश्रुधार ॥31॥
cc-adi-8.31.translation: But if one only chants, with some slight faith, the holy names of Lord Caitanya and Nityānanda, very quickly he is cleansed of all offenses. Thus as soon as he chants the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, he feels the ecstasy of love for God.

lines: tāṅre nā bhajile kabhu nā haya nistāra
devanagari: स्वतन्त्र ईश्वर प्रभु अत्यन्त उदार ।
ताँरे ना भजिले कभु ना हय निस्तार ॥32॥
cc-adi-8.32.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the independent Supreme Personality of Godhead, is greatly magnanimous. Unless one worships Him, one can never be liberated.

devanagari: ओरे मूढ़ लोक, शुन चैतन्य - मङ्गल ।
चैतन्य - महिमा य़ाते जानिबे सकल ॥33॥
cc-adi-8.33.translation: O fools, just read Caitanya-maṅgala! By reading this book you can understand all the glories of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: कृष्ण - लीला भागवते कहे वेद - व्यास ।
चैतन्य - लीलार व्यास वृन्दावन - दास ॥34॥
cc-adi-8.34.translation: As Vyāsadeva has compiled all the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa in Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, Ṭhākura Vṛndāvana dāsa has depicted the pastimes of Lord Caitanya.

devanagari: वृन्दावन - दास कैल ‘चैतन्य - मङ्गल’ ।
याँहार श्रवणे नाशे सर्व अमङ्गल ॥35॥
cc-adi-8.35.translation: Ṭhākura Vṛndāvana dāsa has composed Caitanya-maṅgala. Hearing this book will annihilate all misfortune.

devanagari: चैतन्य - निताइर य़ाते जानिये महिमा ।
याते जानि कृष्ण - भक्ति - सिद्धान्तेर सीमा ॥36॥
cc-adi-8.36.translation: By reading Caitanya-maṅgala one can understand all the glories or truths of Lord Caitanya and Nityānanda and come to the ultimate conclusion of devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: भागवते यत भक्ति - सिद्धान्तेर सार ।
लिखियाछेन इँहा जा नि’ करिया उद्धार ॥37॥
cc-adi-8.37.translation: In Caitanya-maṅgala [later known as Śrī Caitanya-bhāgavata] Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has given the conclusion and essence of devotional service by quoting the authoritative statements of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

devanagari: ‘चैतन्य - मङ्गल’ शुने यदि पाषण्डी, यवन ।
सेह महा - वैष्णव हय ततक्षण ॥38॥
cc-adi-8.38.translation: If even a great atheist hears Caitanya-maṅgala, he immediately becomes a great devotee.

lines: manuṣye racite nāre aiche grantha dhanya
devanagari: मनुष्ये रचिते नारे ऐछे ग्रन्थ धन्य ।
वृन्दावन - दास - मुखे वक्ता श्री - चैतन्य ॥39॥
cc-adi-8.39.translation: The subject matter of this book is so sublime that it appears that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has personally spoken through the writings of Śrī Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: जय जय श्रीवासादि ग्रत भक्त - गण ।
प्रणत हुइया वन्दों सबार चरण ॥4॥
cc-adi-8.4.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and all other devotees of the Lord. I fall down to offer them respect. I worship their lotus feet.

lines: aiche grantha kari' teṅho tārilā saṁsāra
devanagari: वृन्दावन - दास - पदे कोटि नमस्कार ।
ऐछे ग्रन्थ क रि’ तेंहो तारिला संसार ॥40॥
cc-adi-8.40.translation: I offer millions of obeisances unto the lotus feet of Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura. No one else could write such a wonderful book for the deliverance of all fallen souls.

devanagari: नारायणी - चैतन्येर उच्छि ष्ट - भाजन ।
ताँर ग र्भे जन्मिला श्री - दास - वृन्दावन ॥41॥
cc-adi-8.41.translation: Nārāyaṇī eternally eats the remnants of the foodstuffs of Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura was born of her womb.

devanagari: ताँर कि अद्भुत चैतन्य - चरित - वर्णन ।
याहार श्रवणे शुद्ध कैल त्रि - भुवन ॥42॥
cc-adi-8.42.translation: What a wonderful description he has given of the pastimes of Lord Caitanya! Anyone in the three worlds who hears it is purified.

devanagari: अतएव भज, लोक, चैतन्य - नित्यानन्द ।
खण्डिबे संसार - दुःख, पाबे प्रेमानन्द ॥43॥
cc-adi-8.43.translation: I fervently appeal to everyone to adopt the method of devotional service given by Lord Caitanya and Nityānanda and thus be freed from the miseries of material existence and ultimately achieve the loving service of the Lord.

devanagari: वृन्दावन - दास कैल ‘चैतन्य - मङ्गल’ ।
ताहाते चैतन्य - लीला वर्णिल सकल ॥44॥
cc-adi-8.44.translation: Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has written Caitanya-maṅgala and therein described in all respects the pastimes of Lord Caitanya.

lines: sūtra kari' saba līlā karila granthana
devanagari: सूत्र करि’ सब लीला करिल ग्रन्थ न ।
पाछे विस्तारिया ताहार कैल विवरण ॥45॥
cc-adi-8.45.translation: He first summarized all the pastimes of the Lord and later described them vividly in detail.

devanagari: चैतन्य - चन्द्रेर लीला अनन्त अपार ।
वर्णिते वर्णिते ग्रन्थ हइल विस्तार ॥46॥
cc-adi-8.46.translation: The pastimes of Lord Caitanya are unlimited and unfathomable. Therefore, in describing all those pastimes, the book became voluminous.

lines: vistāra dekhiyā kichu saṅkoca haila mana
sūtra-dhṛta kona līlā nā kaila varṇana
devanagari: विस्तार देखिया किछु सङ्कोच हैल मन ।
सूत्र - धृत कोन लीला ना कैल वर्णन ॥47॥
cc-adi-8.47.translation: He saw them to be so extensive that he later felt that some had not been properly described.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - लीला - वर्णने ह इल आवेश ।
चैतन्येर शेष - लीला रहिल अवशेष ॥48॥
cc-adi-8.48.translation: He ecstatically described the pastimes of Lord Nityānanda, but the later pastimes of Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained untold.

devanagari: सेइ सब लीलार शुनिते विवरण ।
वृन्दावन - वासी भक्तेर उत्कण्ठित मन ॥49॥
cc-adi-8.49.translation: The devotees of Vṛndāvana were all very anxious to hear those pastimes.

lines: paṅgu giri laṅghe, andha dekhe tārā-gaṇe
devanagari: मूक कवित्व करे याँ - सबार स्मरणे ।
पङ्गु गिरि लङ्घ, अन्ध देखे तारा - गणे ॥5॥
cc-adi-8.5.translation: By remembering the lotus feet of the Pañca-tattva, a dumb man can become a poet, a lame man can cross mountains, and a blind man can see the stars in the sky.

devanagari: वृन्दावने कल्प - द्रुमे सुवर्ण - सदन ।
महा - योगपीठ ताहाँ, रल - सिंहासन ॥50॥
cc-adi-8.50.translation: In Vṛndāvana, in a great place of pilgrimage underneath the desire trees, is a golden throne bedecked with jewels.

devanagari: ताते व सि’ आछे सदा व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ।
‘श्री - गोविन्द - देव’ नाम साक्षात्मदन ॥51॥
cc-adi-8.51.translation: On that throne sits the son of Nanda Mahārāja, Śrī Govindadeva, the transcendental Cupid.

devanagari: राज - सेवा हय ताँहा विचित्र प्रकार ।
दिव्य सामग्री, दिव्य वस्त्र, अलङ्कार ॥52॥
cc-adi-8.52.translation: Varieties of majestic service are rendered to Govinda there. His garments, ornaments and paraphernalia are all transcendental.

devanagari: सहस्त्र सेवक सेवा करे अनुक्षण ।
सहस्र - वदने सेवा ना याय वर्णन ॥53॥
cc-adi-8.53.translation: In that temple of Govindajī, thousands of servitors always render service to the Lord in devotion. Even with thousands of mouths, one could not describe this service.

devanagari: सेवार अध्यक्ष - श्री - पण्डित हरिदास ।
ताँर यशः - गुण सर्व - जगते प्रकाश ॥54॥
cc-adi-8.54.translation: In that temple the chief servitor was Śrī Haridāsa Paṇḍita. His qualities and fame are known all over the world.

devanagari: सुशील, सहिष्णु, शान्त, वदान्य, गम्भीर ।
मधुर - वचन, मधुर - चेष्टा, महा - धीर ॥55॥
cc-adi-8.55.translation: He was gentle, tolerant, peaceful, magnanimous, grave, sweet in his words and very sober in his endeavors.

devanagari: सबार सम्मान - कर्ता, करेन सबार हित ।
कौटिल्य - मात्सर्य - हिंसा ना जाने ताँर चित ॥56॥
cc-adi-8.56.translation: He was respectful to everyone and worked for the benefit of all. Diplomacy, envy and jealousy were unknown to his heart.

lines: se saba guṇera tāṅra śarīre nivāsa
devanagari: कृष्णेर ये साधारण सद्गुण पञ्चाश ।
से सब गुणेर ताँर शरीरे निवास ॥57॥
cc-adi-8.57.translation: The fifty qualities of Lord Kṛṣṇa were all present in his body.

devanagari: यस्यास्ति भक्तिभंगवत्यकिञ्चना सर्वैर्गुणैस्तत्र समासते सुराः ।
हरावभक्तस्य कुतो महद्गुणा मनोरथेनासति धावतो बहिः ॥58॥
cc-adi-8.58.translation: "In one who has unflinching devotional faith in Kṛṣṇa, all the good qualities of Kṛṣṇa and the demigods are consistently manifested. However, one who has no devotion to the Supreme Personality of Godhead has no good qualifications because he is engaged by mental concoction in material existence, which is the external feature of the Lord."

devanagari: पण्डित - गोसाञि र शिष्य - अनन्त आचार्य ।
कृष्ण - प्रेममय - तनु, उदार, सर्व - आग्न ॥59॥
cc-adi-8.59.translation: Ananta Ācārya was a disciple of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. His body was always absorbed in love of Godhead. He was magnanimous and advanced in all respects.

lines: e-saba nā māne yei paṇḍita sakala
devanagari: ए - सब ना माने येइ पण्डित सकल ।
ता - सबार विद्या - पाठ भेक - कोलाहल ॥6॥
cc-adi-8.6.translation: The education cultivated by so-called learned scholars who do not believe these statements of Caitanya-caritāmṛta is like the tumultuous croaking of frogs.

lines: tāṅhāra ananta guṇa ke karu prakāśa
devanagari: ताँहार अनन्त गुण के करु प्रकाश ।
ताँर प्रिय शिष्य इँह - पण्डित हरिदास ॥60॥
cc-adi-8.60.translation: Ananta Ācārya was a reservoir of all good qualities. No one can estimate how great he was. Paṇḍita Haridāsa was his beloved disciple.

devanagari: चैतन्य - नित्यानन्दे ताँर परम विश्वास ।
चैतन्य - चरिते ताँर परम उल्लास ॥61॥
cc-adi-8.61.translation: Paṇḍita Haridāsa had great faith in Lord Caitanya and Nityānanda. Therefore he took great satisfaction in knowing about Their pastimes and qualities.

devanagari: वैष्णवेर गुण - ग्राही, ना देखये दोष ।
काय - मनो - वाक्ये करे वैष्णव - सन्तोष ॥62॥
cc-adi-8.62.translation: He always accepted the good qualities of Vaiṣṇavas and never found fault in them. He engaged his heart and soul only to satisfy the Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: निरन्तर शुने तेंहो ‘चैतन्य - मङ्गल’ ।
ताँहार प्रसादे शुनेन वैष्णव - सकल ॥63॥
cc-adi-8.63.translation: He always heard the reading of Śrī Caitanya-maṅgala, and all the other Vaiṣṇavas used to hear it by his grace.

lines: kathāya sabhā ujjvala kare yena pūrṇa-candra
devanagari: कथाय सभा उज्वल करे येन पूर्ण - चन्द्र ।
निज - गुणामृते बाड़ाय वैष्णव - आनन्द ॥64॥
cc-adi-8.64.translation: Like the full moon, he illuminated the entire assembly of the Vaiṣṇavas by speaking Caitanya-maṅgala, and by the nectar of his qualities he increased their transcendental bliss.

lines: teṅho ati kṛpā kari' ājñā kailā more
devanagari: तेंहो अति कृपा करि’ आज्ञा कैला मोरे ।
गौराङ्गेर शेष - लीला वर्णिबार तरे ॥65॥
cc-adi-8.65.translation: By his causeless mercy he ordered me to write about the last pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: काशीश्वर गोसाञि र शिष्य - गोविन्द गोसाञि ।
गोविन्देर प्रिय - सेवक ताँर सम नाञि ॥66॥
cc-adi-8.66.translation: Govinda Gosāñi, the priest engaged in the service of Lord Govinda in Vṛndāvana, was a disciple of Kāśīśvara Gosāñi. There was no servant more dear to the Govinda Deity.

devanagari: यादवाचार्य गोसाञि श्री - रूपेर सङ्गी ।
चैतन्य - चरिते तेंहो अति बड़ रङ्गी ॥67॥
cc-adi-8.67.translation: Śrī Yādavācārya Gosāñi, a constant associate of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, was also very enthusiastic in hearing and chanting about Lord Caitanya's pastimes.

lines: gaura-kathā vinā āra mukhe anya nāi
devanagari: पण्डित - गोसाञि र शिष्य - भुगर्भ गोसाञि ।
गौर - कथा विना आर मुखे अन्य नाइ ॥68॥
cc-adi-8.68.translation: Bhugarbha Gosāñi, a disciple of Paṇḍita Gosāñi, was always engaged in topics regarding Lord Caitanya, knowing nothing else.

devanagari: ताँर शिष्य - गोविन्द पूजक चैतन्य - दास ।
मुकुन्दानन्द चक्रवर्ती, प्रेमी कृष्णदास ॥69॥
cc-adi-8.69.translation: Among his disciples were Caitanya dāsa, who was a priest of the Govinda Deity, as well as Mukundānanda Cakravartī and the great devotee Kṛṣṇadāsa.

lines: ei saba nā māne yebā kare kṛṣṇa-bhakti
kṛṣṇa-kṛpā nāhi tāre, nāhi tāra gati
devanagari: एइ सब ना माने येबा करे कृष्ण - भक्ति ।
कृष्ण - कृपा नाहि तारे, नाहि तार गति ॥7॥
cc-adi-8.7.translation: One who does not accept the glories of the Pañca-tattva but still makes a show of devotional service to Kṛṣṇa can never achieve the mercy of Kṛṣṇa nor advance to the ultimate goal.

devanagari: आचार्य - गोसाञि र शिष्य - चक्रवर्ती शिवानन्द ।
निरवधि ताँर चित्ते चैतन्य - नित्यानन्द ॥70॥
cc-adi-8.70.translation: Among the disciples of Ananta Ācārya was Śivānanda Cakravartī, in whose heart dwelled constantly Lord Caitanya and Nityānanda.

devanagari: आर यत वृन्दावने बैसे भक्त - गण ।
शेष - लीला शुनिते सबार हैल मन ॥71॥
cc-adi-8.71.translation: In Vṛndāvana there were also many other great devotees, all of whom desired to hear the last pastimes of Lord Caitanya.

lines: more ājñā karilā sabe karuṇā kariyā
devanagari: मोरे आज्ञा करिला सबे करुणा करिया ।
ताँ - सबार बोले लिखि निर्लज्ज हड्या ॥72॥
cc-adi-8.72.translation: By their mercy, all these devotees ordered me to write of the last pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Because of their order only, although I am shameless, I have attempted to write this Caitanya-caritāmṛta.

devanagari: वैष्णवेर आज्ञा पाञा चिन्तित - अन्तरे ।
मदन - गोपाले गेलाँ आज्ञा मागिबारे ॥73॥
cc-adi-8.73.translation: Having received the order of the Vaiṣṇavas but being anxious within my heart, I went to the temple of Madana-mohana in Vṛndāvana to ask His permission also.

devanagari: दरशन करि कैलुँ चरण वन्दन ।
गोसाञि - दास पूजारी करे चरण - सेवन ॥74॥
cc-adi-8.74.translation: When I visited the temple of Madana-mohana, the priest Gosāñi dāsa was serving the feet of the Lord, and I also prayed at the Lord's lotus feet.

devanagari: प्रभुर चरणे यदि आज्ञा मागिल ।
प्रभु - कण्ठ हैते माला खसिया पड़िल ॥75॥
cc-adi-8.75.translation: When I prayed to the Lord for permission, a garland from His neck immediately slipped down.

lines: gosāñi-dāsa āni' mālā mora gale dila
devanagari: सब वैष्णव - गण हरि - ध्वनि दिल ।
गोसाञि - दास आ नि’ माला मोर गले दिल ॥76॥
cc-adi-8.76.translation: As soon as this happened, the Vaiṣṇavas standing there all loudly chanted, "Haribol!" and the priest, Gosāñi dāsa, brought me the garland and put it around my neck.

devanagari: आज्ञा - माला पाञा आमार हुइल आनन्द ।
ताहाङिकरिनु एइ ग्रन्थेर आरम्भ ॥77॥
cc-adi-8.77.translation: I was greatly pleased to have the garland signifying the order of the Lord, and then and there I commenced to write this book.

devanagari: एइ ग्रन्थ लेखाय मोरे ‘मदन - मोहन’ ।
आमार लिखन येन शुकेर पठन ॥78॥
cc-adi-8.78.translation: Actually Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta is not my writing but the dictation of Śrī Madana-mohana. My writing is like the repetition of a parrot.

devanagari: सेइ लिखि, मदन - गोपाल ये लिखाय ।
काष्ठेर पुत्तली येन कुहके नाचाय ॥79॥
cc-adi-8.79.translation: As a wooden doll is made to dance by a magician, I write as Madana-gopāla orders me to do so.

devanagari: पूर्वे यैछे जरासन्ध - आदि राज - गण ।
वेद - धर्म क रि’ करे विष्णुर पूजन ॥8॥
cc-adi-8.8.translation: Formerly kings like Jarāsandha [the father-in-law of Kaṁsa] strictly followed the Vedic rituals, thus worshiping Lord Viṣṇu.

devanagari: कुलाधिदेवता मोर - मदन - मोहन ।
याँर सेवक - रघुनाथ, रूप, सनातन ॥80॥
cc-adi-8.80.translation: I accept as my family Deity Madana-mohana, whose worshipers are Raghunātha dāsa, Śrī Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmīs.

lines: tāṅra ājñā lañā likhi yāhāte kalyāṇa
devanagari: वृन्दावन - दासेर पाद - पद्म क रि’ ध्यान ।
ताँर आज्ञा लञा लिखि याहाते कल्याण ॥81॥
cc-adi-8.81.translation: I took permission from Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura by praying at his lotus feet, and upon receiving his order I have attempted to write this auspicious literature.

lines: tāṅra kṛpā vinā anye nā haya prakāśa
devanagari: चैतन्य - लीलाते ‘व्यास’ वृन्दावन - दास ।
ताँर कृपा विना अन्ये ना हय प्रकाश ॥82॥
cc-adi-8.82.translation: Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura is the authorized writer on the pastimes of Lord Caitanya. Without his mercy, therefore, one cannot describe these pastimes.

devanagari: मूर्ख, नीच, क्षुद्र मुञि विषय - लालस ।
वैष्णवाज्ञा - बले करि एतेक साहस ॥83॥
cc-adi-8.83.translation: I am foolish, lowborn and insignificant, and I always desire material enjoyment; yet by the order of the Vaiṣṇavas I am greatly enthusiastic to write this transcendental literature.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - चरणेर एइ बल ।
याँर स्मृते सिद्ध हय वाञ्छित - सकल ॥84॥
cc-adi-8.84.translation: The lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī are my source of strength. Remembering their lotus feet can fulfill all one's desires.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥85॥
cc-adi-8.85.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: kṛṣṇa nāhi māne, tāte daitya kari' māni
caitanya nā mānile taiche daitya tāre jāni
devanagari: कृष्ण नाहि माने, ताते दैत्य क रि’ मानि ।
चैतन्य ना मानिले तैछे दैत्य तारे जानि ॥9॥
cc-adi-8.9.translation: One who does not accept Kṛṣṇa as the Supreme Personality of Godhead is certainly a demon. Similarly, anyone who does not accept Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as Kṛṣṇa, the same Supreme Lord, is also to be considered a demon.

devanagari: तं श्रीमत्कृष्ण - चैतन्य - देवं वन्दे जगद्गुरुम् ।
यस्यानुकम्पया श्वापि महाब्धि सन्तरेत्सुखम् ॥1॥
cc-adi-9.1.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto the spiritual master of the entire world, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, by whose mercy even a dog can swim across a great ocean.

devanagari: जय श्री माधवपुरी कृष्ण - प्रेम - पूर ।
भक्ति - कल्पतरुर तेंहो प्रथम अङ्कुर ॥10॥
cc-adi-9.10.translation: All glories to Śrī Mādhavendra Purī, the storehouse of all devotional service unto Kṛṣṇa! He is a desire tree of devotional service, and it is in him that the seed of devotional service first fructified.

devanagari: श्री - ईश्वरपुरी - रूपे अङ्कर पुष्ट हैल ।
आपने चैतन्य - माली स्कन्ध उपजिल ॥11॥
cc-adi-9.11.translation: The seed of devotional service next fructified in the form of Śrī Īśvara Purī, and then the gardener Himself, Caitanya Mahāprabhu, became the main trunk of the tree of devotional service.

devanagari: निजाचिन्त्य - शक्त्ये माली ह ञा स्कन्ध हय ।
सकल शाखार सेइ स्कन्ध मूलाश्रय ॥12॥
cc-adi-9.12.translation: By His inconceivable powers, the Lord became the gardener, the trunk and the branches simultaneously.

devanagari: परमानन्द पुरी, आर केशव भारती ।
ब्रह्मानन्द पुरी, आर ब्रह्मानन्द भारती ॥13॥
cc-adi-9.13-15.translation: Paramānanda Purī, Keśava Bhāratī, Brahmānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī, Śrī Viṣṇu Purī, Keśava Purī, Kṛṣṇānanda Purī, Śrī Nṛsiṁha Tīrtha and Sukhānanda Purī—these nine sannyāsī roots all sprouted from the trunk of the tree. Thus the tree stood steadfastly on the strength of these nine roots.

lines: aṣṭa dike aṣṭa mūla vṛkṣa kaila sthira
devanagari: मध्य - मूल परमानन्द पुरी महा - धीर ।
अष्ट दिके अष्ट मूल वृक्ष कैल स्थिर ॥16॥
cc-adi-9.16.translation: With the sober and grave Paramānanda Purī as the central root and the other eight roots in the eight directions, the tree of Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood firmly.

devanagari: स्कन्धेर उपरे बहु शाखा उपजिल ।
उपरि उपरि शाखा असङ्ख्य हइल ॥17॥
cc-adi-9.17.translation: From the trunk grew many branches and above them innumerable others.

lines: viśa viśa śākhā kari' eka eka maṇḍala
devanagari: विश विश शाखा क रि’ एक एक मण्डल ।
महा - महा - शाखा छाइल ब्रह्माण्ड सकल ॥18॥
cc-adi-9.18.translation: Thus the branches of the Caitanya tree formed a cluster or society, with great branches covering all the universe.

lines: yata upajila śākhā ke gaṇibe kata
devanagari: एकैक शाखाते उपशाखा शत शत ।
यत उपजिल शाखा के गणिबे कत ॥19॥
cc-adi-9.19.translation: From each branch grew many hundreds of sub-branches. No one can count how many branches thus grew.

devanagari: जय ज य श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य गौरचन्द्र ।
जय जयाद्वैत जय जय नित्यानन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-9.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, who is known as Gaurahari! All glories to Advaita and Nityānanda Prabhu!

lines: āge ta' kariba, śuna vṛkṣera varṇana
devanagari: मुख्य मुख्य शाखा - गणेर नाम अगणन ।
आगे त’ करिब, शुन वृक्षेर वर्णन ॥20॥
cc-adi-9.20.translation: I shall try to name the foremost of the innumerable branches. Please hear the description of the Caitanya tree.

lines: vṛkṣera upare śākhā haila dui skandha
devanagari: वृक्षेर उपरे शाखा हैल दुइ स्कन्ध ।
एक ‘अद्वैत’ नाम, आर ‘नित्यान न्द’ ॥21॥
cc-adi-9.21.translation: At the top of the tree the trunk branched into two. One trunk was named Śrī Advaita Prabhu and the other Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu.

devanagari: सेइ दुइ - स्कन्धे बहु शाखा उपजिल ।
तार उपशाखा - गणे जगत्छाइल ॥22॥
cc-adi-9.22.translation: From these two trunks grew many branches and sub-branches that covered the entire world.

lines: yata upajila tāra ke karibe lekhā
devanagari: बड़ शाखा, उपशाखा, तार उपशाखा ।
यत उपजिल तार के करिबे लेखा ॥23॥
cc-adi-9.23.translation: These branches and sub-branches and their sub-branches became so numerous that no one can actually write about them.

devanagari: शिष्य, प्रशिष्य, आर उपशिष्य - गण ।
जगत्व्यापिल तार नाहिक गणन ॥24॥
cc-adi-9.24.translation: Thus the disciples and the granddisciples and their admirers spread throughout the entire world, and it is not possible to enumerate them all.

lines: ei mata bhakti-vṛkṣe sarvatra phala lāge
devanagari: उड़म्बर - वृक्ष येन फले सर्व अङ्गे ।
एइ मत भक्ति - वृक्षे सर्वत्र फल लागे ॥25॥
cc-adi-9.25.translation: As a big fig tree bears fruits all over its body, each part of the tree of devotional service bore fruit.

devanagari: मूल - स्कन्धेर शाखा आ र उपशाखा - गणे ।
लागिला ये प्रेम - फल, - अमृतके जिने ॥26॥
cc-adi-9.26.translation: Since Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu was the original trunk, the taste of the fruits that grew on the branches and sub-branches surpassed the taste of nectar.

devanagari: पाकिल ये प्रेम - फल अमृत - मधुर ।
विलाय चैतन्य - माली, नाहि लय मूल ॥27॥
cc-adi-9.27.translation: The fruits ripened and became sweet and nectarean. The gardener, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, distributed them without asking any price.

lines: eka-phalera mūlya kari' tāhā nāhi gaṇi
devanagari: त्रि - जगते यत आछे धन - रत्नमणि ।
एक - फलेर मूल्य करि’ ताहा नाहि गणि ॥28॥
cc-adi-9.28.translation: All the wealth in the three worlds cannot equal the value of one such nectarean fruit of devotional service.

lines: māge vā nā māge keha, pātra vā apātra
ihāra vicāra nāhi jāne, deya mātra
devanagari: मागे वा ना मागे केह, पात्र वा अपात्र ।
इहार विचार नाहि जाने, देय मात्र ॥29॥
cc-adi-9.29.translation: Not considering who asked for it and who did not, nor who was fit and who unfit to receive it, Caitanya Mahāprabhu distributed the fruit of devotional service.

devanagari: जय जय श्रीवासादि गौर - भक्त - गण ।
सर्वाभीष्ट - पूर्ति - हेतु याँहार स्मरण ॥3॥
cc-adi-9.3.translation: All glories to the devotees of Lord Caitanya, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura! In order to fulfill all my desires, I remember their lotus feet.

devanagari: अञ्जलि अञ्जलि भ रि’ फेले चतुर्दिशे ।
दरिद्र कुड़ाञा खाय, मालाकार हासे ॥30॥
cc-adi-9.30.translation: The transcendental gardener, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, distributed handful after handful of fruit in all directions, and when the poor hungry people ate the fruit, the gardener smiled with great pleasure.

devanagari: मालाकार कहे , - शुन, वृक्ष - परिवार ।
मूलशाखा - उपशाखा यतेक प्रकार ॥31॥
cc-adi-9.31.translation: Lord Caitanya thus addressed the multifarious varieties of branches and sub-branches of the tree of devotional service:

devanagari: अलौकिक वृक्ष करे सर्वेन्द्रिय - कर्म ।
स्थावर हइया धरे जङ्गमेर धर्म ॥32॥
cc-adi-9.32.translation: "Since the tree of devotional service is transcendental, every one of its parts can perform the action of all the others. Although a tree is supposed to be immovable, this tree nevertheless moves.

lines: e vṛkṣera aṅga haya saba sa-cetana
devanagari: ए वृक्षेर अङ्ग हय सब सचेतन ।
बाड़िया व्यापिल सबे सकल भुवन ॥33॥
cc-adi-9.33.translation: "All the parts of this tree are spiritually cognizant, and thus as they grow up they spread all over the world.

lines: ekalā mālākāra āmi kāhāṅ kāhāṅ yāba
ekalā vā kata phala pāḍiyā vilāba
devanagari: एकला मालाकार आमि काहाँ काहाँ याब ।
एकला वा कत फल पाड़िया विलाब ॥34॥
cc-adi-9.34.translation: "I am the only gardener. How many places can I go? How many fruits can I pick and distribute?

lines: keha pāya, keha nā pāya, rahe mane bhrama
devanagari: एकला उठा ञा दिते हय परि श्रम ।
केह पाय, केह ना पाय, रहे मने भ्रम ॥35॥
cc-adi-9.35.translation: "It would certainly be a very laborious task to pick the fruits and distribute them alone, and still I suspect that some would receive them and others would not.

lines: yāhāṅ tāhāṅ prema-phala deha' yāre tāre
devanagari: अतएव आमि आज्ञा दि लुँ सबकारे ।
याहाँ ताहाँ प्रेम - फल दे ह’ यारे तारे ॥36॥
cc-adi-9.36.translation: "Therefore I order every man within this universe to accept this Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement and distribute it everywhere.

lines: ekalā mālākāra āmi kata phala khāba
nā diyā vā ei phala āra ki kariba
devanagari: एकला मालाकार आमि कत फल खाब ।
ना दिया वा एइ फल आर कि करिब ॥37॥
cc-adi-9.37.translation: "I am the only gardener. If I do not distribute these fruits, what shall I do with them? How many fruits can I alone eat?

devanagari: आत्म - इच्छामृते वृक्ष सिञ्चि निरन्तर ।
ताहाते असङ्ख्य फल वृक्षेर उपर ॥38॥
cc-adi-9.38.translation: "By the transcendental desire of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, water has been sprinkled all over the tree, and thus there are innumerable fruits of love of Godhead.

lines: ataeva saba phala deha' yāre tāre
devanagari: अतएव सब फल दे ह’ यारे तारे ।
खाइया हउक् लोक अजर अमरे ॥39॥
cc-adi-9.39.translation: "Distribute this Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement all over the world. Let people eat these fruits and ultimately become free from old age and death.

devanagari: श्री - रूप, सनातन, भट्ट रघुनाथ ।
श्री - जीव, गोपाल - भट्ट, दास - रघुनाथ ॥4॥
cc-adi-9.4.translation: I also remember the six Gosvāmīs-Rūpa, Sanātana, Bhaṭṭa Raghunātha, Śrī Jīva, Gopāla Bhaṭṭa and Dāsa Raghunātha.

lines: jagat vyāpiyā mora habe puṇya khyāti
sukhī ha-iyā loka mora gāhibeka kīrti
devanagari: जगत्व्या पिया मोर हबे पुण्य ख्याति ।
सुखी हइया लोक मोर गाहिबेक कीर्ति ॥40॥
cc-adi-9.40.translation: "If the fruits are distributed all over the world, My reputation as a pious man will be known everywhere, and thus all people will glorify My name with great pleasure.

devanagari: भारत - भूमिते हैल मनुष्य जन्म यार ।
जन्म सार्थक क रि’ कर पर - उपकार ॥41॥
cc-adi-9.41.translation: "One who has taken his birth as a human being in the land of India [Bhārata-varṣa] should make his life successful and work for the benefit of all other people.

devanagari: एतावजन्म - साफल्यं देहिनामिह देहिषु ।
प्राणैरधिया वाचा श्रेय - आचरणं सदा ॥42॥
cc-adi-9.42.translation: "It is the duty of every living being to perform welfare activities for the benefit of others with his life, wealth, intelligence and words."

devanagari: प्राणिनामुपकाराय यदेवेह परत्र च ।
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा तदेव मति - मान्भजेत् ॥43॥
cc-adi-9.43.translation: “ 'By his work, thoughts and words, an intelligent man must perform actions which will be beneficial for all living entities in this life and in the next.'

devanagari: माली मनुष्य आमार नाहि राज्य - धन ।
फल - फुल दिया करि’ पुण्य उपार्जन ॥44॥
cc-adi-9.44.translation: "I am merely a gardener. I have neither a kingdom nor very great riches. I simply have some fruits and flowers that I wish to utilize to achieve piety in My life.

lines: mālī hañā vṛkṣa ha-ilāṅ ei ta' icchāte
devanagari: माली ह ञा वृक्ष हइलाँ एइ त’ इच्छाते ।
सर्व - प्राणीर उपकार हय वृक्ष हैते ॥45॥
cc-adi-9.45.translation: "Although I am acting as a gardener, I also want to be the tree, for thus I can bestow benefit upon all.

devanagari: अहो एषां वरं जन्म सर्व - प्राण्युपजीविनाम् ।
सु - जनस्येव येषां वै विमुखा यान्ति नार्थिनः ॥46॥
cc-adi-9.46.translation: “ 'Just see how these trees are maintaining every living entity! Their birth is successful. Their behavior is just like that of great personalities, for anyone who asks anything from a tree never goes away disappointed.' "

devanagari: एइ आज्ञा कैल यदि चैतन्य - मालाकार ।
परम आनन्द पाइल वृक्ष - परिवार ॥47॥
cc-adi-9.47.translation: The descendants of the tree [the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu] were very glad to receive this order directly from the Lord.

lines: yei yāhāṅ tāhāṅ dāna kare prema-phala
devanagari: येइ याहाँ ताहाँ दान करे प्रेम - फल ।
फलास्वादे मत्त लोक हइल सकल ॥48॥
cc-adi-9.48.translation: The fruit of love of God is so tasteful that wherever a devotee distributes it, those who relish the fruit, anywhere in the world, immediately become intoxicated.

devanagari: महा - मादक प्रेम - फल पेट भ रि’ खाय ।
मातिल सकल लोक - हासे, नाचे, गाय ॥49॥
cc-adi-9.49.translation: The fruit of love of Godhead distributed by Caitanya Mahāprabhu is such a great intoxicant that anyone who eats it, filling his belly, immediately becomes maddened by it, and automatically he chants, dances, laughs and enjoys.

lines: jāni vā nā jāni, kari āpana-śodhana
devanagari: एसब - प्रसादे लिखि चैतन्य - लीला - गुण ।
जानि वा ना जानि, करि आपन - शोधन ॥5॥
cc-adi-9.5.translation: It is by the mercy of all these Vaiṣṇavas and gurus that I attempt to write about the pastimes and qualities of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Whether I know or know not, it is for self-purification that I write this book.

lines: keha gaḍāgaḍi yāya, keha ta' huṅkāra
devanagari: केह गड़ागड़ि याय, केह त’ हुङ्कार ।
देखि’ आनन्दित ह ञा हासे मालाकार ॥50॥
cc-adi-9.50.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the great gardener, sees that people are chanting, dancing and laughing and that some of them are rolling on the floor and some are making loud humming sounds, He smiles with great pleasure.

devanagari: एइ मालाकार खाय एइ प्रेम - फल ।
निरवधि मत्त रहे, विवश - विह्वल ॥51॥
cc-adi-9.51.translation: The great gardener, Lord Caitanya, personally eats this fruit, and as a result He constantly remains mad, as if helpless and bewildered.

lines: preme matta loka vinā nāhi dekhi āna
devanagari: सर्व - लोके मत्त कैला आपन - समान ।
प्रेमे मत्त लोक विना नाहि देखि आन ॥52॥
cc-adi-9.52.translation: With His saṅkīrtana movement the Lord made everyone mad like Himself. We do not find anyone who was not intoxicated by His saṅkīrtana movement.

lines: ye ye pūrve nindā kaila, bali' mātoyāla
seho phala khāya, nāce, bale—bhāla bhāla
devanagari: ये ये पूर्वे निन्दा कैल, बलि’ मातोयाल ।
सेहो फल खाय, नाचे, बले - भाल भाल ॥53॥
cc-adi-9.53.translation: Persons who had formerly criticized Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, calling Him a drunkard, also ate the fruit and began to dance, saying, "Very good! Very good!"

lines: ebe śuna, phala-dātā ye ye śākhā-gaṇa
devanagari: एइ त कहिलँ प्रेम - फल - वितरण ।
एबे शुन, फल - दाता ये ये शाखा - गण ॥54॥
cc-adi-9.54.translation: After describing the Lord's distribution of the fruit of love of Godhead, I now wish to describe the different branches of the tree of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥55॥
cc-adi-9.55.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: माला - कारः स्वयं कृष्ण - प्रेमामर - तरुः स्वयम् ।
दाता भोक्ता तत्फलानां यस्तं चैतन्यमाश्रये ॥6॥
cc-adi-9.6.translation: I take shelter of the Supreme Personality of Godhead Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who Himself is the tree of transcendental love of Kṛṣṇa, its gardener and also the bestower and enjoyer of its fruits.

lines: nāma sārthaka haya, yadi preme viśva bhari
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, आमि ‘विश्वम्भर’ नाम धरि ।
नाम सार्थक हय, यदि प्रेमे विश्व भरि ॥7॥
cc-adi-9.7.translation: Lord Caitanya thought, "My name is Viśvambhara, 'one who maintains the entire universe.' Its meaning will be actualized if I can fill the whole universe with love of Godhead."

devanagari: एत चि न्ति’ लैला प्रभु मालाकार - धर्म ।
नवद्वीपे आरम्भिला फलोद्यान - कर्म ॥8॥
cc-adi-9.8.translation: Thinking in this way, He accepted the duty of a planter and began to grow a garden in Navadvīpa.

devanagari: श्री - चैतन्य मालाकार पृथिवीते आनि’ ।
भक्ति - कल्पतरु रोपिला सिञ्चि’ इच्छा - पानि ॥9॥
cc-adi-9.9.translation: Thus the Lord brought the desire tree of devotional service to this earth and became its gardener. He sowed the seed and sprinkled upon it the water of His will.

devanagari: श्री - चैतन्य - पदाम्भोज - मधुपेभ्यो नमो नमः ।
कथञ्चिदाश्रयाद् येषां श्वापि तद्गन्ध - भाग्भवेत् ॥1॥
cc-adi-10.1.translation: Let me repeatedly offer my respectful obeisances unto the beelike devotees who always taste the honey of the lotus feet of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. If even a doggish nondevotee somehow takes shelter of such devotees, he enjoys the aroma of the lotus flower.

devanagari: दुइ शाखार उपशाखाय ताँ - सबार गणन ।
याँर गृहे महाप्रभुर सदा सङ्कीर्तन ॥10॥
cc-adi-10.10.translation: There is no counting the sub-branches of these two branches. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu held congregational chanting daily at the house of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita.

devanagari: रात्रि - दिने राधा - कृष्णेर मानस सेवन ।
प्रहरेक महाप्रभुर चरित्र - कथन ॥100॥
cc-adi-10.100.translation: Day and night he rendered service within his mind to Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, and for three hours a day he discoursed about the character of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: तिन सन्ध्या राधा - कुण्डे अपतित स्नान ।
व्रज - वासी वैष्णवे करे आलिङ्गन मान ॥101॥
cc-adi-10.101.translation: Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī took three baths daily in the Rādhā-kuṇḍa lake. As soon as he found a Vaiṣṇava residing in Vṛndāvana, he would embrace him and give him all respect.

lines: cāri daṇḍa nidrā, seha nahe kona-dine
devanagari: सार्ध सप्त - प्रहर करे भक्तिर साधने ।
चारि दण्ड निद्रा, सेह नहे कोन - दिने ॥102॥
cc-adi-10.102.translation: He engaged himself in devotional service for more than twenty-two and a half hours a day, and for less than two hours he slept, although on some days that also was not possible.

devanagari: ताँहार साधन - रीति शुनिते चमत्कार ।
सेइ रूप - रघुनाथ प्रभु ये आमार ॥103॥
cc-adi-10.103.translation: I am struck with wonder when I hear about the devotional service he executed. I accept Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī as my guides.

devanagari: इँहा - सबार यैछे हैल प्रभुर मिलन ।
आगे विस्तारिया ताहा करिब वर्णन ॥104॥
cc-adi-10.104.translation: I shall later explain very elaborately how all these devotees met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - गोपाल भट्ट एक शाखा सर्वोत्तम ।
रूप - सनातन - सङ्गे याँर प्रेम - आलापन ॥105॥
cc-adi-10.105.translation: Śrī Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, the forty-seventh branch, was one of the great and exalted branches of the tree. He always engaged in discourses about love of Godhead in the company of Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī.

devanagari: शङ्करारण्य - आचार्य - वृक्षेर एक शाखा ।
मुकुन्द, काशीनाथ, रुद्र - उपशाखा लेखा ॥106॥
cc-adi-10.106.translation: The ācārya Śaṅkarāraṇya was considered the forty-eighth branch of the original tree. From him proceeded sub-branches known as Mukunda, Kāśīnātha and Rudra.

devanagari: श्रीनाथ पण्डित - प्रभुर कृपार भाजन ।
याँर कृष्ण - सेवा दे खि’ वश त्रि - भुवन ॥107॥
cc-adi-10.107.translation: Śrīnātha Paṇḍita, the forty-ninth branch, was the beloved recipient of all the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Everyone in the three worlds was astonished to see how he worshiped Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: जगन्नाथ आचार्य प्रभुर प्रिय दास ।
प्रभुर आज्ञाते तेंहो कैल गङ्गा - वास ॥108॥
cc-adi-10.108.translation: Jagannātha Ācārya, the fiftieth branch of the Caitanya tree, was an extremely dear servant of the Lord, by whose order he decided to live on the bank of the Ganges.

devanagari: कृष्णदास वैद्य, आर पण्डित - शेखर ।
कविचन्द्र, आर कीर्तनीया षष्ठीवर ॥109॥
cc-adi-10.109.translation: The fifty-first branch of the Caitanya tree was Kṛṣṇadāsa Vaidya, the fifty-second was Paṇḍita Śekhara, the fifty-third was Kavicandra, and the fifty-fourth was Ṣaṣṭhīvara, who was a great saṅkīrtana performer.

lines: cāri bhāi sa-vaṁśe kare caitanyera sevā
devanagari: चारि भाइ सवंशे करे चैतन्येर सेवा ।
गौरचन्द्र विना नाहि जाने देवी - देवा ॥11॥
cc-adi-10.11.translation: These four brothers and their family members fully engaged in the service of Lord Caitanya. They knew no other god or goddess.

devanagari: श्रीनाथ मिश्र, शुभानन्द, श्रीराम, ईशान ।
श्रीनिधि, श्रीगोपीकान्त, मिश्र भगवान् ॥110॥
cc-adi-10.110.translation: The fifty-fifth branch was Śrīnātha Miśra, the fifty-sixth was Śubhānanda, the fifty-seventh was Śrīrāma, the fifty-eighth was Īśāna, the fifty-ninth was Śrīnidhi, the sixtieth was Śrī Gopīkānta, and the sixty-first was Miśra Bhagavān.

devanagari: सुबुद्धि मिश्र, हृदयानन्द, कमल - नयन ।
महेश पण्डित, श्रीकर, श्री - मधुसूदन ॥111॥
cc-adi-10.111.translation: The sixty-second branch of the tree was Subuddhi Miśra, the sixty-third was Hṛdayānanda, the sixty-fourth is Kamala-nayana, the sixty-fifth was Maheśa Paṇḍita, the sixty-sixth was Śrīkara, and the sixty-seventh was Śrī Madhusūdana.

devanagari: पुरुषोत्तम, श्री - गालीम, जगन्नाथ - दास ।
श्री चन्द्रशेखर वैद्य, द्विज हरिदास ॥112॥
cc-adi-10.112.translation: The sixty-eighth branch of the original tree was Puruṣottama, the sixty-ninth was Śrī Gālīma, the seventieth was Jagannātha dāsa, the seventy-first was Śrī Candraśekhara Vaidya, and the seventy-second was Dvija Haridāsa.

devanagari: रामदास, कविचन्द्र, श्री - गोपालदास ।
भागवताचार्य, ठाकुर सारङ्गदास ॥113॥
cc-adi-10.113.translation: The seventy-third branch of the original tree was Rāmadāsa, the seventy-fourth was Kavicandra, the seventy-fifth was Śrī Gopāla dāsa, the seventy-sixth was Bhāgavatācārya, and the seventy-seventh was Ṭhākura Sāraṅga dāsa.

devanagari: जगन्नाथ तीर्थ, विप्र श्री - जानकीनाथ ।
गोपाल आचार्य, आर विप्र वाणीनाथ ॥114॥
cc-adi-10.114.translation: The seventy-eighth branch of the original tree was Jagannātha Tīrtha, the seventy-ninth was the brāhmaṇa Śrī Jānakīnātha, the eightieth was Gopāla Ācārya, and the eighty-first was the brāhmaṇa Vāṇīnātha.

devanagari: गोविन्द, माधव, वासुदेव - तिन भाइ ।
याँ - सबार कीर्तने नाचे चैतन्य - निताई ॥115॥
cc-adi-10.115.translation: The three brothers Govinda, Mādhava and Vāsudeva were the eighty-second, eighty-third and eighty-fourth branches of the tree. Lord Caitanya and Nityānanda used to dance in their kīrtana performances.

lines: ṣolasāṅgera kāṣṭha tuli' ye karila vāṅśī
devanagari: रामदास अभिराम - सख्य - प्रेमराशि ।
षोलसाङ्गेर काष्ठ तुलि’ ये करिल वाँशी ॥116॥
cc-adi-10.116.translation: Rāmadāsa Abhirāma was fully absorbed in the mellow of friendship. He made a flute of a bamboo stick with sixteen knots.

devanagari: प्रभुर आज्ञाय नित्यानन्द गौड़े चलिला ।
ताँर सङ्गे तिन - जन प्रभु - आज्ञाय आइला ॥117॥
cc-adi-10.117.translation: By the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, three devotees accompanied Lord Nityānanda Prabhu when He returned to Bengal to preach.

devanagari: रामदास, माधव, आर वासुदेव घोष ।
प्रभु - सङ्गे रहे गोविन्द पाइया सन्तोष ॥118॥
cc-adi-10.118.translation: These three were Rāmadāsa, Mādhava and Vāsudeva Ghoṣa. Govinda Ghoṣa, however, remained with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī and thus felt great satisfaction.

devanagari: भागवताचार्य, चिरञ्जीव श्री - रघुनन्दन ।
माधवाचार्य, कमलाकान्त, श्री - ग्रदुनन्दन ॥119॥
cc-adi-10.119.translation: Bhāgavatācārya, Cirañjīva, Śrī Raghunandana, Mādhavācārya, Kamalākānta and Śrī Yadunandana were all among the branches of the Caitanya tree.

devanagari: ‘आचार्यरत्न’ नाम धरे बड़ एक शाखा ।
ताँर परिकर, ताँर शाखा - उपशाखा ॥12॥
cc-adi-10.12.translation: Another big branch was Ācāryaratna, and his associates were sub-branches.

devanagari: महा - कृपा - पात्र प्रभुर जगाइ, माधाइ ।
‘पतित - पावन’ नामेर साक्षी दुइ भाइ ॥120॥
cc-adi-10.120.translation: Jagāi and Mādhāi, the eighty-ninth and nintieth branches of the tree, were the greatest recipients of Lord Caitanya's mercy. These two brothers were the witnesses who proved that Lord Caitanya was rightly named Patita-pāvana, "the deliverer of the fallen souls."

devanagari: गौड़ - देश - भक्तेर कैल सङ्क्षेप कथन ।
अनन्त चैतन्य - भक्त ना याय गणन ॥121॥
cc-adi-10.121.translation: I have given a brief description of the devotees of Lord Caitanya in Bengal. Actually His devotees are innumerable.

devanagari: नीलाचले एइ सब भक्त प्रभु - सङ्गे ।
दुइ स्थाने प्रभु - सेवा कैल नाना - रङ्गे ॥122॥
cc-adi-10.122.translation: I have especially mentioned all these devotees because they accompanied Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu in Bengal and Orissa and served Him in many ways.

lines: kevala nīlācale prabhura ye ye bhakta-gaṇa
saṅkṣepe kariye kichu se saba kathana
devanagari: केवल नीलाचले प्रभुर ये ये भक्त - गण ।
सङ्क्षेपे करिये किछु से सब कथन ॥123॥
cc-adi-10.123.translation: Let me briefly describe some of the devotees of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu in Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: नीलाचले प्रभु - सङ्गे ग्रत भक्त - गण ।
सबार अध्यक्ष प्रभुर मर्म दुइ - जन ॥124॥
cc-adi-10.124-126.translation: Among the devotees who accompanied the Lord in Jagannātha Purī, two of them-Paramānanda Purī and Svarūpa Dāmodara-were the heart and soul of the Lord. Among the other devotees were Gadādhara, Jagadānanda, Śaṅkara, Vakreśvara, Dāmodara Paṇḍita, Ṭhākura Haridāsa, Raghunātha Vaidya and Raghunātha dāsa.

devanagari: इत्यादिक पूर्व - सङ्गी बड़ भक्त - गण ।
नीलाचले र हि’ करे प्रभुर सेवन ॥127॥
cc-adi-10.127.translation: All these devotees were associates of the Lord from the very beginning, and when the Lord took up residence in Jagannātha Purī they remained there to serve Him faithfully.

devanagari: आर यत भक्त - गण गौड़ - देश - वासी ।
प्रत्यब्दे प्रभुरे देखे नीलाचले आसि’ ॥128॥
cc-adi-10.128.translation: All the devotees who resided in Bengal used to visit Jagannātha Purī to see the Lord.

devanagari: नीलाचले प्रभु - सह प्रथम मिलन ।
सेइ भक्त - गणेर एबे करिये गणन ॥129॥
cc-adi-10.129.translation: Now let me enumerate the devotees of Bengal who first came to see the Lord at Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: आचार्यरलेर नाम ‘श्री - चन्द्रशेखर’ - ।
याँर घरे देवी - भावे नाचिला ईश्वर ॥13॥
cc-adi-10.13.translation: Ācāryaratna was also named Śrī Candraśekhara Ācārya. In a drama in his house, Lord Caitanya played the goddess of fortune.

devanagari: बड़ - शाखा एक , - सार्वभौम भट्टाचार्य ।
ताँर भग्नी - पति श्री - गोपीनाथाचार्य ॥130॥
cc-adi-10.130.translation: There was Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, one of the biggest branches of the tree of the Lord, and his sister's husband, Śrī Gopīnātha Ācārya.

devanagari: काशी - मिश्र, प्रद्युम्न - मिश्र, राय भवानन्द ।
याँहार मिलने प्रभु पाइला आनन्द ॥131॥
cc-adi-10.131.translation: In the list of devotees at Jagannātha Purī [which begins with Paramānanda Purī, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Gopīnātha Ācārya], Kāśī Miśra was the fifth, Pradyumna Miśra the sixth and Bhavānanda Rāya the seventh. Lord Caitanya took great pleasure in meeting with them.

devanagari: आलिङ्गन करि’ ताँरे बलिल वचन ।
तुमि पाण्डु, पञ्च - पाण्डवतोमार नन्दन ॥132॥
cc-adi-10.132.translation: Embracing Rāya Bhavānanda, the Lord declared to him, "You formerly appeared as Pāṇḍu, and your five sons appeared as the five Pāṇḍavas."

devanagari: रामानन्द राय, पट्टनायक गोपीनाथ ।
कलानिधि, सुधानिधि, नायक वाणीनाथ ॥133॥
cc-adi-10.133.translation: The five sons of Bhavānanda Rāya were Rāmānanda Rāya, Paṭṭanāyaka Gopīnātha, Kalānidhi, Sudhānidhi and Nāyaka Vāṇīnātha.

lines: ei pañca putra tomāra mora priyapātra
devanagari: एइ पञ्च पुत्र तोमार मोर प्रियपात्र ।
रामानन्द सह मोर देह - भेद मात्र ॥134॥
cc-adi-10.134.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Bhavānanda Rāya, "Your five sons are all My dear devotees. Rāmānanda Rāya and I are one, although our bodies are different."

devanagari: प्रतापरुद्र राजा, आर ओढ़ कृष्णानन्द ।
परमानन्द महापात्र, ओढ़ शिवानन्द ॥135॥
cc-adi-10.135-136.translation: King Pratāparudra of Orissa, the Oriya devotees Kṛṣṇānanda and Śivānanda, Paramānanda Mahāpātra, Bhagavān Ācārya, Brahmānanda Bhāratī, Śrī Śikhi Māhiti and Murāri Māhiti constantly associated with Caitanya Mahāprabhu while He resided in Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: माधवी - देवी - शिखि - माहितिर भगिनी ।
श्री - राधार दासी - मध्ये याँर नाम गणि ॥137॥
cc-adi-10.137.translation: Mādhavīdevī, the seventeenth of the prominent devotees, was the younger sister of Śikhi Māhiti. She is considered to have formerly been a maidservant of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

devanagari: ईश्वर - पुरीर शिष्य - ब्रह्मचारी काशीश्वर ।
श्री गोविन्द नाम ताँर प्रिय अनुचर ॥138॥
cc-adi-10.138.translation: Brahmacārī Kāśīśvara was a disciple of Īśvara Purī, and Śrī Govinda was another of his dear disciples.

lines: tāṅra siddhi-kāle doṅhe tāṅra ājñā pāñā
devanagari: ताँर सिद्धि - काले दोंहे ताँर आज्ञा पा ञा ।
नीलाचले प्रभु - स्थाने मिलिल आसिया ॥139॥
cc-adi-10.139.translation: In the list of prominent devotees at Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī], Kāśīśvara was the eighteenth and Govinda the nineteenth. They both came to see Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī, being thus ordered by Īśvara Purī at the time of his passing away.

lines: yāṅra nāma lañā prabhu kāndilā āpani
devanagari: पुण्डरीक विद्यानिधि - बड़ - शाखा जानि ।
याँर नाम लञा प्रभु कान्दिला आपनि ॥14॥
cc-adi-10.14.translation: Puṇḍarīka Vidyānidhi, the third big branch, was so dear to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu that in his absence Lord Caitanya Himself would sometimes cry.

lines: tāṅra ājñā māni' sevā dilena doṅhāre
devanagari: गुरुर सम्बन्धे मान्य कैल दुँहाकारे ।
ताँर आज्ञा मा नि’ सेवा दिलेन दोंहारे ॥140॥
cc-adi-10.140.translation: Both Kāśīśvara and Govinda were Godbrothers of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and thus the Lord duly honored them as soon as they arrived. But because Īśvara Purī had ordered them to give Caitanya Mahāprabhu personal service, the Lord accepted their service.

devanagari: अङ्ग - सेवा गोविन्देरे दिलेन ईश्वर ।
जगन्नाथ देखिते चलेन आगे काशीश्वर ॥141॥
cc-adi-10.141.translation: Govinda cared for the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whereas Kāśīśvara went in front of the Lord when He went to see Jagannātha in the temple.

lines: manuṣya ṭheli' patha kare kāśī balavāne
devanagari: अपरश याय गोसाञि मनुष्य - गहने ।
मनुष्य ठेलि’ पथ करे काशी बलवाने ॥142॥
cc-adi-10.142.translation: When Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the temple of Jagannātha, Kāśīśvara, being very strong, cleared the crowds aside with his hands so that Caitanya Mahāprabhu could pass untouched.

devanagari: रामाइ - नन्दाइ - दोहे प्रभुर किङ्कर ।
गोविन्देर सङ्गे सेवा करे निरन्तर ॥143॥
cc-adi-10.143.translation: Rāmāi and Nandāi, the twentieth and twenty-first among the important devotees in Jagannātha Purī, always assisted Govinda twenty-four hours a day in rendering service to the Lord.

lines: bāiśa ghaḍā jala dine bharena rāmāi
devanagari: बाइश घड़ा जल दिने भरेन रामाई ।
गोविन्द - आज्ञाय सेवा करेन नन्दाइ ॥144॥
cc-adi-10.144.translation: Every day Rāmāi filled twenty-two big waterpots, whereas Nandāi personally assisted Govinda.

lines: yāre saṅge laiyā kailā dakṣiṇa gamana
devanagari: कृष्णदास नाम शुद्ध कुलीन ब्राह्मण ।
यारे सड़े लैया कैला दक्षिण गमन ॥145॥
cc-adi-10.145.translation: The twenty-second devotee, Kṛṣṇadāsa, was born of a pure and respectable brāhmaṇa family. While touring southern India, Lord Caitanya took Kṛṣṇadāsa with Him.

devanagari: बलभद्र भट्टाचार्य - भक्ति अधिकारी ।
मथुरा - गमने प्रभुर येंहो ब्रह्मचारी ॥146॥
cc-adi-10.146.translation: As a bona fide devotee, Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya, the twenty-third principal associate, acted as the brahmacārī of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu when He toured Mathurā.

devanagari: बड़ हरिदास, आर छोट हरिदास ।
दुइ कीर्तनीया रहे महाप्रभुर पाश ॥147॥
cc-adi-10.147.translation: Baḍa Haridāsa and Choṭa Haridāsa, the twenty-fourth and twenty-fifth devotees in Nīlācala, were good singers who always accompanied Lord Caitanya.

devanagari: रामभद्राचार्य, आर ओढ़ सिंहेश्वर ।
तपन आचार्य, आर रघु, नीलाम्बर ॥148॥
cc-adi-10.148.translation: Among the devotees who lived with Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī, Rāmabhadra Ācārya was the twenty-sixth, Siṁheśvara the twenty-seventh, Tapana Ācārya the twenty-eighth, Raghunātha the twenty-ninth and Nīlāmbara the thirtieth.

lines: gauḍe pūrva bhṛtya prabhura priya kamalānanda
devanagari: सिङ्गाभट्ट, कामाभट्ट, दन्तुर शिवानन्द ।
गौड़े पूर्व भृत्य प्रभुर प्रिय कमलानन्द ॥149॥
cc-adi-10.149.translation: Siṅgābhaṭṭa was the thirty-first, Kāmābhaṭṭa the thirty-second, Śivānanda the thirty-third and Kamalānanda the thirty-fourth. They all formerly served Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in Bengal, but later these servants left Bengal to live with the Lord in Jagannātha Purī.

lines: teṅho lakṣmī-rūpā, tāṅra sama keha nāi
devanagari: बड़ शाखा , - गदाधर पण्डित - गोसाञि ।
तेंहो लक्ष्मी - रूपा, ताँर सम केह नाइ ॥15॥
cc-adi-10.15.translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita, the fourth branch, is described as an incarnation of the pleasure potency of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. No one, therefore, can equal him.

devanagari: अच्युतानन्द - अद्वैत - आचार्य - तनय ।
नीलाचले रहे प्रभुर चरण आश्रय ॥150॥
cc-adi-10.150.translation: Acyutānanda, the thirty-fifth devotee, was the son of Advaita Ācārya. He also lived with Lord Caitanya, taking shelter of His lotus feet at Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: निर्लोम गङ्गादास, आर विष्णुदास ।
एइ सबेर प्रभु - सङ्गे नीलाचले वास ॥151॥
cc-adi-10.151.translation: Nirloma Gaṅgādāsa and Viṣṇudāsa were the thirty-sixth and thirty-seventh among the devotees who lived at Jagannātha Purī as servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: वाराणसी - मध्ये प्रभुर भक्त तिन जन ।
चन्द्रशेखर वैद्य, आर मिश्र तपन ॥152॥
cc-adi-10.152-154.translation: The prominent devotees at Vārāṇasī were the physician Candraśekhara, Tapana Miśra and Raghunātha Bhaṭṭācārya, Tapana Miśra's son. When Lord Caitanya came to Vārāṇasī after seeing Vṛndāvana, for two months He lived at the residence of Candraśekhara Vaidya and accepted prasāda at the house of Tapana Miśra.

devanagari: रघुनाथ बाल्ये कैल प्रभुर सेवन ।
उच्छिष्ट - मार्जन आर पाद - संवाहन ॥155॥
cc-adi-10.155.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at the house of Tapana Miśra, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, who was then a boy, washed His dishes and massaged His legs.

lines: baḍa haile nīlācale gelā prabhura sthāne
aṣṭa-māsa rahila bhikṣā dena kona dine
devanagari: बड़ हैले नीलाचले गेला प्रभुर स्थाने ।
अष्ट - मास रहिल भिक्षा देन कोन दिने ॥156॥
cc-adi-10.156.translation: When Raghunātha grew to be a young man, he visited Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī and stayed there for eight months. Sometimes he offered prasāda to the Lord.

devanagari: प्रभुर आज्ञा पाञा वृन्दावनेरे आइला ।
आसिया श्री - रूप - गोसाञि र निकटे रहिला ॥157॥
cc-adi-10.157.translation: Later, by the order of Lord Caitanya, Raghunātha went to Vṛndāvana and remained there under the shelter of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

devanagari: ताँर स्थाने रूप - गोसाञि शुनेन भागवत ।
प्रभुर कृपाय तेंहो कृष्ण - प्रेमे मत्त ॥158॥
cc-adi-10.158.translation: While he stayed with Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, his engagement was to recite Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam for him to hear. As a result of this Bhāgavatam recitation, he attained perfectional love of Kṛṣṇa, by which he remained always maddened.

lines: diṅmātra likhi, samyak nā yāya kathana
devanagari: एइ - मत सङ्ख्यातीत चैतन्य - भक्त - गण ।
दिंमात्र लिखि, सम्यक्ना याय कथन ॥159॥
cc-adi-10.159.translation: I list in this way only a portion of the innumerable devotees of Lord Caitanya. To describe them all fully is not possible.

devanagari: ताँर शिष्य - उपशिष्य , - ताँर उपशाखा ।
एइमत सब शाखा - उपशाखार लेखा ॥16॥
cc-adi-10.16.translation: His disciples and granddisciples are his sub-branches. To describe them all would be difficult.

devanagari: एकैक - शाखाते लागे कोटि कोटि डाल ।
तार शिष्य - उपशिष्य, तार उपड़ाल ॥160॥
cc-adi-10.160.translation: From each branch of the tree have grown hundreds and thousands of sub-branches of disciples and granddisciples.

devanagari: सकल भरिया आछे प्रेम - फुल - फले ।
भासाइल त्रि - जगत्कृष्ण - प्रेम - जले ॥161॥
cc-adi-10.161.translation: Every branch and subbranch of the tree is full of innumerable fruits and flowers. They inundate the world with the waters of love of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: eka eka śākhāra śakti ananta mahimā
devanagari: एक एक शाखार शक्ति अनन्त महिमा ।
‘सहस्र वदने’ यार दिते नारे सीमा ॥162॥
cc-adi-10.162.translation: Each and every branch of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees has unlimited spiritual power and glory. Even if one had thousands of mouths, it would be impossible to describe the limits of their activities.

devanagari: सङ्क्षेपे कहिल महाप्रभुर भक्तगण ।
समग्र बलिते नारे ‘सहस्र - वदन’ ॥163॥
cc-adi-10.163.translation: I have briefly described the devotees of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu in different places. Even Lord Śeṣa, who has thousands of mouths, could not list them all.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥164॥
cc-adi-10.164.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: वक्रेश्वर पण्डित - प्रभुर बड़ प्रिय भृत्य ।
एक - भावे चब्बिश प्रहर याँर नृत्य ॥17॥
cc-adi-10.17.translation: Vakreśvara Paṇḍita, the fifth branch of the tree, was a very dear servant of Lord Caitanya's. He could dance with constant ecstasy for seventy-two hours.

devanagari: आपने महाप्रभु गाय याँर नृत्य - काले ।
प्रभुर चरण धरि’ वक्रेश्वर बले ॥18॥
cc-adi-10.18.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally sang while Vakreśvara Paṇḍita danced, and thus Vakreśvara Paṇḍita fell at the lotus feet of the Lord and spoke as follows.

lines: tārā gāya, muñi nācoṅ—tabe mora sukha"
devanagari: “दश - सहस्र गन्धर्व मोरे दे ह’ चन्द्रमुख ।
तारा गाय, मुञि नाचों - तबे मोर सुख” ॥19॥
cc-adi-10.19.translation: "O Candramukha! Please give me ten thousand Gandharvas. Let them sing as I dance, and then I will be greatly happy."

devanagari: जय जय श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य - नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैतचन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-10.2.translation: All glories to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaita Prabhu, and all glories to the devotees of Lord Caitanya, headed by Śrīvāsa!

lines: prabhu bale—tumi mora pakṣa eka śākhā
ākāśe uḍitāma yadi pāṅ āra pākhā
devanagari: प्रभु बले - तुमि मोर पक्ष एक शाखा ।
आकाशे उड़िताम यदि पाँ आर पाखा ॥20॥
cc-adi-10.20.translation: Lord Caitanya replied, "I have only one wing like you, but if I had another, certainly I would fly in the sky!"

devanagari: पण्डित जगदानन्द प्रभुर प्राण - रूप ।
लोके ख्यात येंहो सत्यभामार स्वरूप ॥21॥
cc-adi-10.21.translation: Paṇḍita Jagadānanda, the sixth branch of the Caitanya tree, was celebrated as the life and soul of the Lord. He is known to have been an incarnation of Satyabhāmā [one of the chief queens of Lord Kṛṣṇa].

devanagari: प्रीत्ये करिते चाहे प्रभुर लालन - पालन ।
वैराग्य - लोक - भये प्रभु ना माने कखन ॥22॥
cc-adi-10.22.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita [as an incarnation of Satyabhāmā] always wanted to see to the comfort of Lord Caitanya, but since the Lord was a sannyāsī He did not accept the luxuries that Jagadānanda Paṇḍita offered.

lines: tāṅra prītyera kathā āge kahiba sakala
devanagari: दुइ - जने खमटि लागाय कोन्दल ।
ताँर प्रीत्येर कथा आगे कहिब सकल ॥23॥
cc-adi-10.23.translation: They sometimes appeared to fight over trifles, but these quarrels were based on their affection, of which I shall speak later.

devanagari: राघव - पण्डित - प्रभुर आद्य - अनुचर ।
ताँर एक शाखा मुख्य - मकरध्वज कर ॥24॥
cc-adi-10.24.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's original follower, is understood to have been the seventh branch. From him proceeded another subbranch, headed by Makaradhvaja Kara.

lines: tāṅhāra bhaginī damayantī prabhura priya dāsī
devanagari: ताँहार भगिनी दमयन्ती प्रभुर प्रिय दासी ।
प्रभुर भोग - सामग्री ये करे बार - मासि ॥25॥
cc-adi-10.25.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita's sister Damayantī was the dear maidservant of the Lord. She always collected various ingredients with which to cook for Lord Caitanya.

lines: se saba sāmagrī yata jhālite bhariyā
devanagari: से सब सामग्री यत झालिते भरिया ।
राघव लइया या’न गुपत करिया ॥26॥
cc-adi-10.26.translation: The foodstuffs Damayantī cooked for Lord Caitanya when He was at Purī were carried in a bag by her brother Rāghava without the knowledge of others.

devanagari: बार - मास ताहा प्रभु करेन अङ्गीकार ।
‘राघवेर झा लि’ बलि’ प्रसिद्धि याहार ॥27॥
cc-adi-10.27.translation: The Lord accepted these foodstuffs throughout the entire year. That bag is still celebrated as rāghavera jhāli ["the bag of Rāghava Paṇḍita"].

devanagari: से - सब सामग्री आगे करिब विस्तार ।
याहार श्रवणे भक्तेर वहे अश्रुधार ॥28॥
cc-adi-10.28.translation: I shall describe the contents of the bag of Rāghava Paṇḍita later in this book. Hearing this narration, devotees generally cry, and tears glide down from their eyes.

devanagari: प्रभुर अत्यन्त प्रिय - पण्डित गङ्गादास ।
याँहार स्मरणे हय सर्व - बन्ध - नाश ॥29॥
cc-adi-10.29.translation: Paṇḍita Gaṅgādāsa was the eighth dear branch of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. One who remembers his activities attains freedom from all bondage.

devanagari: एइ मालीर - एइ वृक्षेर अकथ्य कथन ।
एबे शुन मुख्य - शाखार नाम - विवरण ॥3॥
cc-adi-10.3.translation: The description of Lord Caitanya as the gardener and the tree is inconceivable. Now hear with attention about the branches of this tree.

devanagari: चैतन्य - पार्षद - श्री - आचार्य पुरन्दर ।
पिता क रि’ याँरे बले गौराङ्ग - सुन्दर ॥30॥
cc-adi-10.30.translation: Śrī Ācārya Purandara, the ninth branch, was a constant associate of Lord Caitanya. The Lord accepted him as His father.

devanagari: दामोदर - पण्डित शाखा प्रेमेते प्रचण्ड ।
प्रभुर उपरे सेंहो कैल वाक्य - दण्ड ॥31॥
cc-adi-10.31.translation: Dāmodara Paṇḍita, the tenth branch of the Caitanya tree, was so elevated in love of Lord Caitanya that he once unhesitatingly chastised the Lord with strong words.

lines: daṇḍe tuṣṭa prabhu tāṅre pāṭhāilā nadīyā
devanagari: दण्ड - कथा कहिब आगे विस्तार करिया ।
दण्डे तुष्ट प्रभु ताँरे पाठाइला नदीया ॥32॥
cc-adi-10.32.translation: I shall describe in detail this incident of chastisement later in Caitanya-caritāmṛta. The Lord, being very much satisfied by this chastisement, sent Dāmodara Paṇḍita to Navadvīpa.

devanagari: ताँहार अनुज शाखा - शङ्कर - पण्डित ।
‘प्रभु - पादोपाधा न’ याँर नाम विदि त ॥33॥
cc-adi-10.33.translation: The eleventh branch, the younger brother of Dāmodara Paṇḍita, was known as Śaṅkara Paṇḍita. He was celebrated as the shoes of the Lord.

devanagari: सदाशिव - पण्डित याँर प्रभु - पदे आश ।
प्रथमेइ नित्यानन्देर याँर घरे वास ॥34॥
cc-adi-10.34.translation: Sadāśiva Paṇḍita, the twelfth branch, was always anxious to serve the lotus feet of the Lord. It was his good fortune that when Lord Nityānanda came to Navadvīpa He resided at his house.

devanagari: श्रीनृसिंह - उपासक - प्रद्युम्न ब्रह्मचारी ।
प्रभु ताँर नाम कैला ‘नृसिंहानन्द’ करि’ ॥35॥
cc-adi-10.35.translation: The thirteenth branch was Pradyumna Brahmacārī. Since he was a worshiper of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu changed his name to Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī.

devanagari: नारायण - पण्डित एक बड़ई उदार ।
चैतन्य - चरण विनु नाहि जाने आर ॥36॥
cc-adi-10.36.translation: Nārāyaṇa Paṇḍita, the fourteenth branch, a great and liberal devotee, did not know any shelter but Lord Caitanya's lotus feet.

lines: deuṭi dharena, yabe prabhu karena nṛtya
devanagari: श्रीमान्प ण्डित शाखा - प्रभुर निज भृत्य ।
देउटि धरेन, यबे प्रभु करेन नृत्य ॥37॥
cc-adi-10.37.translation: The fifteenth branch was Śrīmān Paṇḍita, who was a constant servitor of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He used to carry a torch while the Lord danced.

lines: yāṅra anna māgi' kāḍi' khāilā bhagavān
devanagari: शुक्लाम्बर - ब्रह्मचारी बड़ भाग्यवान् ।
याँर अन्न मा गि’ काड़ि’ खाइला भगवान् ॥38॥
cc-adi-10.38.translation: The sixteenth branch, Śuklāmbara Brahmacārī, was very fortunate because Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu jokingly or seriously begged food from him or sometimes snatched it from him forcibly and ate it.

lines: lukāiyā dui prabhura yāṅra ghare sthita
devanagari: नन्दन - आचार्य - शाखा जगते विदित ।
लुकाइया दुइ प्रभुर याँर घरे स्थित ॥39॥
cc-adi-10.39.translation: Nandana Ācārya, the seventeenth branch of the Caitanya tree, is celebrated within the world because the two Prabhus [Lord Caitanya and Nityānanda] sometimes hid in his house.

devanagari: चैतन्य गोसाञि र यत पारिषद - चय ।
गुरु - लघु - भाव ताँर ना हय निश्चय ॥4॥
cc-adi-10.4.translation: The associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were many, but none of them should be considered lower or higher. This cannot be ascertained.

devanagari: श्री - मुकुन्द - दत्त शाखा - प्रभुर समाध्यायी ।
याँहार कीर्तने नाचे चैतन्य - गोसाञि ॥40॥
cc-adi-10.40.translation: Mukunda Datta, a class friend of Lord Caitanya's, was another branch of the Caitanya tree. Lord Caitanya danced while he sang.

lines: sahasra-mukhe yāṅra guṇa kahile nā haya
devanagari: वासुदेव दत्त - प्रभुर भृत्य महाशय ।
सहस्र - मुखे याँर गुण कहिले ना हय ॥41॥
cc-adi-10.41.translation: Vāsudeva Datta, the nineteenth branch of the Śrī Caitanya tree, was a great personality and a most confidential devotee of the Lord. One could not describe his qualities even with thousands of mouths.

lines: jagate yateka jīva, tāra pāpa lañā
devanagari: जगते यतेक जीव, तार पाप ला ।
नरक भुञ्जिते चाहे जीव छाड़ाइया ॥42॥
cc-adi-10.42.translation: Śrīla Vāsudeva Datta Ṭhākura wanted to suffer for the sinful activities of all the people of the world so that Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu might deliver them.

lines: tina lakṣa nāma teṅho layena apatita
devanagari: हरिदास - ठाकुर शाखार अद्भुत चरित ।
तिन लक्ष नाम तेंहो लयेन अपतित ॥43॥
cc-adi-10.43.translation: The twentieth branch of the Caitanya tree was Haridāsa Ṭhākura. His character was wonderful. He used to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa 300,000 times a day without fail.

devanagari: ताँहार अनन्त गुण - कहि दिंमात्र ।
आचार्य गोसाञि याँरे भुञ्जाय श्राद्ध - पात्र ॥44॥
cc-adi-10.44.translation: There was no end to the transcendental qualities of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Here I mention but a fraction of his qualities. He was so exalted that Advaita Gosvāmī, when performing the śrāddha ceremony of his father, offered him the first plate.

devanagari: प्रह्लाद - समान ताँर गुणेर तरङ्ग ।
यवन - ताड़नेओ याँर नाहिक भू - भङ्ग ॥45॥
