cc-adi-10.45.translation: The waves of his good qualities were like those of Prahlāda Mahārāja. He did not even slightly raise an eyebrow when persecuted by the Mohammedan ruler.

lines: teṅho siddhi pāile tāṅra deha lañā kole
devanagari: तेंहो सिद्धि पाइले ताँर देह ल ञा कोले ।
नाचिल चैतन्य - प्रभु महा - कुतूहले ॥46॥
cc-adi-10.46.translation: After the passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the Lord Himself took his body on His lap, and He danced with it in great ecstasy.

devanagari: ताँर लीला वर्णियाछेन वृन्दावन - दास ।
येबा अवशिष्ट, आगे करिब प्रकाश ॥47॥
cc-adi-10.47.translation: Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura vividly described the pastimes of Haridāsa Ṭhākura in his Caitanya-bhāgavata. Whatever has remained undescribed I shall try to explain later in this book.

devanagari: ताँर उपशाखा - यत कुलीन - ग्रामी जन ।
सत्यराज - आदि ताँर कृपार भाजन ॥48॥
cc-adi-10.48.translation: One subbranch of Haridāsa Ṭhākura consisted of the residents of Kulīna-grāma. The most important among them was Satyarāja Khāna, or Satyarāja Vasu, who was a recipient of all the mercy of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

lines: prabhura hṛdaya drave śuni' dainya yāṅra
devanagari: श्री - मुरारि गुप्त शाखा - प्रेमेर भाण्डार ।
प्रभुर हृदय द्रवे शुनि’ दैन्य याँर ॥49॥
cc-adi-10.49.translation: Murāri Gupta, the twenty-first branch of the tree of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, was a storehouse of love of Godhead. His great humility and meekness melted the heart of Lord Caitanya.

lines: yata yata mahānta kailā tāṅ-sabāra gaṇana
devanagari: यत यत महान्त कैला ताँ - सबार गणन ।
केह करिबारे नारे ज्येष्ठ - लघु - क्रम ॥5॥
cc-adi-10.5.translation: All the great personalities in the line of Lord Caitanya enumerated these devotees, but they could not distinguish between the greater and the lesser.

lines: pratigraha nāhi kare, nā laya kāra dhana
devanagari: प्रतिग्रह नाहि करे, ना लय कार धन ।
आत्म - वृत्ति करि’ करे कुटुम्ब भरण ॥50॥
cc-adi-10.50.translation: Śrīla Murāri Gupta never accepted charity from friends, nor did he accept money from anyone. He practiced as a physician and maintained his family with his earnings.

devanagari: चिकित्सा करेन यारे हइया सदय ।
देह - रोग भाव - रोग, - दुइ तार क्षय ॥51॥
cc-adi-10.51.translation: As Murāri Gupta treated his patients, by his mercy both their bodily and spiritual diseases subsided.

devanagari: श्रीमान्सेन प्रभुर सेवक प्रधान ।
चैतन्य - चरण विनु नाहि जाने आन ॥52॥
cc-adi-10.52.translation: Śrīmān Sena, the twenty-second branch of the Caitanya tree, was a very faithful servant of Lord Caitanya. He knew nothing else but the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - गदाधर दास शाखा सर्वोपरि ।
काजी - गणेर मुखे येह बोलाइल हरि ॥53॥
cc-adi-10.53.translation: Śrī Gadādhara dāsa, the twenty-third branch, was understood to be the topmost, for he induced all the Mohammedan Kāzīs to chant the holy name of Lord Hari.

lines: prabhu-sthāne yāite sabe layena yāṅra saṅga
devanagari: शिवानन्द सेन - प्रभुर भृत्य अन्तरङ्ग ।
प्रभु - स्थाने याइते सबे लयेन याँर सङ्ग ॥54॥
cc-adi-10.54.translation: Śivananda Sena, the twenty-fourth branch of the tree, was an extremely confidential servant of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Everyone who went to Jagannātha Purī to visit Lord Caitanya took shelter and guidance from Śrī Śivananda Sena.

devanagari: प्रतिवर्षे प्रभु - गण सङ्गेते लाइया ।
नीलाचले चलेन पथे पालन करिया ॥55॥
cc-adi-10.55.translation: Every year he took a party of devotees from Bengal to Jagannātha Purī to visit Lord Caitanya. He maintained the entire party as they journeyed on the road.

lines: bhakte kṛpā karena prabhu e-tina svarūpe
devanagari: भक्ते कृपा करेन प्रभु ए - तिन स्वरूपे ।
‘साक्षात्,’ ‘आवेश’ आर ‘आविर्भाव’ - रूपे ॥56॥
cc-adi-10.56.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bestows His causeless mercy upon His devotees in three features: His own direct appearance [sākṣāt], His prowess within someone He empowers [āveśa], and His manifestation [āvirbhāva].

devanagari: ‘साक्षाते’ सकल भक्त देखे निर्विशेष ।
नकुल ब्रह्मचारि - देहे प्रभुर ‘आवेश’ ॥57॥
cc-adi-10.57.translation: The appearance of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in every devotee's presence is called sākṣāt. His appearance in Nakula Brahmacārī as a symptom of special prowess is an example of āveśa.

devanagari: ‘प्रद्युम्न ब्रह्मचारी’ ताँर आगे नाम छिल ।
‘नृसिंहानन्द’ नाम प्रभु पाछे त’ राखिल ॥58॥
cc-adi-10.58.translation: The former Pradyumna Brahmacārī was given the name Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: ताँहाते हइल चैतन्येर ‘आविर्भाव’ ।
अलौकिक ऐछे प्रभुर अनेक स्वभाव ॥59॥
cc-adi-10.59.translation: In his body there were symptoms of āvirbhāva. Such appearances are uncommon, but Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu displayed many such pastimes through His different features.

lines: nāma-mātra kari, doṣa nā labe āmāra
devanagari: अतएव ताँ - सबारे क रि’ नमस्कार ।
नाम - मात्र करि, दोष ना लबे आमार ॥6॥
cc-adi-10.6.translation: I offer my obeisances unto them as a token of respect. I request them not to consider my offenses.

lines: āsvādila e saba rasa sena śivānanda
devanagari: आस्वादिल ए सब रस सेन शिवानन्द ।
विस्ता रि’ कहिब आगे एसब आनन्द ॥60॥
cc-adi-10.60.translation: Śrīla Śivānanda Sena experienced the three features sākṣāt, āveśa and āvirbhāva. Later I shall vividly describe this transcendentally blissful subject.

devanagari: शिवानन्देर उपशाखा, ताँर परिकर ।
पुत्र - भृत्यादि करि’ चैतन्य - किङ्कर ॥61॥
cc-adi-10.61.translation: The sons, servants and family members of Śivānanda Sena constituted a subbranch. They were all sincere servants of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: चैतन्य - दास, रामदास, आर कर्णपूर ।
तिन पुत्र शिवानन्देर प्रभुर भक्त - शूर ॥62॥
cc-adi-10.62.translation: The three sons of Śivānanda Sena, named Caitanya dāsa, Rāmadāsa and Karṇapūra, were all heroic devotees of Lord Caitanya.

devanagari: श्री - वल्लभसेन, आर सेन श्रीकान्त ।
शिवानन्द - सम्बन्धे प्रभुर भक्त एकान्त ॥63॥
cc-adi-10.63.translation: Śrīvallabha Sena and Śrīkānta Sena were also sub-branches of Śivānanda Sena, for they were not only his nephews but also unalloyed devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: प्रभु - प्रिय गोविन्दानन्द महाभागवत ।
प्रभुर कीर्तनीया आदि श्री गोविन्द दत्त ॥64॥
cc-adi-10.64.translation: Govindānanda and Govinda Datta, the twenty-fifth and twenty-sixth branches of the tree, were performers of kīrtana in the company of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Govinda Datta was the principal singer in Lord Caitanya's kīrtana party.

devanagari: श्री - विजय - दास - नाम प्रभुर आखरिया ।
प्रभुरे अनेक पुँथि दियाछे लिखिया ॥65॥
cc-adi-10.65.translation: Śrī Vijaya dāsa, the twenty-seventh branch, another of the Lord's chief singers, gave the Lord many books written by hand.

devanagari: ‘रत्नबाहु’ बलि’ प्रभु थुइल ताँर नाम ।
अकिञ्चन प्रभुर प्रिय कृष्णदास - नाम ॥66॥
cc-adi-10.66.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave Vijaya dāsa the name Ratnabāhu ["jewel-handed"] because he copied for Him many manuscripts. The twenty-eighth branch was Kṛṣṇadāsa, who was very dear to the Lord. He was known as Akiñcana Kṛṣṇadāsa.

devanagari: खोला - वेचा श्रीधर प्रभुर प्रिय - दास ।
याँहा - सने प्रभु करे नित्य परिहास ॥67॥
cc-adi-10.67.translation: The twenty-ninth branch was Śrīdhara, a trader in banana-tree bark. He was a very dear servant of the Lord. On many occasions, the Lord played jokes on him.

devanagari: प्रभु याँर नित्य लय थोड़ - मोचा - फल ।
याँर फुटा - लौहपात्रे प्रभु पिला जल ॥68॥
cc-adi-10.68.translation: Every day Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu jokingly snatched fruits, flowers and pulp from Śrīdhara and drank from his broken iron pot.

lines: yāṅra dehe kṛṣṇa pūrve hailā adhiṣṭhita
devanagari: प्रभुर अतिप्रिय दास भगवान्पण्डित ।
याँर देहे कृष्ण पूर्वे हैला अधिष्ठित ॥69॥
cc-adi-10.69.translation: The thirtieth branch was Bhagavān Paṇḍita. He was an extremely dear servant of the Lord, but even previously he was a great devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa who always kept the Lord within his heart.

devanagari: वन्दे श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य - प्रेमामर - तरोः प्रियान् ।
शाखा - रूपान्भक्त - गणान्कृष्ण - प्रेम - फल - प्रदान् ॥7॥
cc-adi-10.7.translation: I offer my obeisances to all the dear devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the eternal tree of love of Godhead. I offer my respects to all the branches of the tree, the devotees of the Lord who distribute the fruit of love of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: yāre kṛpā kaila bālye prabhu dayāmaya
devanagari: जगदीश पण्डित, आर हिरण्य महाशय ।
यारे कृपा कैल बाल्ये प्रभु दयामय ॥70॥
cc-adi-10.70.translation: The thirty-first branch was Jagadīśa Paṇḍita, and the thirty-second was Hiraṇya Mahāśaya, unto whom Lord Caitanya in His childhood showed His causeless mercy.

devanagari: एइ दुइ - घरे प्रभु एकादशी दिने ।
विष्णुर नैवेद्य मागि’ खाइल आपने ॥71॥
cc-adi-10.71.translation: In their two houses Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu begged foodstuffs on the Ekādaśī day and ate them personally.

devanagari: प्रभुर पड़या दुइ, पुरुषोत्तम, सञ्जय ।
व्याकरणे दुइ शिष्य दुइ महाशय ॥72॥
cc-adi-10.72.translation: The thirty-third and thirty-fourth branches were the two students of Caitanya Mahāprabhu named Puruṣottama and Sañjaya, who were stalwart students in grammar. They were very great personalities.

lines: soṇāra muṣala hala dekhila prabhura hāte
devanagari: वनमाली पण्डित शाखा विख्यात जगते ।
सोणार मुषल हल देखिल प्रभुर हाते ॥73॥
cc-adi-10.73.translation: Vanamālī Paṇḍita, the thirty-fifth branch of the tree, was very celebrated in this world. He saw in the hands of the Lord a golden club and plow.

devanagari: श्री - चैतन्ये र अति प्रिय बुद्धिमन्त खान् ।
आजन्म आज्ञाकारी तेंहो सेवक - प्रधान ॥74॥
cc-adi-10.74.translation: The thirty-sixth branch, Buddhimanta Khān, was extremely dear to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He was always prepared to carry out the Lord's orders, and therefore he was considered a chief servant of the Lord.

lines: nāma-bale viṣa yāṅre nā karila bala
devanagari: गरुड़ पण्डित लय श्रीनाम - मङ्गल ।
नाम - बले विष याँरे ना करिल बल ॥75॥
cc-adi-10.75.translation: Garuḍa Paṇḍita, the thirty-seventh branch of the tree, always engaged in chanting the auspicious name of the Lord. Because of the strength of this chanting, even the effects of poison could not touch him.

lines: akrūra bali' prabhu yāṅre kailā parihāsa
devanagari: गोपीनाथ सिंह - एक चैतन्येर दास ।
अकूर बलि’ प्रभु याँरे कैला परिहास ॥76॥
cc-adi-10.76.translation: Gopīnātha Siṁha, the thirty-eighth branch of the tree, was a faithful servant of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord jokingly addressed him as Akrūra.

devanagari: भागवती देवानन्द वक्रेश्वर - कृपाते ।
भागवतेर भक्ति - अर्थ पाइल प्रभु हैते ॥77॥
cc-adi-10.77.translation: Devānanda Paṇḍita was a professional reciter of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, but by the mercy of Vakreśvara Paṇḍita and the grace of the Lord he understood the devotional interpretation of the Bhāgavatam.

devanagari: खण्डवासी मुकुन्द - दास, श्री - रघुनन्दन ।
नरहरि - दास, चिरञ्जीव, सुलोचन ॥78॥
cc-adi-10.78-79.translation: Śrī Khaṇḍavāsī Mukunda and his son Raghunandana were the thirty-ninth branch of the tree, Narahari was the fortieth, Cirañjīva the forty-first and Sulocana the forty-second. They were all big branches of the all-merciful tree of Caitanya Mahāprabhu. They distributed the fruits and flowers of love of Godhead anywhere and everywhere.

devanagari: श्रीवास पण्डित, आर श्री - राम पण्डित ।
दुइ भाइ - दुइ शाखा, जगते विदित ॥8॥
cc-adi-10.8.translation: The two brothers Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita and Śrī Rāma Paṇḍita started two branches that are well known in the world.

devanagari: कुलीनग्राम - वासी सत्यराज, रामानन्द ।
यदुनाथ, पुरुषोत्तम, शङ्कर, विद्यानन्द ॥80॥
cc-adi-10.80.translation: Satyarāja, Rāmānanda, Yadunātha, Puruṣottama, Śaṅkara and Vidyānanda all belonged to the twentieth branch. They were inhabitants of the village known as Kulīna-grāma.

lines: vāṇīnātha vasu ādi yata grāmī jana
devanagari: वाणीनाथ वसु आदि यत ग्रामी जन ।
सबेइ चैतन्य - भृत्य, - चैतन्य - प्राणधन ॥81॥
cc-adi-10.81.translation: All the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma village, headed by Vāṇīnātha Vasu, were servants of Lord Caitanya, who was their only life and wealth.

lines: prabhu kahe, kulīnagrāmera ye haya kukkura
sei mora priya, anya jana rahu dūra
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, कुलीनग्रामेर ये हय कुकुर ।
सेइ मोर प्रिय, अन्य जन रहु दूर ॥82॥
cc-adi-10.82.translation: The Lord said, "Not to speak of others, even a dog in the village of Kulīna-grāma is My dear friend.

lines: śūkara carāya ḍoma, seha kṛṣṇa gāya
devanagari: कुलीनग्रामीर भाग्य कहने ना याय ।
शूकर चराय डोम, सेह कृष्ण गाय ॥83॥
cc-adi-10.83.translation: "No one can describe the fortunate position of Kulīna-grāma. It is so sublime that even sweepers who tend their hogs there also chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra."

lines: ei tina śākhā vṛkṣera paścime sarvottama
devanagari: अनुपम - वल्लभ, श्री - रूप, सनातन ।
एइ तिन शाखा वृक्षेर पश्चिमे सर्वोत्तम ॥84॥
cc-adi-10.84.translation: On the western side were the forty-third, forty-fourth and forty-fifth branches-Śrī Sanātana, Śrī Rūpa and Anupama. They were the best of all.

devanagari: ताँर मध्ये रूप - सनातन - बड़ शाखा ।
अनुपम, जीव, राजेन्द्रादि उपशाखा ॥85॥
cc-adi-10.85.translation: Among these branches, Rūpa and Sanātana were principal. Anupama, Jīva Gosvāmī and others, headed by Rājendra, were their sub-branches.

devanagari: मालीर इच्छाय शाखा बहुत बाड़िल ।
बाड़िया पश्चिम देश सब आच्छादिल ॥86॥
cc-adi-10.86.translation: By the will of the supreme gardener, the branches of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī grew many times over, expanding throughout the western countries and covering the entire region.

devanagari: आ - सिन्धुनदी - तीर आर हिमालय ।
वृन्दावन - मथुरादि यत तीर्थ हय ॥87॥
cc-adi-10.87.translation: Extending to the borders of the river Sindhu and the Himalayan Mountain valleys, they expanded throughout India, including all the places of pilgrimage, such as Vṛndāvana, Mathurā and Haridvāra.

devanagari: दुई शाखार प्रेम - फले सकल भासिल ।
प्रेम - फलास्वादे लोक उन्मत्त हइल ॥88॥
cc-adi-10.88.translation: The fruits of love of Godhead which fructified on these two branches were distributed in abundance. Tasting these fruits, everyone became mad after them.

devanagari: पश्चिमेर लोक सब मूढ़ अनाचार ।
ताहाँ प्रचारिल दोंहे भक्ति - सदाचार ॥89॥
cc-adi-10.89.translation: The people in general on the western side of India were neither intelligent nor well behaved, but by the influence of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī they were trained in devotional service and good behavior.

devanagari: श्रीपति, श्रीनिधि - ताँर दुइ सहोदर ।
चारि भाइर दास - दासी, गृह - परिकर ॥9॥
cc-adi-10.9.translation: Their two brothers were named Śrīpati and Śrīnidhi. These four brothers and their servants and maidservants are considered one big branch.

devanagari: शास्त्र - दृष्ट्ये कैल लुप्त - तीर्थेर उद्धार ।
वृन्दावने कैल श्रीमूर्ति - सेवार प्रचार ॥90॥
cc-adi-10.90.translation: In accordance with the directions of the revealed scriptures, both Gosvāmīs excavated the lost places of pilgrimage and inaugurated the worship of Deities in Vṛndāvana.

lines: sarva tyaji' kaila prabhura pada-tale vāsa
devanagari: महाप्रभुर प्रिय भृत्य रघुनाथ - दास ।
सर्व त्यजि’ कैल प्रभुर पद - तले वास ॥91॥
cc-adi-10.91.translation: Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, the forty-sixth branch of the tree, was one of the most dear servants of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He left all his material possessions to surrender completely unto the Lord and live at His lotus feet.

devanagari: प्रभु समर्पिल ताँरे स्वरूपेर हाते ।
प्रभुर गुप्त - सेवा कैल स्वरूपेर सा थे ॥92॥
cc-adi-10.92.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī approached Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī, the Lord entrusted him to the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara, His secretary. Thus they both engaged in the confidential service of the Lord.

devanagari: षोड़श वत्सर कैल अन्तरङ्ग - सेवन ।
स्वरूपेर अन्तर्धाने आइला वृन्दावन ॥93॥
cc-adi-10.93.translation: He rendered confidential service to the Lord for sixteen years at Jagannātha Purī, and after the disappearance of both the Lord and Svarūpa Dāmodara, he left Jagannātha Purī and went to Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: वृन्दावने दुइ भाइर चरण देखियो ।
गोवर्धने त्यजिब देह भृगुपात करिया ॥94॥
cc-adi-10.94.translation: Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī intended to go to Vṛndāvana to see the lotus feet of Rūpa and Sanātana and then give up his life by jumping from Govardhana Hill.

lines: ei ta' niścaya kari' āila vṛndāvane
devanagari: एइ त निश्चय क रि’ आइल वृन्दावने ।
आसि’ रूप - सनातनेर वन्दिल चरणे ॥95॥
cc-adi-10.95.translation: Thus Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī came to Vṛndāvana, visited Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī and offered them his obeisances.

lines: tabe dui bhāi tāṅre marite nā dila
nija tṛtīya bhāi kari' nikaṭe rākhila
devanagari: तबे दुइ भाइ ताँरे मरिते ना दिल ।
निज तृतीय भाइ करि’ निकटे राखिल ॥96॥
cc-adi-10.96.translation: These two brothers, however, did not allow him to die. They accepted him as their third brother and kept him in their company.

lines: dui bhāi tāṅra mukhe śune nirantara
devanagari: महाप्रभुर लीला यत बाहिर - अन्तर ।
दुइ भाइ ताँर मुखे शुने निरन्तर ॥97॥
cc-adi-10.97.translation: Because Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī was an assistant to Svarūpa Dāmodara, he knew much about the external and internal features of the pastimes of Lord Caitanya. Thus the two brothers Rūpa and Sanātana always used to hear of this from him.

devanagari: अन्न - जल त्याग कैल अन्य - कथन ।
पल दुइ - तिन माठा करेन भक्षण ॥98॥
cc-adi-10.98.translation: Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī gradually gave up all food and drink but a few drops of buttermilk.

lines: sahasra daṇḍavat kare, laya lakṣa nāma
devanagari: सहस्त्र दण्डवत्करे, लय लक्ष नाम ।
दुइ सहस्र वैष्णवेरे नित्य परणाम ॥99॥
cc-adi-10.99.translation: As a daily duty, he regularly offered one thousand obeisances to the Lord, chanted at least one hundred thousand holy names and offered obeisances to two thousand Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - पदाम्भो ज - भृङ्गान्प्रेम - मधून्मदान् ।
नत्वाखिलान्तेषु मुख्या लिख्यन्ते कतिचिन्मया ॥1॥
cc-adi-11.1.translation: After offering my obeisances unto all of the devotees of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, who are like bumblebees collecting honey from His lotus feet, I shall try to describe those who are the most prominent.

devanagari: अन्तरे ईश्वर - चेष्टा, बाहिरे निर्दम्भ ।
चैतन्य - भक्ति - मण्डपे तेंहो मूल - स्तम्भ ॥10॥
cc-adi-11.10.translation: He is the main pillar in the hall of devotional service erected by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He knew within Himself that He acted as the Supreme Lord Viṣṇu, but externally He was prideless.

devanagari: अद्यापि याँहार कृपा - महिमा हइते ।
चैतन्य - नित्यानन्द गाय सकल जगते ॥11॥
cc-adi-11.11.translation: It is by the glorious mercy of Śrī Vīrabhadra Gosāñi that people all over the world now have the chance to chant the names of Caitanya and Nityānanda.

devanagari: सेइ वीरभद्र - गोसाञि र लइनु शरण ।
याँहार प्रसादे हय अभीष्ट - पूरण ॥12॥
cc-adi-11.12.translation: I therefore take shelter of the lotus feet of Vīrabhadra Gosāñi so that by His mercy my great desire to write Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta will be properly guided.

devanagari: श्री रामदास आर, गदाधर दास ।
चैतन्य - गोसाञि र भक्त रहे ताँर पाश ॥13॥
cc-adi-11.13.translation: Two devotees of Lord Caitanya, named Śrī Rāmadāsa and Gadādhara dāsa, always lived with Śrī Vīrabhadra Gosāñi.

lines: nityānande ājñā dila yabe gauḍe yāite
mahāprabhu ei dui dilā tāṅra sāthe
devanagari: नित्यानन्दे आज्ञा दिल यबे गौड़े याइते ।
महाप्रभु एइ दुइ दिला ताँर साथे ॥14॥
cc-adi-11.14-15.translation: When Nityānanda Prabhu was ordered to go to Bengal to preach, these two devotees [Śrī Rāmadāsa and Gadādhara dāsa] were ordered to go with Him. Thus they are sometimes counted among the devotees of Lord Caitanya and sometimes among the devotees of Lord Nityānanda. Similarly, Mādhava and Vāsudeva Ghosh belonged to both groups of devotees simultaneously.

lines: ṣolasāṅgera kāṣṭha yei tuli' kaila vaṁśī
devanagari: रामदास - मुख्य - शाखा, सख्य - प्रेम - राशि ।
षोलसाङ्गेर काष्ठ येइ तुलि’ कैल वंशी ॥16॥
cc-adi-11.16.translation: Rāmadāsa, one of the chief branches, was full of fraternal love of Godhead. He made a flute from a stick with sixteen knots.

devanagari: गदाधर दास गोपीभावे पूर्णानन्द ।
याँर घरे दानकेलि कैल नित्यानन्द ॥17॥
cc-adi-11.17.translation: Śrīla Gadādhara dāsa was always fully absorbed in ecstasy as a gopī. In his house Lord Nityānanda enacted the drama Dānakeli.

devanagari: श्री - माधव घोष - मुख्य कीर्तनीया - गणे ।
नित्यानन्द - प्रभु नृत्य करे याँर गाने ॥18॥
cc-adi-11.18.translation: Śrī Mādhava Ghoṣa was a principal performer of kīrtana. While he sang, Nityānanda Prabhu danced.

devanagari: वासुदेव गीते करे प्रभुर वर्णने ।
काष्ठ - पाषाण द्रवे याहार श्रवणे ॥19॥
cc-adi-11.19.translation: When Vāsudeva Ghoṣa performed kīrtana, describing Lord Caitanya and Nityānanda, even wood and stone would melt upon hearing it.

devanagari: जय जय महाप्रभु श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य ।
ताँहार चरणाश्रित येइ, सेइ धन्य ॥2॥
cc-adi-11.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! Anyone who has taken shelter at His lotus feet is glorious.

devanagari: मुरारि - चैतन्य - दासेर अलौकिक लीला ।
व्याघ्र - गाले चड़ मारे, सर्प - सने खेला ॥20॥
cc-adi-11.20.translation: There were many extraordinary activities performed by Murāri, a great devotee of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Sometimes in his ecstasy he would slap the cheek of a tiger, and sometimes he would play with a venomous snake.

devanagari: नित्यानन्देर गण यत - सब व्रज - सखा ।
शृङ्ग - वेत्र - गोपवेश, शिरे शिखि - पाखा ॥21॥
cc-adi-11.21.translation: All the associates of Lord Nityānanda were formerly cowherd boys in Vrajabhūmi. Their symbolic representations were the horns and sticks they carried, their cowherd dress and the peacock plumes on their heads.

devanagari: रघुनाथ वैद्य उपाध्याय महाशय ।
याँहार दर्शने कृष्ण - प्रेम - भक्ति हय ॥22॥
cc-adi-11.22.translation: The physician Raghunātha, also known as Upādhyāya, was so great a devotee that simply seeing him would awaken one's dormant love of Godhead.

devanagari: सुन्दरानन्द - नित्यानन्देर शाखा, भृत्य मर्म ।
याँर सङ्गे नित्यानन्द करे व्रज - नर्म ॥23॥
cc-adi-11.23.translation: Sundarānanda, another branch of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, was Lord Nityānanda's most intimate servant. Lord Nityānanda Prabhu perceived the life of Vrajabhūmi in his company.

devanagari: कमलाकर पिप्पलाइ - अलौकिक रीत ।
अलौकिक प्रेम ताँर भुवने विदित ॥24॥
cc-adi-11.24.translation: Kamalākara Pippalāi is said to have been the third gopāla. His behavior and love of Godhead were uncommon, and thus he is celebrated all over the world.

devanagari: सूर्यदास सरखेल, ताँर भाइ कृष्णदास ।
नित्यानन्दे दृढ़ विश्वास, प्रेमेर निवास ॥25॥
cc-adi-11.25.translation: Sūryadāsa Sarakhela and his younger brother Kṛṣṇadāsa Sarakhela both possessed firm faith in Nityānanda Prabhu. They were a reservoir of love of Godhead.

devanagari: गौरीदास पण्डित याँर प्रेमोद्दण्ड - भक्ति ।
कृष्ण - प्रेमा दिते, निते, धरे महाशक्ति ॥26॥
cc-adi-11.26.translation: Gaurīdāsa Paṇḍita, the emblem of the most elevated devotional service in love of Godhead, had the greatest potency to receive and deliver such love.

devanagari: नित्यानन्दे समर्पिल जाति - कुल - पाँति ।
श्री - चैतन्य - नित्यानन्दे करि प्राणपति ॥27॥
cc-adi-11.27.translation: Making Lord Caitanya and Lord Nityānanda the Lords of his life, Gaurīdāsa Paṇḍita sacrificed everything for the service of Lord Nityānanda, even the fellowship of his own family.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द प्रभुर प्रिय - पण्डित पुरन्दर ।
प्रेमार्णव - मध्ये फिरे यैछन मन्दर ॥28॥
cc-adi-11.28.translation: The thirteenth important devotee of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu was Paṇḍita Purandara, who moved in the ocean of love of Godhead just like the Mandara Hill.

lines: kṛṣṇa-bhakti pāya, tāṅre ye kare smaraṇa
devanagari: परमेश्वर - दास - नित्यानन्दैक - शरण ।
कृष्ण - भक्ति पाय, ताँरे ये करे स्मरण ॥29॥
cc-adi-11.29.translation: Parameśvara dāsa, said to be the fifth gopāla of kṛṣṇa-līlā, completely surrendered to the lotus feet of Nityānanda. Anyone who remembers his name, Parameśvara dāsa, will get love of Kṛṣṇa very easily.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - अद्वैत, जय नित्यानन्द ।
जय जय महाप्रभुर सर्व - भक्त - वृन्द ॥3॥
cc-adi-11.3.translation: All glories to Śrī Advaita Prabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu and all the devotees of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

devanagari: जगदीश पण्डित हय जगत्पावन ।
कृष्ण - प्रेमामृत वर्षे, येन वर्षा घन ॥30॥
cc-adi-11.30.translation: Jagadīśa Paṇḍita, the fifteenth branch of Lord Nityānanda's followers, was the deliverer of the entire world. Devotional love of Kṛṣṇa showered from him like torrents of rain.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - प्रियभृत्य पण्डित धनञ्जय ।
अत्यन्त विरक्त, सदा कृष्ण - प्रेममयं ॥31॥
cc-adi-11.31.translation: The sixteenth dear servant of Nityānanda Prabhu was Dhanañjaya Paṇḍita. He was very much renounced and always merged in love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: महेश पण्डित - व्रजेर उदार गोपाल ।
ढक्का - वाद्ये नृत्य करे प्रेमे मातोयाल ॥32॥
cc-adi-11.32.translation: Maheśa Paṇḍita, the seventh of the twelve gopālas, was very liberal. In great love of Kṛṣṇa he danced to the beating of a kettledrum like a madman.

devanagari: नवद्वीपे पुरुषोत्तम पण्डित महाशय ।
नित्यानन्द - नामे याँर महोन्माद हय ॥33॥
cc-adi-11.33.translation: Puruṣottama Paṇḍita, a resident of Navadvīpa, was the eighth gopāla. He would become almost mad as soon as he heard the holy name of Nityānanda Prabhu.

devanagari: बलराम दास - कृष्ण - प्रेम - रसास्वादी ।
नित्यानन्द - नामे हय परम उन्मादी ॥34॥
cc-adi-11.34.translation: Balarāma dāsa always fully tasted the nectar of love of Kṛṣṇa. Upon hearing the name of Nityānanda Prabhu, he would become greatly maddened.

devanagari: महा - भागवत यदुनाथ कविचन्द्र ।
याँहार हृदये नृत्य करे नित्यानन्द ॥35॥
cc-adi-11.35.translation: Yadunātha Kavicandra was a great devotee. Lord Nityānanda Prabhu always danced in his heart.

devanagari: राढ़े याँर जन्म कृष्णदास द्विजवर ।
श्री - नित्यानन्देर तेंहो परम कि ङ्कर ॥36॥
cc-adi-11.36.translation: The twenty-first devotee of Śrī Nityānanda in Bengal was Kṛṣṇadāsa Brāhmaṇa, who was a first-class servant of the Lord.

devanagari: काला - कृष्णदास बड़ वैष्णव - प्रधान ।
नित्यानन्द - चन्द्र विनु नहि जाने आन ॥37॥
cc-adi-11.37.translation: The twenty-second devotee of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu was Kālā Kṛṣṇadāsa, who was the ninth cowherd boy. He was a first-class Vaiṣṇava and did not know anything beyond Nityānanda Prabhu.

devanagari: श्री - सदाशिव कविराज - बड़ महाशय ।
श्री - पुरुषोत्तम - दास - ताँहार तन य ॥38॥
cc-adi-11.38.translation: The twenty-third and twenty-fourth prominent devotees of Nityānanda Prabhu were Sadāśiva Kavirāja and his son Puruṣottama dāsa, who was the tenth gopāla.

devanagari: आजन्म निमग्न नित्यानन्देर चरणे ।
निरन्तर बाल्य - लीला करे कृष्ण - सने ॥39॥
cc-adi-11.39.translation: Since birth, Puruṣottama dāsa was merged in the service of the lotus feet of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, and he always engaged in childish play with Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: तस्य श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य - सत्प्रेमामर - शाखिनः ।
ऊर्ध्व - स्कन्धावधूतेन्दोः शाखा - रूपान्गणान्नुमः ॥4॥
cc-adi-11.4.translation: Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu is the topmost branch of the indestructible tree of eternal love of Godhead, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu. I offer my respectful obeisances to all the sub-branches of that topmost branch.

devanagari: ताँर पुत्र - महाशय श्री - कानु ठाकुर ।
याँर देहे रहे कृष्ण - प्रेमामृत - पूर ॥40॥
cc-adi-11.40.translation: Śrī Kānu Ṭhākura, a very respectable gentleman, was the son of Puruṣottama dāsa Ṭhākura. He was such a great devotee that Lord Kṛṣṇa always lived in his body.

devanagari: महा - भागवत - श्रेष्ठ दत्त उद्धारण ।
सर्व - भावे सेवे नित्यानन्देर चरण ॥41॥
cc-adi-11.41.translation: Uddhāraṇa Datta Ṭhākura, the eleventh among the twelve cowherd boys, was an exalted devotee of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu. He worshiped the lotus feet of Lord Nityānanda in all respects.

devanagari: आचा र्य वैष्णवानन्द भक्ति - अधिकारी ।
पूर्वे नाम छिल याँर रघुनाथ पुरी’ ॥42॥
cc-adi-11.42.translation: The twenty-seventh prominent devotee of Nityānanda Prabhu was Ācārya Vaiṣṇavānanda, a great personality in devotional service. He was formerly known as Raghunātha Purī.

lines: pūrve yāṅra ghare chilā ṭhākura nitāi
devanagari: विष्णुदास, नन्दन, गङ्गादास - तिन भाइ ।
पूर्वे याँर घरे छिला ठाकुर निताई ॥43॥
cc-adi-11.43.translation: Another important devotee of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu was Viṣṇudāsa, who had two brothers, Nandana and Gaṅgādāsa. Lord Nityānanda Prabhu sometimes stayed at their house.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - भृत्य - परमानन्द उपाध्याय ।
श्री - जीव पण्डित नित्यानन्द - गुण गाय ॥44॥
cc-adi-11.44.translation: Paramānanda Upādhyāya was Nityānanda Prabhu's great servitor. Śrī Jīva Paṇḍita glorified the qualities of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu.

devanagari: परमानन्द गुप्त - कृष्ण - भक्त महामती ।
पूर्वे याँर घरे नित्यानन्देर वसति ॥45॥
cc-adi-11.45.translation: The thirty-first devotee of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu was Paramānanda Gupta, who was greatly devoted to Lord Kṛṣṇa and highly advanced in spiritual consciousness. Formerly Nityānanda Prabhu also resided at his house for some time.

devanagari: नारायण, कृष्णदास आर मनोहर ।
देवानन्द - चारि भाइ निताइ - किङ्कर ॥46॥
cc-adi-11.46.translation: The thirty-second, thirty-third, thirty-fourth and thirty-fifth prominent devotees were Nārāyaṇa, Kṛṣṇadāsa, Manohara and Devānanda, who always engaged in the service of Lord Nityānanda.

devanagari: होड़ कृष्णदास - नित्यानन्द - प्रभु - प्राण ।
नित्यानन्द - पद विनु नाहि जाने आन ॥47॥
cc-adi-11.47.translation: The thirty-sixth devotee of Lord Nityānanda was Hoḍa Kṛṣṇadāsa, whose life and soul was Nityānanda Prabhu. He was always dedicated to the lotus feet of Nityānanda, and he knew no one else but Him.

devanagari: नकड़ि, मुकुन्द, सूर्य, माधव, श्रीधर ।
रामानन्द वसु, जगन्नाथ, महीधर ॥48॥
cc-adi-11.48.translation: Among Lord Nityānanda's devotees, Nakaḍi was the thirty-seventh, Mukunda the thirty-eighth, Sūrya the thirty-ninth, Mādhava the fortieth, Śrīdhara the forty-first, Rāmānanda the forty-second, Jagannātha the forty-third and Mahīdhara the forty-fourth.

devanagari: श्रीमन्त, गोकुल - दास हरिहरानन्द ।
शिवाइ, नन्दाइ, अवधूत परमानन्द ॥49॥
cc-adi-11.49.translation: Śrīmanta was the forty-fifth, Gokula dāsa the forty-sixth, Hariharānanda the forty-seventh, Śivāi the forty-eighth, Nandāi the forty-ninth and Paramānanda the fiftieth.

devanagari: श्री - नित्यानन्द - वृक्षेर स्कन्ध गुरुतर ।
ताहाते जन्मिल शाखा - प्रशाखा विस्तर ॥5॥
cc-adi-11.5.translation: Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu is an extremely heavy branch of the Śrī Caitanya tree. From that branch grow many branches and sub-branches.

devanagari: वसन्त, नवनी होड़, गोपाल, सनातन ।
विष्णाइ हाजरा, कृष्णानन्द, सुलोचन ॥50॥
cc-adi-11.50.translation: Vasanta was the fifty-first, Navanī Hoḍa the fifty-second, Gopāla the fifty-third, Sanātana the fifty-fourth, Viṣṇāi the fifty-fifth, Kṛṣṇānanda the fifty-sixth and Sulocana the fifty-seventh.

devanagari: कंसारि सेन, रामसेन, रामचन्द्र कविराज ।
गोविन्द, श्रीरङ्ग, मुकुन्द, तिन कविराज ॥51॥
cc-adi-11.51.translation: The fifty-eighth great devotee of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu was Kaṁsāri Sena, the fifty-ninth was Rāmasena, the sixtieth was Rāmacandra Kavirāja, and the sixty-first, sixty-second and sixty-third were Govinda, Śrīraṅga and Mukunda, who were all physicians.

devanagari: पीताम्बर, माधवाचार्य, दास दामोदर ।
शङ्कर, मुकुन्द, ज्ञान - दास, मनोहर ॥52॥
cc-adi-11.52.translation: Among the devotees of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, Pītāmbara was the sixty-fourth, Mādhavācārya the sixty-fifth, Dāmodara dāsa the sixty-sixth, Śaṅkara the sixty-seventh, Mukunda the sixty-eighth, Jñāna dāsa the sixty-ninth and Manohara the seventieth.

devanagari: नर्तक गोपाल, रामभद्र, गौराङ्ग - दास ।
नृसिंह - चैतन्य, मीनकेतन रामदास ॥53॥
cc-adi-11.53.translation: The dancer Gopāla was the seventy-first, Rāmabhadra the seventy-second, Gaurāṅga dāsa the seventy-third, Nṛsiṁha-caitanya the seventy-fourth and Mīnaketana Rāmadāsa the seventy-fifth.

devanagari: वृन्दावन - दास - नारायणीर नन्दन ।
‘चैतन्य - मङ्गल’ येंहो करिल रचन ॥54॥
cc-adi-11.54.translation: Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, the son of Śrīmatī Nārāyaṇī, composed Śrī Caitanya-maṅgala [later known as Śrī Caitanya-bhāgavata].

devanagari: भागवते कृष्ण - लीला वर्णिला वेदव्यास ।
चैतन्य - लीलाते व्यास - वृन्दावन दास ॥55॥
cc-adi-11.55.translation: Śrīla Vyāsadeva described the pastimes of Kṛṣṇa in Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. The Vyāsa of the pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu was Vṛndāvana dāsa.

lines: tāṅra upaśākhā yata, tāra anta nāi
devanagari: सर्वशाखा - श्रेष्ठ वीरभद्र गोसाञि ।
ताँर उपशाखा यत, तार अन्त नाइ ॥56॥
cc-adi-11.56.translation: Among all the branches of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, Vīrabhadra Gosāñi was the topmost. His sub-branches were unlimited.

devanagari: अनन्त नित्यानन्द - गण - के करु गणन ।
आत्म - पवित्रता - हेतु लिखिलाँ कत जन ॥57॥
cc-adi-11.57.translation: No one can count the unlimited followers of Nityānanda Prabhu. I have mentioned some of them just for my self-purification.

lines: yāre dekhe, tāre diyā bhāsāila sakale
devanagari: एइ सर्व - शाखा पूर्ण पक्व प्रेम - फले ।
यारे देखे, तारे दिया भा साइल सकले ॥58॥
cc-adi-11.58.translation: All these branches, the devotees of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, being full of ripened fruits of love of Kṛṣṇa, distributed these fruits to all they met, flooding them with love of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: prema dite, kṛṣṇa dite dhare mahābala
devanagari: अनर्गल प्रेम सबार, चेष्टा अनर्गल ।
प्रेम दिते, कृष्ण दिते धरे महाबल ॥59॥
cc-adi-11.59.translation: All these devotees had unlimited strength to deliver unobstructed, unceasing love of Kṛṣṇa. By their own strength they could offer anyone Kṛṣṇa and love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: मालाकारेर इच्छा जले बाड़े शाखा - गण ।
प्रेम - फुल - फले भरि’ छाइल भुवन ॥6॥
cc-adi-11.6.translation: Watered by the desire of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, these branches and sub-branches have grown unlimitedly and covered the entire world with fruits and flowers.

devanagari: सङ्क्षेपे कहिलाँ एइ नित्यानन्द - गण ।
याँहार अवधि ना पाय ‘सहस्र - वदन’ ॥60॥
cc-adi-11.60.translation: I have briefly described only some of the followers and devotees of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu. Even the thousand-mouthed Śeṣa Nāga cannot describe all of these unlimited devotees.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥61॥
cc-adi-11.61.translation: With an ardent desire to serve the purpose of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: asaṅkhya ananta gaṇa ke karu gaṇana
āpanā śodhite kahi mukhya mukhya jana
devanagari: असङ्ख्य अनन्त गण के करु गणन ।
आपना शोधिते कहि मुख्य मुख्य जन ॥7॥
cc-adi-11.7.translation: These branches and sub-branches of devotees are innumerable and unlimited. Who could count them? For my personal purification I shall try to enumerate only the most prominent among them.

lines: tāṅra upaśākhā yata, asaṅkhya tāra lekhā
devanagari: श्री - वीरभद्र गोसाञि स्कन्ध - महाशाखा ।
ताँर उपशाखा व्रत, असङ्ख्य तार लेखा ॥8॥
cc-adi-11.8.translation: After Nityānanda Prabhu, the greatest branch is Vīrabhadra Gosāñi, who also has innumerable branches and sub-branches. It is not possible to describe them all.

devanagari: ईश्वर हइया कहाय महा - भागवत ।
वेद - धर्मातीत ह ञा वेद - धर्मे रत ॥9॥
cc-adi-11.9.translation: Although Vīrabhadra Gosāñi was the Supreme Personality of Godhead, He presented Himself as a great devotee. And although the Supreme Godhead is transcendental to all Vedic injunctions, He strictly followed the Vedic rituals.

devanagari: अद्वैताङ्घ्यब्ज - भृङ्गस्तान्सारासार - भृतोऽखिलान् ।
हित्वासारान्सार - भृतो नौमि चैतन्य - जीवनान् ॥1॥
cc-adi-12.1.translation: The followers of Śrī Advaita Prabhu were of two kinds. Some were real followers, and the others were false. Rejecting the false followers, I offer my respectful obeisances to the real followers of Śrī Advaita Ācārya whose life and soul were Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: ācāryera mata yei, sei mata sāra
tāṅra ājñā laṅghi' cale, sei ta' asāra
devanagari: आचार्गेर मत येइ, सेइ मत सार ।
ताँर आज्ञा लङ्घि’ चले, सेइ त’ असार ॥10॥
cc-adi-12.10.translation: The order of the spiritual master is the active principle in spiritual life. Anyone who disobeys the order of the spiritual master immediately becomes useless.

devanagari: असारेर नामे इहाँ नाहि प्रयोजन ।
भेद जानिबारे करि एकत्र गणन ॥11॥
cc-adi-12.11.translation: There is no need to name those who are useless. I have mentioned them only to distinguish them from the useful devotees.

devanagari: धान्य - राशि मापे यैछे पात्ना सहिते ।
पश्चाते पात्ना उड़ाञा संस्कार करिते ॥12॥
cc-adi-12.12.translation: Paddy is mixed with straw at first, and one must fan it to separate the paddy from the straw.

devanagari: अच्युतानन्द - बड़ शाखा, आचार्य - नन्दन ।
आजन्म सेविला तेंहो चैतन्य - चरण ॥13॥
cc-adi-12.13.translation: A big branch of Advaita Ācārya was Acyutānanda, His son. From the beginning of his life he engaged in the service of the lotus feet of Lord Caitanya.

lines: ei pitāra vākya śuni' duḥkha pāila ati
devanagari: चैतन्य गोसाञि र गुरु - केशव भारती ।
एइ पितार वाक्य शुनि’ दुःख पाइल अति ॥14॥
cc-adi-12.14.translation: When Acyutānanda heard from his father that Keśava Bhāratī was the spiritual master of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he was very unhappy.

lines: tomāra ei upadeśe naṣṭa ha-ila deśa
devanagari: जगद्गुरुते तुमि कर ऐछे उपदेश ।
तोमार एइ उपदेशे नष्ट हइल देश ॥15॥
cc-adi-12.15.translation: He told his father, "Your instruction that Keśava Bhāratī is the spiritual master of Caitanya Mahāprabhu will spoil the entire country.

lines: tāṅra guru—anya, ei kona śāstre nāi
devanagari: चौद्द भुवनेर गुरु - चैतन्य - गोसाञि ।
ताँर गुरु - अन्य, एइ कोन शास्त्रे नाइ ॥16॥
cc-adi-12.16.translation: "Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the spiritual master of the fourteen worlds, but You say that someone else is His spiritual master. This is not supported by any revealed scripture."

lines: pañcama varṣera bālaka kahe siddhāntera sāra
devanagari: पञ्चम वर्षेर बालक कहे सिद्धान्तेर सार ।
शुनिया पाइला आचार्य सन्तोष अपार ॥17॥
cc-adi-12.17.translation: When Advaita Ācārya heard this statement from His five-year-old son Acyutānanda, He felt great satisfaction because of his conclusive judgement.

devanagari: कृष्ण - मिश्र - नाम आर आचार्य - तनय ।
चैतन्य - गोसाञि बैसे याँहार हृदय ॥18॥
cc-adi-12.18.translation: Kṛṣṇa Miśra was a son of Advaita Ācārya. Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu always sat in his heart.

devanagari: श्री - गोपाल - नामे आर आचार्गेर सुत ।
ताँहार चरित्र, शुन, अत्यन्त अद्भुत ॥19॥
cc-adi-12.19.translation: Śrī Gopāla was another son of Śrī Advaita Ācārya Prabhu. Now just hear about his characteristics, for they are all very wonderful.

devanagari: जय जय महाप्रभु श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य ।
जय जय नित्यानन्द जयाद्वैत धन्य ॥2॥
cc-adi-12.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Śrī Advaita Prabhu! All of Them are glorious.

devanagari: गुण्डिचा - मन्दिरे महाप्रभुर सम्मुखे ।
कीर्तने नर्तन करे बड़ प्रेम - सुखे ॥20॥
cc-adi-12.20.translation: When Lord Caitanya personally cleansed the Guṇḍicā-mandira in Jagannātha Purī, Gopāla danced in front of the Lord with great love and happiness.

devanagari: नाना - भावोद्गम देहे अद्भुत नर्तन ।
दुइ गोसाञि ‘हरि’ बले, आनन्दित मन ॥21॥
cc-adi-12.21.translation: While Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Advaita Prabhu danced and chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, there were various ecstatic symptoms in Their bodies, and Their minds were very pleased.

devanagari: नाचिते नाचिते गोपाल हइल मूर्च्छित ।
भूमेते पड़िल, देहे नाहिक संवित ॥22॥
cc-adi-12.22.translation: While all of them danced, Gopāla, dancing and dancing, fainted and fell to the ground unconscious.

lines: duḥkhita ha-ilā ācārya putra kole lañā
devanagari: दुःखित हइला आचार्य पुत्र कोले लञा ।
रक्षा करे नृसिंहेर मन्त्र पड़िया ॥23॥
cc-adi-12.23.translation: Advaita Ācārya Prabhu became very unhappy. Taking His son on His lap, He began to chant the Nṛsiṁha mantra for his protection.

lines: nānā mantra paḍena ācārya, nā haya cetana
devanagari: नाना मन्त्र पड़ेन आचार्य, ना हय चेतन ।
आचार्सेर दुःखे वैष्णव करेन क्रन्दन ॥24॥
cc-adi-12.24.translation: Advaita Ācārya chanted various mantras, but Gopāla did not come to consciousness. Thus all the Vaiṣṇavas present cried in sorrow at His plight.

lines: tabe mahāprabhu, tāṅra hṛde hasta dhari'
devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु, ताँर हृदे हस्त ध रि’ ।
‘उठह, गोपाल ,’ कैल बल ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ॥25॥
cc-adi-12.25.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu then put His hand on the chest of Gopāla and told him, "My dear Gopāla, get up and chant the holy name of the Lord!"

devanagari: उठिल गोपाल प्रभुर स्पर्श - ध्वनि शुनि’ ।
आनन्दित ह ञा सबे करे हरि - ध्वनि ॥26॥
cc-adi-12.26.translation: When he heard this sound and felt the touch of the Lord, Gopāla immediately got up, and all the Vaiṣṇavas chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra in jubilation.

devanagari: आचार आर पुत्र - श्री - बलराम ।
आर पुत्र - ‘स्वरूप’ - शाखा, जगदी श’ नाम ॥27॥
cc-adi-12.27.translation: The other sons of Advaita Ācārya were Śrī Balarāma, Svarūpa and Jagadīśa.

devanagari: ‘कमलाकान्त विश्वास’ - नाम आचार्य - किङ्कर ।
आचार्य - व्यवहार सब - ताँहार गोचर ॥28॥
cc-adi-12.28.translation: Advaita Ācārya's very confidential servant named Kamalākānta Viśvāsa knew all the dealings of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: नीलाचले तेंहो एक पत्रिका लिखिया ।
प्रतापरुद्रेर पाश दिल पाठाइया ॥29॥
cc-adi-12.29.translation: When Kamalākānta Viśvāsa was in Jagannātha Purī, he sent a note through someone to Mahārāja Pratāparudra.

devanagari: श्री - चैतन्यामर - तरोद्वितीय - स्कन्ध - रूपिणः ।
श्रीमदद्वैत - चन्द्रस्य शाखा - रूपान्गणान्नुमः ॥3॥
cc-adi-12.3.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances to the all-glorious Advaita Prabhu, who forms the second branch of the eternal Caitanya tree, and to His followers, who form His sub-branches.

lines: sei patrīra kathā ācārya nāhi jāne
kona pāke sei patrī āila prabhu-sthāne
devanagari: सेइ पत्रीर कथा आचार्य नाहि जाने ।
कोन पाके सेइ पत्री आइल प्रभु - स्थाने ॥30॥
cc-adi-12.30.translation: No one knew of that note, but somehow or other it reached the hands of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: se patrīte lekhā āche—ei ta' likhana
devanagari: से पत्रीते लेखा आछे - एइ त’ लिखन ।
ईश्वरत्वे आचार्येरे करियाछे स्थापन ॥31॥
cc-adi-12.31.translation: That note established Advaita Ācārya as an incarnation of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

lines: kintu tāṅra daive kichu ha-iyāche ṛṇa
devanagari: किन्तु ताँर दैवे किछु हइयाछे ऋण ।
ऋण शोधिबारे चाहि तङ्का शत - तिन ॥32॥
cc-adi-12.32.translation: But it also mentioned that Advaita Ācārya had recently incurred a debt of about three hundred rupees that Kamalākānta Viśvāsa wanted to liquidate.

lines: patra paḍiyā prabhura mane haila duḥkha
devanagari: पत्र पड़िया प्रभुर मने हैल दुःख ।
बाहिरे हासिया किछु बले चन्द्र - मुख ॥33॥
cc-adi-12.33.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu became unhappy upon reading the note, although His face still shone as brightly as the moon. Thus, smiling, He spoke as follows.

devanagari: आचार स्थापियाछे करिया ईश्वर ।
इथे दोष नाहि, आचार्य दैवत ईश्वर ॥34॥
cc-adi-12.34.translation: "He has established Advaita Ācārya as an incarnation of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. There is nothing wrong in this, for He is indeed the Lord Himself.

devanagari: ईश्वरेर दैन्य क रि’ करियाछे भिक्षा ।
अतएव दण्ड क रि’ कराइब शिक्षा ॥35॥
cc-adi-12.35.translation: "But he has made the incarnation of Godhead a poverty-stricken beggar. Therefore I shall punish him for his correction."

lines: bāuliyā viśvāse ethā nā dibe āsite"
devanagari: गोविन्देरे आज्ञा दिल , - “इँहा आजि हैते ।
बाउलिया विश्वासे एथा ना दिबे आसिते” ॥36॥
cc-adi-12.36.translation: The Lord ordered Govinda, "From today on, do not allow that bāuliyā Kamalākānta Viśvāsa to come here."

devanagari: दण्ड शुनि’ ‘विश्वास’ हइल परम दुःखित ।
शुनिया प्रभुर दण्ड आचार्य हर्षित ॥37॥
cc-adi-12.37.translation: When Kamalākānta Viśvāsa heard about this punishment by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he was very unhappy, but when Advaita Prabhu heard about it, He was greatly pleased.

devanagari: विश्वासेरे कहे , - तुमि बड़ भाग्यवान् ।
तोमारे करिल दण्ड प्रभु भगवान् ॥38॥
cc-adi-12.38.translation: Seeing Kamalākānta Viśvāsa unhappy, Advaita Ācārya Prabhu told him, "You are greatly fortunate to have been punished by the Supreme Lord, the Personality of Godhead, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: duḥkha pāi' mane āmi kailuṅ anumāna
devanagari: पूर्वे महाप्रभु मोरे करेन सम्मान ।
दुःख पाइ’ मने आमि कैलुँ अनुमान ॥39॥
cc-adi-12.39.translation: "Formerly Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu always respected Me as His senior, but I did not like such respect. Therefore, My mind being afflicted by unhappiness, I made a plan.

lines: tāṅra yata śākhā ha-ila, tāra lekhā nāñi
devanagari: वृक्षेर द्वितीय स्कन्ध - आचार्य - गोसाञि ।
ताँर यत शाखा हइल, तार लेखा नाञि ॥4॥
cc-adi-12.4.translation: Śrī Advaita Prabhu was the second big branch of the tree. There are many sub-branches, but it is impossible to mention them all.

lines: kruddha hañā prabhu more kaila apamāna
devanagari: मुक्ति - श्रेष्ठ क रि’ कैनु वाशिष्ठ व्याख्यान ।
क्रुद्ध हवा प्रभु मोरे कैल अपमान ॥40॥
cc-adi-12.40.translation: "Thus I expounded the Yoga-vāśiṣṭha, which considers liberation the ultimate goal of life. For this the Lord became angry at Me and treated Me with apparent disrespect.

lines: daṇḍa pāñā haila mora parama ānanda
devanagari: दण्ड पाना हैल मोर परम आनन्द ।
ये दण्ड पाइल भाग्यवान्श्री - मुकुन्द ॥41॥
cc-adi-12.41.translation: "When chastised by Lord Caitanya, I was very happy to receive a punishment similar to that awarded Śrī Mukunda.

lines: se daṇḍa prasāda anya loka pābe kati
devanagari: ये दण्ड पाइल श्री - शची भाग्यवती ।
से दण्ड प्रसाद अन्य लोक पाबे कति ॥42॥
cc-adi-12.42.translation: "A similar punishment was awarded to mother Śacīdevī. Who could be more fortunate than she to receive such punishment?"

lines: eta kahi' ācārya tāṅre kariyā āśvāsa
devanagari: एत क हि’ आचार्य ताँरे करिया आश्वास ।
आनन्दित हइया आइल महाप्रभु - पाश ॥43॥
cc-adi-12.43.translation: After pacifying Kamalākānta Viśvāsa in this way, Śrī Advaita Ācārya Prabhu went to see Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: prabhuke kahena—tomāra nā bujhi e līlā
devanagari: प्रभुके कहेन - तोमार ना बुझि ए लीला ।
आमा हैते प्रसाद - पात्र करिला कमला ॥44॥
cc-adi-12.44.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya told Lord Caitanya, "I cannot understand Your transcendental pastimes. You have shown more favor to Kamalākānta than You generally show to Me.

lines: āmāreha kabhu yei nā haya prasāda
tomāra caraṇe āmi ki kainu aparādha
devanagari: आमारेह कभु येइ ना हय प्रसाद ।
तोमार चरणे आमि कि कैनु अपराध ॥45॥
cc-adi-12.45.translation: "The favor You have shown Kamalākānta is so great that even to Me You have never shown such favor. What offense have I committed at Your lotus feet so as not to be shown such favor?"

devanagari: एत शुनि’ महाप्रभु हासिते लागिला ।
बोलाइया कमलाकान्ते प्रसन्न हइला ॥46॥
cc-adi-12.46.translation: Hearing this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu laughed with satisfaction and immediately called Kamalākānta Viśvāsa.

lines: ācārya kahe, ihāke kene dile daraśana
devanagari: आचार्य कहे, इहाके केने दिले दरशन ।
दुइ प्रकारेते करे मोरे विड़म्बन ॥47॥
cc-adi-12.47.translation: Advaita Ācārya then said to Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Why have You called back this man and allowed him to see You? He has cheated Me in two ways."

devanagari: शुनिया प्रभुर मन प्रसन्न हइल ।
दुँहार अन्तर - कथा दुँहे से जानिल ॥48॥
cc-adi-12.48.translation: When Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this, His mind was satisfied. Only They could understand each other's minds.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे - बाउलिया, ऐछे काहे कर।
आचार्येर लज्जा - धर्म - हानि से आचर ॥49॥
cc-adi-12.49.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Kamalākānta, "You are a bāuliyā, one who does not know things as they are. Why do you act in this way? Why do you invade the privacy of Advaita Ācārya and damage His religious principles?

lines: sei jale puṣṭa skandha bāḍe dine dine
devanagari: चैतन्य - मालीर कृपा - जलेर सेचने ।
सेइ जले पुष्ट स्कन्ध बाड़े दिने दिने ॥5॥
cc-adi-12.5.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was also the gardener, and as He poured the water of His mercy on the tree, all the branches and sub-branches grew, day after day.

lines: viṣayīra anna khāile duṣṭa haya mana
devanagari: प्रतिग्रह कभु ना करिबे राज - धन ।
विषयीर अन्न खाइले दुष्ट हय मन ॥50॥
cc-adi-12.50.translation: "Advaita Ācārya, My spiritual master, should never accept charity from rich men or kings because if a spiritual master accepts money or grains from such materialists his mind becomes polluted.

lines: mana duṣṭa ha-ile nahe kṛṣṇera smaraṇa
devanagari: मन दुष्ट हइले नहे कृष्णेर स्मरण ।
कृष्ण - स्मृति विनु हय निष्फल जीवन ॥51॥
cc-adi-12.51.translation: "When one's mind is polluted, it is very difficult to remember Kṛṣṇa; and when remembrance of Lord Kṛṣṇa is hampered, one's life is unproductive.

lines: aiche karma nā kariha kabhu ihā jāni'
devanagari: लोक - लज्जा हय, धर्म - कीर्ति हय हानि ।
ऐछे कर्म ना करिह कभु इहा जानि’ ॥52॥
cc-adi-12.52.translation: "Thus one becomes unpopular in the eyes of the people in general, for this damages his religiosity and fame. A Vaiṣṇava, especially one who acts as a spiritual master, must not act in such a way. One should always be conscious of this fact."

lines: ei śikṣā sabākāre, sabe mane kaila
devanagari: एइ शिक्षा सबाकारे, सबे मने कैल ।
आचार्य - गोसाञि मने आनन्द पाइल ॥53॥
cc-adi-12.53.translation: When Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave this instruction to Kamalākānta, all present considered it to be meant for everyone. Thus Advaita Ācārya was greatly pleased.

devanagari: आचार्येर अभिप्राय प्रभु - मात्र बुझे ।
प्रभुर गम्भीर वाक्य आचार्य समुझे ॥54॥
cc-adi-12.54.translation: Only Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu could understand the intentions of Advaita Ācārya, and Advaita Ācārya appreciated the grave instruction of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: ei ta' prastāve āche bahuta vicāra
devanagari: एइ त’ प्रस्तावे आछे बहुत विचार ।
ग्रन्थ - बाहुल्य - भये नारि लिखिबार ॥55॥
cc-adi-12.55.translation: In this statement there are many confidential considerations. I do not write of them all, fearing an unnecessary increase in the volume of the book.

devanagari: श्री - यदुनन्दनाचार्य - अद्वैतेर शाखा ।
ताँर शाखा - उपशाखार नाहि हय लेखा ॥56॥
cc-adi-12.56.translation: The fifth branch of Advaita Ācārya was Śrī Yadunandana Ācārya, who had so many branches and sub-branches that it is impossible to write of them.

devanagari: वासुदेव दत्तेर तेंहो कृपार भाजन ।
सर्व - भावे आश्रियाछे चैतन्य - चरण ॥57॥
cc-adi-12.57.translation: Śrī Yadunandana Ācārya was a student of Vāsudeva Datta, and he received all his mercy. Therefore he could accept Lord Caitanya's lotus feet, from all angles of vision, as the supreme shelter.

devanagari: भागवताचार्य, आर विष्णुदासाचार्य ।
चक्रपाणि आचार्य, आर अनन्त आचार्य ॥58॥
cc-adi-12.58.translation: Bhāgavata Ācārya, Viṣṇudāsa Ācārya, Cakrapāṇi Ācārya and Ananta Ācārya were the sixth, seventh, eighth and ninth branches of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: नन्दिनी, आर कामदेव, चैतन्य - दास ।
दुर्लभ विश्वास, आर वनमालि - दास ॥59॥
cc-adi-12.59.translation: Nandinī, Kāmadeva, Caitanya dāsa, Durlabha Viśvāsa and Vanamālī dāsa were the tenth, eleventh, twelfth, thirteenth and fourteenth branches of Śrī Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: सेइ स्कन्धे व्रत प्रेम - फल उपजिल ।
सेइ कृष्ण - प्रेम - फले जगत्भरिल ॥6॥
cc-adi-12.6.translation: The fruits of love of Godhead that grew on those branches of the Caitanya tree were so large that they flooded the entire world with love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: जगन्नाथ कर, आर कर भवनाथ ।
हृदयानन्द सेन, आर दास भोलानाथ ॥60॥
cc-adi-12.60.translation: Jagannātha Kara, Bhavanātha Kara, Hṛdayānanda Sena and Bholānātha dāsa were the fifteenth, sixteenth, seventeenth and eighteenth branches of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: यादव - दास, विजय - दास, दास जनार्दन ।
अनन्त - दास, कानु - पण्डित, दास नारायण ॥61॥
cc-adi-12.61.translation: Yādava dāsa, Vijaya dāsa, Janārdana dāsa, Ananta dāsa, Kānu Paṇḍita and Nārāyaṇa dāsa were the nineteenth, twentieth, twenty-first, twenty-second, twenty-third and twenty-fourth branches of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: श्रीवत्स पण्डित, ब्रह्मचारी हरिदास ।
पुरुषोत्तम ब्रह्मचारी, आर कृष्णदास ॥62॥
cc-adi-12.62.translation: Śrīvatsa Paṇḍita, Haridāsa Brahmacārī, Puruṣottama Brahmacārī and Kṛṣṇadāsa were the twenty-fifth, twenty-sixth, twenty-seventh and twenty-eighth branches of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: पुरुषोत्तम पण्डित, आर रघुनाथ ।
वनमाली कविचन्द्र, आर वैद्यनाथ ॥63॥
cc-adi-12.63.translation: Puruṣottama Paṇḍita, Raghunātha, Vanamālī Kavicandra and Vaidyanātha were the twenty-ninth, thirtieth, thirty-first and thirty-second branches of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: लोकनाथ पण्डित, आर मुरारि पण्डित ।
श्री - हरिचरण, आर माधव पण्डित ॥64॥
cc-adi-12.64.translation: Lokanātha Paṇḍita, Murāri Paṇḍita, Śrī Haricaraṇa and Mādhava Paṇḍita were the thirty-third, thirty-fourth, thirty-fifth and thirty-sixth branches of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: विजय पण्डित, आर पण्डित श्रीराम ।
असङ्ख्य अद्वैत - शाखा कत लइब नाम ॥65॥
cc-adi-12.65.translation: Vijaya Paṇḍita and Śrīrāma Paṇḍita were two important branches of Advaita Ācārya. There are innumerable branches, but I am unable to mention them all.

devanagari: मालि - दत्त जल अद्वैत - स्कन्ध योगाय ।
सेइ जले जीये शाखा, - फुल - फल पाय ॥66॥
cc-adi-12.66.translation: The Advaita Ācārya branch received the water supplied by the original gardener, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In this way, the sub-branches were nourished, and their fruits and flowers grew luxuriantly.

lines: ihāra madhye mālī pāche kona śākhā-gaṇa
devanagari: इहार मध्ये माली पाछे कोन शाखा - गण ।
ना माने चैतन्य - माली दुर्दैव कारण ॥67॥
cc-adi-12.67.translation: After the disappearance of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, some of the branches, for unfortunate reasons, deviated from His path.

lines: kṛtaghna ha-ilā, tāṅre skandha kruddha ha-ila
devanagari: सृजाइल, जीयाइल, ताँरे ना मानिल ।
कृतघ्न हइला, ताँरे स्कन्ध क्रुद्ध हइल ॥68॥
cc-adi-12.68.translation: Some branches did not accept the original trunk that vitalized and maintained the entire tree. When they thus became ungrateful, the original trunk was angry at them.

lines: kruddha hañā skandha tāre jala nā sañcāre
devanagari: क्रुद्ध हञा स्कन्ध तारे जल ना सञ्चारे ।
जलाभावे कृश शाखा शुकाइया मरे ॥69॥
cc-adi-12.69.translation: Thus Lord Caitanya did not sprinkle upon them the water of His mercy, and they gradually withered and died.

lines: sei jala skandhe kare śākhāte sañcāra
devanagari: सेइ जल स्कन्धे करे शाखाते सञ्चार ।
फले - फुले बाड़े, - शाखा हइल विस्तार ॥7॥
cc-adi-12.7.translation: As the trunk and branches were watered, the branches and sub-branches spread lavishly, and the tree grew full with fruits and flowers.

lines: jīvitei mṛta sei, maile daṇḍe yama
devanagari: चैतन्य - रहित देह - शुष्ककाष्ठ - सम ।
जीवितेइ मृत सेइ, मैले दण्डे यम ॥70॥
cc-adi-12.70.translation: A person without Kṛṣṇa consciousness is no better than dry wood or a dead body. He is understood to be dead while living, and after death he is punishable by Yamarāja.

lines: kevala e gaṇa-prati nahe ei daṇḍa
devanagari: केवल ए गण - प्रति नहे एइ दण्ड ।
चैतन्य - विमुख येइ सेइ त’ पाषण्ड ॥71॥
cc-adi-12.71.translation: Not only the misguided descendants of Advaita Ācārya but anyone who is against the cult of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu should be considered an atheist subject to be punished by Yamarāja.

lines: ki paṇḍita, ki tapasvī, kibā gṛhī, yati
devanagari: कि पण्डित, कि तपस्वी, किबा गृही, यति ।
चैतन्य - विमुख येइ, तार एइ गति ॥72॥
cc-adi-12.72.translation: Be one a learned scholar, a great ascetic, a successful householder or a famous sannyāsī, if one is against the cult of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he is destined to suffer the punishment meted out by Yamarāja.

devanagari: ये ये लैल श्री - अच्युतानन्देर मत ।
सेइ आचार गण - महा - भागवत ॥73॥
cc-adi-12.73.translation: The descendants of Advaita Ācārya who accepted the path of Śrī Acyutānanda were all great devotees.

devanagari: सेइ सेइ , - आचार्येर कृपार भाजन ।
अनायासे पाइल सेइ चैतन्य - चरण ॥74॥
cc-adi-12.74.translation: By the mercy of Advaita Ācārya, the devotees who strictly followed the path of Caitanya Mahāprabhu attained the shelter of Lord Caitanya's lotus feet without difficulty.

lines: acyutera yei mata, sei mata sāra
āra yata mata saba haila chārakhāra
devanagari: अच्युतेर येइ मत, सेइ मत सार।
आर यत मत सब हैल छारखार ॥75॥
cc-adi-12.75.translation: It should be concluded, therefore, that the path of Acyutānanda is the essence of spiritual life. Those who did not follow this path simply scattered.

devanagari: सेइ आचार्य - गणे मोर कोटि नमस्कार ।
अच्युतानन्द - प्राय, चैतन्य - जीवन याँहार ॥76॥
cc-adi-12.76.translation: I therefore offer my respectful obeisances millions of times to the actual followers of Acyutānanda whose life and soul were Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: एइ त कहिलाँ आचार्य - गोसाञि र गण ।
तिन स्कन्ध - शाखार कैल सङ्क्षेप गणन ॥77॥
cc-adi-12.77.translation: Thus I have briefly described the three branches [Acyutānanda, Kṛṣṇa Miṣra and Gopāla] of Śrī Advaita Ācārya's descendants.

devanagari: शाखा - उपशाखा, तार नाहिक गणन ।
किछु - मात्र क हि’ करि दिग्दरशन ॥78॥
cc-adi-12.78.translation: There are multifarious branches and sub-branches of Advaita Ācārya. It is very difficult to enumerate them fully. I have simply given a glimpse of the whole trunk and its branches and sub-branches.

lines: tāṅra upaśākhā kichu kari ye gaṇana
devanagari: श्री - गदाधर पण्डित शाखाते महोत्तम ।
ताँर उपशाखा किछ करि ये गणन ॥79॥
cc-adi-12.79.translation: After describing the branches and sub-branches of Advaita Ācārya, I shall now attempt to describe some of the descendants of Śrī Gadādhara Paṇḍita, the most important among the branches.

devanagari: प्रथमे त’ एक - मत आचार्येर गण ।
पाछे दुइ - मत हैल दैवेर कारण ॥8॥
cc-adi-12.8.translation: At first all the followers of Advaita Ācārya shared a single opinion. But later they followed two different opinions, as ordained by providence.

devanagari: शाखा - श्रेष्ठ धुवानन्द, श्रीधर ब्रह्मचारी ।
भागवताचार्य, हरिदास ब्रह्मचारी ॥80॥
cc-adi-12.80.translation: The chief branches of Śrī Gadādhara Paṇḍita were (1) Śrī Dhruvānanda, (2) Śrīdhara Brahmacārī, (3) Haridāsa Brahmacārī and (4) Raghunātha Bhāgavatācārya.

devanagari: अनन्त आचार्य, कविदत्त, मिश्र - नयन ।
गङ्गामन्त्री मामु ठाकुर, कण्ठाभरण ॥81॥
cc-adi-12.81.translation: The fifth branch was Ananta Ācārya; the sixth, Kavi Datta; the seventh, Nayana Miśra; the eighth, Gaṅgāmantrī; the ninth, Māmu Ṭhākura; and the tenth, Kaṇṭhābharaṇa.

lines: yei dui āsi' kaila vṛndāvane vāsa
devanagari: भूगर्भ गोसाञि, आर भागवत - दास ।
येइ दुइ आसि’ कैल वृन्दावने वास ॥82॥
cc-adi-12.82.translation: The eleventh branch of Gadādhara Gosvāmī was Bhūgarbha Gosāñi, and the twelfth was Bhāgavata dāsa. Both of them went to Vṛndāvana and resided there for life.

devanagari: वाणीनाथ ब्रह्मचारी - बड़ महाशय ।
वल्लभ - चैतन्य - दास - कृष्ण - प्रेममय ॥83॥
cc-adi-12.83.translation: The thirteenth branch was Vāṇīnātha Brahmacārī, and the fourteenth was Vallabha-caitanya dāsa. Both of these great personalities were always filled with love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: श्रीनाथ चक्रवर्ती, आर उद्धव दास ।
जितामित्र, काष्ठकाटा - जगन्नाथ - दास ॥84॥
cc-adi-12.84.translation: The fifteenth branch was Śrīnātha Cakravartī; the sixteenth, Uddhava; the seventeenth, Jitāmitra; and the eighteenth, Jagannātha dāsa.

devanagari: श्री - हरि आचार्य, सादि - पुरिया गोपाल ।
कृष्णदास ब्रह्मचारी, पुष्प - गोपाल ॥85॥
cc-adi-12.85.translation: The nineteenth branch was Śrī Hari Ācārya; the twentieth, Sādipuriyā Gopāla; the twenty-first, Kṛṣṇadāsa Brahmacārī; and the twenty-second, Puṣpagopāla.

devanagari: श्रीहर्ष, रघु - मिश्र, पण्डित लक्ष्मीनाथ ।
बङ्गवाटी - चैतन्य - दास, श्री - रघुनाथ ॥86॥
cc-adi-12.86.translation: The twenty-third branch was Śrīharṣa; the twenty-fourth, Raghu Miśra; the twenty-fifth, Lakṣmīnātha Paṇḍita; the twenty-sixth, Caitanya dāsa; and the twenty-seventh, Raghunātha.

devanagari: अमोघ पण्डित, हस्ति - गोपाल, चैतन्य - वल्लभ ।
यदु गाङ्गुलि आर मङ्गल वैष्णव ॥87॥
cc-adi-12.87.translation: The twenty-eighth branch was Amogha Paṇḍita; the twenty-ninth, Hastigopāla; the thirtieth, Caitanya-vallabha; the thirty-first, Yadu Gāṅguli; and the thirty-second, Maṅgala Vaiṣṇava.

devanagari: चक्रवर्ती शिवानन्द सदा व्रजवासी ।
महाशाखा - मध्ये तेंहो सुदृढ़ विश्वासी ॥88॥
cc-adi-12.88.translation: Śivānanda Cakravartī, the thirty-third branch, who always lived in Vṛndāvana with firm conviction, is considered an important branch of Gadādhara Paṇḍita.

lines: ei ta' sañkṣepe kahilāṅ paṇḍitera gaṇa
devanagari: एइ त’ सङ्क्षेपे कहिलाँ पण्डितेर गण ।
ऐछे आर शाखा - उपशाखार गणन ॥89॥
cc-adi-12.89.translation: Thus I have briefly described the branches and sub-branches of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. There are still many more that I have not mentioned here.

lines: keha ta' ācārya ājñāya, keha ta' svatantra
devanagari: केह त’ आचार्य आज्ञाय, केह त’ स्वतन्त्र ।
स्व - मत कल्पना करे दैव - परतन्त्र ॥9॥
cc-adi-12.9.translation: Some of the disciples strictly accepted the orders of the ācārya, and others deviated, independently concocting their own opinions under the spell of daivī-māyā.

devanagari: पण्डितेर गण सब , - भागवत धन्य ।
प्राण - वल्लभ - सबार श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य ॥90॥
cc-adi-12.90.translation: All the followers of Gadādhara Paṇḍita are considered great devotees because they have Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as their life and soul.

lines: ei tina skandhera kailuṅ śākhāra gaṇana
devanagari: एइ तिन स्कन्धेर कैलुँ शाखार गणन।
याँ - सबा - स्मरणे भव - बन्ध - विमोचन ॥91॥
cc-adi-12.91.translation: Simply by remembering the names of all these branches and sub-branches of the three trunks I have described [Nityānanda, Advaita and Gadādhara], one attains freedom from the entanglement of material existence.

devanagari: याँ - सबा - स्मरणे पाइ चैतन्य - चरण ।
याँ - सबा - स्मरणे हय वाञ्छित पूरण ॥92॥
cc-adi-12.92.translation: Simply by remembering the names of all these Vaiṣṇavas, one can attain the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Indeed, simply by remembering their holy names, one achieves the fulfillment of all desires.

devanagari: अतएव ताँ - सबार वन्दिये चरण ।
चैतन्य - मालीर कहि लीला - अनुक्रम ॥93॥
cc-adi-12.93.translation: Therefore, offering my obeisances at the lotus feet of them all, I shall describe the pastimes of the gardener Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in chronological order.

devanagari: गौर - लीलामृत - सिन्धु अपार अगाध ।
के करिते पारे ताहाँ अवगाह - साध ॥94॥
cc-adi-12.94.translation: The ocean of the pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu is immeasurable and unfathomable. Who can take the courage to measure that great ocean?

lines: ataeva taṭe rahi' cāki eka kaṇa
devanagari: ताहार माधुर्य - गन्धे लुब्ध हय मन ।
अतएव तटे र हि’ चाकि एक कण ॥95॥
cc-adi-12.95.translation: It is not possible to dip into that great ocean, but its sweet mellow flavor attracts my mind. I therefore stand on the shore of that ocean to try to taste but a drop of it.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥96॥
cc-adi-12.96.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: स प्रसीदतु चैतन्य - देवो यस्य प्रसादतः ।
तल्लीला - वर्णने योग्यः सद्यः स्यादधमोऽप्ययम् ॥1॥
cc-adi-13.1.translation: I wish the grace of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, by whose mercy even one who is fallen can describe the pastimes of the Lord.

devanagari: चब्बिश वत्सर प्रभु कैल गृह - वास ।
निरन्तर कैल कृष्ण - कीर्तन - विलास ॥10॥
cc-adi-13.10.translation: For twenty-four years Lord Caitanya lived in the gṛhastha-āśrama [household life], always engaging in the pastimes of the Hare Kṛṣṇa movement.

lines: dekhi' uparāga hāsi', śīghra gaṅgā-ghāṭe āsi'
devanagari: देखि’ उपराग हा सि’, शीघ्र गङ्गा - घाटे आ सि’
आनन्दे करिल गङ्गा - स्नान ।
पाञा उपराग - छले, आपनार मनो - बले,
ब्राह्मणेरे दिल नाना दान ॥100॥
cc-adi-13.100.translation: Seeing the lunar eclipse and laughing, both Advaita Ācārya and Haridāsa Ṭhākura immediately went to the bank of the Ganges and bathed in the Ganges in great jubilation. Taking advantage of the occasion of the lunar eclipse, Advaita Ācārya, by His own mental strength, distributed various types of charity to the brāhmaṇas.

lines: tomāra aichana raṅga, mora mana parasanna,
devanagari: जगतानन्दमय, देखि’ मने स - विस्मय
ठारेठोरे कहे हरिदास ।
तोमार ऐछन रङ्ग, मोर मन परसन्न
देखि - किछु कार्ये आछे भास ॥101॥
cc-adi-13.101.translation: When he saw that the whole world was jubilant, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, his mind astonished, directly and indirectly expressed himself to Advaita Ācārya, "Your dancing and distributing charity are very pleasing to me. I can understand that there is some special purpose in these actions."

devanagari: आचार्यरत्न, श्रीवास, हैल मने सुखोल्लास
याइ’ स्नान कैल गङ्गा - जले ।
आनन्दे विह्वल मन, करे हरि - सङ्कीर्तन
नाना दान कैल मनो - बले ॥102॥
cc-adi-13.102.translation: Ācāryaratna [Candraśekhara] and Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura were overwhelmed with joy, and immediately they went to the bank of the Ganges to take bath in the water of the Ganges. Their minds full of happiness, they chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra and gave charity by mental strength.

lines: ei mata bhakta-tati, yāṅra yei deśe sthiti,
nāce, kare saṅkīrtana, ānande vihvala mana,
devanagari: एइ मत भक्त - तति, याँर येइ देशे स्थिति ,
ताहाँ ताहाँ पाञा मनो - बले ।
नाचे, करे सङ्कीर्तन, आनन्दे विह्वल मन ,
दान करे ग्रहणेर छले ॥103॥
cc-adi-13.103.translation: In this way all the devotees, wherever they were situated, in every city and every country, danced, performed saṅkīrtana and gave charity by mental strength on the plea of the lunar eclipse, their minds overwhelmed with joy.

devanagari: ब्राह्मण - सज्जन - नारी, नाना - द्रव्ये थाली भ रि’
आइला सबे यौतुक लइया ।
येन काँचा - सोणा - द्युति, देखि’ बालकेर मूर्ति,
आशीर्वाद करे सुख पाञा ॥104॥
cc-adi-13.104.translation: All sorts of respectful brāhmaṇa gentlemen and ladies, carrying plates filled with various gifts, came with their presentations. Seeing the newborn child, whose form resembled natural glaring gold, all of them with happiness offered their blessings.

lines: sāvitrī, gaurī, sarasvatī, śacī, rambhā, arundhatī
nānā-dravye pātra bhari', brāhmaṇīra veśa dhari',
devanagari: सावित्री, गौरी, सरस्वती, शची, रम्भा, अरुन्धती
आर यत देव - नारीगण ।
नाना - द्रव्ये पात्र भ रि’, ब्राह्मणीर वेश ध रि’,
आसि’ सबे करे दरशन ॥105॥
cc-adi-13.105.translation: Dressing themselves as the wives of brāhmaṇas, all the celestial ladies, including the wives of Lord Brahmā, Lord Śiva, Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva, King Indra and Vasiṣṭha Ṛṣi, and Rambhā, a dancing girl of heaven, came there with varieties of gifts.

lines: nartaka, vādaka, bhāṭa, navadvīpe yāra nāṭa,
devanagari: अन्तरीक्षे देव - गण, गन्धर्व, सिद्ध, चारण ,
स्तुति - नृत्य करे वाद्य - गीत ।
नर्तक, वादक, भाट, नवद्वीपे यार नाट,
सबे आ सि’ नाचे पाञा प्रीत ॥106॥
cc-adi-13.106.translation: In outer space all the demigods, including the inhabitants of Gandharvaloka, Siddhaloka and Cāraṇaloka, offered their prayers and danced with musical songs and the beating of drums. Similarly, in Navadvīpa city all the professional dancers, musicians and blessers gathered together, dancing in great jubilation.

lines: kebā āse kebā yāya, kebā nāce kebā gāya,
devanagari: केबा आसे केबा याय, केबा नाचे केबा गाय
सम्भालिते नारे कार बोल ।
खण्डिलेक दुःख - शोक, प्रमोद - पूरित लोक
मिश्र हैला आनन्दे विह्वल ॥107॥
cc-adi-13.107.translation: No one could understand who was coming and who was going, who was dancing and who was singing. Nor could they understand each other's language. But in effect all unhappiness and lamentation were immediately dissipated, and people became all-jubilant. Thus Jagannātha Miśra was also overwhelmed with joy.

devanagari: आचार्यरत्न, श्रीवास, जगन्नाथ मिश्र - पाश,
आसि’ ताँरे करे सावधान ।
कराइल जातकर्म, ये आछिल विधि - धर्म,
तबे मिश्र करे नाना दान ॥108॥
cc-adi-13.108.translation: Candraśekhara Ācārya and Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura both came to Jagannātha Miśra and drew his attention in various ways. They performed the ritualistic ceremonies prescribed at the time of birth according to religious principles. Jagannātha Miśra also gave varieties of charity.

lines: yautuka pāila yata, ghare vā āchila kata,
yata nartaka, gāyana, bhāṭa, akiñcana jana,
devanagari: यौतुक पाइल यत, घरे वा आछि ल कत ,
सब धन विप्रे दिल दान ।
यत नर्तक, गायन, भाट, अकिञ्चन जन ,
धन दिया कैल सबार मान ॥109॥
cc-adi-13.109.translation: Whatever riches Jagannātha Miśra collected in the form of gifts and presentations, and whatever he had in his house, he distributed among the brāhmaṇas, professional singers, dancers, bhāṭas and the poor. He honored them all by giving them riches in charity.

lines: āra cabbiśa vatsara kaila nīlācale vāsa
devanagari: चब्बिश वत्सर - शेषे करिया सन्न्यास ।
आर चब्बिश वत्सर कैल नीला चले वास ॥11॥
cc-adi-13.11.translation: After twenty-four years He accepted the renounced order of life, sannyāsa, and He resided for twenty-four years more at Jagannātha Purī.

lines: sindūra, haridrā, taila, kha-i, kalā, nārikela,
devanagari: श्रीवासेर ब्राह्मणी, नाम ताँर ‘मालिनी’,
आचार्यरत्नेर पत्नी - सङ्गे ।
सिन्दूर, हरिद्रा, तैल, खइ, कला, नारिकेल ,
दिया पूजे नारीगण रङ्गे ॥110॥
cc-adi-13.110.translation: The wife of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, whose name was Mālinī, accompanied by the wife of Candraśekhara [Ācāryaratna] and other ladies, came there in great happiness to worship the baby with paraphernalia such as vermilion, turmeric, oil, fused rice, bananas and coconuts.

lines: ācāryera ājñā pāñā, gela upahāra lañā,
devanagari: अद्वैत - आचार्य - भार्पा, जगत्पूजिता आर्या
नाम ताँर ‘सीता ठाकुराणी’ ।
आचार आज्ञा पाञा, गेल उपहार ल ञा
देखिते बालक - शिरोमणि ॥111॥
cc-adi-13.111.translation: One day shortly after Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu was born, Advaita Ācārya's wife, Sītādevī, who is worshipable by the whole world, taking permission of her husband, went to see that topmost child with all kinds of gifts and presentations.

devanagari: सुवर्णेर कड़ि - ब - उलि, रजतमुद्रा - पाशुलि,
सुवर्णेर अङ्गद, कङ्कण ।
दु - बाहुते दिव्य शङ्ख, रजतेर मलबङ्क,
स्वर्ण - मुद्रार नाना हारगण ॥112॥
cc-adi-13.112.translation: She brought different kinds of golden ornaments, including bangles for the hand, armlets, necklaces and anklets.

devanagari: व्याघ्र - नख हेम - जड़ि, कटि - पट्टसूत्र - डोरी
हस्त - पदेर यत आभरण ।
चित्र - वर्ण पट्ट - साड़ी, बुनि फोतो पट्टपाड़ी,
स्वर्ण - रौप्य - मुद्रा बहु - धन ॥113॥
cc-adi-13.113.translation: There were also tiger nails set in gold, waist decorations of silk and lace, ornaments for the hands and legs, nicely printed silken sārīs and a child's garment, also made of silk. Many other riches, including gold and silver coins, were also presented to the child.

lines: durvā, dhānya, gorocana, haridrā, kuṅkuma, candana,
vastra-gupta dolā caḍi' saṅge lañā dāsī ceḍī,
devanagari: दुर्वा, धान्य, गोरोचन, हरिद्रा, कुङ्कम, चन्दन ,
मङ्गल - द्रव्य पात्र भरिया ।
वस्त्र - गुप्त दोला चड़ि’ सङ्गे लजा दासी चेड़ी,
वस्त्रालङ्कार पेटारि भरिया ॥114॥
cc-adi-13.114.translation: Riding in a palanquin covered with cloth and accompanied by maidservants, Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī came to the house of Jagannātha Miśra, bringing with her many auspicious articles such as fresh grass, paddy, gorocana, turmeric, kuṅkuma and sandalwood. All these presentations filled a large basket.

lines: bhakṣya, bhojya, upahāra, saṅge la-ila bahu bhāra,
devanagari: भक्ष्य, भोज्य, उपहार, सङ्गे लइल बहु भार,
शची - गृहे हैल उपनीत ।
देखिया बालक - ठाम, साक्षात्गोकुल - कान,
वर्ण - मात्र देखि विपरीत ॥115॥
cc-adi-13.115.translation: When Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī came to the house of Śacīdevī, bringing with her many kinds of eatables, dresses and other gifts, she was astonished to see the newly born child, for she appreciated that except for a difference in color, the child was directly Kṛṣṇa of Gokula Himself.

lines: bālakera divya jyoti, dekhi' pāila bahu prīti,
devanagari: सर्व अङ्ग - सुनिर्माण, सुवर्ण - प्रतिमा - भान
सर्व अङ्ग - सुलक्षणमय ।
बालकेर दिव्य ज्योति, देखि’ पाइल बहु प्रीति
वात्सल्येते द्रविल हृदय ॥116॥
cc-adi-13.116.translation: Seeing the transcendental bodily effulgence of the child, each of His nicely constructed limbs full of auspicious signs and resembling a form of gold, Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī was very much pleased, and because of her maternal affection, she felt as if her heart were melting.

lines: durvā, dhānya, dila śīrṣe, kaila bahu āśīṣe,
devanagari: दुर्वा, धान्य, दिल शीर्षे, कैल बहु आशीषे,
चिरजीवी हओ दुइ भाइ ।
डाकिनी - शाङ्खिनी हैते, शङ्का उपजिल चिते,
डरे नाम थुइल ‘निमाइ’ ॥117॥
cc-adi-13.117.translation: She blessed the newly born child by placing fresh grass and paddy on His head and saying, "May You be blessed with a long duration of life." But being afraid of ghosts and witches, she gave the child the name Nimāi.

lines: śacī-miśrera pūjā lañā, manete hariṣa hañā,
devanagari: पुत्रमाता - स्नानदिने, दिल वस्त्र विभुषणे
पुत्र - सह मिशेरे सम्मा नि’ ।
शची - मिश्रेर पूजा लञा, मनेते ह रिष हञा
घरे आइला सीता ठाकुराणी ॥118॥
cc-adi-13.118.translation: On the day the mother and son took bath and left the maternity home, Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī gave them all kinds of ornaments and garments and then also honored Jagannātha Miśra. Then Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī, being honored by mother Śacīdevī and Jagannātha Miśra, was greatly happy within her mind, and thus she returned home.

devanagari: ऐछे शची - जगन्नाथ, पुत्र पाञा लक्ष्मीनाथ
पूर्ण हइल सकल वाञ्छित ।
धन - धान्ये भरे घर, लोकमान्य कलेवर
दिने दिने हय आनन्दित ॥119॥
cc-adi-13.119.translation: In this way mother Śacīdevī and Jagannātha Miśra, having obtained a son who was the husband of the goddess of fortune, had all their desires fulfilled. Their house was always filled with riches and grains. As they saw the beloved body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, day after day their pleasure increased.

lines: kabhu dakṣiṇa, kabhu gauḍa, kabhu vṛndāvana
devanagari: तार मध्ये छय वत्सर - गमनागमन ।
कभु दक्षिण, कभु गौड़, कभु वृन्दावन ॥12॥
cc-adi-13.12.translation: Of these last twenty-four years, He spent the first six years continuously touring India, sometimes in South India, sometimes in Bengal and sometimes in Vṛndāvana.

lines: putrera prabhāve yata, dhana āsi' mile, tata,
devanagari: मिश्र - वैष्णव, शान्त, अलम्पट, शुद्ध, दान्त,
धन - भोगे नाहि अभि मान ।
पुत्रेर प्रभावे यत, धन आ सि’ मिले, तत,
विष्णु - प्रीते द्विजे देन दान ॥120॥
cc-adi-13.120.translation: Jagannātha Miśra was an ideal Vaiṣṇava. He was peaceful, restrained in sense gratification, pure and controlled. Therefore he had no desire to enjoy material opulence. Whatever money came because of the influence of his transcendental son, he gave it in charity to the brāhmaṇas for the satisfaction of Viṣṇu.

lines: mahāpuruṣera cihna, lagne aṅge bhinna bhinna,
devanagari: महापुरुषेर चिह्न, लग्ने अङ्गे भिन्न भिन्न, ।
देखि, - एइ तारिबे संसारे ॥121॥
cc-adi-13.121.translation: After calculating the birth moment of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nīlāmbara Cakravartī privately said to Jagannātha Miśra that he saw all the different symptoms of a great personality in both the body and birth moment of the child. Thus he understood that in the future this child would deliver all the three worlds.

lines: aiche prabhu śacī-ghare, kṛpāya kaila avatāre,
devanagari: ऐछे प्रभु शची - घरे, कृपाय कैल अवतारे
येइ इहा करये श्रवण ।
गौर - प्रभु दयामय, ताँरे हयेन सदय
सेइ पाय ताँहार चरण ॥122॥
cc-adi-13.122.translation: In this way Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, out of His causeless mercy, made His advent in the house of Śacīdevī. Lord Caitanya is very merciful to anyone who hears this narration of His birth, and thus such a person attains the lotus feet of the Lord.

lines: pāiyā mānuṣa janma, ye nā śune gaura-guṇa,
devanagari: पाइया मानुष जन्म, ये ना शुने गौर - गुण
हेन जन्म तार व्यर्थ हैल ।
पाइया अमृतधुनी, पिये विष - गर्त - पानि
जन्मिया से केने नाहि मैल ॥123॥
cc-adi-13.123.translation: Anyone who attains a human body but does not take to the cult of Śri Caitanya Mahāprabhu is baffled in his opportunity. Amṛtadhunī is a flowing river of the nectar of devotional service. If after getting a human body one drinks the water in a poison pit of material happiness instead of the water of such a river, it would be better for him not to have lived, but to have died long ago.

devanagari: श्री - चैतन्य - नित्यानन्द, आचार्य अद्वैतचन्द्र
स्वरूप - रूप - रघुनाथदास ।
इँहा - सबार श्री - चरण, शिरे वन्दि निज - धन
जन्म - लीला गाइल कृष्णदास ॥124॥
cc-adi-13.124.translation: Taking on my head as my own property the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu, Ācārya Advaitacandra, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Rūpa Gosvāmī and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, have thus described the advent of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: अष्टादश वत्सर रहिला नीलाचले ।
कृष्ण - प्रेम - नामामृते भासा’ल सकले ॥13॥
cc-adi-13.13.translation: For the remaining eighteen years He continuously stayed in Jagannātha Purī. Chanting the nectarean Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, He inundated everyone there in a flood of love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: गार्हस्थ्ये प्रभुर लीला - ‘आदि’ - लीलाख्यान ।
‘मध्य’ - ‘अन्त्य’ - लीला - शेष - लीलार दुइ नाम ॥14॥
cc-adi-13.14.translation: The pastimes of His household life are known as ādi-līlā, or the original pastimes. His later pastimes are known as madhya-līlā and antya-līlā, or the middle and final pastimes.

devanagari: आदि - लीला - मध्ये प्रभुर यतेक चरित ।
सूत्र - रूपे मुरारि गुप्त करिला ग्रथित ॥15॥
cc-adi-13.15.translation: All the pastimes enacted by Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in His ādi-lilā were recorded in the form by Murāri Gupta.

devanagari: प्रभुर ये शेष - लीला स्वरूप - दामोदर ।
सूत्र करि’ ग्रन्थिलेन ग्रन्थेर भितर ॥16॥
cc-adi-13.16.translation: His later pastimes [madhya-līlā and āntya-līlā] were recorded by His secretary, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, and thus kept within a book.

lines: ei dui janera sūtra dekhiyā śuniyā
varṇanā karena vaiṣṇava krama ye kariyā
devanagari: एइ दुइ जनेर सूत्र देखिया शुनिया ।
वर्णना करेन वैष्णव क्रम ये करिया ॥17॥
cc-adi-13.17.translation: By seeing and hearing the notes recorded by these two great personalities, a Vaiṣṇava, a devotee of the Lord, can know these pastimes one after another.

devanagari: बाल्य, पौगण्ड, कैशोर, यौवन, - चारि भेद ।
अतएव आदि - खण्डे लीला चारि भेद ॥18॥
cc-adi-13.18.translation: In His original pastimes there are four divisions: bālya, paugaṇḍa, kaiśora and yauvana [childhood, early boyhood, later boyhood and youth ].

devanagari: सर्व - सद्गुण - पूर्णाम् तां वन्दे फाल्गुन - पूर्णिमाम् ।
यस्यां श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्योऽवतीर्णः कृष्ण - नामभिः ॥19॥
cc-adi-13.19.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances unto the full-moon evening in the month of Phālguna, an auspicious time full of auspicious symptoms, when Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu advented Himself with the chanting of the holy name, Hare Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: जय ज य श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य गौरचन्द्र ।
जयाद्वैतचन्द्र जय जय नित्यानन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-13.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu!

devanagari: फाल्गुन - पूर्णिमा - सन्ध्याय प्रभुर जन्मोदय ।
सेइ - काले दैव - योगे चन्द्र - ग्रहण हय ॥20॥
cc-adi-13.20.translation: On the full-moon evening of the month of Phālguna when the Lord took birth, coincidentally there was also a lunar eclipse.

devanagari: ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ बले लोक हरषित ह ञा ।
जन्मिला चैतन्य - प्रभु ‘नाम’ जन्माइया ॥21॥
cc-adi-13.21.translation: In jubilation everyone was chanting the holy name of the Lord—"Hari! Hari!"—and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then appeared, after first causing the appearance of the holy name.

devanagari: जन्म - बाल्य - पौगण्ड - कैशोर - युवा - काले ।
हरि - नाम लओयाइला प्रभु नाना छले ॥22॥
cc-adi-13.22.translation: At His birth, in His childhood, in His early and later boyhood as well as in His youth, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, under different pleas, induced people to chant the holy name of Hari [the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra].

devanagari: बाल्य - भाव छले प्रभु करेन क्रन्दन ।
‘कृष्ण’ ‘हरि’ नाम शुनि’ रहये रोदन ॥23॥
cc-adi-13.23.translation: In His childhood, when the Lord was crying, He would stop immediately upon hearing the holy names Kṛṣṇa and Hari.

lines: dekhite āise yebā sarva bandhu jana
devanagari: अतएव ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ बले नारीगण ।
देखिते आइसे येबा सर्व बन्धु जन ॥24॥
cc-adi-13.24.translation: All the friendly ladies who came to see the child would chant the holy names, "Hari, Hari!" as soon as the child would cry.

devanagari: ‘गौरहरि’ बलि’ तारे हासे सर्व नारी ।
अतएव हैल ताँर नाम ‘गौरहरि ॥25॥
