cc-adi-13.25.translation: When all the ladies saw this fun, they enjoyed laughing and called the Lord "Gaurahari." Since then, Gaurahari became another of His names.

devanagari: बाल्य वयस - यावत् हाते खड़ि दिल ।
पौगण्ड वयस - यावत्विवाह ना कैल ॥26॥
cc-adi-13.26.translation: His childhood lasted until the date of hāte khaḍi, the beginning of His education, and His age from the end of His childhood until He married is called paugaṇḍa.

devanagari: विवाह करिले हैल नवीन यौवन ।
सर्वत्र लओयाइल प्रभु नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ॥27॥
cc-adi-13.27.translation: After His marriage His youth began, and in His youth He induced everyone to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra anywhere and everywhere.

devanagari: पौगण्ड - वयसे पड़ेन, पड़ान शिष्यगणे ।
सर्वत्र करेन कृष्ण - नामेर व्याख्याने ॥28॥
cc-adi-13.28.translation: During His paugaṇḍa age He became a serious student and also taught disciples. In this way He used to explain the holy name of Kṛṣṇa everywhere.

devanagari: सूत्र - वृत्ति - पाँजि - टीका कृष्णेते तात्पर्य ।
शिष्येर प्रतीत हय , - प्रभाव आश्चर्य ॥29॥
cc-adi-13.29.translation: When teaching a course in grammar [vyākaraṇa] and explaining it with notes, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu taught His disciples about the glories of Lord Kṛṣṇa. All explanations culminated in Kṛṣṇa, and His disciples would understand them very easily. Thus His influence was wonderful.

devanagari: जय जय गदाधर जय श्रीनिवास ।
जय मुकुन्द वासुदेव जय हरिदास ॥3॥
cc-adi-13.3.translation: All glories to Gadādhara Prabhu! All glories to Śrīnivāsa Ācārya Prabhu! All glories to Mukunda Prabhu and Vāsudeva Prabhu! All glories to Haridāsa Ṭhākura!

devanagari: यारे देखे, तारे कहे , - कह कृष्ण - नाम ।
कृष्ण - नामे भासाइल नवद्वीप - ग्राम ॥30॥
cc-adi-13.30.translation: When Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu was a student, He asked whomever He met to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra. In this way He inundated the whole town of Navadvīpa with the chanting of Hare Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: किशोर वयसे आरम्भिला सङ्कीर्तन ।
रात्र - दिने प्रेमे नृत्य, सङ्गे भक्त - गण ॥31॥
cc-adi-13.31.translation: Just prior to His youthful life, He began the saṅkīrtana movement. Day and night He used to dance in ecstasy with His devotees.

devanagari: नगरे नगरे भ्रमे कीर्तन करिया ।
भासाइल त्रिभुवन प्रेम - भक्ति दिया ॥32॥
cc-adi-13.32.translation: The saṅkīrtana movement went on from one part of the town to another, as the Lord wandered everywhere performing kīrtana. In this way He inundated the whole world by distributing love of Godhead.

devanagari: चब्बिश वत्सर ऐछे नवद्वीप - ग्रामे ।
लओयाइला सर्व - लोके कृष्ण - प्रेम - नामे ॥33॥
cc-adi-13.33.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu lived in the Navadvīpa area for twenty-four years, and He induced every person to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra and thus merge in love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: चब्बिश वत्सर छिला करिया सन्न्यास ।
भक्त - गण ल ञा कैला नीलाचले वास ॥34॥
cc-adi-13.34.translation: For His remaining twenty-four years, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, after accepting the renounced order of life, stayed at Jagannātha Purī with His devotees.

devanagari: तार मध्ये नीलाचले छय वत्सर ।
नृत्य, गीत, प्रेमभक्ति - दान निरन्तर ॥35॥
cc-adi-13.35.translation: For six of these twenty-four years in Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī], He distributed love of Godhead by always chanting and dancing.

devanagari: सेतुबन्ध, आर गौड़ - व्यापि वृन्दावन ।
प्रेम - नाम प्रचारिया करिला भ्रमण ॥36॥
cc-adi-13.36.translation: Beginning from Cape Comorin and extending through Bengal to Vṛndāvana, during these six years He toured all of India, chanting, dancing and distributing love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: एइ ‘मध्य - लीला’ नाम - लीला - मुख्यधाम ।
शेष अष्टादश वर्ष - ‘अन्त्य - लीला’ नाम ॥37॥
cc-adi-13.37.translation: The activities of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu in His travels after He accepted sannyāsa are His principal pastimes. His activities during His remaining eighteen years are called antya-līlā, or the final portion of His pastimes.

devanagari: तार मध्ये छय वत्सर भक्तगण - सङ्गे ।
प्रेम - भक्ति लओयाइल नृत्य - गीत - रङ्गे ॥38॥
cc-adi-13.38.translation: For six of the eighteen years He continuously stayed in Jagannātha Purī, He regularly performed kīrtana, inducing all the devotees to love Kṛṣṇa simply by chanting and dancing.

devanagari: द्वादश वत्सर शेष रहिला नीलाचले ।
प्रेमावस्था शिखाइला आस्वादन - च्छले ॥39॥
cc-adi-13.39.translation: For the remaining twelve years He stayed in Jagannātha Purī, He taught everyone how to taste the transcendental mellow ecstasy of love of Kṛṣṇa by tasting it Himself.

lines: ei saba candrodaye tamaḥ kaila lupta
devanagari: जय दामोदर - स्वरूप जय मुरारि गुप्त ।
एइ सब चन्द्रोदये तमः कैल लुप्त ॥4॥
cc-adi-13.4.translation: All glories to Svarūpa Dāmodara and Murāri Gupta! All these brilliant moons have together dissipated the darkness of this material world.

devanagari: रात्रि - दिवसे कृष्ण - विरह - स्फुरण ।
उन्मादेर चेष्टा करे प्रलाप - वचन ॥40॥
cc-adi-13.40.translation: Day and night Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt separation from Kṛṣṇa. Manifesting symptoms of this separation, He cried and talked very inconsistently, like a madman.

devanagari: श्री - राधार प्रलाप यैछे उद्धव - दर्शने ।
सेइमत उन्माद - प्रलाप करे रात्रि - दिने ॥41॥
cc-adi-13.41.translation: As Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī talked inconsistently when She met Uddhava, so also Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu relished, both day and night, such ecstatic talk in the mood of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

devanagari: विद्यापति, जयदेव, चण्डीदासेर गीत ।
आस्वादेन रामानन्द - स्वरूप - सहित ॥42॥
cc-adi-13.42.translation: The Lord used to read the books of Vidyāpati, Jayadeva and Caṇḍīdāsa, relishing their songs with His confidential associates like Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.

devanagari: कृष्णेर वियोगे यत प्रेम - चेष्टित ।
आस्वादिया पूर्ण कैल आपन वाञ्छित ॥43॥
cc-adi-13.43.translation: In separation from Kṛṣṇa, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu relished all these ecstatic activities, and thus He fulfilled His own desires.

lines: ke varṇite pāre, tāhā vistāra kariyā
devanagari: अनन्त चैतन्य - लीला क्षुद्र जीव हञा ।
के वर्णिते पारे, ताहा विस्तार करिया ॥44॥
cc-adi-13.44.translation: The pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu are unlimited. How much can a small living entity elaborate about those transcendental pastimes?

lines: sūtra kari' gaṇe yadi āpane ananta
devanagari: सुत्र करि’ गणे यदि आपने अनन्त ।
सहस्र - वदने तेंहो नाहि पाय अन्त ॥45॥
cc-adi-13.45.translation: If Śeṣaṇāga Ananta personally were to make the pastimes of Lord Caitanya into codes, even with His thousands of mouths there is no possibility that He could find their limit.

devanagari: दामोदर - स्वरूप, आर गुप्त मुरारि ।
मुख्य - मुख्य - लीला सूत्रे लिखियाछे विचारि’ ॥46॥
cc-adi-13.46.translation: Devotees like Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara and Murāri Gupta have recorded all the principal pastimes of Lord Caitanya in the form of notes, after deliberate consideration.

devanagari: सेइ, अनुसारे लिखि लीला - सूत्रगण ।
विस्ता रि’ वर्णिआछेन ताहा दास - वृन्दावन ॥47॥
cc-adi-13.47.translation: The notes kept by Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara and Murāri Gupta are the basis of this book. Following those notes, I write of all the pastimes of the Lord. The notes have been described elaborately by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: चैतन्य - लीलार व्यास , - दास वृन्दावन ।
मधुर करिया लीला करिला रचन ॥48॥
cc-adi-13.48.translation: Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, the authorized writer of the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, is as good as Śrīla Vyāsadeva. He has described the pastimes in such a way as to make them sweeter and sweeter.

lines: sei sei sthāne kichu kariba vyākhyāna
devanagari: ग्रन्थ - विस्तार - भये छाड़िला ने ये स्थान ।
सेइ सेइ स्थाने किछु करिब व्याख्यान ॥49॥
cc-adi-13.49.translation: Being afraid of his book's becoming too voluminous, he left some places without vivid descriptions. I shall try to fill those places as far as possible.

devanagari: जय श्री - चैतन्यचन्द्रेर भक्त चन्द्र - गण ।
सबार प्रेम ज्योत्स्नाय उज्वल त्रिभुवन ॥5॥
cc-adi-13.5.translation: All glories to the moons who are devotees of the principal moon, Lord Caitanyacandra! Their bright moonshine illuminates the entire universe.

devanagari: प्रभुर लीलामृत तेंहो कैल आस्वादन ।
ताँर भुक्त - शेष किछु करिये चर्वण ॥50॥
cc-adi-13.50.translation: The transcendental pastimes of Lord Caitanya have actually been relished by Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura. I am simply trying to chew the remnants of food left by him.

lines: saṅkṣepe likhiye samyak nā yāya likhana
devanagari: आदि - लीला - सूत्र लिखि, शुन, भक्त - गण ।
सङ्क्षेपे लिखिये सम्यक् ना याय लिखन ॥51॥
cc-adi-13.51.translation: My dear devotees of Lord Caitanya, let me now write the codes of the Ādi-līlā in brief because it is not possible to describe these pastimes in full.

devanagari: कोन वाञ्छा पूरण लागि’ व्रजेन्द्र कुमार ।
अवतीर्ण हैते मने करिला विचार ॥52॥
cc-adi-13.52.translation: To fulfill a particular desire within His mind, Lord Kṛṣṇa, Vrajendra-kumāra, decided to descend on this planet after mature contemplation.

lines: saṅkṣepe kahiye, kahā nā yāya vistāra
devanagari: आगे अवतारिला ये ये गुरु - परिवार ।
सङ्क्षेपे कहिये, कहा ना याय विस्तार ॥53॥
cc-adi-13.53.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa therefore first allowed His family of superiors to descend on the earth. I shall try to describe them in brief because it is not possible to describe them fully.

devanagari: श्री - शची - जगन्नाथ, श्री - माधव - पुरी ।
केशव भारती, आर श्री - ईश्वर पुरी ॥54॥
cc-adi-13.54-55.translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, before appearing as Lord Caitanya, requested these devotees to precede Him: Śrī Śacīdevī, Jagannātha Miśra, Mādhavendra Purī, Keśava Bhāratī, Īśvara Purī, Advaita Ācārya, Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita, Ācāryaratna, Vidyānidhi and Ṭhākura Haridāsa.

devanagari: श्रीहट्ट - निवासी श्री - उपेन्द्र मिश्र - नाम ।
वैष्णव, पण्डित, धनी, सद्गुण - प्रधान ॥56॥
cc-adi-13.56.translation: There was also Śrī Upendra Miśra, a resident of the district of Śrīhaṭṭa. He was a great devotee of Lord Viṣṇu, a learned scholar, a rich man and a reservoir of all good qualities.

devanagari: सप्त मिश्र ताँर पुत्र - सप्त ऋषीश्वर ।
कंसारि, परमानन्द, पद्मनाभ, सर्वेश्वर ॥57॥
cc-adi-13.57-58.translation: Upendra Miśra had seven sons, who were all saintly and most influential: (1) Kaṁsāri, (2) Paramānanda, (3) Padmanābha, (4) Sarveśvara, (5) Jagannātha, (6) Janārdana and (7) Trailokyanātha. Jagannātha Miśra, the fifth son, decided to reside on the bank of the Ganges at Nadia.

devanagari: जगन्नाथ मिश्रवर - पदवी ‘पुरन्दर’ ।
नन्द - वसुदेव - रूप सद्गुण - सागर ॥59॥
cc-adi-13.59.translation: Jagannātha Miśra was designated as Purandara. Exactly like Nanda Mahārāja and Vasudeva, he was an ocean of all good qualities.

devanagari: एइ त’ कहिल ग्रन्थारम्भे मुख - बन्ध ।
एबे कहि चैतन्य - लीला - क्रम - अनुबन्ध ॥6॥
cc-adi-13.6.translation: Thus I have spoken the preface of Caitanya-caritāmṛta. Now I shall describe Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes in chronological order.

devanagari: ताँर पत्नी ‘शची’ - नाम, पतिव्रता सती ।
याँर पिता ‘नीलाम्बर’ नाम चक्रवर्ती ॥60॥
cc-adi-13.60.translation: His wife, Śrīmatī Śacīdevī, was a chaste woman highly devoted to her husband. Śacīdevī's father's name was Nīlāmbara, and his surname was Cakravartī.

devanagari: राढ़देशे जन्मिला ठाकुर नित्यानन्द ।
गङ्गादास पण्डित, गुप्त मुरारि, मुकुन्द ॥61॥
cc-adi-13.61.translation: In Rāḍhadeśa, the part of Bengal where the Ganges is not visible, Nityānanda Prabhu, Gaṅgādāsa Paṇḍita, Murāri Gupta and Mukunda took birth.

devanagari: असङ्ख्य भक्तेर कराइला अवतार ।
शेषे अवतीर्ण हैला व्रजेन्द्र कुमार ॥62॥
cc-adi-13.62.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa, Vrajendra-kumāra, first caused countless devotees to appear, and at last He appeared Himself.

devanagari: प्रभुर आविर्भाव - पूर्वे व्रत वैष्णव - गण ।
अद्वैत - आचार स्थाने करेन गमन ॥63॥
cc-adi-13.63.translation: Before the appearance of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the devotees of Navadvīpa used to gather in the house of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: गीता - भागवत कहे आचार्य - गोसाञि ।
ज्ञान - कर्म निन्दि’ करे भक्तिर बड़ाइ ॥64॥
cc-adi-13.64.translation: In these meetings of the Vaiṣṇavas, Advaita Ācārya used to recite Bhagavad-gītā and Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, decrying the paths of philosophical speculation and fruitive activity and establishing the superexcellence of devotional service.

lines: jñāna, yoga, tapo-dharma nāhi māne āna
devanagari: सर्व - शास्त्रे कहे कृष्ण - भक्तिर व्याख्यान ।
ज्ञान, योग, तपो - धर्म नाहि माने आन ॥65॥
cc-adi-13.65.translation: In all the revealed scriptures of Vedic culture, devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa is explained throughout. Therefore devotees of Lord Kṛṣṇa do not recognize the processes of philosophical speculation, mystic yoga, unnecessary austerity and so-called religious rituals. They do not accept any process but devotional service.

lines: tāṅra saṅge ānanda kare vaiṣṇavera gaṇa
devanagari: ताँर सङ्गे आनन्द करे वैष्णवेर गण ।
कृष्ण - कथा, कृष्ण - पूजा, नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ॥66॥
cc-adi-13.66.translation: In the house of Advaita Ācārya, all the Vaiṣṇavas took pleasure in always talking of Kṛṣṇa, always worshiping Kṛṣṇa and always chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.

lines: viṣaye nimagna loka dekhi' pāya duḥkha
devanagari: किन्तु सर्व - लोक दे खि’ कृष्ण - बहिर्मुख ।
विषये निमग्न लोक दे खि’ पाय दुःख ॥67॥
cc-adi-13.67.translation: But Śrī Advaita Ācārya Prabhu felt pained to see all the people without Kṛṣṇa consciousness simply merging in material sense enjoyment.

lines: kemate e saba lokera ha-ibe tāraṇa
devanagari: लोकेर नि स्तार - हेतु करेन चिन्तन ।
केमते ए सब लोकेर हुइबे तारण ॥68॥
cc-adi-13.68.translation: Seeing the condition of the world, He began to think seriously of how all these people could be delivered from the clutches of māyā.

lines: tabe ta' sakala lokera ha-ibe nistāra
devanagari: कृष्ण अवतरि’ करेन भक्तिर विस्तार ।
तबे त’ सकल लोकेर हइबे निस्तार ॥69॥
cc-adi-13.69.translation: Śrīla Advaita Ācārya Prabhu thought, "If Kṛṣṇa Himself appears to distribute the cult of devotional service, then only will liberation be possible for all people."

devanagari: प्रथमे त’ सूत्र - रूपे करिये गणन ।
पाछे ताहा विस्तारि करिब विवरण ॥7॥
cc-adi-13.7.translation: First let me give a synopsis of the Lord's pastimes. Then I shall describe them in detail.

devanagari: कृष्ण अवतारिते आचार्य प्रतिज्ञा करिया ।
कृष्ण - पूजा करे तुलसी - गङ्गाजल दिया ॥70॥
cc-adi-13.70.translation: With this consideration, Advaita Ācārya Prabhu, promising to cause Lord Kṛṣṇa to descend, began to worship the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, with tulasī leaves and water of the Ganges.

devanagari: कृष्णेर आह्वान करे सघन हुङ्कार ।
हुङ्कारे आकृष्ट हैला व्रजेन्द्रकुमार ॥71॥
cc-adi-13.71.translation: By loud cries He invited Kṛṣṇa to appear, and this repeated invitation attracted Lord Kṛṣṇa to descend.

lines: aṣṭa kanyā krame haila, janmi' janmi' mare
devanagari: जगन्नाथमिश्र - पत्नी शचीर उदरे ।
अष्ट कन्या क्रमे हैल, जन्मि’ जन्मि’ मरे ॥72॥
cc-adi-13.72.translation: Before the birth of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, eight daughters took birth one after another from the womb of Śacīmātā, the wife of Jagannātha Miśra. But just after their birth, they all died.

devanagari: अपत्य - विरहे मिश्रेर दुःखी हैल मन ।
पुत्र लागि’ आराधिल विष्णुर चरण ॥73॥
cc-adi-13.73.translation: Jagannātha Miśra was very unhappy at the death of his children one after another. Therefore, desiring a son, he worshiped the lotus feet of Lord Viṣṇu.

devanagari: तबे पुत्र जनमिला ‘विश्वरूप’ नाम ।
महा - गुणवान् तेह - ‘बलदेव’ - धाम ॥74॥
cc-adi-13.74.translation: After this, Jagannātha Miśra got a son of the name Viśvarūpa, who was most powerful and highly qualified because He was an incarnation of Baladeva.

devanagari: बलदेव - प्रकाश - परम - व्योमे ‘सङ्कर्षण’ ।
तेह - विश्वेर उपादान - निमित्त - कारण ॥75॥
cc-adi-13.75.translation: The expansion of Baladeva known as Saṅkarṣaṇa in the spiritual world is the ingredient and immediate cause of this material cosmic manifestation.

lines: tāṅhā ba-i viśve kichu nāhi dekhi āra
devanagari: ताँहा बइ विश्वे किछु नाहि देखि आर ।
अतएव ‘विश्वरूप’ नाम ये ताँहार ॥76॥
cc-adi-13.76.translation: The gigantic universal form is called the Viśvarūpa incarnation of Mahā-saṅkarṣaṇa. Thus we do not find anything within this cosmic manifestation except the Lord Himself.

devanagari: नैतच्चि त्रं भगवति ह्यनन्ते जगदीश्वरे ।
ओतं प्रोतमिदं यस्मिन्तन्तुष्वङ्ग यथा पटः ॥77॥
cc-adi-13.77.translation: "As the thread in a cloth spreads both lengthwise and breadthwise, so everything we see within this cosmic manifestation is directly and indirectly existing in the Supreme Personality of Godhead. This is not very wonderful for Him."

devanagari: अतएव प्रभु ताँरे बले, ‘बड़ भा इ’ ।
कृष्ण, बलराम दुई - चैतन्य, निताई ॥78॥
cc-adi-13.78.translation: Because Mahā-saṅkarṣaṇa is the ingredient and efficient cause of the cosmic manifestation, He is present in every detail of it. Lord Caitanya therefore called Him His elder brother. The two brothers are known as Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma in the spiritual world, but at the present moment they are Caitanya and Nitāi. Therefore the conclusion is that Nityānanda Prabhu is the original Saṅkarṣaṇa, Baladeva.

lines: putra pāñā dampati hailā ānandita mana
devanagari: पुत्र पाञा दम्पति हैला आनन्दित मन ।
विशेषे सेवन करे गोविन्द - चरण ॥79॥
cc-adi-13.79.translation: The husband and wife [Jagannātha Miśra and Śacīmātā], having gotten Viśvarūpa as their son, were very pleased within their minds. Because of their pleasure, they specifically began to serve the lotus feet of Govinda.

devanagari: श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य नवद्वीपे अवतरि ।
आट - चल्लिश वत्सर प्रकट विहरि ॥8॥
cc-adi-13.8.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, adventing Himself in Navadvīpa, was visible for forty-eight years, enjoying His pastimes.

lines: caudda-śata chaya śake śeṣa māgha māse
devanagari: चौद्द - शत छय शके शेष माघ मासे ।
जगन्नाथ - शचीर देहे कृष्णेर प्रवेशे ॥80॥
cc-adi-13.80.translation: In the month of January in the year 1406 of the Śaka Era, Lord Kṛṣṇa entered the bodies of both Jagannātha Miśra and Śacī.

devanagari: मिश्र कहे शची - स्थाने, - देखि आन रीत ।
ज्योतिर्मय देह, गेह लक्ष्मी - अधिष्ठित ॥81॥
cc-adi-13.81.translation: Jagannātha Miśra said to Śacīmātā, "I see wonderful things! Your body is effulgent, and it appears as if the goddess of fortune were now staying personally in my home.

lines: ghare pāṭhāiyā deya dhana, vastra, dhāna
devanagari: याहाँ ताहाँ सर्व - लोक करये सम्मान ।
घरे पाठा इया देय धन, वस्त्र, धान ॥82॥
cc-adi-13.82.translation: "Anywhere and everywhere I go, all people offer me respect. Even without my asking, they voluntarily give me riches, clothing and paddy."

lines: divya-mūrti loka saba yena stuti kare
devanagari: शची कहे , - मुञि देखों आकाश - उपरे ।
दिव्य - मूर्ति लोक सब येन स्तुति करे ॥83॥
cc-adi-13.83.translation: Śacīmatā told her husband, "I also see wonderfully brilliant human beings appearing in outer space, as if offering prayers."

devanagari: जगन्नाथ मिश्र कहे , - स्वप्न ग्ने देखिल ।
ज्योतिर्मय - धाम मोर हृदये पशिल ॥84॥
cc-adi-13.84.translation: Jagannātha Miśra then replied, "In a dream I saw the effulgent abode of the Lord enter my heart.

lines: āmāra hṛdaya haite gelā tomāra hṛdaye
devanagari: आमार हृदय हैते गेला तोमार हृदये ।
हेन बुझि, जन्मिबेन कोन महाशये ॥85॥
cc-adi-13.85.translation: "From my heart it entered your heart. I therefore understand that a great personality will soon take birth."

lines: eta bali' duṅhe rahe haraṣita hañā
devanagari: एत बलि’ बँह रहे हरषित ह ञा ।
शालग्राम सेवा करे विशेष करिया ॥86॥
cc-adi-13.86.translation: After this conversation, both husband and wife were very jubilant, and together they rendered service to the household śālagrāma-śilā.

lines: haite haite haila garbha trayodaśa māsa
devanagari: हैते हैते हैल गर्भ त्रयोदश मास ।
तथापि भूमिष्ठ नहे, - मिश्रर हैल त्रास ॥87॥
cc-adi-13.87.translation: In this way the pregnancy approached its thirteenth month, but still there was no sign of the delivery of the child. Thus Jagannātha Miśra became greatly apprehensive.

lines: ei māse putra habe śubha-kṣaṇa pāñā
devanagari: नीलाम्बर चक्रवर्ती कहिल गणिया ।
एइ मासे पुत्र हबे शुभ - क्षण पाञा ॥88॥
cc-adi-13.88.translation: Nīlāmbara Cakravartī [the grandfather of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu] then did an astrological calculation and said that in that month, taking advantage of an auspicious moment, the child would take birth.

devanagari: चौद्द - शत सात - शके मास ये फाल्गुन ।
पौर्णमासीर सन्ध्या - काले हैले शुभ - क्षण ॥89॥
cc-adi-13.89.translation: Thus in the year 1407 of the Śaka Era, in the month of Phālguna [March-April], on the evening of the full moon, the desired auspicious moment appeared.

devanagari: चौद्द - शत सात शके जन्मेर प्रमाण ।
चौद्द - शत पञ्चान्ने हइल अन्तर्धान ॥9॥
cc-adi-13.9.translation: In the year 1407 of the Śaka Era, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared, and in the year 1455 He disappeared from this world.

devanagari: सिंह - राशि, सिंह - लग्न, उच्च ग्रह - गण ।
षड् - वर्ग, अष्ट - वर्ग, सर्व सुलक्षण ॥90॥
cc-adi-13.90.translation: According to the Jyotir-veda, or Vedic astronomy, when the figure of the lion appears both in the zodiac and the time of birth [lagna], this indicates a very high conjunction of planets, an area under the influence of ṣaḍ-varga and aṣṭa-varga, which are all-auspicious moments.

devanagari: अ - कलङ्क गौरचन्द्र दिला दरशन ।
स - कलङ्क चन्द्रे आर को प्रयोजन ॥91॥
cc-adi-13.91.translation: When the spotless moon of Caitanya Mahāprabhu became visible, what would be the need for a moon full of black marks on its body?

lines: eta jāni' rāhu kaila candrera grahaṇa
devanagari: एत जा नि’ राहु कैल चन्द्रेर ग्रहण ।
‘कृष्ण’ ‘कृष्ण’ ‘हरि’ नामे भासे त्रिभुवन ॥92॥
cc-adi-13.92.translation: Considering this, Rāhu, the black planet, covered the full moon, and immediately vibrations of "Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa! Hari!" inundated the three worlds.

lines: jaya jaya dhvani haila sakala bhuvana
camatkāra haiyā loka bhāve mane mana
devanagari: जय जय ध्वनि हैल सकल भुवन ।
चमत्कार हैया लोक भावे मने मन ॥93॥
cc-adi-13.93.translation: All people thus chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra during the lunar eclipse, and their minds were struck with wonder.

devanagari: जगत् भरिया लोक बले - ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ।
सेइ - क्षणे गौरकृष्ण भूमे अवतरि ॥94॥
cc-adi-13.94.translation: When the whole world was thus chanting the holy name of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa in the form of Gaurahari advented Himself on the earth.

devanagari: प्रसन्न हइल सब जगतेर मन ।
‘हरि’ बलि’ हिन्दुके हास्य करये यवन ॥95॥
cc-adi-13.95.translation: The whole world was pleased. While the Hindus chanted the holy name of the Lord, the non-Hindus, especially the Mohammedans, jokingly imitated the words.

devanagari: ‘हरि’ बलि’ नारीगण देइ हुलाहुलि ।
स्वर्गे वाद्य - नृत्य करे देव कुतूहली ॥96॥
cc-adi-13.96.translation: While all the ladies vibrated the holy name of Hari on earth, in the heavenly planets dancing and music were going on, for the demigods were very curious.

lines: prasanna haila daśa dik, prasanna nadījala
devanagari: प्रसन्न हैल दश दिक, प्रसन्न नदीजल ।
स्थावर - जङ्गम हैल आनन्दे विह्वल ॥97॥
cc-adi-13.97.translation: In this atmosphere, all the ten directions became jubilant, as did the waves of the rivers. Moreover, all beings, moving and nonmoving, were overwhelmed with transcendental bliss.

devanagari: नदीया - उदयगिरि, पूर्णचन्द्र गौरहरि
कृपा करि’ हइल उदय ।
पाप - तमः हैल नाश, त्रि - जगतेर उल्लास
जगभरि’ हरि - ध्वनि हय ॥98॥
cc-adi-13.98.translation: Thus by His causeless mercy the full moon, Gaurahari, rose in the district of Nadia, which is compared to Udayagiri, where the sun first becomes visible. His rising in the sky dissipated the darkness of sinful life, and thus the three worlds became joyful and chanted the holy name of the Lord.

devanagari: सेइ - काले निजालय, उठिया अद्वैत राय ,
नृत्य करे आनन्दित - मने ।
हरिदासे ल ञा सङ्गे, हुङ्कार - कीर्तन - रङ्गे
केने नाचे, केह नाहि जाने ॥99॥
cc-adi-13.99.translation: At that time Śrī Advaita Ācārya Prabhu, in His own house at Śāntipura, was dancing in a pleasing mood. Taking Haridāsa Ṭhākura with Him, He danced and loudly chanted Hare Kṛṣṇa. But why they were dancing, no one could understand.

devanagari: कथञ्चन स्मृते यस्मिन्दुष्करं सुकरं भवेत् ।
विस्मृते विपरीतं स्यात् श्री - चैतन्यं नमामि तम् ॥1॥
cc-adi-14.1.translation: Things that are very difficult to do become easy to execute if one somehow or other simply remembers Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. But if one does not remember Him, even easy things become very difficult. To this Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu I offer my respectful obeisances.

lines: sei kṣaṇe jāgi' nimāi karaye krandana
aṅke lañā śacī tāṅre piyāila stana
devanagari: सेइ क्षणे जा गि’ निमाई करये क्रन्दन ।
अङ्के लञा शची तारे पियाइल स्तन ॥10॥
cc-adi-14.10.translation: While mother Śacī and Jagannātha Miśra were talking, the child Nimāi woke up and began to cry, and mother Śacī took Him on her lap and allowed Him to suck her breast.

lines: sei cihna pāye dekhi' miśre bolāila
devanagari: स्तन पियाइते पुत्रेर चरण देखिल ।
सेइ चिह्न पाये दे खि’ मिश्रे बोलाइल ॥11॥
cc-adi-14.11.translation: While mother Śacī was feeding the child from her breast, she saw on His lotus feet all the marks that were visible on the floor of the room, and she called for Jagannātha Miśra.

devanagari: देखिया मिश्रेर हइल आनन्दित मति ।
गुप्ते बोलाइल नीलाम्बर चक्रवर्ती ॥12॥
cc-adi-14.12.translation: When Jagannātha Miśra saw the wonderful marks on the sole of his son, he became very joyful and privately called for Nīlāmbara Cakravartī.

lines: lagna gaṇi' pūrve āmi rākhiyāchi likhiyā
devanagari: चिह्न दे खि’ चक्रवर्ती बलेन हासिया ।
लग्न ग णि’ पूर्वे आमि राखियाछि लिखिया ॥13॥
cc-adi-14.13.translation: When Nīlāmbara Cakravartī saw those marks, he smilingly said, "Formerly I ascertained all this by astrological calculation and noted it in writing.

lines: ei śiśu aṅge dekhi se saba lakṣaṇa
devanagari: बत्रिश लक्षण - महापुरुष - भूषण ।
एइ शिशु अङ्गे देखि से सब लक्षण ॥14॥
cc-adi-14.14.translation: "There are thirty-two bodily marks that symptomize a great personality, and I see all those marks on the body of this child.

devanagari: पञ्च - दीर्घः पञ्च - सूक्ष्मः सप्त - रक्तः षड् - उन्नतः ।
त्रि - ह्रस्व - पृथु - गम्भीरो द्वात्रिंशल्लक्षणो महान् ॥15॥
cc-adi-14.15.translation: “ 'There are thirty-two bodily symptoms of a great person: five of his bodily parts are large, five fine, seven reddish, six raised, three small, three broad and three grave.'

lines: ei śiśu sarva loke karibe tāraṇa
devanagari: नाराय णेर चिह्न - मुक्त श्री - हस्त चरण ।
एइ शिशु सर्व लोके करिबे तारण ॥16॥
cc-adi-14.16.translation: "This baby has all the symptoms of Lord Nārāyaṇa on His palms and soles. He will be able to deliver all the three worlds.

lines: ihā haite habe dui kulera nistāra
devanagari: एइ त’ करिबे वैष्णव - धर्मेर प्रचार ।
इहा हैते हबे दुइ कुलेर निस्तार ॥17॥
cc-adi-14.17.translation: "This child will preach the Vaiṣṇava cult and deliver both His maternal and paternal families.

devanagari: महोत्सव कर, सब बोलाह ब्राह्मण ।
आजि दिन भाल , - करिब नाम - करण ॥18॥
cc-adi-14.18.translation: "I propose to perform a name-giving ceremony. We should observe a festival and call for the brāhmaṇas because today is very auspicious.

devanagari: सर्व - लोकेर करिबे इहँ धारण, पोषण ।
‘विश्वम्भर’ नाम इहार , - एइ त कारण ॥19॥
cc-adi-14.19.translation: "In the future this child will protect and maintain all the world. For this reason He is to be called Viśvambhara."

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य, जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैतचन्द्र, जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-14.2.translation: All glories to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu, Advaita Prabhu and all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

devanagari: शुनि’ शची - मिश्रेर मने आनन्द बाड़िल ।
ब्राह्मण - ब्राह्मणी आनि महोत्सव कैल ॥20॥
cc-adi-14.20.translation: After hearing Nīlāmbara Cakravartī's prediction, Śacīmātā and Jagannātha Miśra observed the name-giving festival in great joy, inviting all the brāhmaṇas and their wives.

devanagari: तबे कत दिने प्रभुर जानु - चङ्क्रमण ।
नाना चमत्कार तथा कराइल दर्शन ॥21॥
cc-adi-14.21.translation: After some days the Lord began to crawl on His knees, and He caused various wonderful things to be seen.

devanagari: क्रन्दनेर छले बलाइल हरि - नाम ।
नारी सब ‘हरि’ बले, - हासे गौर - धाम ॥22॥
cc-adi-14.22.translation: The Lord caused all the ladies to chant the holy names of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra on the plea of His crying, and while they chanted the Lord would smile.

devanagari: तबे कत दिने कैल पद - चङ्क्रमण ।
शिशु - गणे मि लि’ कैल विविध खेलन ॥23॥
cc-adi-14.23.translation: After some days the Lord began to move His legs and walk. He mixed with other children and exhibited varieties of sports.

lines: bāṭā bhari' diyā baila,—khāo ta' basiyā
devanagari: एकदिन शची खइ - सन्देश आनिया ।
बाटा भ रि’ दिया बैल , - खाओ त’ बसिया ॥24॥
cc-adi-14.24.translation: One day while the Lord was enjoying His playful sports with the other little children, mother Śacī brought a dish filled with fused rice and sweetmeats and asked the child to sit down and eat them.

lines: eta bali' gelā śacī gṛhe karma karite
devanagari: एत बलि’ गेला शची गृहे कर्म करिते ।
लुकाञा लागिला शिशु मृत्तिका खाइते ॥25॥
cc-adi-14.25.translation: But when she returned to her household duties, the child hiding from His mother, began to eat dirt.

lines: dekhi' śacī dhāñā āilā kari' 'hāya, hāya'
māti kāḍi' lañā kahe 'māṭi kene khāya'
devanagari: देखि’ शची धा ञा आइला क रि’ ‘हाय, हाय’ ।
माटि का ड़ि’ लञा कहे ‘माटि केने खा य’ ॥26॥
cc-adi-14.26.translation: Seeing this, mother Śacī hastily returned, exclaiming, "What is this! What is this!" She snatched the dirt from the hands of the Lord and inquired why He was eating it.

lines: tumi māṭi khāite dile, mora kibā doṣa
devanagari: कान्दिया बलेन शिशु, - केने कर रोष ।
तुमि माटि खाइते दिले, मोर किबा दोष ॥27॥
cc-adi-14.27.translation: Crying, the child inquired from His mother, "Why are you angry? You have already given Me dirt to eat. What is My fault?

lines: eho māṭi, seha māṭi, ki bheda-vicāra
devanagari: खइ - सन्देश - अन्न यतेक - माटिर विकार ।
एहो माटि, सेह माटि, कि भेद - विचार ॥28॥
cc-adi-14.28.translation: "Fused rice, sweetmeats or anything eatable is all but a transformation of dirt. This is dirt, that is dirt. Please consider. What is the difference between them?

lines: avicāre deha doṣa, ki balite pāri
devanagari: माटि - देह, माटि - भक्ष्य, देखह विचा रि’ ।
अविचारे देह दोष, कि बलिते पारि ॥29॥
cc-adi-14.29.translation: "This body is a transformation of dirt, and the eatables are also a transformation of dirt. Please reflect upon this. You are blaming Me without consideration. What can I say?"

devanagari: प्रभुर कहिल एइ जन्मलीला - सूत्र ।
यशोदा - नन्दन यैछे हैल शची - पुत्र ॥3॥
cc-adi-14.3.translation: I have thus described in brief the advent of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who appeared as the son of mother Śacī, exactly as Kṛṣṇa appeared as the son of mother Yaśodā.

devanagari: अन्तरे विस्मित शची बलिल ताहारे ।
माटि खाइते ज्ञान - योग के शिखाल तोरे ॥30॥
cc-adi-14.30.translation: Astonished that the child was speaking Māyāvāda philosophy, mother Śacī replied, "Who has taught You this philosophical speculation that justifies eating dirt?"

lines: māṭira vikāra anna khāile deha-puṣṭi haya
māṭi khāile roga haya, deha yāya kṣaya
devanagari: माटिर विकार अन्न खाइले देह - पुष्टि हय ।
माटि खाइले रोग हय, देह व्राय क्षय ॥31॥
cc-adi-14.31.translation: Replying to the Māyāvāda idea of the child philosopher, mother Śacī said, "My dear boy, if we eat earth transformed into grains, our body is nourished, and it becomes strong. But if we eat dirt in its crude state, the body becomes diseased instead of nourished, and thus it is destroyed.

lines: māṭira vikāra ghaṭe pāni bhari' āni
māṭi-piṇḍe dhari yabe, śoṣi' yāya pāni"
devanagari: माटिर विकार घटे पानि भ रि’ आनि ।
माटि - पिण्डे धरि यबे, शोषि’ याय पानि” ॥32॥
cc-adi-14.32.translation: "In a waterpot, which is a transformation of dirt, I can bring water very easily. But if I poured water on a lump of dirt, the lump would soak up the water, and my labor would be useless."

lines: "āge kena ihā, mātā, nā śikhāle more
devanagari: आत्म लुकाइते प्रभु बलिला ताँहारे ।
आगे केन इहा, माता, ना शिखाले मोरे ॥33॥
cc-adi-14.33.translation: The Lord replied to His mother, "Why did you conceal self-realization by not teaching Me this practical philosophy in the beginning?

lines: ebe se jānilāṅ, āra māṭi nā khāiba
kṣudhā lāge yabe, tabe tomāra stana piba"
devanagari: एबे से जानिलाँ, आर माटि ना खाइब ।
क्षुधा लागे यबे, तबे तोमार स्तन पिब ॥34॥
cc-adi-14.34.translation: "Now that I can understand this philosophy, no more shall I eat dirt. Whenever I am hungry I shall suck your breast and drink your breast's milk."

lines: stana pāna kare prabhu īṣat hāsiyā
devanagari: एत बलि’ जननीर कोलेते चड़िया ।
स्तन पान करे प्रभु ईषत् हासिया ॥35॥
cc-adi-14.35.translation: After saying this, the Lord, smiling slightly, climbed on the lap of His mother and sucked her breast.

devanagari: एइमते नाना - छले ऐश्वर्य देखाय ।
बाल्य - भाव प्रकटिया पश्चात् लुकाय ॥36॥
cc-adi-14.36.translation: Thus under various excuses the Lord exhibited His opulences as much as possible in His childhood, and later, after exhibiting such opulences, He hid Himself.

lines: pāche gupte sei vipre karila nistāra
devanagari: अतिथि - विप्रेर अन्न खाइल तिन - बार ।
पाछे गुप्ते सेइ विप्रे करिल निस्तार ॥37॥
cc-adi-14.37.translation: On one occasion the Lord ate the foodstuffs of a brāhmaṇa guest three times, and later, in confidence, the Lord delivered that brāhmaṇa from material engagement.

lines: core lañā gela prabhuke bāhire pāiyā
tāra skandhe caḍi' āilā tāre bhulāiyā
devanagari: चोरे ल ञा गेल प्रभुके बाहिरे पाइयो ।
तार स्क न्धे चड़ि’ आइला तारे भुलाइया ॥38॥
cc-adi-14.38.translation: In His childhood the Lord was taken away by two thieves outside His home. The Lord, however, got up on the shoulders of the thieves, and while they were thinking they were safely carrying the child to rob His ornaments, the Lord misled them, and thus instead of going to their own home the thieves came back to the home of Jagannātha Miśra.

devanagari: व्याधि - छले जगदीश - हिरण्य - सदने ।
विष्णु - नैवेद्य खाइल एकादशी - दिने ॥39॥
cc-adi-14.39.translation: Pretending to be sick, the Lord asked some foodstuffs from the house of Hiraṇya and Jagadīśa on the day of Ekādaśī.

devanagari: सङ्क्षेपे कहिल जन्मलीला - अनुक्रम ।
एबे कहि बाल्य लीला - सूत्रेर गणन ॥4॥
cc-adi-14.4.translation: I have already briefly spoken about the pastimes of His birth in chronological order. Now I shall enumerate the codes of His childhood pastimes.

lines: curi kari' dravya khāya māre bālakere
devanagari: शिशु सब लये पाड़ा - पड़सीर घरे ।
चुरि करि’ द्रव्य खाय मारे बालकेरे ॥40॥
cc-adi-14.40.translation: As usual for small children, He learned to play, and with His playmates He went to the houses of neighboring friends, stealing their eatables and eating them. Sometimes the children fought among themselves.

lines: śuni' śacī putre kichu dilā olāhana
devanagari: शिशु सब शची - स्थाने कैल निवेदन ।
शुनि’ शची पुत्रे किछु दिला ओलाहन ॥41॥
cc-adi-14.41.translation: All the children lodged complaints with Śacīmātā about the Lord's fighting with them and stealing from the neighbors' houses. Therefore sometimes she used to chastise or rebuke her son.

lines: kene para-ghare yāha, kibā nāhi ghare"
devanagari: “केने चुरि कर, केने मारह शिशुरे ।
केने पर - घरे याह, किबा नाहि घरे” ॥42॥
cc-adi-14.42.translation: Śacīmātā said, "Why do You steal others' things? Why do You beat the other children? And why do You go inside others' houses? What do You not have in Your own house?"

lines: śuni' kruddha hañā prabhu ghara-bhitara yāñā
ghare yata bhāṇḍa chila, phelila bhāṅgiyā
devanagari: शुनि’ क्रुद्ध हञा प्रभु घर - भितर याञा ।
घरे यत भाण्ड छिल, फेलिल भाङ्गिया ॥43॥
cc-adi-14.43.translation: Thus rebuked by His mother, he Lord would go in anger to a room and break all the pots within it.

lines: tabe śacī kole kari' karāila santoṣa
devanagari: तबे शची कोले क रि’ कराइल सन्तोष ।
लजित हइला प्रभु जानि’ निज - दोष ॥44॥
cc-adi-14.44.translation: Then Śacīmātā would take her son on her lap and pacify Him, and the Lord would be very much ashamed, admitting His own faults.

devanagari: कभु मृदु - हस्ते कैल माताके ताड़न ।
माताके मूर्च्छिता देखि’ करये क्रन्दन ॥45॥
cc-adi-14.45.translation: Once the child, Caitanya Mahāprabhu, chastised His mother with His soft hand, and His mother falsely fainted. Seeing this, the Lord began to cry.

devanagari: नारीगण कहे , - “नारिकेल देह आ नि’ ।
तबे सुस्थ हइबेन तोमार जननी” ॥46॥
cc-adi-14.46.translation: The neighboring ladies told Him, "Dear child, please bring a coconut from somewhere, and then Your mother will be cured."

devanagari: बाहिरे याजा आनिलेन दुइ नारिकेल ।
देखिया अपूर्व हैल विस्मित सकल ॥47॥
cc-adi-14.47.translation: He then immediately went outside the house and brought two coconuts. All the ladies were astonished to see such wonderful activities.

devanagari: कभु शिशु - सङ्गे स्नान करिल गङ्गाते ।
कन्यागण आइला ताहाँ देवता पूजिते ॥48॥
cc-adi-14.48.translation: Sometimes the Lord, with other children, would go to take bath in the Ganges, and the neighboring girls would also come there to worship various demigods.

devanagari: गङ्गा - स्नान क रि’ पूजा करिते लागिला ।
कन्यागण - मध्ये प्रभु आसिया बसिला ॥49॥
cc-adi-14.49.translation: When the girls, after bathing in the Ganges, engaged in worshiping the different demigods, the young Lord would come there and sit down among them.

devanagari: वन्दे चैतन्य - कृष्णस्य बाल्य - लीलां मनो - हराम् ।
लौकिकीमपि तामीश - चेष्टया वलितान्तराम् ॥5॥
cc-adi-14.5.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto the childhood pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself. Although such pastimes appear exactly like those of an ordinary child, they should be understood as various pastimes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

lines: kanyāre kahe,—āmā pūja, āmi diba vara
devanagari: कन्यारे कहे , - आमा पूज, आमि दिब वर ।
गङ्गा - दुर्गा - दासी मोर, महेश - किङ्कर ॥50॥
cc-adi-14.50.translation: Addressing the girls, the Lord would say, "Worship Me, and I shall give you good husbands or good benedictions. The Ganges and Goddess Durgā are My maidservants. Not to speak of other demigods, even Lord Śiva is My servant."

devanagari: आपनि चन्दन प रि’ परेन फुल - माला ।
नैवेद्य काड़िया खा’न - सन्देश, चाल, कला ॥51॥
cc-adi-14.51.translation: Without the permission of the girls, the Lord would take the sandalwood pulp and smear it on His own body, put the flower garlands on His neck, and snatch and eat all the offerings of sweetmeats, rice and bananas.

lines: grāma-sambandhe hao tumi āmā sabāra bhāi
devanagari: क्रोधे कन्यागण कहे शुन, - हे निमामि ।
ग्राम - सम्बन्धे हओ तुमि आमा सबार भाइ ॥52॥
cc-adi-14.52.translation: All the girls became very angry at the Lord for this behavior. "Dear Nimāi," they told Him, "You are just like our brother in our village relationship.

lines: āmā sabākāra pakṣe ihā karite nā yuyāya
nā laha devatā sajja, nā kara anyāya
devanagari: आमा सबाकार पक्षे इहा करिते ना युयाय ।
ना लह देवता सज्ज, ना कर अन्याय ॥53॥
cc-adi-14.53.translation: "Therefore it does not behoove You to act like this. Don't take our paraphernalia for worship of the demigods. Don't create a disturbance in this way."

lines: prabhu kahe,—"tomā sabāke dila ei vara
tomā sabāra bhartā habe parama sundara
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “तोमा सबाके दिल एइ वर ।
तोमा सबार भर्ता हबे परम सुन्दर” ॥54॥
cc-adi-14.54.translation: The Lord replied, "My dear sisters, I give you the benediction that your husbands will be very handsome.

devanagari: पण्डित, विदग्ध, युवा, धन - धान्यवान् ।
सात सात पुत्र हबे - चिरायु, मतिमान् ॥55॥
cc-adi-14.55.translation: "They will be learned, clever and young and possess abundant wealth and rice. Not only that, but you will each have seven sons, who will all live long lives and be very intelligent."

lines: bāhire bhartsana kare kari' mithyā roṣa
devanagari: वर शुनि’ कन्या - गणेर अन्तरे सन्तोष ।
बाहिरे भर्त्सन करे क रि’ मिथ्या रोष ॥56॥
cc-adi-14.56.translation: Hearing this benediction of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the girls were inwardly very happy, but externally, as is natural for girls, they rebuked the Lord under the pretense of anger.

lines: tāre ḍāki' kahe prabhu sakrodha ha-iyā
devanagari: कोन कन्या पलाइल नैवेद्य लइया ।
तारे डाकि’ कहे प्रभु सक्रोध हइया ॥57॥
cc-adi-14.57.translation: When some of the girls fled, the Lord called them in anger and advised them as follows:

lines: yadi naivedya nā deha ha-iyā kṛpaṇī
buḍā bhartā habe, āra cāri cāri satinī
devanagari: यदि नैवेद्य ना देह हइया कृपणी ।
बुड़ा भर्ता हवे, आर चारि चारि सतिनी ॥58॥
cc-adi-14.58.translation: "If you are miserly and do not give Me the offerings, every one of you will have an old husband with at least four co-wives."

lines: ihā śuni' tā-sabāra mane ha-ila bhaya
kona kichu jāne, kibā devāviṣṭa haya
devanagari: इहा शुनि’ ता - सबार मने हइल भय ।
कोन किछु जाने, किबा देवाविष्ट हय ॥59॥
cc-adi-14.59.translation: Hearing this supposed curse by Lord Caitanya, the girls, considering that He might know something uncommon or be empowered by demigods, were afraid that His curse might be effective.

devanagari: बाल्य - लीलाय आगे प्रभुर उत्तान शयन ।
पिता - माताय देखाइल चिह्न चरण ॥6॥
cc-adi-14.6.translation: In His first childhood pastimes the Lord turned upside down while lying on His bed, and thus He showed His parents the marks of His lotus feet.

devanagari: आनिया नैवेद्य तारा सम्मुखे धरिल ।
खाइया नैवेद्य तारे इष्ट - वर दिल ॥60॥
cc-adi-14.60.translation: The girls then brought the offerings before the Lord, who ate them all and blessed the girls to their satisfaction.

lines: ei mata cāpalya saba lokere dekhāya
duḥkha kāro mane nahe, sabe sukha pāya
devanagari: एइ मत चापल्य सब लोकेरे देखाय ।
दुःख कारो मने नहे, सबे सुख पाय ॥61॥
cc-adi-14.61.translation: When this cunning behavior of the Lord with the girls became known to the people in general, it did not create misunderstandings among them. Rather, they enjoyed happiness in these dealings.

devanagari: एक - दिन वल्लभाचार्य - कन्या ‘लक्ष्मी’ नाम ।
देवता पूजिते आइल करि गङ्गा - स्नान ॥62॥
cc-adi-14.62.translation: One day a girl of the name Lakṣmī, the daughter of Vallabhācārya, came to the bank of the Ganges to take bath in the river and worship the demigods.

lines: tāṅre dekhi' prabhura ha-ila sābhilāṣa mana
lakṣmī citte prīta pāila prabhura darśana
devanagari: ताँरे देखि’ प्रभुर हइल साभिलाष मन ।
लक्ष्मी चित्ते प्रीत पाइल प्रभुर दर्शन ॥63॥
cc-adi-14.63.translation: Seeing Lakṣmīdevī, the Lord became attached to her, and Lakṣmī, upon seeing the Lord, felt great satisfaction within her mind.

devanagari: साहजिक प्रीति दुँहार करिल उदय ।
बाल्य - भावाच्छन्न तभु हइल निश्चय ॥64॥
cc-adi-14.64.translation: Their natural love for one another awakened, and although it was covered by childhood emotions, it became apparent that they were mutually attracted.

lines: duṅhā dekhi' duṅhāra citte ha-ila ullāsa
devanagari: दुँहा देखि’ दुँहार चित्ते हइल उल्लास ।
देव - पूजा छले कैल हे परकाश ॥65॥
cc-adi-14.65.translation: They both enjoyed natural pleasure in seeing one another, and under the pretext of demigod worship they manifested their feelings.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, ‘आमा’ पूज, आमि महेश्वर ।
आमारे पूजिले पाबे अभीप्सित वर’ ॥66॥
cc-adi-14.66.translation: The Lord told Lakṣmī, "Just worship Me, for I am the Supreme Lord. If you worship Me, certainly you will get the benediction you desire."

devanagari: लक्ष्मी ताँर अङ्गे दिल पुष्प - चन्दन ।
मल्लिकार माला दिया करिल वन्दन ॥67॥
cc-adi-14.67.translation: On hearing the order of the Supreme Lord, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Lakṣmī immediately worshiped Him, offering sandalwood pulp and flowers for His body, garlanding Him with mallikā flowers, and offering prayers.

lines: prabhu tāṅra pūjā pāñā hāsite lāgilā
śloka paḍi' tāṅra bhāva aṅgīkāra kailā
devanagari: प्रभु ताँर पूजा पाञा हासिते लागिला ।
श्लोक प ड़ि’ ताँर भाव अङ्गीकार कैला ॥68॥
cc-adi-14.68.translation: Being worshiped by Lakṣmī, the Lord began to smile. He recited a verse from Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and thus accepted the emotion she expressed.

devanagari: सङ्कल्पो विदितः साध्व्यो भवतीनां मदर्चनम् ।
मयानुमोदितः सोऽसौ सत्यो भवितुमर्हति ॥69॥
cc-adi-14.69.translation: "My dear gopīs, I accept your desire to have Me as your husband and thus worship Me. I wish your desire to be fulfilled because it deserves to be so."

lines: tāhe śobhe dhvaja, vajra, śaṅkha, cakra, mīna
devanagari: गृहे दुइ जन देखि लघुपद - चिह्न ।
ताहे शोभे ध्वज, वज्र, शङ्ख, चक्र, मीन ॥7॥
cc-adi-14.7.translation: When the Lord tried to walk, in His small footprints the specific marks of Lord Viṣṇu were visible, namely, the flag, thunderbolt, conchshell, disc and fish.

lines: ei-mata līlā kari' duṅhe gelā ghare
devanagari: एइ - मत लीला क रि’ दुँहे गेला घरे ।
गम्भीर चैतन्य - लीला के बुझिते पारे ॥70॥
cc-adi-14.70.translation: After thus expressing their feelings to one another, Lord Caitanya and Lakṣmī returned home. Who can understand the grave pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

devanagari: चैतन्य - चापल्य दे खि’ प्रेमे सर्व जन ।
शची - जगन्नाथे दे खि’ देन ओलाहन ॥71॥
cc-adi-14.71.translation: Seeing the naughty behavior of Lord Caitanya, the neighboring people, out of love for Him, lodged complaints with Śacīmātā and Jagannātha Miśra.

devanagari: एकदिन शची - देवी पुत्रेरे भर्तिसया ।
धरिबारे गेला, पुत्र गेला पलाइया ॥72॥
cc-adi-14.72.translation: One day mother Śacī, wanting to rebuke her son, went to catch Him, but He fled from the spot.

devanagari: उच्छि ष्ट - गर्ते त्यक्त - हाण्डीर उपर ।
बसियाछेन सुखे प्रभु देव - विश्वम्भर ॥73॥
cc-adi-14.73.translation: Although He is the maintainer of the entire universe, once the Lord sat upon some rejected pots, in the pit where the remnants of foodstuffs were thrown, after they had been used for cooking.

devanagari: शची आ सि’ कहे, - केने अशुचि छुडिला ।
गङ्गा - स्नान कर याइ’ - अपवित्र हइला ॥74॥
cc-adi-14.74.translation: When mother Śacī saw her boy sitting on the rejected pots, she protested, "Why have You touched these untouchable pots? You have now become impure. Go and take bath in the Ganges."

devanagari: इहा शुनि’ माताके कहिल ब्रह्म - ज्ञान ।
विस्मिता हइया माता कराइल स्नान ॥75॥
cc-adi-14.75.translation: Hearing this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu taught His mother about absolute knowledge. Although amazed by this, His mother forced Him to take a bath.

devanagari: कभु पुत्र - सङ्गे शची करिला शयन ।
देखे, दिव्यलोक आ सि’ भरिल भवन ॥76॥
cc-adi-14.76.translation: Sometimes, taking her son with her, mother Śacī would lie down on her bed, and she would see that denizens of the celestial world had come there, filling the entire house.

devanagari: शची बले , - याह, पुत्र, बोलाह बापेरे ।
मातृ - आज्ञा पाइया प्रभु चलिला बाहिरे ॥77॥
cc-adi-14.77.translation: Once mother Śacī told the Lord, "Please go call Your father." Receiving this order from His mother, the Lord went out to call him.

devanagari: चलिते चरणे नूपुर बाजे झन्झन् ।
शुनि’ चमकित हैल पिता - मातार मन ॥78॥
cc-adi-14.78.translation: When the child was going out, there was a tinkling of ankle bells from His lotus feet. Hearing this, His father and mother were struck with wonder.

devanagari: मिश्र कहे , - एइ बड़ अद्भुत काहिनी ।
शिशुर शून्य - पदे केने नूपुरेर ध्वनि ॥79॥
cc-adi-14.79.translation: Jagannātha Miśra said, "This is a very wonderful incident. Why is there a sound of ankle bells from the bare feet of my child?"

lines: kāra pada-cihna ghare, nā pāya niścaya
devanagari: देखिया दोंहार चित्ते जन्मिल विस्मय ।
कार पद - चिह्न घरे, ना पाय निश्चय ॥8॥
cc-adi-14.8.translation: Seeing all these marks, neither His father nor His mother could understand whose footprints they were. Thus struck with wonder, they could not understand how those marks could be possible in their home.

lines: divya divya loka āsi' aṅgana bharila
devanagari: शची कहे , - आर एक अद्भुत देखिल ।
दिव्य दिव्य लोक आ सि’ अङ्गन भरिल ॥80॥
cc-adi-14.80.translation: Mother Śacī said, "I also saw another wonder. People were coming down from the celestial kingdom and crowding the entire courtyard.

lines: kibā kelāhala kare, bujhite nā pāri
devanagari: किबा कोलाहल करे, बुझिते ना पारि ।
काहाके वा स्तुति करे - अनुमान करि ॥81॥
cc-adi-14.81.translation: "They made noisy sounds I could not understand. I guess they were offering prayers to someone."

lines: miśra bale,—kichu ha-uk, cintā kichu nāi
devanagari: मिश्र बले , - किछु हउक्, चिन्ता किछु नाइ ।
विश्वम्भरेर कुशल हउक्, - एइ मात्र चाइ ॥82॥
cc-adi-14.82.translation: Jagannātha Miśra replied, "Never mind what it is. There is no need to worry. Let there always be good fortune for Viśvambhara. This is all I want."

devanagari: एक - दिन मिश्र पुत्रेर चापल्य देखिया ।
धर्म - शिक्षा दिल बहु भर्त्सना करिया ॥83॥
cc-adi-14.83.translation: On another occasion, Jagannātha Miśra, seeing the mischievous acts of his son, gave Him lessons in morality after rebuking Him greatly.

devanagari: रात्रे स्वप्न देखे , - एक आ सि’ ब्राह्मण ।
मिश्रेरे कहये किछु स - रोष वचन ॥84॥
cc-adi-14.84.translation: On that very night, Jagannātha Miśra dreamt that a brāhmaṇa had come before him speaking these words in great anger:

lines: "miśra, tumi putrera tattva kichui nā jāna
devanagari: “मिश्र, तुमि पुत्रेर तत्त्व किछुइ ना जान ।
भर्त्सन - ताड़न कर , - पुत्र करि’ मान” ॥85॥
cc-adi-14.85.translation: "My dear Miśra, you do not know anything about your son. You think Him your son, and therefore you rebuke and chastise Him."

lines: miśra kahe,—deva, siddha, muni kene naya
ye se baḍa ha-uk mātra āmāra tanaya
devanagari: मिश्र कहे , - देव, सिद्ध, मुनि केने नय ।
ये से बड़ हउक् मात्र आमार तनय ॥86॥
cc-adi-14.86.translation: Jagannātha Miśra replied, "This boy may be a demigod, a mystic yogī or a great saintly person. It doesn't matter what He is, for I think He is only my son.

lines: āmi nā śikhāle kaiche janibe dharma-marma
devanagari: पुत्रेर लालन - शिक्षा - पितार स्व - धर्म ।
आमि ना शिखाले कैछे जनिबे धर्म - मर्म ॥87॥
cc-adi-14.87.translation: "It is the duty of a father to educate his son in both religion and morality. If I do not give Him this education, how will He know of it?"

devanagari: विप्न कहे , - पुत्र यदि दैव - सिद्ध हय ।
स्वतः - सिद्ध - ज्ञान, तबे शिक्षा व्यर्थ हय ॥88॥
cc-adi-14.88.translation: The brāhmaṇa replied, "If your son is a transcendental mystic boy with self-effulgent perfect knowledge, what is the use of your education?"

devanagari: मिश्र कहे , - “पुत्र केने नहे नारायण ।
तथापि पितार धर्मपुत्रेर शिक्षण” ॥89॥
cc-adi-14.89.translation: Jagannātha Miśra replied, "Even if my son is not a common man but Nārāyaṇa, still it is the duty of a father to instruct his son."

lines: teṅho mūrti hañā ghare khele, jāni, raṅge
devanagari: मिश्र कहे , - बालगोपाल आछे शिला - सङ्गे ।
तेंहो मूर्ति हञा घरे खेले, जानि, रङ्गे ॥9॥
cc-adi-14.9.translation: Jagannātha Miśra said, "Certainly child Kṛṣṇa is with the śālagrāma-śilā. Taking His childhood form, He is playing within the room."

devanagari: एइ - मते दुँहे करेन धर्मेर विचार ।
विशुद्ध - वात्सल्य मिशेर, नाहि जाने आर ॥90॥
cc-adi-14.90.translation: In this way Jagannātha Miśra and the brāhmaṇa discussed the principles of religion in the dream, yet Jagannātha Miśra was absorbed in unalloyed parental mellow and did not want to know anything else.

lines: eta śuni' dvija gelā hañā ānandita
devanagari: एत शुनि’ द्विज गेला ह ञा आनन्दित ।
मिश्र जागिया हइला परम विस्मित ॥91॥
cc-adi-14.91.translation: Being very much pleased, the brāhmaṇa left after talking with Jagannātha Miśra, and when Jagannātha Miśra awakened from his dream, he was very much astonished.

devanagari: बन्धु - बान्धव - स्थाने स्वप्न कहिल ।
शुनिया सकल लोक विस्मित हइल ॥92॥
cc-adi-14.92.translation: He related the dream to his friends and relatives, and every one of them was very much astonished to hear of it.

devanagari: एइ मत शिशु - लीला करे गौरचन्द्र ।
दिने दिने पिता - मातार बाड़ाय आनन्द ॥93॥
cc-adi-14.93.translation: In this way Gaurahari performed His childhood pastimes and day after day increased the pleasure of His parents.

lines: kata dine miśra putrera hāte khaḍi dila
devanagari: कत दिने मिश्र पुत्रेर हाते खड़ि दिल ।
अल्प दिने द्वादश - फला अक्षर शिखिल ॥94॥
cc-adi-14.94.translation: After some days Jagannātha Miśra inaugurated the primary education of his son by performing the hāte khaḍi ceremony. Within a very few days the Lord learned all the letters and combinations of letters.

devanagari: बाल्यलीला - सूत्र एइ कैल अनुक्रम ।
इहा विस्तारियाछेन दा स - वृन्दावन ॥95॥
cc-adi-14.95.translation: This is a synopsis of the childhood pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, placed herewith in chronological order. Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has already elaborately explained these pastimes in his book Caitanya-bhāgavata.

devanagari: अतएव एइ - लीला सङ्क्षेपे सूत्र कैल ।
पुनरुक्ति - भये विस्तारिया ना कहिल ॥96॥
cc-adi-14.96.translation: I have therefore made only a brief summary. Being afraid of repetition, I have not elaborated upon this subject matter.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥97॥
cc-adi-14.97.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: कु - मनाः सु - मनस्त्वं हि याति यस्य पदाब्जयोः ।
सु - मनोऽर्पण - मात्रेण तं चैतन्य - प्रभुं भजे ॥1॥
cc-adi-15.1.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of Lord Caitanya because simply by offering a sumanas flower at His lotus feet even the most ardent materialist becomes a devotee.

devanagari: शची कहे , - ना खाइब, भाल - इ कहिला ।
सेइ हैते एकादशी करिते लागिला ॥10॥
cc-adi-15.10.translation: Mother Śacī said, "You have spoken very nicely. I shall not eat grains on Ekādaśī." From that day, she began to observe fasting on Ekādaśī.

lines: kanyā cāhi' vivāha dite karilena mana
devanagari: तबे मिश्र विश्वरूपेर देखिया यौवन ।
कन्या चा हि’ विवाह दिते करिलेन मन ॥11॥
cc-adi-15.11.translation: Thereafter, seeing Viśvarūpa a grown-up youth, Jagannātha Miśra wanted to find a girl and arrange a marriage ceremony for Him.

devanagari: विश्वरूप शुनि’ घर छाड़ि पलाइला ।
सन्न्यास करिया तीर्थ करिबारे गेला ॥12॥
cc-adi-15.12.translation: Hearing of this, Viśvarūpa immediately left home and went away to accept sannyāsa and travel from one place of pilgrimage to another.

devanagari: शुनि, शची - मिश्रेर दुःखी हैल मन ।
तबे प्रभु माता - पितार कैल आश्वासन ॥13॥
cc-adi-15.13.translation: When Śacīmātā and Jagannātha Miśra heard of the departure of their elder son, Viśvarūpa, they were very unhappy, but Lord Caitanya tried to console them.

devanagari: भाल हैल , - विश्वरूप सन्न्यास करिल ।
पितृ - कुल, मातृ - कुल, दुइ उद्धारिल ॥14॥
cc-adi-15.14.translation: "My dear mother and father," the Lord said, "it is very good that Viśvarūpa has accepted the sannyāsa order, for thus He has delivered both His father's family and His mother's family."

lines: āmi ta' kariba tomā' duṅhara sevana
devanagari: आमि त’ करिब तोमा’ दुँहार सेवन ।
शुनिया सन्तुष्ट हैल पिता - मातार मन ॥15॥
cc-adi-15.15.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu assured His parents that He would serve them, and thus the minds of His father and mother were satisfied.

devanagari: एक - दिन नैवेद्य - ताम्बूल खाइया ।
भूमिते पड़िला प्रभु अचेतन हञा ॥16॥
cc-adi-15.16.translation: One day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate betel nuts offered to the Deity, but they acted as an intoxicant, and He fell down on the ground unconscious.

lines: sustha hañā kahe prabhu apūrva kāhinī
devanagari: आस्ते - व्यस्ते पिता - माता मुखे दिल पानि ।
सुस्थ हञा कहे प्रभु अपूर्व काहिनी ॥17॥
cc-adi-15.17.translation: After His father and mother sprinkled water on His mouth with great haste, the Lord revived and said something wonderful they had never heard before.

lines: ethā haite viśvarūpa more lañā gelā
devanagari: एथा हैते विश्वरूप मोरे ल ञा गेला ।
सन्न्यास करह तुमि, आमारे कहिला ॥18॥
cc-adi-15.18.translation: The Lord said, "Viśvarūpa took Me away from here, and He requested Me to accept the sannyāsa order.

devanagari: आमि कहि , - आमार अनाथ पिता - माता ।
आमि बालक, सन्यासेर किबा जानि कथा ॥19॥
cc-adi-15.19.translation: "I replied to Viśvarūpa, 'I have My helpless father and mother, and also I am but a child. What do I know about the sannyāsa order of life?

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैतचन्द्र, जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-15.2.translation: All glories to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

devanagari: गृहस्थ हइया करिब पिता - मातार सेवन ।
इहाते - इ तुष्ट हबेन लक्ष्मी - नारायण ॥20॥
cc-adi-15.20.translation: “ 'Later I shall become a householder and thus serve My parents, for this action will very much satisfy Lord Nārāyaṇa and His wife, the goddess of fortune.'

devanagari: तबे विश्वरूप इहाँ पाठाइल मोरे ।
माताके कहिओ कोटि कोटि नमस्कारे ॥21॥
cc-adi-15.21.translation: "Then Viśvarūpa returned Me home and requested, 'Offer thousands and thousands of obeisances unto My mother, Śacīdevī.' "

lines: ei mata nānā līlā kare gaurahari
ki kāraṇe līlā,—ihā bujhite nā pāri
devanagari: एइ मत नाना लीला करे गौरहरि ।
कि कारणे लीला , - इहा बुझिते ना पारि ॥22॥
cc-adi-15.22.translation: In this way Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed various pastimes, but why He did so I cannot understand.

lines: kata dina rahi' miśra gelā para-loka
devanagari: कत दिन र हि’ मिश्र गेला पर - लोक ।
माता - पुत्र दुँहार बाड़िल हृदि शोक ॥23॥
cc-adi-15.23.translation: After some days, Jagannātha Miśra passed away from this world to the transcendental world, and both mother and son were very much aggrieved in their hearts.

devanagari: बन्धु - बान्धव अ सि’ बँहा प्रबोधिल ।
पितृ - क्रिया विधि - मते ईश्वर करिल ॥24॥
cc-adi-15.24.translation: Friends and relatives came there to pacify both Lord Caitanya and His mother. Then Lord Caitanya, even though He was the Supreme Personality of Godhead, executed the rituals for His dead father according to the Vedic system.

lines: kata dine prabhu citte karilā cintana
devanagari: कत दिने प्रभु चित्ते करिला चिन्तन ।
गृहस्थ हइलाम, एबे चाहि गृह - धर्म ॥25॥
cc-adi-15.25.translation: After some days the Lord thought, "I did not take sannyāsa, and since I am remaining at home it is My duty to act as a gṛhastha.

lines: gṛhiṇī vinā gṛha-dharma nā haya śobhana
eta cinti' vivāha karite haila mana
devanagari: गृहिणी विना गृह - धर्म ना हय शोभन ।
एत चि न्ति’ विवाह करते हैल मन ॥26॥
cc-adi-15.26.translation: "Without a wife," Lord Caitanya considered, "there is no meaning to householder life." Thus the Lord decided to marry.

devanagari: न गृहं गृहमित्याहुगृहिणी गृहमुच्यते ।
तया हि सहितः सर्वान्पुरुषार्थान्समश्नुते ॥27॥
cc-adi-15.27.translation: "Merely a house is not a home, for it is a wife who gives a home its meaning. If one lives at home with his wife, together they can fulfill all the interests of human life."

lines: daive eka dina prabhu paḍiyā āsite
devanagari: दैवे एक दिन प्रभु पड़िया आसिते ।
वल्लभाचार्येर कन्या देखे गङ्गा - पथे ॥28॥
cc-adi-15.28.translation: One day when the Lord was coming back from school He accidently saw the daughter of Vallabhācārya on the way to the Ganges.

devanagari: पूर्व - सिद्ध भाव दुँहार उदय करिल ।
दैवे वनमाली घटक शची - स्थाने आइल ॥29॥
cc-adi-15.29.translation: When the Lord and Lakṣmīdevī met, their relationship awakened, having already been settled, and coincidently the marriage-maker Vanamālī came to see Śacīmātā.

devanagari: पौगण्ड - लीलार सूत्र करिये गणन ।
पौगण्ड - वयसे प्रभुर मुख्य अध्ययन ॥3॥
cc-adi-15.3.translation: Let me now enumerate the activities of the Lord between the ages of five and ten. His chief occupation during this period was to engage Himself in study.

devanagari: शचीर इङ्गिते सम्बन्ध करिल घटन ।
लक्ष्मीके विवाह कैल शचीर नन्दन ॥30॥
cc-adi-15.30.translation: Following the indications of Śacīdevī, Vanamālī Ghaṭaka arranged the marriage, and thus in due course the Lord married Lakṣmīdevī.

devanagari: विस्तारिया वर्णिला ताहा वृन्दावन - दास ।
एइ त’ पौगण्ड - लीलार सूत्र - प्रकाश ॥31॥
cc-adi-15.31.translation: Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has elaborately described all these pastimes of the Lord's early age. What I have given is but a condensed representation of the same pastimes.

devanagari: पौगण्ड वयसे लीला बहुत प्रकार ।
वृन्दावन - दास इहा करियाछेन विस्तार ॥32॥
cc-adi-15.32.translation: The Lord performed many varieties of pastimes in His early age, and Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has described them elaborately.

devanagari: अतएव दिंमात्र इहाँ देखाइल ।
‘चैतन्य मङ्गले’ सर्व - लोके ख्यात हैल ॥33॥
cc-adi-15.33.translation: I have given but a single hint of these pastimes, for Vrndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, in his book Caitanya-maṅgala [now Caitanya-bhāgavata], has described them all vividly.

cc-adi-15.34.devanagari:
श्री-रूप-रघुनाथ-पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य-चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥३४॥
cc-adi-15.34.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

cc-adi-15.4.devanagari:
पौगण्ड-लीला चैतन्य-
कृष्णस्यातिसुविस्तृता ।
विद्यारम्भमुखा पाणि-
ग्रहणान्ता मनोहरा ॥४॥
cc-adi-15.4.translation: The pastimes of the Lord during His paugaṇḍa age were very extensive. His education was His chief occupation, and after that His very beautiful marriage took place.

cc-adi-15.5.devanagari:
गङ्गादास पण्डित-स्थाने पढ़ेन व्याकरण ।
श्रवण-मात्रे कण्ठे कैला सूत्र-वृत्ति-गण ॥५॥
cc-adi-15.5.translation: When the Lord was studying grammar at the place of Gaṅgādāsa Paṇḍita, He would immediately learn grammatical rules and definitions by heart simply by hearing them once.

devanagari: अल्प - काले हैला पञ्जी - टीकाते प्र वीण ।
चिर - कालेर प डुया जिने हइया नवीन ॥6॥
cc-adi-15.6.translation: He soon became so expert in commenting on the Pañjī-ṭīkā that He could win victory over all the other students, although He was a neophyte.

cc-adi-15.7.devanagari:
अध्ययन-लीला प्रभुर वृन्दावन ।
'चैतन्य-मङ्गले' कैल विस्तारि वर्णन ॥७॥
cc-adi-15.7.translation: In his book Caitanya-maṅgala [which later became Caitanya-bhāgavata], Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura very elaborately described the Lord's pastimes of study.

lines: eka dina mātāra pade kariyā praṇāma
prabhu kahe,—mātā, more deha eka dāna
cc-adi-15.8.devanagari:
एक दिन मातर पदे करिया प्रणाम ।
प्रभु कहे,—मात, मोरे देह एक दान ॥८॥
cc-adi-15.8.translation: One day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell down at the feet of His mother and requested her to give Him one thing in charity.

lines: mātā bale,—tāi diba, yā tumi māgibe
cc-adi-15.9.devanagari:
माता बले,—ताइ दिब, या तुमि मागिबे ।
प्रभु कहे,—एकादशीते अन्न ना खाइबे ॥९॥
cc-adi-15.9.translation: His mother replied, "My dear son, I will give You whatever You ask." Then the Lord said, "My dear mother, please do not eat grains on the Ekādaśī day."

cc-adi-16.1.devanagari:
कृपा-सुधा-सरीद् यस्य
विश्वम् आप्लावयन्त्य् अपि
नीच-गैव सदा भाति
तं चैतन्य-प्रभुं भजे ॥१॥
cc-adi-16.1.translation: I worship Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whose nectarean mercy flows like a great river, inundating the entire universe. Just as a river flows downstream, Lord Caitanya especially extends Himself to the fallen.

devanagari: सेइ देशे विप्र, नाम - मिश्र तपन ।
निश्चय करिते नारे साध्य - साधन ॥10॥
cc-adi-16.10.translation: In East Bengal there was a brāhmaṇa named Tapana Miśra who could not ascertain the objective of life nor how to attain it.

lines: tomā-sama kavi kothā nāhi dekhi āra
cc-adi-16.100.devanagari:
तोमार कवित्व येन गङ्गा-जल-धार ।
तोमा-सम कवि कोथा नाहि देखि आर ॥१००॥
cc-adi-16.100.translation: "Your poetic skill is like the constant flow of the waters of the Ganges. I find no one in the world who can compete with you.

cc-adi-16.101.devanagari:
भवभूति, जयदेव, आर कालिदास ।
ताँ-सबार कवित्वे आछे दोषेर प्रकाश ॥१०१॥
cc-adi-16.101.translation: "Even in the poetic compositions of such great poets as Bhavabhūti, Jayadeva and Kālidāsa there are many examples of faults.

devanagari: दोष - गुण - विचार - एइ अल्प क रि’ मानि ।
कवित्व - करणे शक्ति, ताँहा से वाखानि ॥102॥
cc-adi-16.102.translation: "Such mistakes should be considered negligible. One should see only how such poets have displayed their poetic power.

lines: śiṣyera samāna muñi nā haṅ tomāra
devanagari: शैशव - चापल्य किछु ना लबे आमार ।
शिष्येर समान मुञि ना हँ तोमार ॥103॥
cc-adi-16.103.translation: "I am not even fit to be your disciple. Therefore kindly do not take seriously whatever childish impudence I have shown.

lines: āji vāsā' yāha, kāli miliba ābāra
devanagari: आजि वासा’ याह, कालि मिलिब आबार ।
शुनिब तोमार मुखे शास्त्रेर विचार ॥104॥
cc-adi-16.104.translation: "Please go back home, and tomorrow we may meet again so that I may hear discourses on the śāstras from your mouth."

lines: ei-mate nija ghare gelā dui jana
devanagari: एइ - मते निज घरे गेला दुइ जन ।
कवि रात्रे कैल सरस्वती - आराधन ॥105॥
cc-adi-16.105.translation: In this way both the poet and Caitanya Mahāprabhu went back to their homes, and at night the poet worshiped mother Sarasvatī.

devanagari: सरस्वती स्वप्ने ताँरे उपदेश कैल ।
साक्षातीश्वर क रि’ प्रभुके जानिल ॥106॥
cc-adi-16.106.translation: In a dream the goddess informed him of the Lord's position, and the poetic champion could understand that Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself.

lines: prabhu kṛpā kaila, tāṅra khaṇḍila bandhana
devanagari: प्राते आ सि’ प्रभु - पदे लइल शरण ।
प्रभु कृपा कैल, ताँर खण्डिल बन्धन ॥107॥
cc-adi-16.107.translation: The next morning the poet came to Lord Caitanya and surrendered unto His lotus feet. The Lord bestowed His mercy upon him and cut off all his bondage to material attachment.

devanagari: भाग्यवन्त दिग्विजयी सफल - जीवन ।
विद्या - बले पाइल महाप्रभुर चरण ॥108॥
cc-adi-16.108.translation: The poetic champion was certainly most fortunate. His life was successful by dint of his vast learning and erudite scholarship, and thus he attained the shelter of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: ye kichu viśeṣa ihāṅ karila prakāśa
devanagari: ए - सब लीला वर्णियाछेन वृन्दावन - दास ।
ये किछु विशेष इहाँ करिल प्रकाश ॥109॥
cc-adi-16.109.translation: Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has described all these incidents elaborately. I have only presented the specific incidents he has not described.

devanagari: बहु - शास्त्रे बहु - वाक्ये चित्ते भ्रम हय ।
साध्य - साधन श्रेष्ठ ना हय निश्चय ॥11॥
cc-adi-16.11.translation: If one becomes a bookworm, reading many books and scriptures and hearing many commentaries and the instructions of many men, this will produce doubt within his heart. One cannot in this way ascertain the real goal of life.

devanagari: चैतन्य - गोसाञि र लीला - अमृतेर धार ।
सर्वेन्द्रिय तृप्त हय श्रवणे याहार ॥110॥
cc-adi-16.110.translation: The nectarean drops of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes can satisfy the senses of everyone who hears them.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥111॥
cc-adi-16.111.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: स्वप्ने एक विप्र कहे , - शुनह तपन ।
निमाजि - पण्डित पाशे करह गमन ॥12॥
cc-adi-16.12.translation: Tapana Miśra, being thus bewildered, was directed by a brāhmaṇa in a dream to go to Nimāi Paṇḍita [Caitanya Mahāprabhu].

devanagari: तेंहो तोमार साध्य - साधन करिबे निश्चय ।
साक्षातीश्वर तेंहो , - नाहिक संशय ॥13॥
cc-adi-16.13.translation: "Because He is the Lord [īśvara]," the brāhmaṇa told him, "undoubtedly He can give you proper direction."

lines: svapna dekhi' miśra āsi' prabhura caraṇe
devanagari: स्वप्न दे खि’ मिश्र आ सि’ प्रभुर चरणे ।
स्वप्नेर वृत्तान्त सब कैल निवेदने ॥14॥
cc-adi-16.14.translation: After seeing the dream, Tapana Miśra came to the shelter of Lord Caitanya's lotus feet, and he described all the details of the dream to the Lord.

devanagari: प्रभु तुष्ट हञा साध्य - साधन कहिल ।
नाम - सङ्कीर्तन कर, - उपदेश कैल ॥15॥
cc-adi-16.15.translation: The Lord, being satisfied, instructed him about the object of life and the process to attain it. He instructed him that the basic principle of success is to chant the holy name of the Lord [the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra].

devanagari: ताँर इच्छा , - प्रभु - सङ्गे नवद्वीपे वसि ।
प्रभु आज्ञा दिल, - तुमि याओ वा राणसी ॥16॥
cc-adi-16.16.translation: Tapana Miśra s desire was to live with the Lord in Navadvīpa, but the Lord asked him to go to Vārāṇasī [Benares].

lines: ājñā pāñā miśra kaila kāśīte gamana
devanagari: ताहाँ आमा - सङ्गे तोमार हबे दरशन ।
आज्ञा पाञा मिश्र कैल काशीते गमन ॥17॥
cc-adi-16.17.translation: The Lord assured Tapana Miśra that they would meet again in Vārāṇasī. Receiving this order, Tapana Miśra went there.

devanagari: प्रभुर अतर्क्स - लीला बुझिते ना पारि ।
स्व - सङ्ग छाड़ाबा केने पाठाय काशीपुरी ॥18॥
cc-adi-16.18.translation: I cannot understand the inconceivable pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for although Tapana Miśra wanted to live with Him in Navadvīpa, the Lord advised him to go to Vārāṇasī.

lines: ei mata baṅgera lokera kailā mahā hita
devanagari: एइ मत बङ्गेर लोकेर कैला महा हित ।
‘नाम’ दिया भक्त कैल, पड़ाञा पण्डित ॥19॥
cc-adi-16.19.translation: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu contributed the greatest benefit to the people of East Bengal by initiating them into hari-nāma, the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, and making them learned scholars by educating them.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्या नन्द ।
जयाद्वैतचन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-16.2.translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of the Lord!

lines: ei mata baṅge prabhu kare nānā līlā
ethā navadvīpe lakṣmī virahe duḥkhī hailā
devanagari: एइ मत बङ्गे प्रभु करे नाना लीला ।
एथा नवद्वीपे लक्ष्मी विरहे दुःखी हैला ॥20॥
cc-adi-16.20.translation: Because the Lord was engaged in various ways in preaching work in East Bengal, His wife, Lakṣmīdevī, was very unhappy at home in separation from her husband.

devanagari: प्रभुर विरह - सर्प लक्ष्मीरे दंशिल ।
विरह - सर्प - विषे ताँर परलोक हैल ॥21॥
cc-adi-16.21.translation: The snake of separation bit Lakṣmīdevī, and its poison caused her death. Thus she passed to the next world. She went back home, back to Godhead.

devanagari: अन्तरे जानिला प्रभु, याते अन्तर्यामी ।
देशेरे आइला प्रभु शची - दुःख जानि’ ॥22॥
cc-adi-16.22.translation: Lord Caitanya knew about the disappearance of Lakṣmīdevī because He is the Supersoul Himself. Thus He returned home to solace His mother, Śacīdevī, who was greatly unhappy about the death of her daughter-in-law.

lines: ghare āilā prabhu bahu lañā dhana-jana
devanagari: घरे आइला प्रभु बहु लञा धन - जन ।
तत्त्व - ज्ञाने कैला शचीर दुःख विमोचन ॥23॥
cc-adi-16.23.translation: When the Lord returned home, bringing with Him great wealth and many followers, He spoke to Śacīdevī about transcendental knowledge to relieve her of the grief she was suffering.

devanagari: शिष्य - गण लञा पुनः विद्यार विलास ।
विद्या - बले सबा जि नि’ औद्धत्य प्रकाश ॥24॥
cc-adi-16.24.translation: After coming back from East Bengal, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again began educating others. By the strength of His education He conquered everyone, and thus He was greatly proud.

lines: tabe ta' karila prabhu digvijayī jaya
devanagari: तबे विष्णुप्रिया - ठाकुराणीर परिणय ।
तबे त’ करिल प्रभु दिग्विजयी जय ॥25॥
cc-adi-16.25.translation: Then Lord Caitanya married Viṣṇupriyā, the goddess of fortune, and thereafter He conquered a champion of learning named Keśava Kāśmīrī.

devanagari: वृन्दावन - दास इहा करियाछेन विस्तार ।
स्फुट नाहि करे दोष - गुणेर विचार ॥26॥
cc-adi-16.26.translation: Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has previously elaborately described this. That which is clear need not be scrutinized for qualities and faults.

lines: sei aṁśa kahi, tāṅre kari' namaskāra
yā' śuni' digvijayī kaila āpanā dhik-kāra
devanagari: सेइ अंश कहि, ताँरे करि’ नमस्कार ।
या’ शुनि’ दिग्विजयी कैल आपना धिक्कार ॥27॥
cc-adi-16.27.translation: Offering my obeisances to Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, I shall try to describe that portion of the Lord's analysis which, when he heard it, made the Digvijayī feel himself condemned.

devanagari: ज्योत्स्नावती रात्रि, प्रभु शिष्य - गण सङ्गे ।
वसियाछेन गङ्गातीरे विद्यार प्रसङ्गे ॥28॥
cc-adi-16.28.translation: On one full moon night the Lord was sitting on the bank of the Ganges with His many disciples and discussing literary topics.

devanagari: हेन - काले दिग्विजयी ता हाङिआइला ।
गङ्गारे वन्दन करि’ प्रभुरे मिलिला ॥29॥
cc-adi-16.29.translation: Coincidently Keśava Kāśmīrī Paṇḍita also came there. While offering his prayers to mother Ganges, he met Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: जीयाकैशोर - चैतन्यो मूर्ति - मत्या गृहाश्रमात् ।
लक्ष्म्यार्चितोऽथ वाग्देव्या दिशां जय - जय - च्छलात् ॥3॥
cc-adi-16.3.translation: Long live Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu in His kaiśora age! Both the goddess of fortune and the goddess of learning worship Him. The goddess of learning, Sarasvatī, worshiped Him in His victory over the scholar who had conquered all the world, and the goddess of fortune, Lakṣmīdevī, worshiped Him at home. Since He is therefore the husband or Lord of both goddesses, I offer my obeisances unto Him.

devanagari: वसाइला तारे प्रभु आदर करिया ।
दिग्विजयी कहे मने अवज्ञा करिया ॥30॥
cc-adi-16.30.translation: The Lord received him with adoration, but because Keśava Kāśmīrī was very proud, he talked to the Lord very inconsiderately.

lines: vyākaraṇa paḍāha, nimāñi paṇḍita tomāra nāma
devanagari: व्याकरण पड़ाह, निमात्रि पण्डित तोमार नाम ।
बाल्य - शास्त्रे लोके तोमार कहे गुण - ग्राम ॥31॥
cc-adi-16.31.translation: "I understand that You are a teacher of grammar," he said, "and that Your name is Nimāi Paṇḍita. People speak very highly of Your teaching of beginners' grammar.

devanagari: व्याकरण - मध्ये, जानि, पड़ाह कलाप ।
शुनिहुँ फाङ्किते तोमार शिष्येर संलाप ॥32॥
cc-adi-16.32.translation: "I understand that You teach Kalāpa-vyākaraṇa. I have heard that Your students are very expert in the word jugglery of this grammar."

lines: śiṣyete nā bujhe, āmi bujhāite nāri
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, व्याकरण पड़ाइ - अभिमान करि ।
शिष्येते ना बुझे, आमि बुझाइते नारि ॥33॥
cc-adi-16.33.translation: The Lord said, "Yes, I am known as a teacher of grammar, but factually I cannot impress My students with grammatical knowledge, nor can they understand Me very well.

devanagari: काहाँ तुमि सर्व - शास्त्रे कवित्वे प्रवीण ।
काहाँ आमि सबे शिशु - पड़या नवीन ॥34॥
cc-adi-16.34.translation: "My dear sir, whereas you are a very learned scholar in all sorts of scriptures and are very experienced in composing poetry, I am only a boy-a new student and nothing more.

lines: tomāra kavitva kichu śunite haya mana
kṛpā kari' kara yadi gaṅgāra varṇana
devanagari: तोमार कवित्व किछु शुनिते हय मन ।
कृपा करि’ कर यदि गङ्गार वर्णन ॥35॥
cc-adi-16.35.translation: "Therefore I desire to hear your skill in composing poetry. We could hear this if you would mercifully describe the glory of mother Ganges."

lines: ghaṭī eke śata śloka gaṅgāra varṇilā
devanagari: शुनिया ब्राह्मण गर्वे वर्णिते लागिला ।
घटी एके शत श्लोक गङ्गार वर्णिला ॥36॥
cc-adi-16.36.translation: When the brāhmaṇa, Keśava Kāśmīrī, heard this, he became still more puffed up, and within one hour he composed one hundred verses describing mother Ganges.

lines: tomā sama pṛthivīte kavi nāhi āra
devanagari: शुनिया करिल प्रभु बहुत सत्कार ।
तोमा सम पृथिवीते कवि नाहि आर ॥37॥
cc-adi-16.37.translation: The Lord praised him, saying, "Sir, there is no greater poet than you in the entire world.

lines: tomāra kavitā śloka bujhite kāra śakti
tumi bhāla jāna artha kiṁvā sarasvatī
devanagari: तोमार कविता श्लोक बुझिते कार शक्ति ।
तुमि भाल जान अर्थ किंवा सरस्वती ॥38॥
cc-adi-16.38.translation: "Your poetry is so difficult that no one can understand it but you and mother Sarasvatī, the goddess of learning.

lines: eka ślokera artha yadi kara nija-mukhe
śuni' saba loka tabe pāiba baḍa-sukhe
devanagari: एक श्लोकेर अर्थ यदि कर निज - मुखे ।
शुनि’ सब लोक तबे पाइब बड़ - सुखे ॥39॥
cc-adi-16.39.translation: "But if you explain the meaning of one verse, we can all hear it from your own mouth and thus be very happy."

devanagari: एइ त’ कैशोर - लीलार सूत्र - अनुबन्ध ।
शिष्य - गण पड़ाइते करिला आरम्भ ॥4॥
cc-adi-16.4.translation: At the age of eleven Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to teach students. This marks the beginning of His kaiśora age.

lines: śata ślokera eka śloka prabhu ta' paḍila
devanagari: तबे दिग्विजयी व्याख्यार श्लोक पुछिल ।
शत श्लोकेर एक श्लोक प्रभु त’ पड़िल ॥40॥
cc-adi-16.40.translation: The Digvijayī, Keśava Kāśmīrī, inquired which verse He wanted explained. The Lord then recited one of the one hundred verses Keśava Kāśmīrī had composed.

lines: mahattvaṁ gaṅgāyāḥ satatam idam ābhāti nitarāṁ
devanagari: महत्त्वं गङ्गायाः सततमिदमाभाति नितरां प्रदेषा श्री - विष्णोश्चरण - कमलोत्पत्ति - सुभगा ।
द्वितीय - श्री - लक्ष्मीरिव सुर - नरैरर्थ्य - चरणा भवानी - भर्तुर्या शिरसि विभवत्यद्भुत - गुणा ॥41॥
cc-adi-16.41.translation: “ 'The greatness of mother Ganges always brilliantly exists. She is the most fortunate because she emanated from the lotus feet of Śrī Viṣṇu, the Personality of Godhead. She is the second goddess of fortune, and therefore she is always worshiped both by demigods and by humanity. Endowed with all wonderful qualities, she flourishes on the head of Lord Śiva.' "

devanagari: ‘एइ श्लोकेर अर्थ कर’ - प्रभु यदि बैल ।
विस्मित ह ञा दिग्विजयी प्रभुरे पुछिल ॥42॥
cc-adi-16.42.translation: When Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked him to explain the meaning of this verse, the champion, very much astonished, inquired from Him as follows.

lines: tāra madhye śloka tumi kaiche kaṇṭhe kaila
devanagari: झञ्झावात - प्राय आमि श्लोक पड़िल ।
तार मध्ये श्लोक तुमि कैछे कण्ठे कैल ॥43॥
cc-adi-16.43.translation: "I recited all the verses like the blowing wind. How could You completely learn by heart even one among those verses?"

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, देवेर वरे तुमि - ‘कवि - वर’ ।
ऐछे देवेर वरे केहो ह य’ श्रुतिधर’ ॥44॥
cc-adi-16.44.translation: The Lord replied, "By the grace of the Lord someone may become a great poet, and similarly by His grace someone else may become a great śruti-dhara who can memorize anything immediately."

lines: ślokera artha kaila vipra pāiyā santoṣa
devanagari: श्लोकेर अर्थ कैल विप्र पाइया सन्तोष ।
प्रभु कहे - कह श्लोकेर किबा गुण - दोष ॥45॥
cc-adi-16.45.translation: Satisfied by the statement of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the brāhmaṇa [Keśava Kāśmīrī] explained the quoted verse. Then the Lord said, "Now kindly explain the special qualities and faults in the verse."

lines: vipra kahe śloke nāhi doṣera ābhāsa
devanagari: विप्र कहे श्लोके नाहि दो षेर आभास ।
उपमालङ्कार गुण, किछु अनुप्रास ॥46॥
cc-adi-16.46.translation: The brāhmaṇa replied, "There is not a tinge of fault in that verse. Rather, it has the good qualities of similes and alliteration."

lines: prabhu kahena,—kahi, yadi na karaha roṣa
kaha tomāra ei śloke kibā āche doṣa
devanagari: प्रभु कहेन, - कहि, यदि न करह रोष ।
कह तोमार एइ श्लोके किबा आछे दोष ॥47॥
cc-adi-16.47.translation: The Lord said, "My dear sir, I may say something to you if you will not become angry. Can you explain the faults in this verse?

devanagari: प्रतिभा र काव्य तोमार देवता सन्तोषे ।
भाल - मते विचारिले जानि गुण - दोषे ॥48॥
cc-adi-16.48.translation: "There is no doubt that your poetry is full of ingenuity, and certainly it has satisfied the Supreme Lord. Yet if we scrutinizingly consider it we can find both good qualities and faults."

lines: tāte bhāla kari' śloka karaha vicāra
devanagari: ताते भाल क रि’ श्लोक करह विचार ।
कवि कहे , - ये कहिले सेइ वेद - सार ॥49॥
cc-adi-16.49.translation: The Lord concluded, "Now, therefore, let us carefully scrutinize this verse." The poet replied, "Yes, the verse You have recited is perfectly correct.

lines: śata śata śiṣya saṅge sadā adhyāpana
devanagari: शत शत शिष्य सङ्गे सदा अध्यापन ।
व्याख्या शुनि सर्व - लोकेर चमकित मन ॥5॥
cc-adi-16.5.translation: As soon as the Lord became a teacher, many, many students came to Him, every one of them astonished to hear His mode of explanation.

lines: tumi ki jānibe ei kavitvera sāra
devanagari: व्याकरणिया तुमि नाहि पड़ अलङ्कार ।
तुमि कि जानिबे एइ कवित्वेर सार ॥50॥
