cc-adi-16.50.translation: "You are an ordinary student of grammar. What do You know about literary embellishments? You cannot review this poetry because You do not know anything about it."

devanagari: प्रभु कहेन - अतएव पुछिये तोमारे ।
विचारिया गुण - दोष बुझाह आमारे ॥51॥
cc-adi-16.51.translation: Taking a humble position, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Because I am not of your level, I have asked you to teach Me by explaining the faults and qualities in your poetry.

lines: tāte ei śloke dekhi bahu doṣa-guna
devanagari: नाहि पड़ि अलङ्कार, करियाछि श्रवण ।
ताते एइ श्लोके देखि बहु दोष - गुण ॥52॥
cc-adi-16.52.translation: "Certainly I have not studied the art of literary embellishments. But I have heard about it from higher circles, and thus I can review this verse and find in it many faults and many good qualities."

lines: prabhu kahena,—kahi, śuna, nā kariha roṣa
devanagari: कवि कहे , - कह देखि, कोन् गुण - दोष ।
प्रभु कहेन, कहि, शुन, ना करिह रोष ॥53॥
cc-adi-16.53.translation: The poet said, "All right, let me see what qualities and faults You have found." The Lord replied, "Let Me speak, and please hear Me without becoming angry.

lines: pañca doṣa ei śloke pañca alaṅkāra
krame āmi kahi, śuna, karaha vicāra
devanagari: पञ्च दोष एइ श्लोके पञ्च अलङ्कार ।
क्रमे आमि कहि, शुन, करह विचार ॥54॥
cc-adi-16.54.translation: "My dear sir, in this verse there are five faults and five literary ornaments. I shall state them one after another. Kindly hear Me and then give your judgment.

devanagari: ‘अविमृष्ट - विधेयांश - दुइ ठाजि चिह्न ।
‘विरुद्ध - मति’, ‘भग्न - क्रम’, ‘पुनरात्त’, दोष तिन ॥55॥
cc-adi-16.55.translation: "In this verse the fault of avimṛṣṭa-vidheyāṁśa occurs twice, and the faults of viruddha-mati, bhagna-krama and punar-ātta occur once each.

devanagari: ‘गङ्गार महत्त्व’ - श्लोके मूल विधेय’ ।
इदं शब्दे ‘अनुवाद’ - पाछे अविधेय ॥56॥
cc-adi-16.56.translation: "The glorification of the Ganges [mahattvaṁ gaṅgāyāḥ] is the principal unknown subject matter in this verse, and the known subject matter is indicated by the word 'idam,' which has been placed after the unknown.

lines: ei lāgi' ślokera artha kariyāche bādha
devanagari: ‘विधेय’ आगे क हि’ पाछे कहिले ‘अनुवाद’ ।
एइ ला गि’ श्लोकेर अर्थ करियाछे बाध ॥57॥
cc-adi-16.57.translation: "Because you have placed the known subject at the end and that which is unknown at the beginning, the composition is faulty, and the meaning of the words has become doubtful.

devanagari: अनुवादमनुक्त्वैव न विधेयमुदीरयेत् ।
न ह्यलब्धास्पदं किञ्चित्कुत्रचित्प्रतितिष्ठति ॥58॥
cc-adi-16.58.translation: “ 'Without first mentioning what is known, one should not introduce the unknown, for that which has no solid basis can never be established anywhere.'

lines: samāse gauṇa haila, śabdārtha gela kṣaya
devanagari: ‘द्वितीय श्री - लक्ष्मी’ - इहाँ ‘द्वितीयत्व’ विधेय ।
समासे गौण हैल, शब्दार्थ गेल क्षय ॥59॥
cc-adi-16.59.translation: "In the word 'dvitīya-śrīlakṣmī' ['the second all-opulent goddess of fortune'], the quality of being a second Lakṣmī is the unknown. In making this compound word, the meaning became secondary and the originally intended meaning was lost.

devanagari: सर्व - शास्त्रे सर्व पण्डित पाय पराजय ।
विनय - भङ्गीते कारो दुःख नाहि हय ॥6॥
cc-adi-16.6.translation: The Lord defeated all kinds of scholars in discourses about all the scriptures, yet because of His gentle behavior, none of them were unhappy.

devanagari: ‘द्वितीय’ शब्द - विधेय ताहा पड़िल समासे ।
‘लक्ष्मीर समता’ अर्थ करिल विनाशे ॥60॥
cc-adi-16.60.translation: "Because the word 'dvitīya' ['second'] is the unknown, in its combination in this compound word the intended meaning of equality with Lakṣmī is lost.

lines: āra eka doṣa āche, śuna sāvadhāna
devanagari: ‘अविमृष्ट - विधेयांश’ - एइ दोषेर नाम ।
आर एक दोष आछे, शुन सावधान ॥61॥
cc-adi-16.61.translation: "Not only is there the fault avimṛṣṭa-vidheyāṁśa, but there is also another fault, which I shall point out to you. Kindly hear Me with great attention.

devanagari: ‘भवानी - भर्तृ’ - शब्द दिले पाइया सन्तोष ।
‘विरुद्ध - मति - कृत्’ नाम एइ महा दोष ॥62॥
cc-adi-16.62.translation: "Here is another great fault. You have arranged the word 'bhavānī-bhartṛ' to your great satisfaction, but this betrays the fault of contradiction.

lines: tāṅra bhartā kahile dvitīya bhartā jāni
devanagari: भवानी - शब्दे कहे महादेवेर गृहिणी ।
ताँर भर्ता कहिले द्वितीय भर्ता जानि ॥63॥
cc-adi-16.63.translation: "The word 'bhavānī' means 'the wife of Lord Śiva.' But when we mention her husband, one might conclude that she has another husband.

devanagari: ‘शिव - पत्नीर भर्ता’ इहा शुनिते विरुद्ध ।
‘विरुद्ध - मति - कृत्’ शब्द शास्त्रे नहे शुद्ध ॥64॥
cc-adi-16.64.translation: "It is contradictory to hear that Lord Śiva's wife has another husband. The use of such words in literature creates the fault called viruddha-mati-kṛt.

devanagari: ‘ब्राह्मण - पत्नीर भर्तार हस्ते देह दा न’ ।
शब्द शुनितेइ हय द्वितीय - भर्ता ज्ञान ॥65॥
cc-adi-16.65.translation: "If someone says, 'Place this charity in the hand of the husband of the wife of the brāhmaṇa,' when we hear these contradictory words we immediately understand that the brāhmaṇa's wife has another husband.

devanagari: ‘विभवति’ क्रियाय वाक्य - साङ्ग, पुनः विशेषण ।
‘अद्भुत - गुणा’ - एइ पुनरात्त दूषण ॥66॥
cc-adi-16.66.translation: "The statement by the word 'vibhavati' ['flourishes'] is complete. Qualifying it with the adjective 'adbhuta-guṇā' ['wonderful qualities'] creates the fault of redundancy.

devanagari: तिन पादे अनुप्रास देखि अनुपम ।
एक पादे नाहि, एइ दोष ‘भग्न - क्रम’ ॥67॥
cc-adi-16.67.translation: "There is extraordinary alliteration in three lines of the verse, but in one line there is no such alliteration. This is the fault of deviation.

lines: yadyapi ei śloke āche pañca alaṅkāra
devanagari: यद्यपि एइ श्लोके आछे पञ्च अलङ्कार ।
एइ पञ्च - दोषे श्लोक कैल छारखार ॥68॥
cc-adi-16.68.translation: "Although there are five literary ornaments decorating this verse, the entire verse has been spoiled by these five most faulty presentations.

lines: daśa alaṅkāre yadi eka śloka haya
eka doṣe saba alaṅkāra haya kṣaya
devanagari: दश अलङ्कारे यदि एक श्लोक हय ।
एक दोषे सब अलङ्कार हय क्षय ॥69॥
cc-adi-16.69.translation: "If there are ten literary ornaments in a verse but even one faulty expression, the entire verse is nullified.

devanagari: विविध औद्धत्य करे शिष्य - गण - सङ्गे ।
जाह्नविते जल - केलि करे नाना रङ्गे ॥7॥
cc-adi-16.7.translation: The Lord, as a teacher, performed various kinds of pranks in His sporting pastimes in the water of the Ganges.

devanagari: सुन्दर शरीर यैछे भूषणे भूषित ।
एक श्वेत - कुष्ठे यैछे करये विगीत ॥70॥
cc-adi-16.70.translation: "One's beautiful body may be decorated with jewels, but one spot of white leprosy makes the entire body abominable.

devanagari: रसालङ्कार - वत् काव्यं दोष - मुक् चेद् विभूषितम् ।
स्याद्वपुः सुन्दरमपि श्वित्रेणैकेन दुर्भगम् ॥71॥
cc-adi-16.71.translation: “ 'As one's body, although well-decorated with ornaments, is made unfortunate by even one spot of white leprosy, so an entire poem is made useless by a fault, despite alliteration, similes and metaphors.'

devanagari: पञ्च अलङ्कारेर एबे शुनह विचार ।
दुइ शब्दालङ्कार, तिन अर्थ - अलङ्कार ॥72॥
cc-adi-16.72.translation: "Now hear the description of the five literary embellishments. There are two ornaments of sound and three ornaments of meaning.

devanagari: शब्दालङ्कार - तिन - पादे आछे अनुप्रास ।
‘श्री - लक्ष्मी’ शब्दे ‘पुनरुक्तवदाभास’ ॥73॥
cc-adi-16.73.translation: "There is a sound ornament of alliteration in three lines. And in the combination of words 'śrī' and 'lakṣmī' there is the ornament of a tinge of redundancy.

devanagari: प्रथम - चरणे पञ्च ‘त’ - कारेर पाँति ।
तृतीय - चरणे हय पञ्च ‘रेफ’ - स्थिति ॥74॥
cc-adi-16.74.translation: "In the arrangement of the first line the letter 'ta' occurs five times, and the arrangement of the third line repeats the letter 'ra' five times.

devanagari: चतुर्थ - चरणे चारि ‘भ’ - कार - प्रकाश ।
अतएव शब्दालङ्कार अनुप्रास ॥75॥
cc-adi-16.75.translation: "In the fourth line the letter 'bha' occurs four times. This arrangement of alliteration is a pleasing ornamental use of sounds.

devanagari: ‘श्री’ - शब्दे, ‘लक्ष्मी’ - शब्दे - एक वस्तु उक्त ।
पुनरुक्त - प्राय भासे, नहे पुनरुक्त ॥76॥
cc-adi-16.76.translation: "Although the words 'śrī' and 'lakṣmī' convey the same meaning and are therefore almost redundant, they are nevertheless not redundant.

devanagari: ‘श्री - युक्त लक्ष्मी’ अर्थे अर्थेर विभेद ।
पुनरुक्तवदाभास, शब्दालङ्कार - भेद ॥77॥
cc-adi-16.77.translation: "Describing Lakṣmī as possessed of śrī [opulence] offers a difference in meaning with a tinge of repetition. This is the second ornamental use of words.

devanagari: ‘लक्ष्मीरि व’ अर्थालङ्कार - उपमा - प्रकाश ।
आर अर्थालङ्कार आछे, नाम - ‘विरोधाभास’ ॥78॥
cc-adi-16.78.translation: "The use of 'lakṣmīr iva' ['like Lakṣmī'] manifests the ornament of meaning called upamā [analogy]. There is also the further ornament of meaning called virodhābhāsa, or a contradictory indication.

devanagari: ‘गङ्गाते कमल जन्मे’ - सबार सुबोध ।
‘कमले गङ्गार जन्म’ - अत्यन्त विरोध ॥79॥
cc-adi-16.79.translation: "Everyone knows that lotus flowers grow in the water of the Ganges. But to say that the Ganges takes birth from a lotus flower seems extremely contradictory.

lines: kata dine kaila prabhu baṅgete gamana
devanagari: कत दिने कैल प्रभु बङ्गेते गमन ।
याहाँ याय, ताहाँ लओयाय नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ॥8॥
cc-adi-16.8.translation: After some days the Lord went to East Bengal, and wherever He went He introduced the saṅkīrtana movement.

devanagari: ‘इहाँ विष्णु - पाद - पो गङ्गार उत्पत्ति’ ।
विरोधालङ्कार इहा महा - चमत्कृति ॥80॥
cc-adi-16.80.translation: "The existence of mother Ganges begins from the lotus feet of the Lord. Although this statement that water comes from a lotus flower is a contradiction, in connection with Lord Viṣṇu it is a great wonder.

devanagari: ईश्वर - अचिन्त्य - शक्त्ये गङ्गार प्रकाश ।
इहाते विरोध ना हि, विरोध - आभास ॥81॥
cc-adi-16.81.translation: "In this birth of the Ganges by the inconceivable potency of the Lord, there is no contradiction although it appears contradictory.

lines: ambujam ambuni jātaṁ kvacid api na jātam ambujād ambu
devanagari: अम्बुजमम्बुनि जातं क्वचिदपि न जातमम्बुजादम्बु ।
मुर - भिदि तद्विपरीतं पादाम्भोजान्महा - नदी जाता ॥82॥
cc-adi-16.82.translation: “ 'Everyone knows that lotus flowers grow in the water but water never grows from a lotus. All such contradictions, however, are wonderfully possible in Kṛṣṇa: the great river Ganges has grown from His lotus feet.'

devanagari: गङ्गार महत्त्व साध्य, साधन ताहार ।
विष्णु - पादोत्पत्ति - ‘अनुमान’ अलङ्कार ॥83॥
cc-adi-16.83.translation: "The real glory of mother Ganges is that she has grown from the lotus feet of Lord Viṣṇu. Such a hypothesis is another ornament, called anumāna.

lines: sthūla ei pañca doṣa, pañca alaṅkāra
devanagari: स्थूल एइ पञ्च दोष, पञ्च अलङ्कार ।
सूक्ष्म विचारिये यदि आछये अपार ॥84॥
cc-adi-16.84.translation: "I have simply discussed the five gross faults and five literary embellishments of this verse, but if we consider it in fine detail we will find unlimited faults.

devanagari: प्रतिभा, कवित्व तोमार देवता - प्रसादे ।
अविचार काव्ये अवश्य पड़े दोष - बाधे ॥85॥
cc-adi-16.85.translation: "You have achieved poetic imagination and ingenuity by the grace of your worshipable demigod. But poetry not well reviewed is certainly subject to criticism.

devanagari: विचारि’ कवित्व कैले हय सुनिर्मल ।
सालङ्कार हैले अर्थ करे झलमल ॥86॥
cc-adi-16.86.translation: "Poetic skill used with due consideration is very pure, and with metaphors and analogies it is dazzling."

lines: mukhe nā niḥsare vākya, pratibhā stambhita
devanagari: शुनिया प्रभुर व्याख्या दिग्विजयी विस्मित ।
मुखे ना निःसरे वाक्य, प्रतिभा स्तम्भित ॥87॥
cc-adi-16.87.translation: After hearing the explanation of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the champion poet, struck with wonder. His cleverness stunned, he could not say anything.

lines: kahite cāhaye kichu, nā āise uttara
devanagari: कहिते चाहये किछु, ना आइसे उत्तर ।
तबे विचारये मने हइया फाँफर ॥88॥
cc-adi-16.88.translation: He wanted to say something, but no reply could come from his mouth. He then began to consider this puzzle within his mind.

lines: paḍuyā bālaka kaila mora buddhi lopa
devanagari: पडुया बालक कैल मोर बुद्धि लोप ।
जानि - सरस्वती मोरे करियाछेन कोप ॥89॥
cc-adi-16.89.translation: "This mere boy has blocked my intelligence. I can therefore understand that mother Sarasvatī has become angry with me.

lines: śata śata paḍuyā āsi lāgilā paḍite
devanagari: विद्यार प्रभाव देखि चम त्कार चिते ।
शत शत पडूया आसि लागिला पड़िते ॥9॥
cc-adi-16.9.translation: Struck with wonder by the influence of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's intellectual prowess, many hundreds of students came to Him and began studying under His direction.

lines: ye vyākhyā karila, se manuṣyera nahe śakti
devanagari: ये व्याख्या करिल, से मनुष्येर नहे शक्ति ।
निमाजि - मुखे रहि’ बले आपने सरस्वती ॥90॥
cc-adi-16.90.translation: "The wonderful explanation the boy has given could not have been possible for a human being. Therefore mother Sarasvatī must have spoken personally through His mouth."

lines: tava vyākhyā śuni' āmi ha-ilāṅ vismita
devanagari: एत भावि’ कहे - शुन, निमात्रि पण्डित ।
तव व्याख्या शुनि’ आमि हइलाँ विस्मित ॥91॥
cc-adi-16.91.translation: Thinking thus, the paṇḍita said, "My dear Nimāi Paṇḍita, please hear me. Hearing Your explanation, I am simply struck with wonder.

lines: kemane e saba artha karile prakāśa
devanagari: अलङ्कार नाहि पड़, नाहि शास्त्राभ्यास ।
केमने ए सब अर्थ करिले प्रकाश ॥92॥
cc-adi-16.92.translation: "I am surprised. You are not a literary student and do not have long experience in studying the śāstras. How have You been able to explain all these critical points?"

lines: ihā śuni' mahāprabhu ati baḍa raṅgī
tāṅhāra hṛdaya jāni' kahe kari' bhaṅgī
devanagari: इहा शुनि’ महाप्रभु अति बड़ रङ्गी ।
ताँहार हृदय जा नि’ कहे क रि’ भङ्गी ॥93॥
cc-adi-16.93.translation: Hearing this and understanding the paṇḍita's heart, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied in a humorous way.

lines: sarasvatī ye balāya, sei bali vāṇī
devanagari: शास्त्रेर विचार भाल - मन्द नाहि जानि ।
सरस्वती ये बलाय, सेइ बलि वाणी ॥94॥
cc-adi-16.94.translation: "My dear sir, I do not know what is good composition and what is bad. But whatever I have spoken must be understood to have been spoken by mother Sarasvatī."

devanagari: इहा शुनि’ दिग्विजयी करिल निश्चय ।
शिशु - द्वारे देवी मोरे कैल पराजय ॥95॥
cc-adi-16.95.translation: When he heard this judgment from Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the paṇḍita sorrowfully wondered why mother Sarasvatī wanted to defeat him through a small boy.

devanagari: आजि ताँरे निवेदिब, करि’ जप - ध्यान ।
शिशु - द्वारे कैल मोरे एत अपमान ॥96॥
cc-adi-16.96.translation: "I shall offer prayers and meditation to the goddess of learning," the champion concluded, "and ask her why she has insulted me so greatly through this boy."

devanagari: वस्तुतः सरस्वती अशुद्ध श्लोक कराइल ।
विचार - समय ताँर बुद्धि आच्छादिल ॥97॥
cc-adi-16.97.translation: Sarasvatī had in fact induced the champion to compose his verse in an impure way. Furthermore, when it was discussed she covered his intelligence, and thus the Lord's intelligence was triumphant.

devanagari: तबे शिष्य - गण सब हासिते लागिल ।
ता’ - सबा निषेधि’ प्रभु कविरे कहिल ॥98॥
cc-adi-16.98.translation: When the poetic champion was thus defeated, all the Lord's disciples sitting there began to laugh loudly. But Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked them not to do so, and He addressed the poet as follows.

devanagari: तुमि बड़ पण्डित, महाकवि - शिरोमणि ।
याँर मुखे बाहिराय ऐछे कव्य - वाणी ॥99॥
cc-adi-16.99.translation: "You are the most learned scholar and the topmost of all great poets, for otherwise how could such fine poetry come from your mouth?

devanagari: वन्दे स्वैराद्भुतेहं तं चैतन्यं यत्प्रसादतः ।
यवनाः सुमनायन्ते कृष्ण - नाम - प्रजल्पकाः ॥1॥
cc-adi-17.1.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, by whose mercy even unclean yavanas become perfectly well-bred gentlemen by chanting the holy name of the Lord. Such is the power of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: शचीके प्रेम - दान, तबे अद्वैत - मिलन ।
अद्वैत पाइल विश्वरूप - दरशन ॥10॥
cc-adi-17.10.translation: Thereafter the Lord delivered love of Kṛṣṇa to His mother, Śacīdevī, nullifying her offense at the feet of Advaita Ācārya. Thus there was a meeting with Advaita Ācārya, who later had a vision of the Lord's universal form.

lines: tāra skandhe caḍi nṛtya kaila bahu-kṣaṇa
devanagari: महेश - आवेश हैला शचीर नन्दन ।
तार स्कन्धे चड़ि नृत्य कैल बहु - क्षण ॥100॥
cc-adi-17.100.translation: Then Lord Caitanya, adopting the mood of Lord Śiva, got on the man's shoulders, and thus they danced together for a long time.

lines: āra dina eka bhikṣuka āilā māgite
prabhura nṛtya dekhi nṛtya lāgila karite
devanagari: आर दिन एक भिक्षुक आइला मागिते ।
प्रभुर नृत्य देखि नृत्य लागिल करिते ॥101॥
cc-adi-17.101.translation: On another day a mendicant came to beg alms from the Lord's house, but when he saw the Lord dancing, he also began to dance.

lines: prabhu tāre prema dila, prema-rase bhāse
devanagari: प्रभु - सङ्गे नृत्य करे परम उल्लासे ।
प्रभु तारे प्रेम दिल, प्रेम - रसे भासे ॥102॥
cc-adi-17.102.translation: He danced with the Lord because he was favored by love of Kṛṣṇa. Thus he flowed in the mellowness of love of Godhead.

lines: āra dine jyotiṣa sarva-jña eka āila
tāhāre sammāna kari' prabhu praśna kaila
devanagari: आर दिने ज्योतिष सर्वज्ञ एक आइल ।
ताहारे सम्मान क रि’ प्रभु प्रश्न कैल ॥103॥
cc-adi-17.103.translation: On another day an astrologer came who was supposed to know everything-past, present and future. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu received him with all honor and put this question before him.

lines: ke āchiluṅ āmi pūrva janme kaha gaṇi'
devanagari: के आछि लुँ आमि पूर्व जन्मे कह गणि’ ।
गणिते लागिला सर्वज्ञ प्रभु - वाक्य शुनि’ ॥104॥
cc-adi-17.104.translation: "Please tell Me who I was in My previous birth," the Lord said. "Please tell Me by your astrological computations." Hearing the words of the Lord, the astrologer immediately began to calculate.

devanagari: गणि’ ध्याने देखे सर्वज्ञ, - महा - ज्योतिर्मय ।
अनन्त वैकुण्ठ - ब्रह्माण्ड - सबार आश्रय ॥105॥
cc-adi-17.105.translation: Through calculation and meditation, the all-knowing astrologer saw the greatly effulgent body of the Lord, which is the resting place of all the unlimited Vaikuṇṭha planets.

lines: dekhi' prabhura mūrti sarva-jña ha-ila phāṅphara
devanagari: परम - तत्त्व, पर - ब्रह्म, परम - ईश्वर ।
देखि’ प्रभुर मूर्ति सर्वज्ञ हइल फाँफर ॥106॥
cc-adi-17.106.translation: Seeing Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu to be the same Absolute Truth, the Supreme Brahman, the Personality of Godhead, the astrologer was confused.

lines: balite nā pāre kichu, mauna ha-ila
prabhu punaḥ praśna kaila, kahite lāgila
devanagari: बलिते ना पारे किछु, मौन हइल ।
प्रभु पुनः प्रश्न कैल, कहिते लागिल ॥107॥
cc-adi-17.107.translation: Struck with wonder, the astrologer remained silent, unable to speak. But when the Lord again put the question before him, he replied as follows.

devanagari: पूर्व जन्मे छिला तुमि जगताश्रय ।
परिपूर्ण भगवान् सर्वैश्वर्यमय ॥108॥
cc-adi-17.108.translation: "My dear sir, in Your previous birth You were the shelter of all creation, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, full of all opulences.

lines: pūrve yaiche chilā tumi ebeha se-rūpa
devanagari: पूर्वे यैछे छिला तुमि एबेह से - रूप ।
दुर्विज्ञेय नित्यानन्द तोमार स्वरूप ॥109॥
cc-adi-17.109.translation: "You are now the same Personality of Godhead that You were in Your previous birth. Your identity is inconceivable eternal happiness."

lines: khāṭe vasi' prabhu kailā aiśvarya prakāśa
devanagari: प्रभुर अभिषेक तबे करिल श्रीवास ।
खाटे व सि’ प्रभु कैला ऐश्वर्य प्रकाश ॥11॥
cc-adi-17.11.translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura then worshiped Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu by the process of abhiṣeka. Sitting on a cot, the Lord exhibited transcendental opulence.

lines: prabhu hāsi' kailā,—tumi kichu nā jānilā
devanagari: प्रभु हासि’ कैला, - तुमि किछु ना जानिला ।
पूर्वे आमि आछिलाँ जातिते गोयाला ॥110॥
cc-adi-17.110.translation: When the astrologer was speaking so highly of Him, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped him and began to smile. "My dear sir," He said, "I think you do not know very clearly what I was, for I know that in My previous birth I was a cowherd boy.

devanagari: गोप - गृहे जन्म छिल, गाभीर राखाल ।
सेइ पुण्ये हैलाँ एबे ब्राह्मण - छाओयाल ॥111॥
cc-adi-17.111.translation: "In My last birth I was born in the family of cowherd men, and I gave protection to the calves and cows. Because of such pious activities, I have now become the son of a brāhmaṇa."

lines: sarva-jña kahe āmi tāhā dhyāne dekhilāṅ
devanagari: सर्वज्ञ कहे आमि ताहा ध्याने देखिलाँ ।
ताहाते ऐश्वर्य दे खि’ फाँफर हइलाँ ॥112॥
cc-adi-17.112.translation: The astrologer said, "What I saw in meditation was full of opulence, and therefore I was confused.

lines: kabhu bheda dekhi, ei māyāya tomāra
devanagari: सेइ - रूपे एइ - रूपे देखि एकाकार ।
कभु भेद देखि, एइ मायाय तोमार ॥113॥
cc-adi-17.113.translation: "I am certain that Your form and the form I saw in my meditation are one and the same. If I see any difference, this is an act of Your illusory energy."

lines: ye hao, se hao tumi, tomāke namaskāra
prabhu tāre prema diyā kaila puraskāra
devanagari: ये हओ, से हओ तुमि, तोमाके नमस्कार ।
प्रभु तारे प्रेम दिया कैल पुरस्कार ॥114॥
cc-adi-17.114.translation: The all-knowing astrologer concluded, "Whatever You may be or whoever You may be, I offer my respectful obeisances unto You!" By His causeless mercy, the Lord then gave him love of Godhead, thus rewarding him for his service.

devanagari: एक दिन प्रभु विष्णु - मण्डपे वसिया ।
‘मधु आन’, ‘मधु आन’ बलेन डाकिया ॥115॥
cc-adi-17.115.translation: One day the Lord sat down in the corridor of a Viṣṇu temple and began calling very loudly, "Bring some honey! Bring some honey!"

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - गोसाञि प्रभुर आवेश जानिल ।
गङ्गा - जल - पात्र आ नि’ सम्मुखे धरिल ॥116॥
cc-adi-17.116.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu Gosāñi, understanding the ecstatic mood of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, brought a pot of Ganges water as a token and put it before Him.

lines: jala pāna kariyā nāce hañā vihvala
devanagari: जल पान करिया नाचे ह ञा विह्वल ।
यमुनाकर्षण - लीला देखये सकल ॥117॥
cc-adi-17.117.translation: After drinking the water, Lord Caitanya became so ecstatic that He began to dance. Thus everyone saw the pastime of attracting the river Yamunā.

devanagari: मद - मत्त - गति बलदेव - अनुकार ।
आचार्य शेखर ताँरे देखे रामाकार ॥118॥
cc-adi-17.118.translation: When the Lord, in His ecstasy of Baladeva, was moving as if intoxicated by the beverage, Advaita Ācārya, the chief of the ācāryas [ācārya śekhara], saw Him in the form of Balarāma.

lines: sabe mili' nṛtya kare āveśe vihvala
devanagari: वनमाली आचार्य देखे सोणार लाङ्गल ।
सबे मि लि’ नृत्य करे आवेशे विह्वल ॥119॥
cc-adi-17.119.translation: Vanamālī Ācārya saw a golden plow in the hand of Balarāma, and the devotees all assembled together and danced, overwhelmed by ecstasy.

devanagari: तबे नित्यानन्द - स्वरूपेर आगमन ।
प्रभुके मिलिया पाइल षड् - भुज - दर्शन ॥12॥
cc-adi-17.12.translation: After this function at the house of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, Nityānanda Prabhu appeared, and when He met with Lord Caitanya He got the opportunity to see Him in His six-armed form.

lines: sandhyāya gaṅgā-snāna kari' sabe gelā ghara
devanagari: एइ - मत नृत्य हइल चारि प्रहर ।
सन्ध्याय गङ्गा - स्नान क रि’ सबे गेला घर ॥120॥
cc-adi-17.120.translation: In this way they danced continuously for twelve hours, and in the evening they all took bath in the Ganges and then returned to their homes.

lines: nagariyā loke prabhu yabe ājñā dilā
devanagari: नगरिया लोके प्रभु यबे आज्ञा दिला ।
घरे घरे सङ्कीर्तन करिते लागिला ॥121॥
cc-adi-17.121.translation: The Lord ordered all the citizens of Navadvīpa to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, and in each and every home they began performing saṅkīrtana regularly.

devanagari: ‘हरये नमः, कृष्ण यादवाय नमः ।
गोपाल गोविन्द राम श्री - मधुसूदन’ ॥122॥
cc-adi-17.122.translation: [All the devotees sang this popular song along with the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.] "Haraye namaḥ, kṛṣṇa yādavāya namaḥ gopāla govinda rāma śrī-madhusūdana."

devanagari: मृदङ्ग - करताल सङ्कीर्तन - महाध्वनि ।
‘हरि’ ‘हरि - ध्वनि विना अन्य नाहि शुनि ॥123॥
cc-adi-17.123.translation: When the saṅkīrtana movement thus started, no one in Navadvīpa could hear any other sound than the words "Hari! Hari!" and the beating of the mrdaṅga and clashing of hand bells.

lines: śuniyā ye kruddha haila sakala yavana
devanagari: शुनिया ये क्रुद्ध हैल सकल यवन ।
काजी - पाशे आ सि’ सबे कैल निवेदन ॥124॥
cc-adi-17.124.translation: Hearing the resounding vibration of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, the local Mohammedans, greatly angry, submitted a complaint to the Kazi.

lines: krodhe sandhyā-kāle kājī eka ghare āila
devanagari: क्रोधे सन्ध्या - काले काजी एक घरे आइल ।
मृदङ्ग भाङ्गिया लोके कहिते लागिल ॥125॥
cc-adi-17.125.translation: Chand Kazi angrily came to one home in the evening, and when he saw kīrtana going on, he broke a mṛdaṅga and spoke as follows.

lines: ebe ye udyama cālāo kāra bala jāni'
devanagari: एत - काल केह नाहि कैल हिन्दुयानि ।
एबे ये उद्यम चालाओ कार बल जा नि’ ॥126॥
cc-adi-17.126.translation: "For so long you did not follow the regulative principles of the Hindu religion, but now you are following them with great enthusiasm. May I know by whose strength you are doing so?

lines: keha kīrtana nā kariha sakala nagare
āji āmi kṣamā kari' yāitechoṅ ghare
devanagari: केह कीर्तन ना करिह सकल नगरे ।
आजि आमि क्षमा क रि’ याइतेछों घरे ॥127॥
cc-adi-17.127.translation: "No one should perform saṅkīrtana on the streets of the city. Today I am excusing the offense and returning home.

lines: āra yadi kīrtana karite lāga pāimu
sarvasva daṇḍiyā tāra jāti ye la-imu
devanagari: आर यदि कीर्तन करिते लाग पाइमु ।
सर्वस्व दण्डिया तार जाति ये लइमु ॥128॥
cc-adi-17.128.translation: "The next time I see someone performing such saṅkīrtana, certainly I shall chastise him by not only confiscating all his property but also converting him into a Mohammedan."

devanagari: एत बलि’ काजी गेल , - नगरिया लोक ।
प्रभु - स्थाने निवेदिल पाञा बड़ शोक ॥129॥
cc-adi-17.129.translation: After saying this, the Kazi returned home, and the devotees, greatly shocked that they were forbidden to chant Hare Kṛṣṇa, submitted their grief to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: प्रथमे षड् - भुज ताँरे देखाइल ईश्वर ।
शङ्ख - चक्र - गदा - पद्म - शाङ्ग - वेणु - धर ॥13॥
cc-adi-17.13.translation: One day Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu exhibited to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu a six-armed form bearing a conchshell, disc, club, lotus flower, bow and flute.

devanagari: प्रभु आज्ञा दिल - याह करह कीर्तन ।
मुञि संहारिमु आजि सकल यवन ॥130॥
cc-adi-17.130.translation: Lord Caitanya ordered, "Go perform saṅkīrtana! Today I shall kill all the Mohammedans!"

lines: ghare giyā saba loka karaye kīrtana
kājīra bhaye svacchanda nahe, camakita mana
devanagari: घरे गिया सब लोक करये कीर्तन ।
काजीर भये स्वच्छन्द नहे, चमकित मन ॥131॥
cc-adi-17.131.translation: Returning home, all the citizens began performing saṅkīrtana, but because of the order of the Kazi, they were not carefree but always full of anxiety.

lines: tā-sabhāra antare bhaya prabhu mane jāni
kahite lāgilā loke śīghra ḍāki' āni'
devanagari: ता - सभार अन्तरे भय प्रभु मने जानि ।
कहिते लागिला लोके शीघ्र डाकि’ आनि’ ॥132॥
cc-adi-17.132.translation: Understanding the anxiety within the people's minds, the Lord called them together and spoke to them as follows.

devanagari: नगरे नगरे आजि करिमु कीर्तन ।
सन्ध्या - काले कर सभे नगर - मण्डन ॥133॥
cc-adi-17.133.translation: "In the evening I shall perform saṅkīrtana in each and every town. Therefore you should all decorate the city in the evening.

lines: sandhyāte deuṭi sabe jvāla ghare ghare
dekha, kona kājī āsi' more mānā kare
devanagari: सन्ध्याते देउटि सबै ज्वाल घरे घरे ।
देख, कोन काजी आ सि’ मोरे माना करे ॥134॥
cc-adi-17.134.translation: "In the evening, burn torchlights in every home. I shall give protection to everyone. Let us see what kind of Kazi comes to stop our kīrtana."

devanagari: एत क हि’ सन्ध्या - काले चाले गौरराय ।
कीर्तनेर कैल प्रभु तिन सम्प्रदाय ॥135॥
cc-adi-17.135.translation: In the evening Lord Gaurasundara went out and formed three parties to perform kīrtana.

devanagari: आगे सम्प्रदाये नृत्य करे हरिदास ।
मध्ये नाचे आचार्य - गोसाञि परम उल्लास ॥136॥
cc-adi-17.136.translation: In the front party danced Ṭhākura Haridāsa, and in the middle party danced Advaita Ācārya with great jubilation.

lines: tāṅra saṅge nāci' bule prabhu nityānanda
devanagari: पाछे सम्प्रदाये नृत्य करे गौरचन्द्र ।
ताँर सङ्गे नाचि’ बुले प्रभु नित्यानन्द ॥137॥
cc-adi-17.137.translation: Lord Gaurasundara Himself danced in the rear party, and Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu moved with Lord Caitanya's dancing.

devanagari: वृन्दावन - दास इहा ‘चैतन्य - मङ्गले’ ।
विस्ता रि’ वर्णियाछेन, प्रभु - कृपा - बले ॥138॥
cc-adi-17.138.translation: By the grace of the Lord, Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has elaborately described this incident in his Caitanya-maṅgala.

lines: ei mata kīrtana kari' nagare bhramilā
devanagari: एइ मत कीर्तन क रि’ नगरे भ्रमिला ।
भ्रमिते भ्रमिते सभे काजी - द्वारे गेला ॥139॥
cc-adi-17.139.translation: Performing kīrtana in this way, circumambulating through every nook and corner of the city, they finally reached the door of the Kazi.

lines: tabe catur-bhuja hailā, tina aṅga vakra
dui haste veṇu bājāya, duye śaṅkha-cakra
devanagari: तबे चतुर्भुज हैला, तिन अङ्ग वक्र ।
दुइ हस्ते वेणु बाजाय, दुये शङ्ख - चक्र ॥14॥
cc-adi-17.14.translation: Thereafter the Lord showed Him His four-armed form, standing in a three-curved posture. With two hands He played upon a flute, and in the other two He carried a conchshell and disc.

devanagari: तर्ज - गर्ज करे लोक, करे कोलाहल ।
गौरचन्द्र - बले लोक प्रश्रय - पागल ॥140॥
cc-adi-17.140.translation: Murmuring in anger and making a roaring sound, the people, under the protection of Lord Caitanya, became mad through such indulgence.

lines: tarjana garjana śuni' nā haya bāhire
devanagari: कीर्तनेर ध्वनिते काजी लुकाइल घरे ।
तर्जन गर्जन शुनि’ ना हय बाहिरे ॥141॥
cc-adi-17.141.translation: The loud sound of the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra certainly made the Kazi very much afraid, and he hid himself within his room. Hearing the people thus protesting, murmuring in great anger, the Kazi would not come out of his home.

devanagari: उद्धत लोक भाङ्गे काजीर घर - पुष्पवन ।
विस्ता रि’ वणिला इहा दास - वृन्दावन ॥142॥
cc-adi-17.142.translation: Naturally some of the people who were very much agitated began to retaliate the Kazi's actions by wrecking his house and flower garden. Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has elaborately described this incident.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु तार द्वारेते वसिला ।
भव्य - लोक पाठाइया काजीरे बोलाइला ॥143॥
cc-adi-17.143.translation: Thereafter, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu reached the Kazi's house, He sat down by the doorway and sent some respectable persons to call for the Kazi.

lines: dūra ha-ite āilā kājī māthā noyāiyā
devanagari: दूर हइते आइला काजी माथा नोयाइयो ।
काजीरे वसाइला प्रभु सम्मान करिया ॥144॥
cc-adi-17.144.translation: When the Kazi came, his head bowed down, the Lord gave him proper respect and a seat.

devanagari: प्रभु बलेन, - आमि तोमार आइलाम अभ्यागते ।
आमि देखि लुकाइला, - ए - धर्म केमत ॥145॥
cc-adi-17.145.translation: In a friendly way, the Lord said, "Sir, I have come to your house as your guest, but upon seeing Me you hid yourself in your room. What kind of etiquette is this?"

devanagari: काजी कहे - तुमि आइस क्रुद्ध हुइया ।
तोमा शान्त कराइते रहिनु लुकाइया ॥146॥
cc-adi-17.146.translation: The Kazi replied, "You have come to my house in a very angry mood. To pacify You, I did not come before You immediately but kept myself hidden.

lines: ebe tumi śāntā haile, āsi, mililāṅ
devanagari: एबे तुमि शान्ता हैले, आसि, मिलिलाँ ।
भाग्य मोर , - तोमा हेन अतिथि पाइलाँ ॥147॥
cc-adi-17.147.translation: "Now that You have become pacified, I have come to You. It is my good fortune to receive a guest like Your Honor.

devanagari: ग्राम - सम्बन्धे ‘चक्रवर्ती’ हय मोर चाचा ।
देह - सम्बन्धे हैते हय ग्राम - सम्बन्ध साँचा ॥148॥
cc-adi-17.148.translation: "In our village relationship, Nīlāmbara Cakravartī Ṭhākura was my uncle. Such a relationship is stronger than a bodily relationship.

devanagari: नीलाम्बर चक्रवर्ती हय तोमार नाना ।
से - सम्बन्धे हओ तुमि आमार भागिना ॥149॥
cc-adi-17.149.translation: "Nīlāmbara Cakravartī is Your maternal grandfather, and by this relationship You are thus my nephew.

devanagari: तबे त’ द्वि - भुज केवल वंशी - वदन ।
श्याम - अङ्ग पीत - वस्त्र व्रजे न्द्र - नन्दन ॥15॥
cc-adi-17.15.translation: Finally the Lord showed Nityānanda Prabhu His two-armed form of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda, simply playing on His flute, His bluish body dressed in yellow garments.

devanagari: भागिनार क्रोध मामा अवश्य सहय ।
मातुलेर अपराध भागिना ना लय ॥150॥
cc-adi-17.150.translation: "When a nephew is very angry, his maternal uncle is tolerant, and when the maternal uncle commits an offense, the nephew does not take it very seriously."

lines: ei mata duṅhāra kathā haya ṭhāre-ṭhore
bhitarera artha keha bujhite nā pāre
devanagari: एइ मत दुँहार कथा हय ठारे - ठोरे ।
भितरेर अर्थ केह बुझिते ना पारे ॥151॥
cc-adi-17.151.translation: In this way the Kazi and the Lord talked with one another with different indications, but no outsider could understand the inner meaning of their conversation.

lines: prabhu kahe,—praśna lāgi' āilāma tomāra sthāne
kājī kahe,—ājñā kara, ye tomāra mane
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - प्रश्न ला गि’ आइलाम तोमार स्थाने ।
काजी कहे , - आज्ञा कर, ये तोमार मने ॥152॥
cc-adi-17.152.translation: The Lord said, "My dear uncle, I have come to your home just to ask you some questions."

lines: prabhu kahe,—go-dugdha khāo, gābhī tomāra mātā
vṛṣa anna upajāya, tāte teṅho pitā
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - गो - दुग्ध खाओ, गाभी तोमार माता ।
वृष अन्न उपजाय, ताते तेंहो पिता ॥153॥
cc-adi-17.153.translation: The Lord said, "You drink cows' milk; therefore the cow is your mother. And the bull produces grains for your maintenance; therefore he is your father.

lines: kon bale kara tumi e-mata vikarma
devanagari: पिता - माता मा रि’ खाओ - एबा को धर्म ।
को बले कर तुमि ए - मत विकर्म ॥154॥
cc-adi-17.154.translation: "Since the bull and cow are your father and mother, how can you kill and eat them? What kind of religious principle is this? On what strength are you so daring that you commit such sinful activities?"

devanagari: काजी कहे , - तोमार यैछे वेद - पुराण ।
तैछे आमार शास्त्र - केताब ‘कोराण’ ॥155॥
cc-adi-17.155.translation: The Kazi replied, "As You have Your scriptures called the Vedas and Purāṇas, we have our scripture, known as the holy Koran.

devanagari: सेइ शास्त्रे कहे , - प्रवृत्ति - निवृत्ति - मार्ग - भेद ।
निवृत्ति - मार्गे जीव - मात्र - वधेर निषेध ॥156॥
cc-adi-17.156.translation: "According to the Koran, there are two ways of advancement—through increasing the propensity to enjoy and decreasing the propensity to enjoy. On the path of decreasing attachment [nivṛtti-mārga], the killing of animals is prohibited.

devanagari: प्रवृत्ति - मार्गे गो - वध करिते विधि हय ।
शास्त्र - आज्ञाय वध कैले नाहि पाप - भय ॥157॥
cc-adi-17.157.translation: "On the path of material activities, there is regulation for killing cows. If such killing is done under the guidance of scripture, there is no sin."

lines: ataeva go-vadha kare baḍa baḍa muni
devanagari: तोमार वेदेते आ छे गो - वधेर वाणी ।
अतएव गो - वध करे बड़ बड़ मुनि ॥158॥
cc-adi-17.158.translation: As a learned scholar, the Kazi challenged Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "In Your Vedic scriptures there is an injunction for killing a cow. On the strength of this injunction, great sages performed sacrifices involving cow-killing."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - वेदे कहे गो - वध निषेध ।
अतएव हिन्दु - मात्र ना करे गो - वध ॥159॥
cc-adi-17.159.translation: Refuting the Kazi's statement, the Lord immediately replied, "The Vedas clearly enjoin that cows should not be killed. Therefore any Hindu, whoever he may be, does not indulge in cow-killing.

devanagari: तबे नित्यानन्द - गोसाञि र व्यास - पूजन ।
नित्यानन्दावेशे कैल मुषल धारण ॥16॥
cc-adi-17.16.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu then arranged to offer Vyāsa-pūjā, or worship of the spiritual master, to Lord Śrī Gaurasundara. But Lord Caitanya carried the plough-like weapon called muṣala in the ecstasy of being Nityānanda Prabhu.

lines: jiyāite pāre yadi, tabe māre prāṇī
devanagari: जियाइते पारे यदि, तबे मारे प्राणी ।
वेद - पुराणे आछे हेन आज्ञा - वाणी ॥160॥
cc-adi-17.160.translation: "In the Vedas and Purāṇas there are injunctions declaring that if one can revive a living being, he can kill it for experimental purposes.

devanagari: अतएव जरद्गव मारे मुनि - गण ।
वेद - मन्त्रे सिद्ध करे ताहार जीवन ॥161॥
cc-adi-17.161.translation: "Therefore the great sages sometimes killed old cows, and by chanting Vedic hymns they again brought them to life for perfection.

lines: tāte tāra vadha nahe, haya upakāra
devanagari: जरगव हञा युवा हय आर - वार ।
ताते तार वध नहे, हय उपकार ॥162॥
cc-adi-17.162.translation: "The killing and rejuvenation of such old and invalid cows was not truly killing but an act of great benefit.

lines: ataeva go-vadha keha nā kare ekhane
devanagari: कलि - काले तैछे शक्ति नाहिक ब्राह्मणे ।
अतएव गो - वध केह ना करे एखने ॥163॥
cc-adi-17.163.translation: "Formerly there were powerful brāhmaṇas who could make such experiments using Vedic hymns, but now, because of Kali-yuga, brāhmaṇas are not so powerful. Therefore the killing of cows and bulls for rejuvenation is forbidden.

devanagari: अश्वमेधं गवालम्भं सन्यासं पल - पैतृकम् ।
देवरेण सुतोत्पत्तिं कलौ पञ्च विवर्जयेत् ॥164॥
cc-adi-17.164.translation: “ 'In this Age of Kali, five acts are forbidden: the offering of a horse in sacrifice, the offering of a cow in sacrifice, the acceptance of the order of sannyāsa, the offering of oblations of flesh to the forefathers, and a man's begetting children in his brother's wife.'

devanagari: तोमरा जीयाइते नार , - वध - मात्र सार ।
नरक हइते तोमार नाहिक निस्तार ॥165॥
cc-adi-17.165.translation: "Since you Mohammedans cannot bring killed animals back to life, you are responsible for killing them. Therefore you are going to hell; there is no way for your deliverance.

lines: go-aṅge yata loma, tata sahasra vatsara
devanagari: गो - अङ्गे यत लोम, तत सहस्र वत्सर ।
गो - वधी रौरव - मध्ये पचे निरन्तर ॥166॥
cc-adi-17.166.translation: "Cow-killers are condemned to rot in hellish life for as many thousands of years as there are hairs on the body of the cow.

lines: nā jāni' śāstrera marma aiche ājñā dila
devanagari: तोमा - सबार शास्त्र - कर्ता - सेह भ्रान्त हैल ।
ना जा नि’ शास्त्रेर मर्म ऐछे आज्ञा दिल ॥167॥
cc-adi-17.167.translation: "There are many mistakes and illusions in your scriptures. Their compilers, not knowing the essence of knowledge, gave orders that were against reason and argument."

lines: śuni' stabdha haila kājī, nāhi sphure vāṇī
devanagari: शुनि’ स्तब्ध हैल काजी, नाहि स्फुरे वाणी ।
विचारिया कहे काजी पराभव मा नि’ ॥168॥
cc-adi-17.168.translation: After hearing these statements by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Kazi, his arguments stunned, could not put forward any more words. Thus, after due consideration, the Kazi accepted defeat and spoke as follows.

lines: tumi ye kahile, paṇḍita, sei satya haya
devanagari: तुमि ये कहिले, पण्डित, सेइ सत्य हय ।
आधुनिक आमार शास्त्र, विचार - सह नये ॥169॥
cc-adi-17.169.translation: "My dear Nimāi Paṇḍita, what You have said is all true. Our scriptures have developed only recently, and they are certainly not logical and philosophical.

devanagari: तबे शची देखिल, राम - कृष्णदुइ भाइ ।
तबे निस्तारिल प्रभु जगाइ - माधाइ ॥17॥
cc-adi-17.17.translation: Thereafter mother Śacīdevī saw the brothers Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma in Their manifestation of Lord Caitanya and Nityānanda. Then the Lord delivered the two brothers Jagāi and Mādhāi.

devanagari: कल्पित आमार शास्त्र , - आमि सब जानि ।
जाति - अनुरोधे तबु सेइ शास्त्र मानि ॥170॥
cc-adi-17.170.translation: "I know that our scriptures are full of imagination and mistaken ideas, yet because I am a Mohammedan I accept them for the sake of my community, despite their insufficient support.

devanagari: सहजे यवन - शास्त्रे अदृढ़ विचार ।
हासि’ ताहे महाप्रभु पुछेन आर - बार ॥171॥
cc-adi-17.171.translation: "The reasoning and arguments in the scriptures of the meat-eaters are not very sound," the Kazi concluded. Upon hearing this statement, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smiled and inquired from him as follows.

lines: āra eka praśna kari, śuna, tumi māmā
yathārtha kahibe, chale nā vañchibe āmā'
devanagari: आर एक प्रश्न करि, शुन, तुमि मामा ।
यथार्थ कहिबे, छले ना वञ्छिबे आमा’ ॥172॥
cc-adi-17.172.translation: "My dear maternal uncle, I wish to ask you another question. Please tell Me the truth. Do not try to cheat Me with tricks.

devanagari: तोमार नगरे हय सदा सङ्कीर्तन ।
वाद्य - गीत - कोलाहल, सङ्गीत, नर्तन ॥173॥
cc-adi-17.173.translation: "In your city there is always congregational chanting of the holy name. A tumultuous uproar of music, singing and dancing is always going on.

lines: ebe ye nā kara mānā bujhite nā pāri
devanagari: तुमि काजी - हिन्दु - धर्म - विरोधे अधिकारी ।
एबे ये ना कर माना बुझिते ना पारि ॥174॥
cc-adi-17.174.translation: "As a Mohammedan magistrate, you have the right to oppose the performance of Hindu ceremonies, but now you do not forbid them. I cannot understand the reason why."

lines: sei nāme āmi tomāya sambodhana kari
devanagari: काजी बले - सभे तोमाय बले ‘गौरहरि’ ।
सेइ नामे आमि तोमाय सम्बोधन करि ॥175॥
cc-adi-17.175.translation: The Kazi said, "Everyone calls You Gaurahari. Please let me address You by that name.

lines: nibhṛta hao yadi, tabe kari nivedana
devanagari: शुन, गौरहरि, एइ प्रश्नेर कारण ।
निभृत हओ यदि, तबे करि निवेदन ॥176॥
cc-adi-17.176.translation: "Kindly listen, O Gaurahari! If You come to a private place, I shall then explain the reason."

lines: prabhu bale,—e loka āmāra antaraṅga haya
sphuṭa kari' kaha tumi, nā kariha bhaya
devanagari: प्रभु बले, - ए लोक आमार अन्तरङ्ग हय ।
स्फुट करि’ कह तुमि, ना करिह भय ॥177॥
cc-adi-17.177.translation: The Lord replied, "All these men are My confidential associates. You may speak frankly. There is no reason to be afraid of them."

lines: kājī kahe,—yabe āmi hindura ghare giyā
devanagari: काजी कहे , - यबे आमि हिन्दुर घरे गिया ।
कीर्तन करितुं माना मृदङ्ग भाङ्गिया ॥178॥
cc-adi-17.178-179.translation: The Kazi said, "When I went to the Hindu's house, broke the drum and forbade the performance of congregational chanting, in my dreams that very night I saw a greatly fearful lion, roaring very loudly, His body like a human being's and His face like a lion's.

devanagari: तबे स प्त - प्रहर छिला प्रभु भावावेशे ।
यथा तथा भक्त - गण देखिल विशेषे ॥18॥
cc-adi-17.18.translation: After this incident, the Lord remained in an ecstatic position for twenty-one hours, and all the devotees saw His specific pastimes.

lines: śayane āmāra upara lāpha diyā caḍi'
devanagari: शयने आमार उपर लाफ दिया च ड़ि’ ।
अट्ट अट्ट हासे, करे दन्त - कड़मड़ि ॥180॥
cc-adi-17.180.translation: "While I was asleep, the lion jumped on my chest, laughing fiercely and gnashing His teeth.

lines: mora buke nakha diyā ghora-svare bale
devanagari: मोर बुके नख दिया घोर - स्वरे बले ।
फाड़िमु तोमार बुक मृदङ्ग बदले ॥181॥
cc-adi-17.181.translation: "Placing its nails on my chest, the lion said in a grave voice, 'I shall immediately bifurcate your chest as you broke the mṛdaṅga drum!

lines: mora kīrtana mānā karis, karimu tora kṣaya
āṅkhi mudi' kāṅpi āmi pāñā baḍa bhaya
devanagari: मोर कीर्तन माना करिस्, करिमु तोर क्षय ।
आङ्घि मुदि’ काँपि आमि पाञा बड़ भय ॥182॥
cc-adi-17.182.translation: “ 'You have forbidden the performance of My congregational chanting. Therefore I must destroy you!' Being much afraid of Him, I closed my eyes and trembled.

lines: bhīta dekhi' siṁha bale ha-iyā sadaya
tore śikṣā dite kailu tora parājaya
devanagari: भीत दे खि’ सिंह बले हइया सदय ।
तोरे शिक्षा दिते कैलु तोर पराजय ॥183॥
cc-adi-17.183.translation: "Seeing me so afraid, the lion said, 'I have defeated you just to teach you a lesson, but I must be merciful to you.

lines: se dina bahuta nāhi kaili utpāta
teñi kṣamā kari' nā karinu prāṇāghāta
devanagari: से दिन बहुत नाहि कैलि उत्पात ।
तेजि क्षमा क रि’ ना करिनु प्राणाघात ॥184॥
cc-adi-17.184.translation: “ 'On that day you did not create a very great disturbance. Therefore I have excused you and not taken your life.

lines: aiche yadi punaḥ kara, tabe nā sahimu
devanagari: ऐछे यदि पुनः कर, तबे ना सहिमु ।
सवंशे तोमारे मारि यवन नाशिमु ॥185॥
cc-adi-17.185.translation: “ 'But if you perform such activities again, I shall not be tolerant. At that time I shall kill you, your entire family and all the meat-eaters.'

lines: eta kahi' siṁha gela, āmāra haila bhaya
devanagari: एत क हि’ सिंह गेल, आमार हैल भय ।
एइ देख, नख - चिह्न अमोर हृदय ॥186॥
cc-adi-17.186.translation: "After saying this, the lion left, but I was very afraid of Him. Just see the marks of His nails on my heart!"

devanagari: एत बलि’ काजी निज - बुक देखाइल ।
शुनि’ देखि’ सर्व - लोक आश्चर्य मानिल ॥187॥
cc-adi-17.187.translation: After this description, the Kazi showed his chest. Having heard him and seen the marks, all the people there accepted the wonderful incident.

lines: kājī kahe,—ihā āmi kāre nā kahila
sei dina āmāra eka piyādā āila
devanagari: काजी कहे , - इहा आमि कारे ना कहिल ।
सेइ दिन आमार एक पियादा आइल ॥188॥
cc-adi-17.188.translation: The Kazi continued, "I did not speak to anyone about this incident, but on that very day one of my orderlies came to see me.

lines: agni ulkā mora mukhe lāge ācambite
devanagari: आसि’ कहे, - गेलु मुनि कीर्तन निषेधिते ।
अग्नि उल्का मोर मुखे लागे आचम्बिते ॥189॥
cc-adi-17.189.translation: "After coming to me, the orderly said, 'When I went to stop the congregational chanting, suddenly flames struck my face.

lines: tāṅra skandhe caḍi' prabhu nācilā aṅgane
devanagari: वराह - आवेश हैला मुरारि - भवने ।
ताँर स्कन्धे च ड़ि’ प्रभु नाचिला अङ्गने ॥19॥
cc-adi-17.19.translation: One day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt the ecstasy of the boar incarnation and got up on the shoulders of Murāri Gupta. Thus they both danced in Murāri Gupta's courtyard.

lines: puḍila sakala dāḍi, mukhe haila vraṇa
yei peyādā yāya, tāra ei vivaraṇa
devanagari: पुड़िल सकल दाड़ि, मुखे हैल व्रण ।
येइ पेयादा याय, तार एइ विवरण ॥190॥
cc-adi-17.190.translation: “ 'My beard was burned, and there were blisters on my cheeks.' Every orderly who went gave the same description.

lines: tāhā dekhi' rahinu muñi mahā-bhaya pāñā
kīrtana nā varjiha, ghare rahoṅ ta' vasiyā
devanagari: ताहा दे खि’ रहिनु मुञि महा - भय पाञा ।
कीर्तन ना वर्जिह, घरे रहों त’ वसिया ॥191॥
cc-adi-17.191.translation: "After seeing this, I was very afraid. I asked them not to stop the congregational chanting but to go sit down at home.

lines: tabe ta' nagare ha-ibe svacchande kīrtana
śuni' saba mleccha āsi' kaila nivedana
devanagari: तबे त’ नगरे हइबे स्वच्छन्दे कीर्तन ।
शुनि’ सब म्लेच्छ आ सि’ कैल निवेदन ॥192॥
cc-adi-17.192.translation: "Then all the meat-eaters came to submit a petition, complaining, 'After this order, there will always be unrestricted congregational chanting in the city.

devanagari: नगरे हिन्दुर धर्म बाड़िल अपार ।
‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ध्वनि बइ नाहि शुनि आर ॥193॥
cc-adi-17.193.translation: “ 'The religion of the Hindus will increase unlimitedly. There are always vibrations of "Hari! Hari!" We do not hear anything but this.'

lines: hāse, kānde, nāce, gāya, gaḍi yāya dhūli
devanagari: आर म्लेच्छ कहे , - हिन्दु कृष्ण कृष्ण’ बलि’ ।
हासे, कान्दे, नाचे, गाय, गड़ि याय धूलि ॥194॥
cc-adi-17.194.translation: "One meat-eater said, 'The Hindus say, "Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa," and they smile, cry, dance, chant and fall on the ground, smearing their bodies with dirt.

devanagari: ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ करि’ हिन्दु करे कोलाहल ।
पातसाह शुनिले तोमार करिबेक फल ॥195॥
cc-adi-17.195.translation: “ 'Vibrating "Hari, Hari," the Hindus make a tumultuous sound. If the king [pātasāha] hears it, certainly he will punish you.'

lines: tabe sei yavanere āmi ta' puchila
devanagari: तबे सेइ यवनेरे आमि त’ पुछिल ।
हिन्दु ‘हरि’ बले, तार स्वभाव जानिल ॥196॥
cc-adi-17.196.translation: "I then inquired from these yavanas, 'I know that these Hindus by nature chant "Hari, Hari."

lines: hindura devatāra nāma laha ki kāraṇa
devanagari: तुमित यवन हञा केने अनुक्षण ।
हिन्दुर देवतार नाम लह कि कारण ॥197॥
cc-adi-17.197.translation: “ 'The Hindus chant the name Hari because that is the name of their God. But you are Mohammedan meat-eaters. Why do you chant the name of the Hindus' God?'

devanagari: म्लेच्छ कहे , - हिन्दुरे आमि करि परिहास ।
केह केह - कृष्णदास, केह - रामदास ॥198॥
cc-adi-17.198.translation: "The meat-eater replied, 'Sometimes I joke with the Hindus. Some of them are called Kṛṣṇadāsa, and some are called Rāmadāsa.

lines: jāni kāra ghare dhana karibeka curi
devanagari: केह - हरिदास, सदा बले ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ।
जानि कार घरे धन करिबेक चुरि ॥199॥
cc-adi-17.199.translation: “ 'Some of them are called Haridāsa. They always chant "Hari, Hari," and thus I thought they would steal the riches from someone's house.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैतचन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-adi-17.2.translation: All glories to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

devanagari: तबे शुक्लाम्बरेर कैल तण्डुल - भक्षण ।
‘हरेर्नाम’ श्लोकेर कैल अर्थ विवरण ॥20॥
cc-adi-17.20.translation: After this incident the Lord ate raw rice given by Śuklāmbara Brahmacārī and explained very elaborately the import of the "harer nāma" śloka mentioned in the Bṛhan-nāradīya Purāṇa.

lines: icchā nāhi, tabu bale,—ki upāya kari
devanagari: सेइ हैते जिह्वा मोर बले ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ।
इच्छा नाहि, तबु बले, - कि उपाय करि ॥200॥
cc-adi-17.200.translation: “ 'Since that time, my tongue also always vibrates the sound "Hari, Hari." I have no desire to say it, but still my tongue says it. I do not know what to do.'

lines: āra mleccha kahe, śuna—āmi ta' ei-mate
hinduke parihāsa kainu se dina ha-ite
devanagari: आर म्लेच्छ कहे, शुन - आमि त’ एइ - मते ।
हिन्दुके परिहास कैनु से दिन हइते ॥201॥
cc-adi-17.201-202.translation: "Another meat-eater said, 'Sir, please hear me. Since the day I joked with some Hindus in this way, my tongue chants the Hare Kṛṣṇa hymn and cannot give it up. I do not know what mystic hymns and herbal potions these Hindus know.'

devanagari: एत शुनि’ ता’ - संभारे घरे पाठाइल ।
हेन - काले पाषण्डी हिन्दु पाँच - सात आइल ॥203॥
cc-adi-17.203.translation: "After hearing all this, I sent all the mlecchas back to their homes. Five or seven nonbeliving Hindus then approached me.

lines: ye kīrtana pravartāila, kabhu śuni nāi
devanagari: आसि’ कहे, - हिन्दुर धर्म भाङ्गिल निमाइ ।
ये कीर्तन प्रवर्ताइल, कभु शुनि नाइ ॥204॥
cc-adi-17.204.translation: "Coming to me, the Hindus complained, 'Nimāi Paṇḍita has broken the Hindu religious principles. He has introduced the saṅkīrtana system, which we never heard from any scripture.

devanagari: मङ्गलचण्डी विषहरि करि’ जागरण ।
ता’ते वाद्य, नृत्य, गीत, - योग्य आचरण ॥205॥
cc-adi-17.205.translation: “ 'When we keep a nightlong vigil to observe religious performances for the worship of Maṅgalacaṇḍī and Viṣahari, playing on musical instruments, dancing and chanting are certainly fitting customs.

lines: pūrve bhāla chila ei nimāi paṇḍita
devanagari: पूर्वे भाल छिल एइ निमाइ पण्डित ।
गया हैते आसिया चालाय विपरीत ॥206॥
cc-adi-17.206.translation: “ 'Nimāi Paṇḍita was previously a very good boy, but since He has returned from Gayā He conducts Himself differently.

lines: ucca kari' gāya gīta, deya karatāli
devanagari: उच्च क रि’ गाय गीत, देय करतालि ।
मृदङ्ग - करताल - शब्दे कर्णे लागे तालि ॥207॥
cc-adi-17.207.translation: “ 'Now He loudly sings all kinds of songs, clapping, playing drums and hand bells, and making a tumultuous sound that deafens our ears.

lines: nā jāni,—ki khāñā matta hañā nāce, gāya
hāse, kānde, paḍe, uṭhe, gaḍāgaḍi yāya
devanagari: ना जानि , - कि खाजा मत्त ह ञा नाचे, गाय ।
हासे, कान्दे, पड़े, उठे, गड़ागड़ि याय ॥208॥
cc-adi-17.208.translation: “ 'We do not know what He eats that makes Him become mad, dancing, singing, sometimes laughing, crying, falling down, jumping up and rolling on the ground.

lines: rātre nidrā nāhi yāi, kari jāgaraṇa
devanagari: नगरियाके पागल कैल सदा सङ्कीर्तन ।
रात्रे निद्रा नाहि याइ, करि जागरण ॥209॥
cc-adi-17.209.translation: “ 'He has made all the people practically mad by always performing congregational chanting. At night we cannot get any sleep; we are always kept awake.

devanagari: हरेर्नाम हरेर्नाम हरेर्नामेव केवलम् ।
कलौ नास्त्येव नास्त्येव नास्त्येव गतिरन्यथा ॥21॥
cc-adi-17.21.translation: “ 'In this Age of Kali there is no other means, no other means, no other means for self-realization than chanting the holy name, chanting the holy name, chanting the holy name of Lord Hari.'

lines: hindura dharma naṣṭa kaila pāṣaṇḍa sañcāri'
devanagari: ‘निमाजि’ नाम छा ड़ि’ एबे बोलाय ‘गौरहरि’ ।
हिन्दुर धर्म नष्ट कैल पाषण्ड सञ्चारि’ ॥210॥
cc-adi-17.210.translation: “ 'Now He has given up His own name Nimāi and introduced Himself by the name Gaurahari. He has spoiled the Hindu religious principles and introduced the irreligion of nonbelievers.

lines: kṛṣṇera kīrtana kare nīca bāḍa bāḍa
devanagari: कृष्णेर कीर्तन करे नीच बाड़ बाड़ ।
एइ पापे नवद्वीप हइबे उजाड़ ॥211॥
cc-adi-17.211.translation: “ 'Now the lower classes are chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra again and again. For this sinful activity, the entire city of Navadvīpa will be deserted.

lines: sarva-loka śunile mantrera vīrya haya hāni
devanagari: हिन्दु - शास्त्रे ‘ईश्वर’ नाम - महा - मन्त्र जानि ।
सर्व - लोक शुनिले मन्त्रेर वीर्य हय हानि ॥212॥
cc-adi-17.212.translation: “ 'According to Hindu scripture, God's name is supposed to be the most powerful hymn. If everyone hears the chanting of the name, the potency of the hymn will be lost.

lines: grāmera ṭhākura tumi, saba tomāra jana
devanagari: ग्रामेर ठाकुर तुमि, सब तोमार जन ।
निमाइ बोलाइया तारे करह वर्जन ॥213॥
cc-adi-17.213.translation: “ 'Sir, you are the ruler of this town. Whether Hindu or Moslem, everyone is under your protection. Therefore please call Nimāi Paṇḍita and make Him leave the town.'

lines: sabe ghare yāha, āmi niṣedhiba tāre
devanagari: तबे आमि प्रीति - वाक्य कहिल सबारे ।
सबे घरे याह, आमि निषेधिब तारे ॥214॥
cc-adi-17.214.translation: "After hearing their complaints, in sweet words I told them, 'Please go back home. I shall certainly prohibit Nimāi Paṇḍita from continuing His Hare Kṛṣṇa movement.'

lines: sei tumi hao,—hena laya mora mana
devanagari: हिन्दुर ईश्वर बड़ येइ नारायण ।
सेइ तुमि हओ, हेन लय मोर मन ॥215॥
cc-adi-17.215.translation: "I know that Nārāyaṇa is the Supreme God of the Hindus, and I think that You are the same Nārāyaṇa. This I feel within my mind."

devanagari: एत शुनि’ महाप्रभु हासिया हासिया ।
कहिते लागिला किछु काजिरे छुडिया ॥216॥
cc-adi-17.216.translation: After hearing the Kazi speak so nicely, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu touched him and smilingly spoke as follows.

devanagari: तोमार मुखे कृष्ण - नाम, - ए बड़ विचित्र ।
पाप - क्षय गेल, हैला परम पवित्र ॥217॥
cc-adi-17.217.translation: "The chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa from your mouth has performed a wonder—it has nullified the reactions of all your sinful activities. Now you have become supremely pure.

devanagari: ‘हरि’ ‘कृष्ण’ ‘नारायण’ - लैले तिन नाम ।
बड़ भाग्यवान्तुमि, बड़ पुण्यवान् ॥218॥
cc-adi-17.218.translation: "Because you have chanted three holy names of the Lord-Hari, Kṛṣṇa and Nārāyaṇa-you are undoubtedly the most fortunate and pious."

lines: eta śuni' kājīra dui cakṣe paḍe pāni
devanagari: एत शुनि’ काजी र दुइ चक्षे पड़े पानि ।
प्रभुर चरण छुङि’ बले प्रिय - वाणी ॥219॥
cc-adi-17.219.translation: After the Kazi heard this, tears flowed down from his eyes. He immediately touched the lotus feet of the Lord and spoke the following sweet words.

devanagari: कलि - काले नाम - रूपे कृष्ण - अवतार ।
नाम हैते हय सर्व - जगनिस्तार ॥22॥
cc-adi-17.22.translation: "In this Age of Kali, the holy name of the Lord, the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, is the incarnation of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Simply by chanting the holy name, one associates with the Lord directly. Anyone who does this is certainly delivered.

lines: ei kṛpā kara,—yena tomāte rahu bhakti
devanagari: तोमार प्रसादे मोर घुचिल कुमति ।
एइ कृपा कर, - येन तोमाते रहु भक्ति ॥220॥
cc-adi-17.220.translation: "Only by Your mercy have my bad intentions vanished. Kindly favor me so that my devotion may always be fixed upon You."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - एक दान मागिये तोमाय ।
सङ्कीर्तन वाद यैछे नहे नदीयाय ॥221॥
cc-adi-17.221.translation: The Lord said, "I wish to beg you for one favor in charity. You must pledge that this saṅkīrtana movement will not be checked, at least in the district of Nadia."

devanagari: काजी कहे , - मोर वंशे यत उपजिबे ।
ताहाके ‘तालाक’ दिब, - कीर्तन ना बाधिबे ॥222॥
cc-adi-17.222.translation: The Kazi said, "To as many descendants as take birth in my dynasty in the future, I give this grave admonition: No one should check the saṅkīrtana movement."

devanagari: शुनि’ प्रभु ‘हरि’ बलि’ उठिला आपनि ।
उठिल वैष्णव सब क रि’ हरि - ध्वनि ॥223॥
cc-adi-17.223.translation: Hearing this, the Lord got up, chanting "Hari! Hari!" Following Him, all the other Vaiṣṇavas also got up, chanting the vibration of the holy name.

lines: saṅge cali' āise kājī ullasita mana
devanagari: कीर्तन करिते प्रभु करिला गमन ।
सङ्गे चलि’ आइसे काजी उल्लसित मन ॥224॥
cc-adi-17.224.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went back to perform kīrtana, and the Kazi, his mind jubilant, went with Him.

devanagari: काजीरे विदाय दिल शचीर नन्दन ।
नाचिते नाचिते आइला आपन भवन ॥225॥
cc-adi-17.225.translation: The Lord asked the Kazi to go back home. Then the son of mother Śacī came back to His own home, dancing and dancing.

lines: ei mate kājīre prabhu karilā prasāda
ihā yei śune tāra khaṇḍe aparādha
devanagari: एइ मते काजीरे प्र भु करिला प्रसाद ।
इहा येइ शुने तार खण्डे अपराध ॥226॥
cc-adi-17.226.translation: This is the incident concerning the Kazi and the Lord's mercy upon him. Anyone who hears this is also freed from all offenses.

devanagari: एक दिन श्रीवासेर मन्दिरे गोसाञि ।
नित्यानन्द - सङ्गे नृत्य करे दुइ भाइ ॥227॥
cc-adi-17.227.translation: One day the two brothers Lord Nityānanda Prabhu and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were dancing in the holy house of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura.

lines: tabu śrīvāsera citte nā janmila śoka
devanagari: श्रीवास - पुत्रेर ताहाँ हैल परलोक ।
तबु श्रीवासेर चित्ते ना जन्मिल शोक ॥228॥
cc-adi-17.228.translation: At that time a calamity took place-Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura's son died. Yet Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura was not at all sorry.

devanagari: मृत - पुत्र - मुखे कैल ज्ञानेर कथन ।
आपने दुइ भाइ हैला श्रीवास - नन्दन ॥229॥
cc-adi-17.229.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu caused the dead son to speak about knowledge, and then the two brothers personally became the sons of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: दाढर्य लागि’ ‘हरेर्नाम’ - उक्ति तिन - वार ।
जड़ लोक बुझाइते पुनः ‘एव’ - कार ॥23॥
cc-adi-17.23.translation: "This verse repeats the word 'eva' ['certainly'] three times for emphasis, and it also three times repeats 'harer nāma' ['the holy name of the Lord'], just to make common people understand.

lines: tabe ta' karilā saba bhakte vara dāna
devanagari: तबे त’ करिला सब भक्ते वर दान ।
उच्छिष्ट दिया नारायणीर करिल सम्मान ॥230॥
cc-adi-17.230.translation: Thereafter the Lord charitably bestowed His benediction upon all His devotees. He gave the remnants of His food to Nārāyaṇī, showing her special respect.

devanagari: श्रीवासेर वस्त्र सिंये दरजी यवन ।
प्रभु तारे निज - रूप कराइल दर्शन ॥231॥
cc-adi-17.231.translation: There was a tailor who was a meat-eater but was sewing garments for Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. The Lord, being merciful to him, showed him His own form.

lines: preme nṛtya kare, haila vaiṣṇava āgala
devanagari: ‘देखिनु’ ‘देखिनु’ बलि’ हइल पागल ।
प्रेमे नृत्य करे, हैल वैष्णव आगल ॥232॥
cc-adi-17.232.translation: Saying "I have seen! I have seen!" and dancing in ecstatic love as though mad, he became a first-class Vaiṣṇava.

lines: āveśete śrīvāse prabhu vaṁśī ta' māgila
śrīvāsa kahe,—vaṁśī tomāra gopī hari' nila
devanagari: आवेशेते श्रीवासे प्रभु वंशी त’ मागिल ।
श्रीवास कहे , - वंशी तोमार गोपी हरि’ निल ॥233॥
cc-adi-17.233.translation: In ecstasy the Lord asked Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura to deliver His flute, but Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura replied, "Your flute has been stolen away by the gopīs."

devanagari: शुनि’ प्रभु ‘बल’ ‘बल’ बलेन आवेशे ।
श्रीवास वर्णेन वृन्दावन - लीला - रसे ॥234॥
cc-adi-17.234.translation: Hearing this reply, the Lord said in ecstasy, "Go on talking! Go on talking!" Thus Śrīvāsa described the transcendental mellow pastimes of Śrī Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: प्रथमेते वृन्दावन - माधुर्य वर्णिल ।
शुनिया प्रभुर चित्ते आनन्द बाड़िल ॥235॥
cc-adi-17.235.translation: In the beginning Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura described the transcendental sweetness of Vṛndāvana's pastimes. Hearing this, the Lord felt great and increasing jubilation in His heart.

lines: punaḥ punaḥ kahe śrīvāsa kariyā vistāra
devanagari: तबे ‘बल’ ‘बल’ प्रभु बले वार - वार ।
पुनः पुनः कहे श्रीवास करिया विस्तार ॥236॥
cc-adi-17.236.translation: Thereafter the Lord again and again asked him, "Speak on! Speak on!" Thus Śrīvāsa again and again described the pastimes of Vṛndāvana, vividly expanding them.

devanagari: वंशी - वाद्ये गोपी - गणेर वने आकर्षण ।
ताँ - सबार सङ्गे यैछे वन - विहरण ॥237॥
cc-adi-17.237.translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura extensively explained how the gopīs were attracted to the forests of Vṛndāvana by the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute and how they wandered together in the forest.

devanagari: ताहि मध्ये छय - ऋतु लीलार वर्णन ।
मधु - पान, रासोत्सव, जल - केलि कथन ॥238॥
cc-adi-17.238.translation: Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita narrated all the pastimes enacted during the six changing seasons. He described the drinking of honey, the celebration of the rāsa dance, the swimming in the Yamunā, and other such incidents.

lines: śrīvāsa kahena tabe rāsa rasera vilāsa
devanagari: ‘बल’ ‘बल’ बले प्रभु शुनिते उल्लास ।
श्रीवास कहेन तबे रास रसेर विलास ॥239॥
cc-adi-17.239.translation: When the Lord, hearing with great pleasure, said, "Go on speaking! Go on speaking!" Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura described the rasa-lila, the transcendental mellow dancing.

devanagari: ‘केवल’ - शब्दे पुनरपि निश्चय - करण ।
ज्ञान - योग - तप - कर्म - आदि निवारण ॥24॥
cc-adi-17.24.translation: "The use of the word 'kevala' ['only'] prohibits all other processes, such as cultivation of knowledge, practice of mystic yoga, and performance of austerities and fruitive activities.

devanagari: कहिते, शुनिते ऐछे प्रातःकाल हैल ।
प्रभु श्रीवासेरे तोषि’ आलिङ्गन कैल ॥240॥
cc-adi-17.240.translation: As thus the lord requested and Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura spoke, the morning appeared, and the Lord embraced Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and satisfied him.

devanagari: तबे आचार घरे कैल कृष्ण - लीला ।
रुक्मिणी - स्वरूप प्रभु आपने हइला ॥241॥
cc-adi-17.241.translation: Thereafter a dramatization of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes was performed in the house of Advaita Ācārya. The Lord personally took the part of Rukmiṇī, the foremost of Kṛṣṇa's queens.

lines: kabhu durgā, lakṣmī haya, kabhu vā cic-chakti
devanagari: कभु दुर्गा, लक्ष्मी हय, कभु वा चिच्छक्ति ।
खाटे व सि’ भक्त - गणे दिला प्रेम - भक्ति ॥242॥
cc-adi-17.242.translation: The Lord sometimes took the part of Goddess Durgā, Lakṣmī [the goddess of fortune] or the chief potency, Yogamāyā. Sitting on a cot, He delivered love of Godhead to all the devotees present.

devanagari: एक - दिन महाप्रभुर नृत्य - अवसाने ।
एक ब्राह्मणी आ सि’ धरिल चरणे ॥243॥
cc-adi-17.243.translation: One day when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had finished His dancing, a woman, the wife of a brāhmaṇa, came there and caught hold of His lotus feet.

lines: caraṇera dhūli sei laya vāra vāra
devanagari: चरणेर धूलि सेइ लय वार वार ।
देखिया प्रभुर दुःख हइल अपार ॥244॥
cc-adi-17.244.translation: As she took the dust of His lotus feet again and again, the Lord became unlimitedly unhappy.

devanagari: सेइ - क्षणे धाबा प्रभु गङ्गाते पड़िल ।
नित्यानन्द - हरिदास ध रि’ उठाइल ॥245॥
cc-adi-17.245.translation: Immediately He ran to the river Ganges and jumped in to counteract the sinful activities of that woman. Lord Nityānanda and Haridāsa Ṭhākura caught Him and raised Him from the river.

lines: vijaya ācāryera ghare se rātre rahilā
prātaḥ-kāle bhakta sabe ghare lañā gelā
devanagari: विजय आचार घरे से रात्रे रहिला ।
प्रातः - काले भक्त सबे घरे ल ञा गेला ॥246॥
cc-adi-17.246.translation: That night the Lord stayed at the house of Vijaya Ācārya. In the morning the Lord took all His devotees and returned home.

devanagari: एक - दिन गोपी - भावे गृहेते वसिया ।
‘गोपी’ ‘गोपी’ नाम लय विषण्ण ह ञा ॥247॥
cc-adi-17.247.translation: One day the Lord, in the ecstasy of the gopīs, was sitting in His house. Very morose in separation, He was calling, "Gopī! Gopī!"

devanagari: एक पड़या आइल प्रभुके देखिते ।
‘गोपी’ ‘गोपी’ नाम शुनि’ लागिल बलिते ॥248॥
cc-adi-17.248.translation: A student who came to see the Lord was astonished that the Lord was chanting "Gopī! Gopī!" Thus he spoke as follows.

devanagari: कृष्ण - नाम ना लओ केने, कृष्ण - नाम - धन्य ।
‘गोपी’ ‘गोपी’ बलिले वा किबा हय पुण्य ॥249॥
cc-adi-17.249.translation: "Why are You chanting the names 'Gopī, Gopī' instead of the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa, which is so glorious? What pious result will You achieve by such chanting?"

lines: anyathā ye māne, tāra nāhika nistāra
devanagari: अन्यथा ये माने, तार नाहिक निस्तार ।
नाहि, नाहि, नाहिए तिन ‘एव’ - कार ॥25॥
cc-adi-17.25.translation: "This verse clearly states that anyone who accepts any other path cannot be delivered. This is the reason for the triple repetition 'nothing else, nothing else, nothing else,' which emphasizes the real process of self-realization.

lines: śuni' prabhu krodhe kaila kṛṣṇe doṣodgāra
ṭheṅgā lañā uṭhilā prabhu paḍuyā māribāra
devanagari: शुनि’ प्रभु क्रोधे कैल कृष्णे दोषोद्गार ।
ठेङ्गा लञा उठिला प्रभु पड़या मारिबार ॥250॥
cc-adi-17.250.translation: Hearing the foolish student, the Lord, greatly angry, rebuked Lord Kṛṣṇa in various ways. Taking up a stick, He rose to strike the student.

lines: bhaye palāya paḍuyā, prabhu pāche pāche dhāya
devanagari: भये पलाय पड़या, प्रभु पाछे पाछे धाय ।
आस्ते व्यस्ते भक्त - गण प्रभुरे रहाय ॥251॥
cc-adi-17.251.translation: The student ran away in fear, and the Lord followed him. But somehow or other the devotees checked the Lord.

lines: prabhure śānta kari' ānila nija ghare
devanagari: प्रभुरे शान्त करि’ आनिल निज घरे ।
पडुया पलाया गेल पडुया - सभारे ॥252॥
cc-adi-17.252.translation: The devotees pacified the Lord and brought Him home, and the student ran away to an assembly of other students.

lines: prabhura vṛttānta dvija kahe tāhāṅ yāi
devanagari: पड़या सहस्र याहाँ पड़े एक - ठाजि ।
प्रभुर वृत्तान्त द्विज कहे ताहाँ याइ ॥253॥
cc-adi-17.253.translation: The brāhmaṇa student ran to a place where a thousand students were studying together. There he described the incident to them.

lines: śuni' krodha kaila saba paḍuyāra gaṇa
sabe meli' kare tabe prabhura nindana
devanagari: शुनि’ क्रोध कैल सब पड़यार गण ।
सबे मे लि’ करे तबे प्रभुर निन्दन ॥254॥
cc-adi-17.254.translation: Hearing of the incident, all the students, greatly angry, joined together in criticizing the Lord.

lines: saba deśa bhraṣṭa kaila ekalā nimāñi
devanagari: सब देश भ्रष्ट कैल एकला निमामि ।
ब्राह्मण मारिते चाहे, धर्म - भय नाइ ॥255॥
cc-adi-17.255.translation: "Nimāi Paṇḍita alone has spoiled the entire country," they accused. "He wants to strike a caste brāhmaṇa. He has no fear of religious principles.

lines: punaḥ yadi aiche kare māriba tāhare
kon vā mānuṣa haya, ki karite pāre
devanagari: पुनः यदि ऐछे करे मारिब ताहरे ।
कोन् वा मानुष हय, कि करिते पारे ॥256॥
cc-adi-17.256.translation: "If He again performs such an atrocious act, certainly we shall retaliate and strike Him in turn. Who is He—an important person—that He can check us in this way?"

lines: prabhura nindāya sabāra buddhi haila nāśa
supaṭhita vidyā kārao nā haya prakāśa
devanagari: प्रभुर निन्दाय सबार बुद्धि हैल नाश ।
सुपठित विद्या कारओ ना हय प्रकाश ॥257॥
cc-adi-17.257.translation: When all the students thus resolved, criticizing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, their intelligence was spoiled. Thus although they were learned scholars, because of this offense the essence of knowledge was not manifest in them.

lines: tathāpi dāmbhika paḍuyā namra nāhi haya
yāhaṅ tāhāṅ prabhura nindā hāsi' se karaya
devanagari: तथापि दाम्भिक प डुया नम्र नाहि हय ।
याहाँ ताहाँ प्रभुर निन्दा हासि’ से करय ॥258॥
cc-adi-17.258.translation: But the proud student community did not become submissive. On the contrary, the students spoke of the incident anywhere and everywhere. In a laughing manner they criticized the Lord.

devanagari: सर्व - ज्ञ गोसाञि जानि’ सबार दुर्गति ।
घरे वसि’ चिन्ते ता’ - सबार अव्याहति ॥259॥
cc-adi-17.259.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, being omniscient, could understand the degradation of these students. Thus He sat at home, contemplating how to rescue them.

lines: tṛṇa haite nīca hañā sadā labe nāma
devanagari: तृण हैते नीच हा सदा लबे नाम ।
आपनि निरभिमानी, अन्ये दिबे मान ॥26॥
cc-adi-17.26.translation: "To chant the holy name always, one should be humbler than the grass in the street and devoid of all desire for personal honor, but one should offer others all respectful obeisances.

devanagari: यत अध्यापक, आर ताँर शिष्य - गण ।
धर्मी, कर्मी, तपो - निष्ठ, निन्दक, दुर्जन ॥260॥
cc-adi-17.260.translation: "All the so-called professors and scientists and their students generally follow the regulative principles of religion, fruitive activities and austerities," the Lord thought, "yet at the same time they are blasphemers and rogues.

lines: āmi nā laoyāile bhakti, nā pāre la-ite
devanagari: एइ सब मोर निन्दा - अपराध हैते ।
आमि ना लओयाइले भक्ति, ना पारे लइते ॥261॥
cc-adi-17.261.translation: "If I do not induce them to take to devotional service, because of committing the offense of blasphemy none of these people will be able to take to it.

devanagari: निस्तारिते आइलाम आमि, हैल विपरीत ।
ए - सब दुर्जनेर कैछे हइबेक हित ॥262॥
cc-adi-17.262.translation: "I have come to deliver all the fallen souls, but now just the opposite has happened. How can these rogues be delivered? How may they be benefited?

lines: tabe se ihāre bhakti laoyāile laya
devanagari: आमाके प्रणति करे, हय पाप - क्षय ।
तबे से इहारे भक्ति लओयाइले लय ॥263॥
cc-adi-17.263.translation: "If these rogues offer Me obeisances, the reactions of their sinful activities will be nullified. Then, if I induce them, they will take to devotional service.

lines: more nindā kare ye, nā kare namaskāra
devanagari: मोरे निन्दा करे ये, ना करे नमस्कार ।
ए - सब जीवेरे अवश्य करिब उद्धार ॥264॥
cc-adi-17.264.translation: "I must certainly deliver all these fallen souls who blaspheme Me and do not offer Me obeisances.

devanagari: अतएव अवश्य आमि सन्न्यास करिब ।
सन्यासि - बुद्ध्ये मोरे प्रणत हुइब ॥265॥
cc-adi-17.265.translation: "I shall accept the sannyāsa order of life, for thus people will offer Me their obeisances, thinking of Me as a member of the renounced order.

devanagari: प्रणतिते ह’बे इहार अपराध क्षय ।
निर्मल हृदये भक्ति कराइब उदय ॥266॥
cc-adi-17.266.translation: "Offering obeisances will relieve them of all the reactions to their offenses. Then, by My grace, devotional service [bhakti] will awaken in their pure hearts.

lines: āra kona upāya nāhi, ei yukti sāra
devanagari: ए - सब पाषण्डीर तबे हइबे निस्तार ।
आर कोन उपाय नाहि, एइ युक्ति सार ॥267॥
cc-adi-17.267.translation: "All the unfaithful rogues of this world can be delivered by this process. There is no alternative. This is the essence of the argument."

lines: ei dṛḍha yukti kari' prabhu āche ghare
devanagari: एइ दृढ़ युक्ति करि’ प्रभु आछे घरे ।
केशव भारती आइला नदीया - नगरे ॥268॥
cc-adi-17.268.translation: After coming to this firm conclusion, the Lord continued to stay at home. In the meantime Keśava Bhāratī came to the town of Nadia.

devanagari: प्रभु ताँरे नमस्क रि’ कैल निमन्त्रण ।
भिक्षा कराइया ताँरे कैल निवेदन ॥269॥
cc-adi-17.269.translation: The Lord offered him respectful obeisances and invited him to His house. After feeding him sumptuously, He submitted to him His petition.

devanagari: तरु - सम सहिष्णुता वैष्णव करिबे ।
भर्त्सन - ताड़ने काके किछु ना बलिबे ॥27॥
cc-adi-17.27.translation: "A devotee engaged in chanting the holy name of the Lord should practice forbearance like that of a tree. Even if rebuked or chastised, he should not say anything to others to retaliate.

lines: kṛpā kari' kara mora saṁsāra mocana
devanagari: तुमि त’ ईश्वर बट , - साक्षात्नारायण ।
कृपा करि’ कर मोर संसार मोचन ॥270॥
cc-adi-17.270.translation: "Sir, you are directly Nārāyaṇa. Therefore please be merciful unto Me. Deliver Me from this material bondage."

lines: ye karāha, se kariba,—svatantra nahi āmi
devanagari: भारती कहेन, तुमि ईश्वर, अन्तर्यामी ।
ये कराह, से करिब , - स्वतन्त्र नहि आमि ॥271॥
cc-adi-17.271.translation: Keśava Bhāratī replied to the Lord, "You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the Supersoul. I must do whatever You cause me to do. I am not independent of You."

lines: eta bali' bhāratī gosāñi kāṭoyāte gelā
devanagari: एत बलि’ भारती गोसाञि काटोयाते गेला ।
महाप्रभु ताहा याइ’ सन्न्यास करिला ॥272॥
cc-adi-17.272.translation: After saying this, Keśava Bhāratī, the spiritual master, went back to his village, Katwa. Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu went there and accepted the renounced order of life [sannyāsa].

devanagari: सङ्गे नित्यानन्द, चन्द्रशेखर आचार्य ।
मुकुन्द - दत्त, - एइ तिन कैल सर्व कार्य ॥273॥
cc-adi-17.273.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted sannyāsa, three personalities were with Him to perform all the necessary activities. They were Nityānanda Prabhu, Candraśekhara Ācārya and Mukunda Datta.

devanagari: एइ आदि - लीलार कैल सूत्र गणन ।
विस्तारि वर्णिला इहा दास वृन्दावन ॥274॥
cc-adi-17.274.translation: Thus I have summarized the incidents of the ādi-līlā. Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has described them elaborately [in his Caitanya-bhāgavata].

devanagari: यशोदा - नन्दन हैला शचीर नन्दन ।
चतुर्विध भक्त - भाव करे आस्वादन ॥275॥
cc-adi-17.275.translation: The same Supreme Personality of Godhead who appeared as the son of mother Yaśodā has now appeared as the son of mother Śacī, relishing four kinds of devotional activities.

devanagari: स्व - माधुर्य राधा - प्रेम - रस आस्वादिते ।
राधा - भाव अङ्गी करियाछे भाल - मते ॥276॥
cc-adi-17.276.translation: To taste the mellow quality of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's loving affairs in Her relationship with Kṛṣṇa, and to understand the reservoir of pleasure in Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa Himself, as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, accepted the mood of Rādhārāṇī.

devanagari: गोपी - भाव याते प्रभु धरियाछे एकान्त ।
व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दने माने आपना र कान्त ॥277॥
cc-adi-17.277.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted the mood of the gopīs, who accept Vrajendranandana, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, as their lover.

devanagari: गोपिका - भावेर एइ सुदृढ़ निश्चय ।
व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन विना अन्यत्र ना हय ॥278॥
cc-adi-17.278.translation: It is firmly ascertained that the ecstatic mood of the gopīs is possible only before Kṛṣṇa, and no one else.

devanagari: श्यामसुन्दर, शिखिपिच्छ - गुञ्जा - विभूषण ।
गोप - वेश, त्रि - भङ्गिम, मुरली - वदन ॥279॥
cc-adi-17.279.translation: He has a bluish complexion, a peacock feather on His head, a guñjā garland and the decorations of a cowherd boy. His body is curved in three places, and He has a flute in His mouth.

lines: kāṭileha taru yena kichu nā bolaya
śukāiyā mare, tabu jala nā māgaya
devanagari: काटिलेह तरु येन किछु ना बोलय ।
शुकाइया मरे, तबु जल ना मागय ॥28॥
cc-adi-17.28.translation: "For even if one cuts a tree, it never protests, nor even if it is drying up and dying it does it ask anyone for water.

lines: ihā chāḍi' kṛṣṇa yadi haya anyākāra
gopikāra bhāva nāhi yāya nikaṭa tāhāra
devanagari: इहा छा ड़ि’ कृष्ण यदि हय अन्याकार ।
गोपिकार भाव नाहि याय निकट ताहार ॥280॥
cc-adi-17.280.translation: If Lord Kṛṣṇa gives up this original form and assumes another Viṣṇu form, nearness to Him cannot invoke the ecstatic mood of the gopīs.

lines: gopīnāṁ paśupendra-nandana-juṣo bhāvasya kas tāṁ krtī
āviṣkurvati vaiṣṇavīm api tanuṁ tasmin bhujair jiṣṇubhir
yāsāṁ hanta caturbhir adbhuta-ruciṁ rāgodayaḥ kuñcati
devanagari: गोपीनां पशुपेन्द्र - नन्दन - जुषो भावस्य कस्तां कृती विज्ञातुं क्षमते दुरूह - पदवी - सञ्चारिणः प्रक्रियाम् ।
आविष्कुर्वति वैष्णवीमपि तनुं तस्मिन्भुजैजिष्णुभिर् यासां हन्त चतुर्भिरद्भुत - रुचिं रागोदयः कुञ्चति ॥281॥
cc-adi-17.281.translation: "Once Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa with a playful motive manifested Himself as Nārāyaṇa, with four victorious hands and a very beautiful form. Seeing this exalted form, however, crippled the ecstatic feelings of the gopīs. A learned scholar, therefore, cannot understand the gopīs' ecstatic feelings, which are firmly fixed upon the original form of Lord Kṛṣṇa as the son of Nanda Mahārāja. The wonderful feelings of the gopīs in ecstatic parama-rasa with Kṛṣṇa are the greatest mystery in spiritual life.""

devanagari: वसन्त - काले रा स - लीला करे गोवर्धने ।
अन्तर्धान कैला सङ्केत करि’ राधा - सने ॥282॥
cc-adi-17.282.translation: During the season of springtime, when the rāsa dance was going on, suddenly Kṛṣṇa disappeared from the scene, indicating that He wanted to be alone with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

devanagari: निभृत - निकुञ्जे वसि’ देखे राधार बाट ।
अन्वेषिते आइला ताहाँ गोपिकार ठाट ॥283॥
cc-adi-17.283.translation: Kṛṣṇa was sitting in a solitary bush, waiting for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī to pass by. But while He was searching, the gopīs arrived there, like a phalanx of soldiers.

lines: dūra haite kṛṣṇe dekhi' bale gopī-gaṇa
devanagari: दूर हैते कृष्णे देखि’ बले गोपी - गण ।
“एइ देख कुञ्जर भितर व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन” ॥284॥
cc-adi-17.284.translation: "Just see!" the gopīs said, seeing Kṛṣṇa from a distant place. "Here within a bush is Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja."

devanagari: गोपी - गण दे खि’ कृष्णेर हइल साध्वस ।
लुकाइते नारिल, भये हैला विवश ॥285॥
cc-adi-17.285.translation: As soon as Kṛṣṇa saw all the gopīs, He was struck with emotion. Thus He could not hide Himself, and out of fear He became motionless.

lines: kṛṣṇa dekhi' gopī kahe nikaṭe āsiyā
devanagari: चतुर्भुज मूर्ति धरि’ आछेन वसिया ।
कृष्ण देखि’ गोपी कहे निकटे आसिया ॥286॥
cc-adi-17.286.translation: Kṛṣṇa assumed His four-armed Nārāyaṇa form and sat there. When all the gopīs came, seeing Him they spoke as follows.

lines: eta bali' tāṅre sabhe kare nati-stuti
devanagari: ‘इहों कृष्ण नहे, इहों नारायण मूर्ति’ ।
एत बलि’ ताँरे सभे करे नति - स्तुति ॥287॥
cc-adi-17.287.translation: "He is not Kṛṣṇa! He is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Nārāyaṇa." After saying this, they offered obeisances and the following respectful prayers.

devanagari: “नमो नारायण, देव करह प्रसाद ।
कृष्ण - सङ्ग देह’ मोर घुचाह विषाद” ॥288॥
cc-adi-17.288.translation: "O Lord Nārāyaṇa, we offer our respectful obeisances unto You. Kindly be merciful to us. Give us the association of Kṛṣṇa and thus vanquish our lamentation."

devanagari: एत बलि नमस्क रि’ गेला गोपी - गण ।
हेन - काले राधा आ सि’ दिला दरशन ॥289॥
cc-adi-17.289.translation: After saying this and offering obeisances, all the gopīs dispersed. Then Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī came and appeared before Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: ei-mata vaiṣṇava kāre kichu nā māgiba
devanagari: एइ - मत वैष्णव कारे किछु ना मागिब ।
अयाचित - वृत्ति, किंवा शाक - फल खाइब ॥29॥
cc-adi-17.29.translation: "Thus a Vaiṣṇava should not ask anything from anyone else. If someone gives him something without being asked, he should accept it, but if nothing comes, a Vaiṣṇava should be satisfied to eat whatever vegetables and fruits are easily available.

lines: rādhā dekhi' kṛṣṇa tāṅre hāsya karite
devanagari: राधा दे खि’ कृष्ण ताँरे हास्य करिते ।
सेइ चतुर्भुज मूर्ति चाहेन राखिते ॥290॥
cc-adi-17.290.translation: When Lord Kṛṣṇa saw Rādhārāṇī, He wanted to maintain the four-armed form to joke with Her.

lines: bahu yatna kailā kṛṣṇa, nārila rākhite
devanagari: लुकाइला दुइ भुज राधार अग्रेते ।
बहु यत्न कैला कृष्ण, नारिल राखिते ॥291॥
cc-adi-17.291.translation: In front of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, Śrī Kṛṣṇa tried to hide the two extra arms. He tried His best to keep four arms before Her, but He was completely unable to do so.

devanagari: राधार विशुद्ध - भावेर अचिन्त्य प्रभाव ।
