ये कृष्णेरे कराइला द्वि - भुज - स्वभाव ॥292॥
cc-adi-17.292.translation: The influence of Rādhārāṇī's pure ecstasy is so inconceivably great that it forced Kṛṣṇa to come to His original two-armed form.

lines: dṛṣṭaṁ gopayituṁ svam uddhura-dhiyā yā suṣṭhu sandarśitā
rādhāyāḥ praṇayasya hanta mahimā yasya śriyā rakṣituṁ
sā śakyā prabhaviṣṇunāpi hariṇā nāsīc catur-bāhutā
devanagari: रासारम्भ - विधौ निलीय वसता कुल्ले मृगाक्षी - गणैर् दृष्टं गोपयितुं स्वमुद्धर - धिया या सुष्ठ सन्दर्शिता ।
राधायाः प्रणयस्य हन्त महिमा यस्य श्रिया रक्षितुं सा शक्या प्रभविष्णुनापि हरिणा नासीच्चतुर्बाहुता ॥293॥
cc-adi-17.293.translation: "Prior to the rāsa dance, Lord Kṛṣṇa hid Himself in a grove just to have fun. When the gopīs came, their eyes resembling those of deer, by His sharp intelligence He exhibited His beautiful four-armed form to hide Himself. But when Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī came there, Kṛṣṇa could not maintain His four arms in Her presence. This is the wonderful glory of Her love."

devanagari: सेइ व्रजेश्वर - इहँ जगन्नाथ पिता ।
सेइ व्रजेश्वरी - इहँ शचीदेवी माता ॥294॥
cc-adi-17.294.translation: Father Nanda, the King of Vrajabhūmi, is now Jagannātha Miśra, the father of Caitanya Mahāprabhu. And mother Yaśodā, the Queen of Vrajabhūmi, is now Śacīdevī, Lord Caitanya's mother.

devanagari: सेइ नन्द - सुत - इहँ चैतन्य - गोसाञि ।
सेइ बलदेव - इहँ नित्यानन्द भाइ ॥295॥
cc-adi-17.295.translation: The former son of Nanda Mahārāja is now Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the former Baladeva, Kṛṣṇa's brother, is now Nityānanda Prabhu, the brother of Lord Caitanya.

devanagari: वात्सल्य, दास्य, सख्य - तिन भावमय ।
सेइ नित्यानन्द - कृष्ण - चैतन्य - सहाय ॥296॥
cc-adi-17.296.translation: Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu always feels the ecstatic emotions of paternity, servitude and friendship. He always assists Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in that way.

lines: tāṅra caritra loke nā pāre bujhite
devanagari: प्रेम - भक्ति दिया तेंहो भासा’ ल जगते ।
ताँर चरित्र लोके ना पारे बुझिते ॥297॥
cc-adi-17.297.translation: Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu overflooded the entire world by distributing transcendental loving service. No one can understand His character and activities.

devanagari: अद्वैत - आचार्य - गोसाञि भक्त - अवतार ।
कृष्ण अवतारिया कैला भक्तिर प्रचार ॥298॥
cc-adi-17.298.translation: Śrīla Advaita Ācārya Prabhu appeared as an incarnation of a devotee. He is in the category of Kṛṣṇa, but He descended to this earth to propagate devotional service.

devanagari: सख्य, दास्य, दुइ भाव सहज ताँहार ।
कभु प्रभु करेन ताँरे गुरु - व्यवहार ॥299॥
cc-adi-17.299.translation: His natural emotions were always on the platform of fraternity and servitude, but the Lord sometimes treated Him as His spiritual master.

devanagari: कैशोर - लीलार सूत्र करिल गणन ।
यौवन - लीलार सूत्र करि अनुक्रम ॥3॥
cc-adi-17.3.translation: I have already given a synopsis of the kaiśora-līlā of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Now let me enumerate His youthful pastimes in chronological order.

devanagari: सदा नाम लइब, यथा - लाभेते सन्तोष ।
एइत आचार करे भक्ति - धर्म - पोष ॥30॥
cc-adi-17.30.translation: "One should strictly follow the principle of always chanting the holy name, and one should be satisfied with whatever he gets easily. Such devotional behavior solidly maintains one's devotional service.

devanagari: श्रीवासादि यत महाप्रभुर भक्त - गण ।
निज निज भावे करेन चैतन्य - सेवन ॥300॥
cc-adi-17.300.translation: All the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, have their own emotional humors in which they render service unto Him.

lines: sei sei rase prabhu hana tāṅra vaśa
devanagari: पण्डित - गोसाञि आदि याँर येइ रस ।
सेइ सेइ रसे प्रभु हन ताँर वश ॥301॥
cc-adi-17.301.translation: Personal associates like Gadādhara, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Rāmānanda Rāya, and the six Gosvāmīs (headed by Rūpa Gosvāmī) are all situated in their respective transcendental humors. Thus the Lord submits to various transcendentally mellow positions.

lines: ihaṅ gaura—kabhu dvija, kabhu ta' sannyāsī
devanagari: तिहँ श्याम , - वंशी - मुख, गोप - विलासी ।
इहँ गौर - कभु द्विज, कभु त’ सन्यासी ॥302॥
cc-adi-17.302.translation: In kṛṣṇa-lilā the Lord's complexion is blackish. A flute in His mouth, He enjoys as a cowherd boy. Now the selfsame person has appeared with a fair complexion, sometimes acting as a brāhmaṇa and sometimes accepting the renounced order of life.

devanagari: अतएव आपने प्रभु गोपी - भाव ध रि’ ।
व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दने कहे ‘प्राण - नाथ’ करि’ ॥303॥
cc-adi-17.303.translation: Therefore the Lord Himself, accepting the emotional ecstasy of the gopīs, now addresses the son of Nanda Mahārāja, "O master of My life! O My dear husband!"

devanagari: सेइ कृष्ण, सेइ गोपी , - परम विरोध ।
अचिन्त्य चरित्र प्रभुर अति सुदुर्बोध ॥304॥
cc-adi-17.304.translation: He is Kṛṣṇa, yet He has accepted the mood of the gopīs. How is it so? It is the inconceivable character of the Lord, which is very difficult to understand.

lines: ithe tarka kari' keha nā kara saṁśaya
devanagari: इथे तकर् क रि’ केह ना कर संशय ।
कृष्णेर अचिन्त्य - शक्ति एइ मत हय ॥305॥
cc-adi-17.305.translation: One cannot understand the contradictions in Lord Caitanya's character by putting forward mundane logic and arguments. Consequently one should not maintain doubts in this connection. One should simply try to understand the inconceivable energy of Kṛṣṇa; otherwise one cannot understand how such contradictions are possible.

lines: citra bhāva, citra guṇa, citra vyavahāra
devanagari: अचिन्त्य, अद्भुत कृष्ण - चैतन्य - विहार ।
चित्र भाव, चित्र गुण, चित्र व्यवहार ॥306॥
cc-adi-17.306.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu are inconceivable and wonderful. His ecstasy is wonderful, His qualities are wonderful, and His behavior is wonderful.

lines: tarke ihā nāhi māne yei durācāra
devanagari: तकर्े इहा नाहि माने येइ दुराचार ।
कुम्भीपाके पचे, तार नाहिक निस्तार ॥307॥
cc-adi-17.307.translation: If one simply adheres to mundane arguments and therefore does not accept this, he will boil in the hell of Kumbhīpāka. For him there is no deliverance.

devanagari: अचिन्त्याः खलु ये भावा न तांस्तकेंण योजयेत् ।
प्रकृतिभ्यः परं यच्च तदचिन्त्यस्य लक्षणम् ॥308॥
cc-adi-17.308.translation: "Anything transcendental to material nature is called inconceivable, whereas arguments are all mundane. Since mundane arguments cannot touch transcendental subject matters, one should not try to understand transcendental subjects through mundane arguments."

lines: sei jana yāya caitanyera pada pāśa
devanagari: अद्भुत चैतन्य - लीलाय याहार विश्वास ।
सेइ जन याय चैतन्येर पद पाश ॥309॥
cc-adi-17.309.translation: Only a person who has firm faith in the wonderful pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu can approach His lotus feet.

devanagari: तृणादपि सु - नीचेन तरोरिव सहिष्णुना ।
अमानिना मान - देन कीर्तनीयः सदा हरिः ॥31॥
cc-adi-17.31.translation: "One who thinks himself lower than the grass, who is more tolerant than a tree, and who does not expect personal honor yet is always prepared to give all respect to others can very easily always chant the holy name of the Lord."

lines: ihā yei śune, śuddha-bhakti haya tāra
devanagari: प्रसङ्गे कहिल एइ सिद्धान्तेर सार ।
इहा येइ शुने, शुद्ध - भक्ति हय तार ॥310॥
cc-adi-17.310.translation: In this discourse I have explained the essence of the devotional conclusion. Anyone who hears this develops unalloyed devotional service to the Lord.

lines: tabe se granthera artha pāiye āsvāda
devanagari: लिखित ग्रन्थेर यदि करि अनुवाद ।
तबे से ग्रन्थेर अर्थ पाइये आस्वाद ॥311॥
cc-adi-17.311.translation: If I repeat what is already written, I may thus relish the purpose of this scripture.

lines: kathā kahi' anuvāda kare vāra vāra
devanagari: देखि ग्रन्थे भागवते व्यासेर आचार ।
कथा क हि’ अनुवाद करे वार वार ॥312॥
cc-adi-17.312.translation: We can see in the scripture Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam the conduct of its author, Śrī Vyāsadeva. After speaking the narration, he repeats it again and again.

devanagari: ताते आदि - लीलार करि परिच्छेद गणन ।
प्रथम परिच्छेदे कैलै ‘मङ्गलाचरण’ ॥313॥
cc-adi-17.313.translation: Therefore I shall enumerate the chapters of the Ādi-līlā. In the First Chapter I offer obeisances to the spiritual master, for this is the beginning of auspicious writing.

devanagari: द्वितीय परिच्छेदे ‘चैतन्य - तत्त्व - निरूपण’ ।
स्वयं भगवान् येइ व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ॥314॥
cc-adi-17.314.translation: The Second Chapter explains the truth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda.

devanagari: तेंहो त’ चैतन्य - कृष्ण - शचीर नन्दन ।
तृतीय परिच्छेदे जन्मेर ‘सामान्य’ कारण ॥315॥
cc-adi-17.315.translation: Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is Kṛṣṇa Himself, has now appeared as the son of mother Śacī. The Third Chapter describes the general cause of His appearance.

devanagari: तहिं मध्ये प्रेम - दान - ‘विशेष’ कारण ।
युग - धर्म - कृष्ण - नाम - प्रेम - प्रचारण ॥316॥
cc-adi-17.316.translation: The Third Chapter specifically describes the distribution of love of Godhead. It also describes the religion of the age, which is simply to distribute the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa and propagate the process of loving Him.

devanagari: चतुर्थे कहिलूँ जन्मेर ‘मूल’ प्रयोजन ।
स्व - माधुर्य - प्रेमानन्द - रस - आस्वादन ॥317॥
cc-adi-17.317.translation: The Fourth Chapter describes the main reason for His appearance, which is to taste the mellow quality of His own transcendental loving service and His own sweetness.

devanagari: पञ्चमे ‘श्री नित्यानन्द’ - तत्त्व निरूपण ।
नित्यानन्द हैला राम रोहिणी - नन्दन ॥318॥
cc-adi-17.318.translation: The Fifth Chapter describes the truth of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, who is none other than Balarāma, the son of Rohiṇī.

devanagari: षष्ठ परिच्छेदे ‘अद्वैत तत्त्वे’र विचार ।
अद्वैत - आचार्य महा - विष्णु - अवतार ॥319॥
cc-adi-17.319.translation: The Sixth Chapter considers the truth of Advaita Ācārya. He is an incarnation of Mahā-Viṣṇu.

lines: nāma-sūtre gāṅthi' para kaṇṭhe ei śloka
devanagari: ऊर्ध्व - बाहु करि’ कहों, शुन, सर्व - लोक ।
नाम - सूत्रे गाँथि’ पर कण्ठे एइ श्लोक ॥32॥
cc-adi-17.32.translation: Raising my hands, I declare, "Everyone please hear me! String this verse on the thread of the holy name and wear it on your neck for continuous remembrance."

devanagari: सप्तम परिच्छेदे ‘पञ्च - तत्त्वे’र आख्यान ।
पञ्च - तत्त्व मिलि’ ग्रैछे कैला प्रेम - दान ॥320॥
cc-adi-17.320.translation: The Seventh Chapter describes the Pañca-tattva-Śrī Caitanya, Prabhu Nityānanda, Śrī Advaita, Gadādhara and Śrīvāsa. They all combined together to distribute love of Godhead everywhere.

devanagari: अष्टमे ‘चैतन्य - लीला - वर्णन’ कारण ।
एक कृष्ण - नामेर महा - महिमा - कथन ॥321॥
cc-adi-17.321.translation: The Eighth Chapter gives the reason for describing Lord Caitanya's pastimes. It also describes the greatness of Lord Kṛṣṇa's holy name.

devanagari: नवमेते ‘भक्ति - कल्प - वृक्षेर वर्णन’ ।
श्री - चैतन्य - माली कैला वृक्ष आरोपण ॥322॥
cc-adi-17.322.translation: The Ninth Chapter describes the desire tree of devotional service. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself is the gardener who planted it.

devanagari: दशमेते मूल - स्कन्धेर ‘शाखादि - गणन’।
सर्व - शाखा - गणेर यैछे फल - वितरण ॥323॥
cc-adi-17.323.translation: The Tenth Chapter describes the branches and sub-branches of the main trunk, and the distribution of their fruits.

devanagari: एकादशे ‘नित्यानन्द - शाखा - विवरण’ ।
द्वादशे ‘अद्वैत - स्कन्ध शाखार वर्ण न’ ॥324॥
cc-adi-17.324.translation: The Eleventh Chapter describes the branch called Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu. The Twelfth Chapter describes the branch called Śrī Advaita Prabhu.

devanagari: त्रयोदशे महाप्रभुर ‘जन्म - विवरण’ ।
कृष्ण - नाम - सह यैछे प्रभुर जनम ॥325॥
cc-adi-17.325.translation: The Thirteenth Chapter describes the birth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, which took place with the chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: चतुर्दशे ‘बाल्य - लीला’र किछु विवरण ।
पञ्चदशे ‘पौगण्ड - लीला’र सङ्क्षेपे कथन ॥326॥
cc-adi-17.326.translation: The Fourteenth Chapter gives some description of the Lord's childhood pastimes. The Fifteenth briefly describes the Lord's boyhood pastimes.

devanagari: षोड़श परिच्छेदे ‘कैशोर - लीला’ र उद्देश ।
सप्तदशे ‘यौवन - लीला’ कहिलुँ विशेष ॥327॥
cc-adi-17.327.translation: In the Sixteenth Chapter I have indicated the pastimes of the kaiśora age [the age prior to youth]. In the Seventeenth Chapter I have specifically described His youthful pastimes.

devanagari: एइ सप्त दश प्रकार आदि - लीलार प्रबन्ध ।
द्वादश प्रबन्ध ताते ग्रन्थ - मुखबन्ध ॥328॥
cc-adi-17.328.translation: Thus there are seventeen varieties of subjects in the First Canto, which is known as the Ādi-līlā. Twelve of these constitute the preface of this scripture.

devanagari: पञ्च - प्रबन्धे पञ्च - रसेर चरित ।
सङ्क्षेपे कहिलुँ अति, - ना क ैलुँ विस्तृत ॥329॥
cc-adi-17.329.translation: After the chapters of the preface, I have described five transcendental mellows in five chapters. I have described them very briefly rather than expansively.

devanagari: प्रभु - आज्ञाय कर एइ श्लोक आचरण ।
अवश्य पाइबे तबे श्री - कृष्ण - चरण ॥33॥
cc-adi-17.33.translation: One must strictly follow the principles given by Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu in this verse. If one simply follows in the footsteps of Lord Caitanya and the Gosvāmīs, certainly he will achieve the ultimate goal of life, the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: वृन्दावन - दास इहा ‘चैतन्य - मङ्गले’ ।
विस्ता रि’ वणिला नित्यानन्द - आज्ञा - बले ॥330॥
cc-adi-17.330.translation: By the order and strength of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has elaborately described in his Caitanya-maṅgala all that I have not.

devanagari: श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य - लीला - अद्भुत, अनन्त ।
ब्रह्मा - शिव - शेष याँर नाहि पाय अन्त ॥331॥
cc-adi-17.331.translation: The pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are wonderful and unlimited. Even personalities like Lord Brahmā, Lord Śiva and Śeṣa Nāga cannot find their end.

lines: ye yei aṁśa kahe, śune sei dhanya
devanagari: ये येइ अंश कहे, शुने सेइ धन्य ।
अचिरे मिलिबे तारे श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य ॥332॥
cc-adi-17.332.translation: Anyone who describes or hears any part of this elaborate subject will very soon receive the causeless mercy of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य, अद्वैत, नित्यानन्द ।
श्रीवास - गदाधरादि यत भक्त - वृन्द ॥333॥
cc-adi-17.333.translation: [Herein the author again describes the Pañca-tattva.] Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, Prabhu Nityānanda, Śrī Advaita, Gadādhara, Śrīvāsa and all the devotees of Lord Caitanya.

lines: namra hañā śire dharoṅ sabāra caraṇe
devanagari: यत यत भक्त - गण वैसे वृन्दावने ।
नम्र हञा शिरे धरों सबार चरणे ॥334॥
cc-adi-17.334.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances to all the residents of Vṛndāvana. I wish to place their lotus feet on my head in great humbleness.

devanagari: श्री - स्वरूप - श्री - रूप - श्री - सनातन ।
श्री - रघुनाथ - दास, आर श्री - जीव - चरण ॥335॥
cc-adi-17.335-336.translation: I wish to place the lotus feet of the Gosvāmīs on my head. Their names are Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī and Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī. Placing their lotus feet on my head, always hoping to serve them, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: तबे प्रभु श्रीवासेर गृहे निरन्तर ।
रात्रे सङ्कीर्तन कैल एक संवत्सर ॥34॥
cc-adi-17.34.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu regularly led congregational chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra in the house of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura every night for one full year.

lines: kapāṭa diyā kīrtana kare parama āveśe
pāṣaṇḍī hāsite āise, nā pāya praveśe
devanagari: कपाट दिया कीर्तन करे परम आवेशे ।
पाषण्डी हासिते आइसे, ना पाय प्रवेशे ॥35॥
cc-adi-17.35.translation: This ecstatic chanting was performed with the doors closed so that nonbelievers who came to make fun could not gain entrance.

lines: kīrtana śuni' bāhire tārā jvali' puḍi' mare
śrīvāsere duḥkha dite nānā yukti kare
devanagari: कीर्तन शुनि’ बाहिरे तारा ज्व लि’ पुड़ि’ मरे ।
श्रीवासेरे दुःख दिते नाना युक्ति करे ॥36॥
cc-adi-17.36.translation: Thus the nonbelievers almost burned to ashes and died in envy. To retaliate, they planned various ways to give trouble to Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: एक - दिन विप्र, नाम - गोपाल चापा ल’ ।
पाषण्डि - प्रधान सेइ दुर्मुख, वाचाल ॥37॥
cc-adi-17.37-38.translation: One night while kīrtana was going on inside Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura's house, a brāhmaṇa named Gopāla Cāpāla, the chief of the nonbelievers, who was talkative and very rough in his speech, placed all the paraphernalia for worshiping the goddess Durgā outside Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura's door.

devanagari: कलार पात उपरे थुइल ओड़ - फुल ।
हरिद्रा, सिन्दूर आर रक्त - चन्दन, तण्डुल ॥39॥
cc-adi-17.39.translation: On the upper portion of a plantain leaf he placed such paraphernalia for worship as oḍa-phula, turmeric, vermillion, red sandalwood and rice.

devanagari: विद्या - सौन्दर्य - सद्वेश - सम्भोग - नृत्य - कीर्तनैः ।
प्रेम - नाम - प्रदानैश्च गौरो दीव्यति यौवने ॥4॥
cc-adi-17.4.translation: Exhibiting His scholarship, beauty and fine dress, Lord Caitanya danced, as He chanted and distributed the holy name of the Lord to awaken dormant love of Kṛṣṇa. Thus Lord Śrī Gaurasundara shone in His youthful pastimes.

devanagari: मद्य - भाण्ड - पाशे ध रि’ निज - घरे गेल ।
प्रातःकाले श्री वास ताहा त’ देखिल ॥40॥
cc-adi-17.40.translation: He placed a pot of wine beside all this, and in the morning when Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura opened his door he saw this paraphernalia.

lines: baḍa baḍa loka saba ānila bolāiyā
devanagari: बड़ बड़ लोक सब आनिल बोलाइया ।
सबारे कहे श्रीवास हासिया हासिया ॥41॥
cc-adi-17.41.translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura called for all the respectable gentlemen of the neighborhood and smilingly addressed them as follows.

devanagari: नित्य रात्रे करि आमि भवानी - पूजन ।
आमार महिमा देख, ब्राह्मण - सज्जन ॥42॥
cc-adi-17.42.translation: "Gentlemen, every night I worship the goddess Bhavānī. Since the paraphernalia for the worship is present here, now all you respectable brāhmaṇas and members of the higher castes can understand my position."

lines: aiche karma hethā kaila kon durācāra
devanagari: तबे सब शिष्ट - लोक करे हाहाकार ।
ऐछे कर्म हेथा कैल को दुराचार ॥43॥
cc-adi-17.43.translation: Then all the assembled gentlemen exclaimed, "What is this? What is this? Who has performed such mischievous activities? Who is that sinful man?"

devanagari: हाड़िके आनिया सब दूर कराइल ।
जल - गोमय दिया सेइ स्थान लेपाइल ॥44॥
cc-adi-17.44.translation: They called for a sweeper [hāḍi], who threw all the items of worship far away and cleansed the place by mopping it with a mixture of water and cow dung.

devanagari: तिन दिन र हि’ सेइ गोपाल - चापाल ।
सर्वाङ्गे हइल कुष्ठ, वहे रक्त - धार ॥45॥
cc-adi-17.45.translation: After three days, leprosy attacked Gopāla Cāpāla, and blood oozed from sores all over his body.

devanagari: सर्वाङ्ग बेड़िल कीटे, काटे निरन्तर ।
असह्य वेदना, दुःखे ज्वलये अन्तर ॥46॥
cc-adi-17.46.translation: Incessantly covered with germs and insects biting him all over his body, Gopāla Cāpāla felt unbearable pain. His entire body burned in distress.

lines: eka dina bale kichu prabhuke dekhiyā
devanagari: गङ्गा - घाटे वृक्ष - तले रहे त’ वसिया ।
एक दिन बले किछु प्रभुके देखिया ॥47॥
cc-adi-17.47.translation: Since leprosy is an infectious disease, Gopāla Cāpāla left the village to sit down on the bank of the Ganges underneath a tree. One day, however, he saw Caitanya Mahāprabhu passing by and spoke to Him as follows.

devanagari: ग्राम - सम्बन्धे आमि तोमार मातुल ।
भागिना, मुइ कुष्ठ - व्याधिते हजाछि व्याकुल ॥48॥
cc-adi-17.48.translation: "My dear nephew, I am Your maternal uncle in our village relationship. Please see how greatly this attack of leprosy has afflicted me.

lines: muñi baḍa dukhī, more karaha uddhāra
devanagari: लोक सब उद्घारिते तोमार अवतार ।
मुञि बड़ दुखी, मोरे करह उद्धार ॥49॥
cc-adi-17.49.translation: "As an incarnation of God, You are delivering so many fallen souls. I am also a greatly unhappy fallen soul. Kindly deliver me by Your mercy."

devanagari: यौवन - प्रवेशे अङ्गेर अङ्ग विभूषण ।
दिव्य वस्त्र, दिव्य वेश, माल्य - चन्दन ॥5॥
cc-adi-17.5.translation: As He entered His youth, the Lord decorated Himself with ornaments, dressed Himself in fine cloth, garlanded Himself with flowers and smeared Himself with sandalwood.

lines: eta śuni' mahāprabhura ha-ila kruddha mana
devanagari: एत शुनि’ महाप्रभुर हुइल क्रुद्ध मन ।
क्रोधावेशे बले तारे तर्जन - वचन ॥50॥
cc-adi-17.50.translation: Hearing this, Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared greatly angry, and in that angry mood He spoke some words chastising him.

lines: āre pāpi, bhakta-dveṣi, tore na uddhārimu
devanagari: आरे पापि, भक्त - द्वेषि, तोरे न उद्धारिमु ।
कोटि - जन्म एइ मते कीड़ाय खाओयाइमु ॥51॥
cc-adi-17.51.translation: "O sinful person, envious of pure devotees, I shall not deliver you! Rather, I shall have you bitten by these germs for many millions of years.

lines: koṭi janma habe tora raurave patana
devanagari: श्रीवासे कराइलि तुइ भवानी - पूजन ।
कोटि जन्म हबे तोर रौरवे पतन ॥52॥
cc-adi-17.52.translation: "You have made Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura appear to have been worshiping the goddess Bhavānī. Simply for this offense, you will have to fall down into hellish life for ten million births.

devanagari: पाषण्डी संहारिते मोर एइ अवतार ।
पाषण्डी संहारि’ भक्ति करिमु प्रचार ॥53॥
cc-adi-17.53.translation: "I have appeared in this incarnation to kill the demons [pāṣaṇḍīs] and, after killing them, to preach the cult of devotional service."

lines: eta bali' gelā prabhu karite gaṅgā-snāna
sei pāpī duḥkha bhoge, nā yāya parāṇa
devanagari: एत बलि’ गेला प्रभु करिते गङ्गा - स्नान ।
सेइ पापी दुःख भोगे, ना याय पराण ॥54॥
cc-adi-17.54.translation: After saying this, the Lord left to take His bath in the Ganges, and that sinful man did not give up his life but continued to suffer.

lines: sannyāsa kariyā yabe prabhu nīlācale gelā
tathā haite yabe kuliyā grāme āilā
devanagari: सन्न्यास करिया यबे प्रभु नीलाचले गेला ।
तथा हैते यबे कुलिया ग्रामे आइला ॥55॥
cc-adi-17.55-56.translation: When Śrī Caitanya, after accepting the renounced order of life, went to Jagannātha Purī and then came back to the village of Kuliyā, upon His return that sinful man took shelter at the Lord's lotus feet. The Lord, being merciful to him, gave him instructions for his benefit.

lines: tathā yāha, teṅho yadi karena prasāda
devanagari: श्रीवास पण्डितेर स्थाने आछे अपराध ।
तथा याह, तेंहो यदि करेन प्रसाद ॥57॥
cc-adi-17.57-58.translation: "You have committed an offense at the lotus feet of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura," the Lord said. "First you must go there and beg for his mercy, and then if he gives you his blessings and you do not commit such sins again, you will be freed from these reactions."

lines: tabe vipra la-ila āsi śrīvāsa śaraṇa
devanagari: तबे विप्र लइल आसि श्रीवास शरण ।
ताँहार कृपाय हैल पाप - विमोचन ॥59॥
cc-adi-17.59.translation: Then the brāhmaṇa, Gopāla Cāpāla, went to Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and took shelter of his lotus feet, and by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura's mercy he was freed from all sinful reactions.

lines: vidyāra auddhatye kāhoṅ nā kare gaṇana
devanagari: विद्यार औद्धत्ये काहों ना करे गणन ।
सकल पण्डित जि नि’ करे अध्यापन ॥6॥
cc-adi-17.6.translation: By dint of pride in His education, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, not caring for anyone else, defeated all kinds of learned scholars while executing His studies.

lines: āra eka vipra āila kīrtana dekhite
devanagari: आर एक विप्र आइल कीर्तन देखिते ।
द्वारे कपाट , - ना पाइल भितरे याइते ॥60॥
cc-adi-17.60.translation: Another brāhmaṇa also came to see the kīrtana performance, but the door was closed, and he could not enter the hall.

lines: phiri' gela vipra ghare mane duḥkha pāñā
āra dina prabhuke kahe gaṅgāya lāga pāñā
devanagari: फिरि’ गेल विप्र घरे मने दुःख पाञा ।
आर दिन प्रभुके कहे गङ्गाय लाग पाञा ॥61॥
cc-adi-17.61.translation: He returned home with an unhappy mind, but on the next day he met Lord Caitanya on the bank of the Ganges and spoke to Him.

devanagari: शापिब तोमारे मुञि, पाञाछि मनो - दुःख ।
पैता छिण्डिया शापे प्रचण्ड दुर्मुख ॥62॥
cc-adi-17.62.translation: That brāhmaṇa was expert in talking harshly and cursing others. Thus he broke his sacred thread and declared, "I shall now curse You, for Your behavior has greatly aggrieved me."

lines: śāpa śuni' prabhura citte ha-ila ullāsa
devanagari: संसार - सुख तोमार हउक विनाश ।
शाप शुनि’ प्रभुर चित्ते हइल उल्लास ॥63॥
cc-adi-17.63.translation: The brāhmaṇa cursed the Lord, "You shall be bereft of all material happiness!" When the Lord heard this, He felt great jubilation within Himself.

devanagari: प्रभुर शाप - वार्ता येइ शुने श्रद्धावान् ।
ब्रह्म - शाप हैते तार हय परित्राण ॥64॥
cc-adi-17.64.translation: Any faithful person who hears of this brāhmaṇa's cursing Lord Caitanya is delivered from all brahminical curses.

devanagari: मुकुन्द - दत्तेरे कैल दण्ड - परसाद ।
खण्डिल ताहार चित्तेर सब अवसाद ॥65॥
cc-adi-17.65.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu blessed Mukunda Datta with punishment and in that way vanquished all his mental depression.

devanagari: आचार्य - गोसाञि रे प्रभु करे गुरु - भक्ति ।
ताहाते आचार्य बड़ हय दुःख - मति ॥66॥
cc-adi-17.66.translation: Lord Caitanya respected Advaita Ācārya as His spiritual master, but Advaita Ācārya Prabhu was greatly aggrieved by such behavior.

devanagari: भङ्गी करि’ ज्ञान - मार्ग करिल व्याख्यान ।
क्रोधावेशे प्रभु तारे कैल अवज्ञान ॥67॥
cc-adi-17.67.translation: Thus He whimsically began to explain the path of philosophical speculation, and the Lord, in His anger, seemingly disrespected Him.

devanagari: तबे आचार्य - गोसाञि र आनन्द हइल ।
लजित हइया प्रभु प्रसाद करिल ॥68॥
cc-adi-17.68.translation: At that time Advaita Ācārya was greatly pleased. The Lord understood this, and He was somewhat ashamed, but He offered Advaita Ācārya His benediction.

devanagari: मुरारि - गुप्त - मुखे शुनि’ राम - गुण - ग्राम ।
ललाटे लिखिल ताँर ‘रामदास’ नाम ॥69॥
cc-adi-17.69.translation: Murāri Gupta was a great devotee of Lord Rāmacandra. When Lord Caitanya heard Lord Rāmacandra's glories from his mouth, He immediately wrote on his forehead "rāmadāsa" [the eternal servant of Lord Rāmacandra].

devanagari: वायु - व्याधि - च्छले कैल प्रे म परकाश ।
भक्त - गण ल ञा कैल विविध विलास ॥7॥
cc-adi-17.7.translation: In His youth, the Lord, on the plea of disturbances of the bodily airs, exhibited His ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa. Accompanied by His confidential devotees, He enjoyed various pastimes in this way.

devanagari: श्रीधरेर लौह - पात्रे कैल जल - पान ।
समस्त भक्तेरे दिल इष्ट वर - दान ॥70॥
cc-adi-17.70.translation: Once Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the house of Śrīdhara after kīrtana and drank water from his damaged iron pot. Then He bestowed His benediction upon all the devotees according to their desires.

devanagari: हरिदास ठाकुरेरे करिल प्रसाद ।
आचार्य - स्थाने मातार खण्डाइल अपराध ॥71॥
cc-adi-17.71.translation: After this incident the Lord blessed Haridāsa Ṭhākura and vanquished the offense of His mother at the home of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: भक्त - गणे प्रभु नाम - महिमा कहिल ।
शुनिया पडूया ताहाँ अर्थ - वाद कैल ॥72॥
cc-adi-17.72.translation: Once the Lord explained the glories of the holy name to the devotees, but some ordinary students who heard Him fashioned their own interpretation.

lines: nāme stuti-vāda śuni' prabhura haila duḥkha
devanagari: नामे स्तुति - वाद शुनि’ प्रभुर हैल दुःख ।
सबारे निषेधिल , - इहार ना देखिह मुख ॥73॥
cc-adi-17.73.translation: When a student interpreted the glories of the holy name as a prayer of exaggeration, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, greatly unhappy, immediately warned everyone not to see the student's face henceforward.

devanagari: सगणे सचेले गिया कैल गङ्गा - स्नान ।
भक्तिर महिमा ताहाँ करिल व्याख्यान ॥74॥
cc-adi-17.74.translation: Without even changing His garments, Lord Caitanya, with His companions, took bath in the Ganges. There He explained the glories of devotional service.

devanagari: ज्ञान - कर्म - योग - धर्मे नहे कृष्ण वश ।
कृष्ण - वश - हेतु एक - प्रेम - भक्ति - रस ॥75॥
cc-adi-17.75.translation: "By following the paths of speculative philosophical knowledge, fruitive activity or mystic yoga to control the senses, one cannot satisfy Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Lord. Unalloyed devotional love for Kṛṣṇa is the only cause for the Lord's satisfaction.

devanagari: न साधय ति मां योगो न साङ्ख्यं धर्म उद्धव ।
न स्वाध्यायस्तपस्त्यागो यथा भक्तिर्ममोर्जिता ॥76॥
cc-adi-17.76.translation: "[The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, said:] 'My dear Uddhava, neither through aṣṭāṅga-yoga [the mystic yoga system to control the senses], nor through impersonal monism or an analytical study of the Absolute Truth, nor through study of the Vedas, nor through practice of austerities, nor through charity, nor through acceptance of sannyāsa can one satisfy Me as much as one can by developing unalloyed devotional service unto Me.' "

lines: murārike kahe tumi kṛṣṇa vaśa kailā
devanagari: मुरारिके कहे तुमि कृष्ण वश कैला ।
शुनिया मुरारि श्लोक कहिते लागिला ॥77॥
cc-adi-17.77.translation: Lord Caitanya then praised Murāri Gupta, saying, "You have satisfied Lord Kṛṣṇa." Hearing this, Murāri Gupta quoted a verse from Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

devanagari: क्वाहं दरिद्रः पापीयान् क्व कृष्णः श्री - निकेतनः ।
ब्रह्म - बन्धुरिति स्माहं बाहुभ्यां परिरम्भितः ॥78॥
cc-adi-17.78.translation: “ 'Since I am but a poor, sinful brahma-bandhu, not brahminically qualified although born in a brāhmaṇa family, and You, Lord Kṛṣṇa, are the shelter of the goddess of fortune, it is simply wonderful, my dear Lord Kṛṣṇa, that You have embraced me with Your arms.' "

devanagari: एक - दिन प्रभु सब भक्त - गण ल ञा ।
सङ्कीर्तन करि’ वैसे श्रम - युक्त हञा ॥79॥
cc-adi-17.79.translation: One day the Lord performed saṅkīrtana with all His devotees, and when they were greatly fatigued they sat down.

devanagari: तबेत करिला प्रभु गयाते गमन ।
ईश्वर - पुरीर सङ्गे तथाइ मिलन ॥8॥
cc-adi-17.8.translation: Thereafter the Lord went to Gayā. There He met Śrīla Īśvara Purī.

devanagari: एक आम्र - बीज प्रभु अङ्गने रोपिल ।
तत्क्षणे जन्मिल वृक्ष बाड़िते लागिल ॥80॥
cc-adi-17.80.translation: The Lord then sowed a mango seed in the yard, and immediately the seed fructified into a tree and began to grow.

devanagari: देखिते देखिते वृक्ष हइल फलित ।
पाकिल अनेक फल, सबेइ विस्मित ॥81॥
cc-adi-17.81.translation: As people looked on, the tree became fully grown, with fruits that fully ripened. Thus everyone was struck with wonder.

lines: śata dui phala prabhu śīghra pāḍāila
devanagari: शत दुइ फल प्रभु शीघ्र पाड़ाइल ।
प्रक्षालन क रि’ कृष्णे भोग लागाइल ॥82॥
cc-adi-17.82.translation: The Lord immediately picked about two hundred fruits, and after washing them He offered them to Kṛṣṇa to eat.

lines: eka janera peṭa bhare khāile eka phala
devanagari: रक्त - पीत - वर्ण, - नाहि अष्ठि - वल्कल ।
एक जनेर पेट भरे खाइले एक फल ॥83॥
cc-adi-17.83.translation: The fruits were all red and yellow, with no seed inside and no skin outside, and eating one fruit would immediately fill a man's belly.

devanagari: देखिया सन्तुष्ट हैला शचीर नन्दन ।
सबाके खाओयाल आगे करिया भक्षण ॥84॥
cc-adi-17.84.translation: Seeing the quality of the mangos, the Lord was greatly satisfied, and thus after eating first, He fed all the other devotees.

lines: eka phala khāile rase udara pūraya
devanagari: अष्ठि - वल्कल नाहि , - अमृत - रसमय ।
एक फल खाइले रसे उदर पूरय ॥85॥
cc-adi-17.85.translation: The fruits had no seeds or skins. They were full of nectarean juice and were so sweet that a man would be fully satisfied by eating only one.

devanagari: एइ - मत प्रतिदिन फले बार मास ।
वैष्णव खायेन फल , - प्रभुर उल्लास ॥86॥
cc-adi-17.86.translation: In this way, fruits grew on the tree every day throughout the twelve months of the year, and the Vaiṣṇavas used to eat them, to the Lord's great satisfaction.

lines: ei saba līlā kare śacīra nandana
anya loka nāhi jāne vinā bhakta-gaṇa
devanagari: एइ सब लीला करे शचीर नन्दन ।
अन्य लोक नाहि जाने विना भक्त - गण ॥87॥
cc-adi-17.87.translation: These are confidential pastimes of the son of Śacī. Other than devotees, no one knows of this incident.

devanagari: एइ मत बार - मास कीर्तन - अवसाने ।
आम्र - महोत्सव प्रभु करे दिने दिने ॥88॥
cc-adi-17.88.translation: In this way the Lord Performed saṅkīrtana every day, and at the end of saṅkīrtana there was a mango-eating festival every day for twelve months.

devanagari: कीर्तन करिते प्रभु आइल मेघ - गण ।
आपन - इच्छाय कैल मेघ निवारण ॥89॥
cc-adi-17.89.translation: Once while Caitanya Mahāprabhu was performing kīrtana, clouds assembled in the sky, and the Lord, by His own will, immediately stopped them from pouring rain.

devanagari: दीक्षा - अनन्तरे हैल, प्रेमेर प्रकाश ।
देशे आगमन पुनः प्रेमेर विलास ॥9॥
cc-adi-17.9.translation: In Gayā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was initiated by Īśvara Purī, and immediately afterwards He exhibited signs of love of Godhead. He again displayed such symptoms after returning home.

devanagari: एक - दिन प्रभु श्रीवासेरे आज्ञा दिल ।
‘बृहत्सहस्र - नाम’ पड़, शुनिते मन हैल ॥90॥
cc-adi-17.90.translation: One day the Lord ordered Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura to read the Bṛhat-sahasra-nāma [the thousand names of Lord Viṣṇu], for He wanted to hear them at that time.

devanagari: पड़िते आइला स्तवे नृसिंहेर नाम ।
शुनिया आविष्ट हैला प्रभु गौरधाम ॥91॥
cc-adi-17.91.translation: As he read the thousand names of the Lord, in due course the holy name of Lord Nṛsiṁha appeared. When Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard the holy name of Lord Nṛsiṁha, He became fully absorbed in thought.

devanagari: नृसिंह - आवेशे प्रभु हाते गदा ल ञा ।
पाषण्डी मारिते याय नगरे धाइया ॥92॥
cc-adi-17.92.translation: In the mood of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva, Lord Caitanya ran through the city streets, club in hand, ready to kill all the atheists.

lines: patha chāḍi' bhāge loka pāñā baḍa bhaya
devanagari: नृसींह - आवेश दे खि’ महा - तेजोमय ।
पथ छा ड़ि’ भागे लोक पाञा बड़ भय ॥93॥
cc-adi-17.93.translation: Seeing Him appearing very fierce in the ecstasy of Lord Nṛsiṁha, people ran from the street and fled here and there, afraid of His anger.

devanagari: लोक - भय दे खि’ प्रभुर बाह्य हइल ।
श्रीवास - गृहेते गिया गदा फेलाइल ॥94॥
cc-adi-17.94.translation: Seeing the people so afraid, the Lord came to His external senses and thus returned to the house of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and threw away the club.

devanagari: श्रीवासे कहेन प्रभु करिया विषाद ।
लोक भय पाय , - मोर हय अपराध ॥95॥
cc-adi-17.95.translation: The Lord became morose and said to Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, "When I adopted the mood of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva, people were greatly afraid. Therefore I stopped, since causing fear among people is an offense."

lines: tāra koṭi aparādha saba haya kṣaya
devanagari: श्रीवास बलेन , - ये तोमार नाम लय ।
तार कोटि अपराध सब हय क्षय ॥96॥
cc-adi-17.96.translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura replied, "Anyone who takes Your holy name vanquishes ten million of his offenses immediately.

lines: ye tomā' dekhila, tāra chuṭila saṁsāra
devanagari: अपराध नाहि, कैले लोकेर निस्तार।
ये तोमा’ देखिल, तार छुटिल संसार ॥97॥
cc-adi-17.97.translation: "There was no offense in Your appearing as Nṛsiṁhadeva. Rather, any man who saw You in that mood was immediately liberated from the bondage of material existence."

devanagari: एत बलि’ श्रीवास करिल सेवन ।
तुष्ट हञा प्रभु आइला आपन - भवन ॥98॥
cc-adi-17.98.translation: After saying this, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura worshiped the Lord, who was then greatly satisfied and returned to His own home.

devanagari: आर दिन शिव - भक्त शिव - गुण गाय ।
प्रभुर अङ्गने नाचे, डमरु बाजाय ॥99॥
cc-adi-17.99.translation: On another day a great devotee of Lord Śiva, chanting of Lord Śiva's qualities, came to Lord Caitanya's house, where he began dancing in the courtyard and playing his ḍamaru [a musical instrument].
